title: After One-Click Video: The Inflow of Service-Type Content, the Failure of the Recommendation Pool Mechanism, and the BoLe System
summary: In September 2026, a new large language model was released. Soon after, a new way of making explainer videos became very popular: people asked the model to write a program, and the program produced the video. "One-click video" content then appeared in large amounts on many platforms. On the surface, this is a rise in creative power at the level of the individual. We argue that, at a deeper level, it changes the structure of the content industry. This judgment rests on two observations. First, this wave of content is service-type content. People watch it to meet a need, not to enjoy the content itself. The other kind is work-type content. AI makes both kinds faster to produce. But anyone can come in and make service-type content, while work-type content is limited by the number of people who have something to say. So the ratio between the two slowly becomes unbalanced. Second, free platforms choose content through layers of trial viewing, and this uses up user attention. The total amount of attention is fixed. The unbalanced ratio also dilutes good content. A simplified mathematical model shows that, as long as these conditions hold, the recommendation pool mechanism will fail once new content grows past a certain multiple. Based on this, we discuss one possible way out. Machines and entry rules judge whether service-type content passes the bar. Trusted people judge work-type content. We call this the BoLe system. At the end, we briefly imagine how the two kinds of content may develop from here.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，2026年9月新大模型催生的“一键视频”浪潮，表面是个人创作力提升，深层则改变了内容产业结构：服务型内容（满足需求）可无限涌入，而作品型内容受创作者数量约束，二者比例失衡；叠加免费平台分层试看机制消耗固定注意力、稀释优质内容。简化数学模型表明，当新增内容超过某倍数时推荐池机制将失效。作者据此提出“伯乐系统”：机器与准入规则把关服务型内容，可信人类把关作品型内容。
AI.motivation: 针对“一键视频”内容在平台大量涌现的现象，作者不满足于“个人创作力提升”的表层解读，希望从产业结构层面解释其后果，并预警推荐系统可能的失效风险。
AI.method: 采用概念性二分框架（服务型内容 vs. 作品型内容）进行定性论证，并结合一个简化数学模型，分析在注意力总量固定、平台靠多层试看筛选内容的条件下，推荐池机制的失效阈值。
AI.result: 论证表明：服务型内容进入门槛低、供给近乎无上限，作品型内容受“有话可说者”数量限制，二者比例将逐渐失衡；失衡叠加对固定注意力的消耗与优质内容稀释，导致新增内容规模超过某倍数后推荐池机制失效。
AI.conclusion: 内容产业的结构性变化需要分层治理：以机器与准入规则筛选服务型内容，以可信人类评价作品型内容，即“伯乐系统”；文末对两类内容的未来演化作了简要展望。

title: chATLAS: A Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Assistant for the ATLAS Experiment
summary: Large scientific collaborations produce extensive internal documentation spread across heterogeneous systems, making it difficult for collaborators to locate and reuse existing knowledge. We present chATLAS, a deployed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant developed for the ATLAS experiment at CERN. The system provides conversational access to more than 30,000 documents from several collaboration resources, material largely unavailable to general-purpose language models, using hybrid dense--sparse retrieval deployed on CERN infrastructure. A domain-specific benchmark built from automatically generated question--answer pairs is used to evaluate retrieval and generation performance and to guide design choices. We study the selection and domain-specific fine-tuning of an embedding model, contextual retrieval, ranking strategies, and generator choice. Fine-tuning combined with contextual retrieval more than doubles how often the correct document is returned as the top result on the most technically challenging documentation source. The deployed system also includes intent routing, safety handling, Mattermost integration, and an MCP server for future agentic workflows. chATLAS demonstrates that domain-adapted RAG can provide source-attributed, domain-specific access to collaboration knowledge, and offers a practical foundation for scientific collaborations and other organisations that rely on accurate, up-to-date retrieval from proprietary documentation.

AI.tldr: 我们提出并部署了 chATLAS——面向 CERN ATLAS 实验的检索增强生成（RAG）助手，为大型科研协作体提供对 3 万余份异构内部文档的对话式、可溯源访问；通过领域自适应嵌入微调与上下文检索，使最难文档源上的正确文档 top-1 召回率提升一倍以上。
AI.motivation: 大型科学协作产生大量分散于异构系统的内部文档，协作者难以定位与复用已有知识；这些专有资料通常不在通用大模型的知识范围内，因此需要具备领域适配与来源可溯能力的检索问答系统。
AI.method: 基于 CERN 基础设施部署混合稠密—稀疏检索的 RAG 系统，覆盖多个协作资源共 3 万余份文档；构建由自动生成问答对组成的领域基准，用以评估检索与生成性能并指导设计决策；系统研究了嵌入模型选型与领域微调、上下文检索（contextual retrieval）、排序策略及生成器选择；工程层面集成意图路由、安全处理、Mattermost 接入，并提供 MCP server 以支持未来 agentic 工作流。
AI.result: 领域微调结合上下文检索使最具技术挑战性的文档源上的正确文档 top-1 返回率提升超过一倍；自动生成 QA 基准可有效用于检索与生成性能评估及设计决策；系统已在生产环境部署并接入协作平台。
AI.conclusion: 领域自适应的 RAG 能够为协作体知识提供带来源标注、领域专属的访问方式，为科学协作组织及其他依赖对专有文档进行准确、时效性检索的机构提供了可落地的实践基础。

title: DuQUAD: A Dual-View Framework with Quality-Aware Evidence Pruning for Multi-Document Question Answering
summary: Large language models with retrieval-augmented generation systematically underutilize evidence in the middle of multi-document contexts, a phenomenon known as Lost in the Middle. Existing mitigation strategies, such as document reordering and attention steering, can reduce boundary bias but remain brittle in noisy settings, where inaccurate relevance estimation and spurious documents still obscure useful evidence in central positions. We propose DuQUAD, a multi-document QA framework that mitigates positional bias through dual-view reasoning and quality-aware evidence pruning. DuQUAD combines a Local Agent guided by a Structural Fusion Score with a Global Agent that reasons over the full document set, providing both targeted evidence recovery and broad contextual understanding. The framework further filters candidate evidence using explicit quality scoring and refines it at the sentence level to reduce noise. DuQUAD consistently outperforms strong Lost-in-the-Middle mitigation baselines, including hybrid retrieval and reranking, multi-agent reasoning, and context optimization methods, improving accuracy by 3.0% on average over the strongest competing baseline and gold evidence recall by 9.4%, while substantially reducing computational cost compared to existing multi-agent frameworks.

AI.tldr: 提出 DuQUAD 框架，通过双视角推理与质量感知证据剪枝缓解多文档 QA 中的 Lost in the Middle 位置偏差，在精度、金标证据召回和计算成本上均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: RAG 大模型在多文档上下文中系统性地低估中间位置证据（Lost in the Middle）。现有缓解手段（文档重排序、注意力引导）虽能降低边界偏差，但在噪声场景下仍脆弱：不准确的相关性估计与虚假文档会继续掩盖位于中间的有用证据。
AI.method: DuQUAD 采用双视角推理：Local Agent 由 Structural Fusion Score 引导进行定向证据恢复，Global Agent 对全量文档集推理以获得整体上下文理解；并引入显式质量评分过滤候选证据，再做句子级精炼以降低噪声。
AI.result: 在多种强基线上（混合检索与重排序、多智能体推理、上下文优化方法）保持一致领先，平均准确率提升 3.0%，金标证据召回提升 9.4%，且相较现有多智能体框架显著降低计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 双视角推理结合质量感知剪枝能有效缓解位置偏差与噪声干扰，兼顾证据定位与全局理解，并在效果与效率间取得更好平衡。

title: Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration for Spectral Compression of Dense Retrieval Embeddings
summary: Spectral compression reduces the storage and scoring costs of dense retrieval by projecting embeddings onto a smaller principal subspace. However, its corpus-derived weighting rules tie all retained directions to a shared spectral trend, without directly accounting for their individual contributions to relevance. To address this, we propose Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration (RRC), a closed-form method for refining spectral weights using relevance judgments. RRC estimates margin-based weights from the means and variances of positive--negative score contributions along each retained direction. It retains directions with positive estimated weights, decomposes their log weights into a fitted power-law trend and a residual, and adds the residual to the compressor's log weights on this support. This allows relevance judgments to adjust individual directions while preserving the compressor's overall spectral trend. RRC applies to PCA, Whitening, and SpecTemp, and incorporates the corrections into the existing transformation shared by documents and queries, without iterative model training or an additional inference stage. Experiments with three encoders on nine datasets covering conventional and reasoning-intensive retrieval show that SpecTemp + RRC achieves the highest mean effectiveness among tested compressors on the BEIR group and BRIGHT at every target dimension. On the five evaluated BRIGHT datasets, it improves over SpecTemp by an average of 2.34 nDCG@10 points at 768 dimensions. The gains also persist under scalar and product quantization, improving the trade-off between per-document storage and retrieval effectiveness. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rrc-spectral-compression-B5CE/

AI.tldr: 提出 Relevance-Guided Residual Calibration（RRC），一种闭式方法，利用相关性判断修正谱压缩各保留方向的权重，在保持压缩器整体谱趋势的前提下提升稠密检索效果。
AI.motivation: 谱压缩通过将嵌入投影到较小主子空间来降低存储与打分成本，但其基于语料库的加权规则把所有保留方向绑定到统一的谱趋势上，未直接考虑各方向对相关性的个体贡献。
AI.method: RRC 沿每个保留方向估计正负样本得分贡献的均值与方差，得到基于间隔（margin-based）的权重；保留估计权重为正的方向，将其对数权重分解为拟合的幂律趋势与残差，把残差叠加到压缩器在该支撑集上的对数权重上；修正直接并入文档与查询共享的现有变换，无需迭代训练或额外推理阶段。方法适用于 PCA、Whitening、SpecTemp。
AI.result: 三种编码器、九个数据集（含常规与推理密集型检索）实验显示：SpecTemp + RRC 在 BEIR 与 BRIGHT 上各目标维度均取得最高平均有效性；BRIGHT 五个数据集上 768 维较 SpecTemp 平均提升 2.34 nDCG@10；在标量量化与乘积量化下增益仍保持，改善每文档存储与检索效果的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 相关性判断可作为轻量、闭式的后校准信号，在保留压缩器谱趋势的同时调整单个方向权重，普适地提升谱压缩稠密检索的效率—效果权衡。

title: ICALL-BENCH: Benchmarking LLM Interprocedural Reasoning in Binary Programs
summary: Recent benchmarks show that LLMs achieve strong performance in both function-level binary understanding and end-to-end binary reverse engineering tasks, but whether LLMs can reason over interprocedural semantics in compiled binaries remains unclear. Function-level benchmarks offer limited visibility into cross-function relationships, while whole-program benchmarks typically evaluate final outcomes of tasks that may be solvable from local clues alone, making it difficult to disentangle interprocedural reasoning from exploration, tool use, execution, and retrieval. To address this limitation, we introduce ICALL-BENCH, a benchmark that directly evaluates whether LLMs and agents can understand and reason over interprocedural semantics in binary programs, using indirect-call target recovery as a measurable probe. ICALL-BENCH covers 50 complete real-world C/C++ programs spanning different complexity levels and multiple optimization configurations, with an average of 74,746 lines of code and 941 functions per program. We further introduce three analysis regimes spanning model-only reasoning, static tool-augmented agents, and Internet-enabled open-world agents to examine how intrinsic reasoning, active information acquisition, and external knowledge each contribute to interprocedural binary analysis. We evaluate five recent LLMs and their corresponding agents. Our results reveal a wide separation across current models and agents, with program-level verifiable success rates ranging from 23% to 81%. They also show that greater information access does not consistently lead to better results, with particularly limited gains on the hardest cases, where deeper interprocedural reasoning remains the primary bottleneck. Uneven performance across models and frequent verifiable failures even under an optimistic evaluation indicate that robust binary interprocedural reasoning remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出ICALL-BENCH基准，以间接调用目标恢复为探针，直接评估LLM与智能体对二进制的跨过程语义推理能力，覆盖50个真实C/C++程序，程序级成功率23%–81%，信息获取增加并不稳定带来收益，跨过程推理仍是核心瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有函数级基准看不到跨函数关系；整程序基准通常只评估可能仅靠局部线索即可完成的任务终态，难以将跨过程推理与探索、工具使用、执行、检索等因素解耦，因此无法判断LLM是否真正具备跨过程语义推理能力。
AI.method: 构建ICALL-BENCH：包含50个完整真实C/C++程序，跨多复杂度与多种优化配置，平均每程序74,746行代码、941个函数；以间接调用目标恢复作为可度量的探针任务；设计三种分析范式——纯模型推理、静态工具增强智能体、联网开放世界智能体，并评测5个近期LLM及其对应智能体。
AI.result: 程序级可验证成功率在23%至81%之间，模型与智能体间差距显著；更多信息获取并不一致地带来更好结果，在最难样例上增益尤其有限；即使采用乐观评估设定仍频繁出现可验证失败，且不同模型表现不均衡。
AI.conclusion: 深层跨过程推理而非信息可及性才是主要瓶颈；稳健的二进制跨过程语义推理仍是开放挑战，ICALL-BENCH为解耦并直接测量该能力提供了可验证的评测手段。

title: A Hybrid Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks Method
summary: Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks (PIHNNs) exploit complex-analytic representations to satisfy homogeneous PDEs by construction, but their extension to nonhomogeneous problems is nontrivial. We propose a hybrid physics-informed holomorphic neural network (HPIHNN) framework based on a decomposition of the solution into particular and homogeneous components. The particular component is computed by a spectral method on a simple extended domain, while the homogeneous component is approximated by a PIHNN trained only on the boundary with modified boundary data. The resulting formulation avoids meshing complex geometries and retains the dimensionality-reduction advantage of holomorphic representations. The method is applied to nonhomogeneous Poisson, Stokes, biharmonic, linear elasticity, and Helmholtz equations. Numerical experiments covering complex geometries, corner singularities, and nearly incompressible regimes demonstrate that the proposed method accurately resolves the corresponding solutions and, in the considered tests, generally achieves lower errors and shorter training times than standard PINNs. The results indicate that coupling spectral particular solutions with holomorphic neural approximations provides an efficient approach to nonhomogeneous PDEs on complex domains.

AI.tldr: 提出混合物理信息全纯神经网络（HPIHNN）框架，将解分解为特解与齐次分量：特解用谱方法在简单扩展域上计算，齐次分量用仅在边界上训练的PIHNN近似，从而在非齐次PDE上保持全纯表示的降维优势并避免复杂网格划分。
AI.motivation: PIHNN通过复解析表示可构造性满足齐次PDE，但推广到非齐次问题并不平凡，需要一种既能处理非齐次源项、又能保留全纯表示降维优势并规避复杂几何网格生成的框架。
AI.method: 解分解为特解与齐次分量：特解在简单扩展域上用谱方法求得；齐次分量由PIHNN以修改后的边界数据、仅在边界上训练近似。该形式化避免复杂几何网格划分并保留全纯表示的降维优势。
AI.result: 在非齐次Poisson、Stokes、双调和、线弹性与Helmholtz方程上验证；涵盖复杂几何、角点奇异性与近不可压情形的数值实验显示方法能准确求解，且在所考察测试中总体误差更低、训练时间短于标准PINN。
AI.conclusion: 将谱特解与全纯神经网络近似耦合，为复杂域上的非齐次PDE提供了一种高效求解途径。

title: LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited GPU memory. We present LRMoE, a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. During forward execution, it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. During backpropagation, a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. A capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. Physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped GEMMs, reducing backward traffic, computation, and execution-buffer demand. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B show that LRMoE reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.

AI.tldr: LRMoE：一种内存感知的MoE训练系统，通过前向规划保留配额与专家放置、反向用负载重校准指标筛选token-expert对，并配合容量感知路由与物理压缩，降低反向通信/计算/缓冲需求。在Qwen3-30B-A3B与GLM4.5-106B-A12B上，达到固定loss目标的累计MoE层训练时间较SYMI降低21.2–44.8%。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE模型虽提供可扩展容量，但路由不均衡导致计算与通信瓶颈。现有放置与复制方法通过增加专家副本重分布负载，却与token相关缓冲区争夺有限GPU显存，形成内存与负载均衡的矛盾。
AI.method: LRMoE联合重校准反向需求与均衡保留负载：前向执行在资源约束下规划保留配额与专家放置，同时保持所有被路由的计算；反向传播中提出负载重校准指标，估计每个token-expert对对该专家更新的贡献，并在配额内选取配对；容量感知路由算法将保留配对分配到原专家的可用实例上；物理压缩形成更小的通信载荷与变长分组GEMM。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM4.5-106B-A12B上的实验表明，相对于SYMI，LRMoE将达到固定loss目标的累计MoE层训练时间缩短21.2–44.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在前向保留全部路由计算、在反向按贡献度选择性保留更新并配合容量感知路由与物理压缩，LRMoE在有限显存下实现了负载均衡与反向开销的协同优化，显著加速MoE训练。

title: Moment-Guided Optimizers for Noisy Deep Learning: MGO-SC as a Simple Consistency Gate for Adam-Style Updates
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Global Emerging Technologies Conference (iGET), Irvine, CA, USA, Oct. 21-25, 2026
summary: Adaptive optimizers are widely used in deep learning, yet their behavior can degrade under heavy stochasticity and label noise where the sign and magnitude of gradients can be unstable. We study MGO-SC (Moment-Guided Optimizer with Sign-Consistency), a lightweight modification of Adam-style methods that derives a coordinate-wise consistency gate from the magnitude of a sign exponential moving average (EMA): coordinates whose gradient sign is stable are trusted, while coordinates whose sign fluctuates are down-weighted. We show that the naive form of this gate, which can only shrink updates, loses effective step size and underperforms when the learning rate is matched to the baseline. We therefore introduce a mean-preserving variant that reallocates trust across coordinates without changing the net per-tensor step magnitude. On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18, under a matched learning rate and decoupled weight decay, mean-preserving MGO-SC consistently improves over its AdamW baseline across clean, symmetric, and asymmetric label noise (e.g., +1.4 points at 40% symmetric noise; paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; Wilcoxon p<0.01), while adding no second-order information or per-sample filtering. We report matched-seed effect sizes, nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired significance tests, and we release code and raw logs.

AI.tldr: 提出 MGO-SC，一种基于符号 EMA 幅值构建逐坐标“符号一致性门”的 Adam 类优化器轻量改进；指出朴素门控会损失有效步长，进而提出均值守恒变体，在 CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 匹配学习率与解耦权重衰减条件下于干净、对称与非对称标签噪声中稳定优于 AdamW。
AI.motivation: 自适应优化器在高随机性与标签噪声下，梯度符号与幅值不稳定，导致优化行为退化；作者希望以低成本方式利用梯度符号稳定性信息来抑制不可靠的坐标更新，同时避免引入二阶信息或逐样本过滤。
AI.method: MGO-SC：对梯度符号维护指数滑动平均（sign EMA），由该 EMA 的幅值导出逐坐标一致性门控——符号稳定坐标获得更高信任，符号波动坐标被降权。发现朴素门控只能收缩更新、造成有效步长损失；因此提出均值守恒（mean-preserving）变体，在坐标间重分配信任而不改变每张量整体步长幅度。基线为 AdamW，采用匹配学习率与解耦权重衰减。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10 + ResNet-18 上，匹配学习率下均值守恒 MGO-SC 在干净、对称与非对称标签噪声下均一致优于 AdamW。例如 40% 对称噪声下提升 +1.4 个百分点；配对 bootstrap 95% 置信区间不含零，Wilcoxon 检验 p<0.01。报告了匹配随机种子的效应量、非参数 bootstrap 置信区间与配对显著性检验，并公开代码与原始日志。
AI.conclusion: 基于符号一致性门控的坐标级信任重分配是提升 Adam 类优化器在噪声环境下鲁棒性的有效轻量手段；关键在于门控须均值守恒，否则单纯收缩会抵消收益。方法无需二阶信息或样本筛选，实验统计严谨且可复现。

title: Beyond Similarity Search: Knowledge Graph Metadata Enrichment for Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: A key challenge of RAG systems is retrieving information from enterprise documents created by multiple teams over time, where it is not possible to enrich the information using the latest information and metadata available outside the scope of organizational documentation responsibility. We investigated whether using a knowledge graph to store metadata and frequently changing information would improve upon knowledge retrieval over similarity search over embeddings. To perform the experiment, we created a snapshot of the SEC EDGAR dataset for a quarter, comprising 167,050 filings from 10,511 companies and 508,714 embedded chunks of risk-factor text. To simulate the enrichment, we created a knowledge graph of 430,257 nodes and 561,144 edges carrying an accession number on every edge. To evaluate the gain obtained via a graph-based design, we evaluated three architectures: text-to-SQL over typed columns, dense-vector RAG with HNSW cosine search, and a two-stage GraphRAG design. All architectures share the same model and temperature to allow comparison. Results are scored programmatically by an LLM as judge over 20 questions divided across four categories, each question asked three times. GraphRAG solved 16 of 20 questions on all three attempts, compared to 10 for text-to-SQL and 3 for vector RAG. GraphRAG lost on structured aggregation queries. Vector RAG lost the single-document category it was expected to win, passing 3 of 15 where GraphRAG passed 15 of 15, because company attribution is not recoverable from cosine similarity at this scale. All six confident falsehoods in the benchmark were text-to-SQL conflating distinct people who share a surname, the failure that resolving identity to an identifier before reading any text prevents structurally; GraphRAG made none. We claim no advantage beyond this corpus, this model and this question set.

AI.tldr: 在企业文档RAG场景中，将元数据与频繁变化的信息存入知识图谱，采用两阶段GraphRAG设计，在20题基准上显著优于text-to-SQL与向量RAG，但在结构化聚合类查询上仍有短板。
AI.motivation: 企业文档由多团队随时间创建，无法用职责范围外的最新信息和元数据来富化，导致基于嵌入相似度的检索效果受限。作者希望验证用知识图谱存储元数据与高频变更信息能否改善检索。
AI.method: 构建SEC EDGAR单季度快照（167,050份文件、10,511家公司、508,714个风险因素文本嵌入块），并建立含430,257节点、561,144条边、每条边携带accession number的知识图谱。对比三种架构：类型化列上的text-to-SQL、基于HNSW余弦搜索的稠密向量RAG、两阶段GraphRAG，统一模型与temperature。以LLM as judge对4类共20题、每题3次进行程序化评分。
AI.result: GraphRAG在三次尝试中全部解出16/20题，text-to-SQL为10题，向量RAG仅3题。GraphRAG在结构化聚合查询上失分；向量RAG在本应占优的单文档类别上仅通过3/15，而GraphRAG为15/15，原因是该规模下公司归属无法从余弦相似度中恢复。基准中全部6例高置信度错误均来自text-to-SQL，将同姓氏的不同人物混淆；GraphRAG无此类错误。
AI.conclusion: 在图谱中先将身份解析到标识符、再读取文本，可从结构上避免实体混淆类错误；GraphRAG在本语料、本模型、本问题集上具备优势，但不主张超出该范围的泛化结论。

title: Cognitive Debt in the GenAI Era - Listening to Practitioners' Voices on the Loss of Understanding
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Manuscript under review at ICSE-SEIP
summary: Fast-paced AI-assisted software development risks reducing developers' understanding of the systems they build. This growing gap between what the system does and what developers understand about it, described as ``cognitive debt'', is not new, but AI has exacerbated it. This has led to a recent surge in blog posts and online discussions, in which practitioners recognize and write about cognitive debt, and share their experiences well before academic studies can capture them. To understand their concerns and inform future research and practice, we conduct a grey literature review of 76 sources, focusing on how cognitive debt is conceptualized and manifests, its contributing factors, its consequences, and the practices to prevent, detect, and mitigate it. We find that cognitive debt can accumulate unnoticed behind working code and passing tests, particularly when developers accept AI-generated solutions without building understanding. Practitioners report consequences such as harder maintenance and debugging, fragmented knowledge in the team, and reduced productivity. They propose practices such as documenting design rationale, review-sized changes, comprehension gates, and knowledge-sharing rituals, along with signals like reliability metrics to detect it. Our findings give software teams a structured view of emerging practical approaches in AI-assisted development and stress the need to preserve human understanding alongside faster code production.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对76篇灰色文献的综述，系统梳理了AI辅助开发中"认知债务"（cognitive debt）的概念、表现、成因、后果及应对实践。
AI.motivation: AI辅助软件开发加速了代码产出，但可能削弱开发者对所构建系统的理解，形成"认知债务"。该问题虽非新生，却被AI显著放大；实践者已在博客与网络讨论中先行记录相关经验，而学术研究尚未及时捕捉，因此有必要整合这些灰色文献以指导后续研究与实践。
AI.method: 对76篇灰色文献进行系统性综述（grey literature review），围绕四个维度展开分析：认知债务的概念化与表现形式、其促成因素、其后果，以及预防、检测与缓解的实践。
AI.result: 认知债务可能在"代码可运行、测试通过"的表象下悄然累积，尤其当开发者直接接受AI生成的方案而不建立理解时。实践者报告的后果包括：维护与调试更困难、团队知识碎片化、生产力下降。提出的实践包括记录设计理由、控制评审规模的变更、设置理解关卡（comprehension gates）、建立知识共享仪式，并以可靠性指标等信号来检测认知债务。
AI.conclusion: 研究为软件团队提供了AI辅助开发中新兴实践的结构化视图，强调在加速代码生产的同时必须维护人的理解能力，以免认知债务被掩盖。

title: Exponential-Nemytskii Neural Operators: Learning Field Evolution Across Step Sizes
summary: In variable-step operator learning, agreement at observed step sizes does not by itself determine predictions at other temporal resolutions. We propose an operator whose step-size dependence is prescribed by a first-order Duhamel approximation of semilinear dynamics. It combines exact linear propagation with a local nonlinear function of the field and its derivatives, allowing evaluation below the observation interval without supervision densely sampled across step sizes. Under suitable conditions and at fixed spatial resolution, we prove that agreement between models at two step sizes controls their prediction differences throughout a prescribed range. We also give conditions for local identifiability of both components from two step sizes, supporting interpretation of the learned structure. A latent extension applies the same construction to learned fields. We evaluate the base model on two synthetic problems and the extension on two real datasets against several baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出步长依赖由半线性动力学的Duhamel一阶近似所规定的算子，将精确线性传播与场及其导数的局部非线性函数结合，可在小于观测间隔的步长上评估而无需多步长稠密监督；理论上证明两个步长上的一致性可控制指定范围内预测差异，并给出双步长下两分量的局部可辨识条件。
AI.motivation: 变步长算子学习中，模型仅在观测步长上一致，并不能决定其在其他时间分辨率下的预测，缺乏跨步长外推的保证。
AI.method: 以半线性动力学的一阶Duhamel近似显式规定步长依赖：精确线性传播 + 关于场及其导数的局部非线性项；并给出潜空间扩展以适配学习到的场。
AI.result: 在固定空间分辨率与适当条件下，证明两步长上模型一致即可控制规定范围内整体预测差异；给出两分量自两个步长可局部辨识的条件；在两个合成问题与两个真实数据集上同多种基线比较评估。
AI.conclusion: 将步长依赖结构化为算子设计先验，可提升变步长预测的可控性与可解释性，并支持低于观测间隔的推断。

title: Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration with Application to an Ocean Turbulence Closure
summary: Model discrepancy may prevent a single calibration parameter from reproducing a physical response across the context domain. In addition, uncertainties in observations and contexts affect calibration and must be accounted for and quantified. We construct a family of localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods according to their proximity to a target context. Gaussian localization weights incorporate context uncertainty through covariance inflation, with reflection at domain boundaries and an optional correction for uneven context sampling. A conditional normalizing flow approximates the family of posteriors through amortized variational inference. Integrating the localized posteriors under a prescribed context measure gives the marginalized parameter distribution. In a twin experiment with the Branin-Hoo model, we compare global and localized inference under uniform and skewed context distributions. Localization reduces the reported aggregate predictive errors relative to the global posterior. An application to the k-$ε$ turbulence closure in a single-column ocean model, with atmospheric surface forcing as context, shows that localized posterior calibration reduces temperature and zonal-velocity errors relative to deterministic and global-posterior calibration. Both twin experiments are constructed to admit local compensation.

AI.tldr: 论文针对模型偏差导致单一校准参数无法在全上下文域内再现物理响应的问题，提出基于高斯核加权的局部化后验族，用条件归一化流做摊销变分推断，并按上下文测度积分得到边缘参数分布，在Branin-Hoo孪生实验与k-ε湍流闭合单柱海洋模型中验证了局部化校准优于全局校准。
AI.motivation: 模型偏差（model discrepancy）使得单一校准参数难以在整个上下文域内同时复现物理响应；同时观测与上下文均存在不确定性，需被纳入并量化。因此需要发展随上下文变化的参数校准方法。
AI.method: 按观测与目标上下文的邻近度对观测似然加权，构造局部化后验族；采用高斯局部化权重，通过协方差膨胀纳入上下文不确定性，在域边界处做反射处理，并可选择性地校正上下文采样不均。用条件归一化流通过摊销变分推断近似该后验族，再按预设的上下文测度对局部化后验积分，得到边缘化参数分布。
AI.result: 在Branin-Hoo模型孪生实验中，于均匀与偏斜上下文分布下对比全局与局部化推断，局部化降低了聚合预测误差；在单柱海洋模型的k-ε湍流闭合应用中（以大气表面强迫为上下文），局部化后验校准相比确定性与全局后验校准降低了温度与纬向速度误差。两个孪生实验均被设计为允许局部补偿。
AI.conclusion: 局部化后验校准能在存在模型偏差与上下文、观测不确定性时改善预测精度，优于全局后验与确定性校准；该方法可推广至地球物理等具有显著上下文依赖的模型校准问题。

title: What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages
summary: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, Tülu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining windows sit at the random level on prose, SFT five times above it, RL-Zero and RLVR at 400-1,500, and DPO at 400-23,000. With this instrument we find that pretraining accumulates into noise: windows of 30k to 1M steps are no more consequential on prose than random directions of their size, as a noisy quadratic model of SGD predicts. We find that training precision changes what an update looks like: training bf16 parameters without an fp32 master copy freezes 36-99% of coordinates, lowers leverage up to sevenfold, and creates an alignment between update magnitudes and the diagonal Fisher that fp32 training does not show. We derive and verify a law for reuse: the sign-flip null predicts the relative damage of random drop-and-rescale (DARE) at keep rate $p$ as $(1-p)/(p\,ρ_{\mathrm{sign}})$, within a factor of two of measurement wherever DARE succeeds. Two controls make these readings reliable: every controlled SFT and DPO trajectory with fp32 master weights loses leverage as it moves, and two re-runs of a released DPO stage from its anchor with its published recipe land within 1% of the released displacement and 4% of its leverage, where a plain recipe reads five to six times lower; leaving one component out traces the level to the length-normalized loss and its batch size of 128 together.

AI.tldr: 论文提出「leverage」这一精确度量：以Fisher二次型衡量单位权重变化换来多少行为改变，逐方向用一次前向模式自动求导计算，并用同规模随机方向作归一化基准。结果显示预训练窗口在散文中等于随机水平，SFT约5倍，RL-Zero/RLVR为400–1500倍，DPO为400–23000倍，跨四个数量级。
AI.motivation: 后训练使权重相对移动约千分之一却能剧烈改变模型行为，预训练移动约三分之一却只带来缓慢漂移，这一"移动量-效果"的不对称缺乏可解释的定量刻画。作者希望引入一个可精确计算、可跨检查点与训练阶段比较的"单位权重变化的价值"度量，用以区分预训练与各类后训练更新的功效差异，并检验训练精度与数据复用带来的效应。
AI.method: 定义leverage为更新方向的Fisher二次型，除以同一检查点上同尺寸随机方向的同一二次型；每个方向以一次前向模式（forward-mode）pass即可精确求得，无需反向传播近似。在Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2的已发布检查点上按训练阶段排序比较。以噪声二次模型刻画SGD下的预训练漂移；对比bf16无fp32主权重（master weights）训练与fp32训练的坐标冻结率、leverage与更新幅度-对角Fisher对齐性；推导基于符号翻转零假设的DARE复用损伤定律(1-p)/(p·ρ_sign)；并用fp32主权重下的受控SFT/DPO轨迹与两次复现已发布DPO阶段作为对照验证。
AI.result: leverage跨四个数量级排序：预训练窗口在散文上处于随机水平，SFT约5倍，RL-Zero与RLVR为400–1500倍，DPO为400–23000倍。预训练30k–1M步窗口在散文上并不比同尺寸随机方向更具影响，与噪声二次SGD模型预测一致。bf16无fp32主权重训练冻结36–99%坐标，leverage最多降低7倍，并产生fp32训练不具备的更新幅度与对角Fisher对齐。符号翻转零假设给出的DARE相对损伤公式(1-p)/(p·ρ_sign)在DARE有效处与实测相差不到2倍。所有fp32主权重受控SFT/DPO轨迹随训练推进leverage下降；用已发布配方重启DPO阶段可复现位移在1%内、leverage在4%内，而朴素配方读数低5–6倍；逐项消融将水平定位到长度归一化损失与其128的批大小共同作用。
AI.conclusion: leverage提供了一个精确、廉价（每方向一次前向模式pass）且可复现的度量，量化了不同训练阶段"权重变化的价值"并解释预训练/后训练不对称。结论包括：预训练在散文上积累近似噪声、bf16无主权重训练扭曲更新几何、DARE复用损伤可由符号翻转零假设预测，且该度量对配方高度敏感、可复现，能作为诊断与对齐训练配方的工具。

title: Statistical Detection of Positional Bias in LLM-Based Recommender Systems: Methodologies and Empirical Evidence
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as recommendation generators in conversational recommender systems (RS) via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). This flexible design introduces new sources of structural bias. This paper studies positional bias in top-1 and single-turn LLM-based RS: systematic dependence of the recommended item on the order in which candidates are presented in the prompt. We propose two complementary detection methodologies: (i) POB-ICM, based on contingency matrix analysis and Chi-square independence testing, and (ii) POB-UNBP, a sample-efficient approach derived from a uniformity null model under permutation-based evaluation, enabling stochastic decoding with formal statistical guarantees. Using a controlled RAG testbed for product recommendation, built on a real product catalog, a fixed prompt template and 2000 template-generated user queries with 20 permutations each (40,000 instances), both methodologies reject the null hypothesis of positional independence and uniformity in all evaluated state-of-the-art models. We introduce three complementary metrics -- permutation sensitivity, positional bias, and strong positional bias -- to quantify this effect, the latter targeting cases where the position displaces the recommendation towards clearly less relevant items rather than only choosing among comparably relevant ones. A robustness analysis across candidate-set size and decoding temperature shows that the bias is structural and model-dependent, not an artifact of deterministic decoding or candidate-set size. These results establish positional bias as a measurable, reproducible property of prompt-mediated recommendation pipelines in the evaluated setting and motivate routine auditing and governance controls (e.g., order randomization, standardized prompting) for deployed LLM-based RS. Source code is publicly released.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于RAG的LLM推荐系统中由候选排序引起的结构性位置偏差，提出两种检测方法与三项度量指标，并在受控测试平台上验证该偏差在多个SOTA模型中普遍存在且具有结构性。
AI.motivation: LLM通过RAG被广泛用作对话式推荐系统的推荐生成器，这种灵活设计引入了新的结构性偏差来源；现有研究缺乏对"候选在提示中呈现顺序"如何系统性影响推荐结果的可量化、可复现的检测手段。
AI.method: 聚焦top-1、单轮LLM推荐中的位置偏差；提出两种互补检测方法：(i) POB-ICM，基于列联表分析与卡方独立性检验；(ii) POB-UNBP，基于置换评估下的均匀性零模型推导的样本高效方法，支持随机解码并具形式化统计保证。构建基于真实商品目录的受控RAG测试平台，使用固定提示模板与2000条模板生成查询、每条20种排列（共40,000个实例）；提出排列敏感度、位置偏差、强位置偏差三项指标，并在候选集规模与解码温度上做稳健性分析。
AI.result: 两种方法在所有被评估的SOTA模型上均拒绝位置独立性与均匀性零假设；偏差随模型而异且为结构性，并非确定性解码或候选集规模的产物；强位置偏差指标可识别出位置将推荐推向明显更不相关项的案例。
AI.conclusion: 位置偏差是被评估设定下提示中介推荐流程的可测量、可复现属性，应纳入常规审计与治理控制（如顺序随机化、标准化提示）；代码已公开。

title: Reusable LLM-Based Plans with Probabilistic Guarantees for Self-Adaptive Systems
summary: Self-adaptive systems are designed to accommodate variants of their environment, which form a family of instances whose uncertainty is captured by probabilistic models, and must meet probabilistic requirements on each instance. Within such a family, changes in size and structure complicate the fundamental adaptation decision: whether to retain, reuse, or construct a new controller, since controllers are often synthesized for and specific to an instance. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been used to write reusable controllers, but existing approaches largely target deterministic domains, and probabilistic model checking of their output remains limited to preliminary single-instance studies. In this paper, we propose a verifier-guided framework for controller reuse with explicit support for families of environments. The framework introduces a novel combination of LLM-written controllers with probabilistic model checking to provide per-instance guarantees for probabilistic requirements. We evaluate our approach using three LLMs on three benchmarks, assessing its effectiveness and cost with respect to baseline implementations, the distribution of adaptation decisions, and the impact of individual framework components. On grid worlds, LLM-written rule lists are verified on about 90% of held-out instances, against at most 77% for the baselines, and verifying a stored rule list is 15 to 103 times faster than per-instance synthesis. Reuse serves most episodes at a small fraction of the cost of generation or per-instance synthesis, and model-checking feedback increases verified coverage over independent restarts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种验证器引导的框架，将LLM编写的控制器与概率模型检查结合，为环境族中每个实例的概率需求提供保证，并支持控制器复用决策。
AI.motivation: 自适应系统需应对环境变体构成的环境族，其不确定性由概率模型刻画，且每个实例都须满足概率需求。环境族在规模与结构上的变化使"保留、复用还是新建控制器"的决策变得困难，因为控制器通常针对特定实例合成。现有LLM生成可复用控制器的方法主要面向确定性领域，对其输出的概率模型检查仅限于初步的单实例研究。
AI.method: 提出验证器引导的控制器复用框架，显式支持环境族：将LLM编写的控制器与概率模型检查新颖结合，为每个实例提供概率需求的保证；并基于验证结果做出复用/重建等自适应决策。
AI.result: 在三个基准、三个LLM上评估。网格世界中，LLM编写的规则列表在约90%的留出实例上通过验证，基线至多77%；验证已存储规则列表比逐实例合成快15至103倍；复用以远低于生成或逐实例合成的成本服务大多数回合；模型检查反馈相比独立重启提升了验证覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 验证器引导的LLM控制器复用能有效支持环境族下的概率需求保证，兼顾覆盖率与成本，模型检查反馈对提升验证覆盖率有实质贡献。

title: Data-driven Random-feature Approximation of Koopman Generators of Nonlinear Continuous-time Systems
summary: Learning continuous-time dynamical systems from data is an active area of research. The Koopman formalism is often used here, because it is a flexible approach that is informative about the system's fundamental properties. The formalism represents dynamical systems through linear operators acting on a suitable function space. A practical difficulty arising in the numerical approximation of Koopman operators is the choice of a ``dictionary'', meaning an effective finite-dimensional representation of the function space. In this paper, we focus on learning dynamical systems in continuous-time, and so we consider numerical approximations of the Koopman generator instead of the Koopman operator. Our main contribution is a data-driven random-feature method to obtain a parsimonious and effective function representation for Galerkin approximation methods such as gEDMD. The representation we construct is data-informed, which allows us to improve upon data-agnostic methods. We empirically demonstrate the suitability of our method for forecasting tasks and system analysis. The numerical experiments show that our approach is accurate, and faster than iterative optimization. Further, we prove convergence of our approximation of the vector field and the resulting trajectories. In addition to the numerical results, we also make theoretical contributions, including a general convergence criterion for the semigroup generated by the gEDMD approximation and a counterexample showing that gEDMD does not generally preserve exponential boundedness. With our contribution, we advance the frontier of efficiently learning continuous-time dynamics from data, towards interpretable and mathematically robust modelling based on the Koopman framework.

AI.tldr: 该文提出数据驱动的随机特征方法，为gEDMD等Galerkin型Koopman生成元近似构造简约而有效的函数字典，并给出向量场与轨迹的收敛性证明。
AI.motivation: 连续时间动力系统的Koopman生成元数值近似中，函数空间有限维表示（字典）的选择是关键且困难的实践问题；数据无关的字典往往不够有效。
AI.method: 针对Koopman生成元的Galerkin近似（如gEDMD），构建数据驱动的随机特征字典，得到紧凑、数据自适应的函数表示；与迭代优化方法相比避免昂贵优化。
AI.result: 数值实验表明该方法在预测与系统分析任务上准确且快于迭代优化；理论上证明了向量场近似及所得轨迹的收敛性，给出gEDMD近似所生成半群的通用收敛判据，并构造反例表明gEDMD一般不保持指数有界性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法推进了基于Koopman框架的高效连续时间动力学学习，朝向可解释、数学上稳健的建模。

title: ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions
summary: Many uses of language models end in a typed decision: a choice among a closed set of options, whose probabilities code can act on. Reading those probabilities from one forward pass is fast but often wrong on decisions that take several steps, such as arithmetic, counting, and date comparison. Letting the model think first fixes most of these errors, but costs seconds per decision instead of milliseconds. To pay for thinking only where it helps, ThinkJev builds a fast and a slow system from one open hybrid-thinking model that can answer directly or after a thought. System 1 reads the model's probabilities for the option letters when it answers directly; System 2 reads the same letters after the model has thought on the same cached prompt, so escalating repeats no work and both systems give probabilities over the same options. Because the letters can be read after any number of thought tokens, one sampled thought also gives the answer under every thinking budget. Without training, ThinkJev lets System 1 answer alone only where a statistical test on labeled dev data guarantees that its accepted answers stay under a target error rate. At a 5% target, Qwen3.5-27B answers 24.5% of 8359 test decisions this way with a realized error of 3.9% (Qwen3.5-4B and 9B: 6.5% and 0.0%). For the rest, stopping each thought as soon as its answer is confident reaches 81.6% accuracy, against 82.7% for always thinking, with 72% of the thought tokens. Choosing when to think from System 1's confidence alone saves less, because the decisions System 1 is least sure of are often not the ones thinking fixes. On the public items of JevBench, an independent benchmark of typed-decision services, Qwen3.5-27B thinks on 29.4% and is not distinguishable in accuracy from the two thinking APIs listed (exploratory). Code and data generators are available at https://github.com/ding-xiaolu/ThinkJev.

AI.tldr: ThinkJev 用一个开源混合推理模型同时构建快速（直接作答）与慢速（先思考）两套系统，在开发集上以统计检验保证被接受的直接答案错误率不超过目标值，其余样本按置信度提前停止思考，从而在几乎不损失准确率的前提下大幅节省思考 token。
AI.motivation: 语言模型大量使用最终归结为封闭选项集的"类型化决策"（如算术、计数、日期比较）。单次前向传播读取选项字母概率虽快（毫秒级）但在多步推理上常出错；先思考可修正大部分错误但每次决策耗时数秒。因此希望只在"思考确实有效"的决策上付出思考成本。
AI.method: 1) 基于同一支持混合思考的开源模型构建两级系统：System 1 在直接作答时读取选项字母概率；System 2 在同一缓存提示上思考后读取相同字母的概率，升级不重复计算，且二者输出同一选项集上的概率分布。2) 由于任意思考 token 数后均可读取字母概率，一次采样思考即可得到所有思考预算下的答案。3) 无需训练：在带标签的开发集上做统计检验，仅在能保证被接受的直接答案错误率低于目标值时允许 System 1 独立作答。4) 对其余样本，在思考过程中一旦答案置信即停止。
AI.result: 在 5% 目标错误率下，Qwen3.5-27B 以 System 1 独立答对 8359 个测试决策中的 24.5%，实测错误率 3.9%（4B 与 9B 分别为 6.5% 与 0.0%）。对其余样本，置信即停达到 81.6% 准确率，对比"总是思考"的 82.7%，仅用 72% 的思考 token。仅凭 System 1 置信度决定是否思考的收益更小，因为 System 1 最不确定的决策往往并非思考能修正的决策。在 JevBench 公开条目上，Qwen3.5-27B 仅对 29.4% 的决策进行思考，准确率与所列两个思考型 API 无显著差异（探索性）。
AI.conclusion: 按统计保证进行路由并用思考过程置信度提前停止，可在几乎不牺牲准确率的情况下显著降低思考成本；System 1 的不确定性并非有效的"该不该思考"信号。代码与数据生成器已开源。

title: Threshold Compatibility and Support-Selection Diagnostics in Neural Discovery of Partial Differential Equations
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Accurate regression need not yield the correct equation after support selection. For a median/sample-standard-deviation threshold in neural PDE discovery, we derive an exact two-signal retention boundary and a complete-vector perturbation bound. Exact advection-diffusion libraries lose diffusion despite coefficient recovery to numerical precision. True-support refits of forty saved sparse states reduce diffusion error without restoring all derivative accuracy. A fixed sequential threshold ridge comparator recovers exact support in sixty ideal controls but selects extra terms in every learned state. All-fold correct-support candidates are rejected by conditional validation; post hoc energy pooling preserves their higher minimum loss in all sixty states. Supplied-support estimates outperform unchanged selected equations in all 240 physical-residual comparisons on four unused analytic trajectories. With coefficients, observation points and weights fixed, exact replacement of the learned library and target reverses their learned-row ordering in 59/60 states. Weighting both losses also fails the specified Burgers diffusion-benefit criterion at every tested budget. These finite diagnostics distinguish threshold incompatibility, refit damage and score rejection; they establish neither automatic correction nor general recovery or predictive stability.

AI.tldr: 该文针对神经偏微分方程（PDE）发现中的稀疏支持选择问题，通过有限诊断实验表明：准确回归≠正确方程。作者推导了中位数/样本标准差阈值下的两信号保留边界与全向量扰动界，并用实验刻画阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤与评分拒绝三类失效机制。
AI.motivation: 动机：PDE 发现流程中普遍假设"系数回归准确即支持集正确"。作者质疑该假设，关注支持选择阶段（阈值/稀疏化）是否会系统性破坏方程结构，缺乏对失效原因与粒度的明确诊断。
AI.method: 方法：1) 理论：针对基于中位数/样本标准差阈值的阈值规则，推导精确的两信号保留边界与完整向量扰动界；2) 实验：在精确平流-扩散库中检验扩散项丢失现象；对40个已保存稀疏状态做真实支持重拟合；构建固定序贯阈值岭回归对照器（60个理想控制 vs. 学习状态）；采用条件验证与事后能量池化对比候选；在4条未使用解析轨迹上进行240次物理残差比较；固定系数、观测点与权重后交换学习库与目标，检验行排序反转（59/60）；对双损失加权检验 Burgers 扩散收益准则。
AI.result: 结果：精确平流-扩散库即使系数恢复到数值精度仍丢失扩散项；真实支持重拟合降低扩散误差但未恢复全部导数精度；固定阈值岭回归对照器在60个理想控制中恢复精确支持，但在所有学习状态中多选项；全折正确支持候选被条件验证拒绝，事后能量池化在60个状态中均保留其更小的最小损失；在240次物理残差比较中供给支持估计全面优于未修改的选中方程；交换库与目标后59/60状态出现学习行序反转；双损失加权在所有测试预算下均未满足指定的 Burgers 扩散收益准则。
AI.conclusion: 结论：这些有限诊断区分了阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤与评分拒绝三类失效来源，但不构成自动校正方案，也未证明一般性恢复或预测稳定性。

title: Merge and Branch: Efficient Tree-Structured Supervised Fine-Tuning of LLMs for Recommendation
summary: LLM-based generative recommendation reads long, text-rich interaction histories but generates only short semantic identifiers (SIDs). This asymmetry makes supervised fine-tuning inefficient: encoding the history is expensive, yet each history usually provides supervision for only one target. We present Merge and Branch (M&B) to reduce input cost and learn more from each encoded history. Merge compresses each historical item's SID and text into a small number of learned tokens. Branch uses the compressed history to predict multiple target SIDs. To share history computation while keeping these targets independent, M&B organizes each example as a shallow, wide tree. We develop tree FlashAttention to execute this layout efficiently, processing the shared history once and propagating gradients from every branch for end-to-end training. A tree-structured key/value cache extends history sharing to constrained decoding. Experiments on public benchmarks show that M&B outperforms strong recommendation baselines while substantially improving training and decoding efficiency.

AI.tldr: M&B通过将历史压缩为少量token并用树状结构从同一历史预测多个目标SID，配合tree FlashAttention与树形KV缓存，实现更高效且更准确的生成式推荐。
AI.motivation: LLM生成式推荐需编码长而文本丰富的历史，却只生成短语义ID（SID），这种输入输出不对称导致监督微调低效：历史编码代价高，但每条历史通常只提供一个目标的监督信号。
AI.method: 提出Merge and Branch（M&B）：Merge将每个历史item的SID与文本压缩为少量可学习token；Branch用压缩历史预测多个目标SID。为共享历史计算同时保持各目标独立，将样本组织为浅而宽的树结构，并设计tree FlashAttention高效执行该布局（历史只算一次、梯度从所有分支回传，端到端训练）；树结构key/value缓存将历史共享扩展到约束解码。
AI.result: 在公开基准上，M&B优于强推荐基线，同时显著提升训练与解码效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过历史压缩与多分支树状监督，M&B缓解了生成式推荐中历史编码昂贵、单目标监督不足的问题，在效果与效率上同时获益。

title: Understanding Post-Quantum Cryptography Adoption: Practices, Challenges, and Evolution in Open-Source Software
summary: Post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards establish algorithms for quantum-safe systems, but empirical evidence about how software projects implement and maintain PQC support remains limited. We investigate this implementation and maintenance work by mining 114,361 commits and 5,713 issues across 179 open-source repositories. We use human annotation and validated LLM classification to identify PQC algorithms in commits, classify their adoption status and deployment mode, and identify technical challenges in issue discussions. The commit classification for PQC algorithms reveals that 90% of commits concern maintenance of existing support. From the issue discussions, we construct an 11-category taxonomy of recurring technical challenges. Build, packaging, and dependency failures, along with functional defects, account for approximately half of categorized issues. To examine how PQC support evolves, we use time-series analysis and first implementations of individual algorithms within repositories around NIST standardization milestones. After the 2024 finalization, standardized algorithm names appeared in more than 80% of the PQC development changes analyzed, although earlier names such as Kyber continued to appear. Development activity increased over the observation period. Our milestone analysis, however, did not find a significant increase in first implementations. Migration plans should therefore account for sustained maintenance, prioritize build reliability and integration testing, and track both standardized and predecessor algorithm names. We make the dataset, taxonomy, annotations, and analysis pipeline publicly available.

AI.tldr: 通过对179个开源仓库的114,361次提交和5,713个issue进行挖掘与LLM辅助分类，揭示了PQC支持以维护为主、构建与依赖问题突出、标准化命名迁移滞后但首次实现未显著增长的实证图景。
AI.motivation: PQC标准已确立，但软件项目如何实际实现与维护PQC支持的实证证据有限，迁移规划缺乏数据支撑。
AI.method: 挖掘179个开源仓库的114,361条提交与5,713个issue；结合人工标注与经验证的LLM分类识别提交中的PQC算法、判定采纳状态与部署模式；对issue构建技术挑战分类法；采用时间序列分析与NIST标准化节点前后的首次实现分析。
AI.result: 90%的PQC提交属于既有支持的维护；构建、打包与依赖失败及功能缺陷约占已归类issue的一半；共构建11类技术挑战分类法；2024年标准定稿后，标准化算法名称出现在80%以上的PQC开发变更中，但Kyber等旧名称仍沿用；开发活动整体上升，而首次实现未出现显著增长。
AI.conclusion: 迁移规划应预留持续维护成本、优先保障构建可靠性与集成测试，并同时追踪标准化名称与前身算法名称；数据集、分类法、标注与分析流水线已公开。

title: OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. The corpus records problem statements, context, progress, and other information for 12,151 problems. The benchmark contains 200 problems, 110 resolved in 2026 and 90 still open, each with a Lean~4 statement checked by automated probes and two independent reviews; a subset HQ-50 further filters based on quality score, etc. Our evaluation protocol grades formal proofs with two independent checkers in an isolated sandbox under closed-book, frozen-retrieval, and live-web conditions. Evaluating seven LLM agents on the HQ-50 subset under a standardized budget, we find that closed-book rediscovery is rare, at most 7 of 40 resolved problems, whereas live-web success mostly reflects retrieval of published solutions. By linking a broad research-problem corpus to a formally graded evaluation subset with documented solutions, OpenFrontiers provides a foundation for measuring research-level rediscovery and studying progress toward solving currently open scientific problems. The dataset and benchmark could be found in https://huggingface.co/collections/FlippyDora/openfrontiers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OpenFrontiers，一个包含 12,151 条开放研究问题语料库及 200 道数学问题回溯基准的跨学科资源；基准中 110 题为 2026 年已解决、90 题仍开放，均配经自动探测与双人独立审阅的 Lean 4 形式化陈述，并从中筛出 HQ-50 子集；在封闭书本、冻结检索和实时联网三种条件下用双独立检查器评测七个 LLM 智能体，发现封闭书本下的"重新发现"极少（40 道已解题中至多 7 道），而联网成功多源于检索已发表解法。
AI.motivation: 研究级问题求解是 LLM 能力的重要前沿，但缺乏系统收集的研究级问题集合，且在此类问题上评测仍具挑战性：既需要高质量的开放问题语料，也需要可形式化验证、有已知答案的回溯性基准，以区分真正的"重新发现"与对已发表解法的检索。
AI.method: 构建 OpenFrontiers 跨学科资源，由两部分组成：(1) 结构化开放研究问题语料库，记录 12,151 个问题的陈述、背景、进展等信息；(2) 数学领域回溯基准，含 200 题（110 题于 2026 年解决、90 题仍开放），每题配 Lean 4 形式化陈述，经自动探测及两次独立评审校验，并依据质量分等指标筛出 HQ-50 子集。评测协议在隔离沙箱中用两个独立检查器对形式化证明打分，设置封闭书本、冻结检索、实时联网三种条件；在标准化预算下评测七个 LLM 智能体。
AI.result: 在 HQ-50 子集上，封闭书本条件下真正的重新发现极为罕见——40 道已解题中至多 7 道被解出；实时联网条件下的成功则主要反映对已发表解法的检索，而非独立推理。
AI.conclusion: OpenFrontiers 将广泛的研究问题语料库与形式化评分、带有记录解法的评测子集相连接，为衡量研究级"重新发现"、并研究面向当前开放科学问题的进展提供了基础。数据集与基准见 https://huggingface.co/collections/FlippyDora/openfrontiers 。

title: Predicate Neuron: Differentiable Quantization of Predicate Relations in Gradient-based Learning
summary: In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. Results show that incorporating Predicate Neurons accelerates convergence, boosts accuracy, and lowers loss in general, with particularly strong improvements in tasks requiring monotonic reasoning or handling discontinuities. Overall, the Predicate Neuron natively integrates into standard neural networks to enable fuzzy logic operations and is available in Keras and PyTorch.

AI.tldr: 提出"原生谓词神经元"（Native Predicate Neuron），一种基于一阶逻辑量化的可微逻辑推理模块，让标准神经网络原生具备符号推理能力，并可在 Keras 与 PyTorch 中使用。
AI.motivation: 现有符号推理方法多依赖静态架构，难以嵌入深度神经网络与梯度优化框架，符号推理与可微学习之间存在割裂。
AI.method: 设计可微逻辑神经元，用单一可训练参数学习在运算间切换以建模关系逻辑；采用"双性质"梯度机制——训练时执行硬逻辑运算，同时保持可反传的可微性；对输入与选择状态进行量化，从而逼近连续与非连续函数、化解标准深度网络难以处理的间断问题。
AI.result: 在全连接、卷积、循环与 Transformer 架构上，于 MNIST、Wikitext 等基准测试：加入谓词神经元后整体加速收敛、提升准确率、降低损失；在需要单调推理或处理间断性的任务上提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 谓词神经元可原生集成进标准神经网络以实现模糊逻辑运算，并已开源提供 Keras 与 PyTorch 实现。

title: Predicting What Answer Engines Cite: Open Decision Models, Rerankers and a Distilled 4B Student on Ten Engines under Controlled Retrieval
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Model: https://huggingface.co/citead/geo-citation-ranker-4b ; benchmark and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/citead/geo-citation-benchmark
summary: Generative engine optimization needs a scorer that ranks candidate pages by the share of an answer they will receive as citations. We measure pretrained rerankers, a hosted typed decision model (Jev), eight open decision models and distilled students on GEO-Bench queries answered by ten engines that receive the same candidate sources in their prompt. Where several engines answer the same query, they agree with one another at a within-group Spearman correlation of 0.704. Jev and two open 27B decision models, used without training, are the strongest scorers at 0.575 to 0.578. A Qwen3-Reranker-4B fine-tuned with low-rank adapters on teacher labels for other GEO-Bench queries, released as GEO Citation Ranker 4B, reaches 0.542 to 0.549 across three seeds, and its differences with the 27B models and with Jev are not distinguishable from zero on 229 queries. Most of the remaining distance between the student and Jev disappears when Jev scores one passage at a time, as the student does. Students trained on teacher labels and on observed engine citations reach the same level, and labels from Jev alone match the two-teacher target at 0.6B. We release the model, the benchmark, the predictions of every reported scorer and the code.

AI.tldr: 论文构建GEO检索式评分器评测框架：在GEO-Bench查询上测量预训练重排器、托管类型化决策模型Jev、八个开放决策模型及其蒸馏学生，提出以"引用份额"为目标的评分任务，并发布GEO Citation Ranker 4B模型、基准与全部预测。
AI.motivation: 生成式引擎优化（GEO）需要一个能按"候选页面将获得多大比例的答案引用份额"进行排序的评分器，而现有工作缺乏对多种评分器在统一候选源、统一查询条件下的可比评测与轻量化可行方案。
AI.method: 让十个引擎在提示中接收相同的候选来源，回答相同的GEO-Bench查询；在该设定下评测预训练重排器、托管类型化决策模型Jev、八个开放决策模型及蒸馏学生。以Spearman相关衡量引擎间一致性与各评分器与目标的一致性；用LoRA在教师标签上微调Qwen3-Reranker-4B（跨其他GEO-Bench查询），三随机种子验证；并通过"逐段落打分"消融及教师标签来源（教师标签 vs 观测引擎引用）对照实验定位学生与教师的差距来源。
AI.result: 同组引擎间一致性（within-group Spearman）为0.704；无训练使用时Jev与两个开放27B决策模型最强，达0.575–0.578；GEO Citation Ranker 4B在三个种子上为0.542–0.549，其与27B模型及Jev的差异在229条查询上不可区分于零；Jev改为逐段落打分后，学生与Jev的剩余差距大部分消失；仅用Jev标签在0.6B规模即可匹配双教师目标。
AI.conclusion: 一个4B的LoRA蒸馏学生可在统计上匹配无训练的27B决策模型与Jev，说明评分能力可在小模型上低成本复现；差距主要来源于打分粒度而非模型容量；标签来源可简化。作者发布模型、基准、全部评分器预测与代码。

title: Template-Free Dynamic Invariant Detection
summary:
A dynamic invariant detector proposes invariants, such as method pre- and postconditions, and rules out those that do not hold at run time. Traditional detectors propose invariants from a fixed library of templates, which limits their expressiveness. A large language model (LLM) can propose invariants instead of, or in addition to, template-derived ones. With the right prompt and context choices, we found that this idea can both improve the invariants' expressiveness and reduce the cost of inferring the invariants.
  Greater expressiveness brings complications: an LLM-proposed invariant can execute arbitrary code during invariant evaluation, causing side effects or infinite loops. Our novel instrumentation strategies mitigate these problems. We wrap each candidate and evaluate only one invariant per thread at a time, so nested invariant evaluations cannot trigger one another indefinitely. To recover from non-nested hangs, we monitor each run for stalls and retry it under a growing time budget. Because we cannot prove a candidate side-effect-free in advance, we use delta debugging over the invariants evaluated during a failing test to isolate and disable a side-effecting candidate without discarding the rest of the run.
  We compared our implementation, Oca, to the popular template-based Daikon invariant detector on real open-source Java projects. Oca produces more expressive invariants: on average, 28% of its held invariants call a project-specific method, which Daikon's templates cannot express. Its invariants are more often valid, with a false-positive rate of 18% in a manual inspection, vs. 76% for Daikon, and more useful: as properties for property-based testing, they exposed 9 of 25 real bugs, compared with 4 for Daikon. Oca also costs less, using 566 minutes and 27 GB of disk, compared with 2,817 minutes and 827 GB for Daikon.

AI.tldr: 提出用LLM替代/补充固定模板来生成动态不变量（前置/后置条件等），并以新型插桩策略（候选包裹+单线程单不变量、停滞监控与递增时间预算重试、增量调试定位副作用候选）解决LLM不变量可执行任意代码带来的副作用与死循环问题；实现Oca，在真实Java开源项目上相比Daikon表达力更强、误报更低、更实用且成本显著更低。
AI.motivation: 传统动态不变量检测器仅从固定模板库提出候选不变量，表达力受限；LLM有望生成更丰富的候选。但引入LLM候选会带来新的工程与安全挑战：不变量在求值时执行任意代码，可能产生副作用或无限循环，且无法事先证明候选无副作用。
AI.method: 核心思路：以恰当的prompt与上下文让LLM提出（或补充）模板之外的不变量。缓解机制：(1) 将每个候选包裹（wrap）并在同一线程内一次只求值一个不变量，防止嵌套求值相互触发形成无限递归；(2) 对非嵌套性挂起，监控每次运行是否停滞，并在逐步增长的时间预算下重试；(3) 由于无法预先证明候选无副作用，在失败测试期间对所求值的不变量做增量调试（delta debugging），隔离并禁用一个有副作用的候选而不丢弃整次运行结果。
AI.result: 在真实开源Java项目上与基于模板的Daikon对比：Oca保持不变的不变量中平均28%调用了项目特定方法（Daikon模板无法表达）；人工检查误报率18%（Daikon 76%）；作为属性测试的性质，25个真实缺陷中暴露9个（Daikon 4个）；开销566分钟/27 GB磁盘，对比Daikon的2,817分钟/827 GB。
AI.conclusion: LLM可用于提升动态不变量推断的表达力并降低成本，其带来的副作用与挂起风险可由插桩层面的包裹、重试预算与增量调试机制有效缓解；实证表明该方法在有效性、真实缺陷检出与资源开销上均优于传统模板式检测器。

title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
summary:
Web agents require diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for reproducible training and evaluation. Human-assisted mirrors demand per-site engineering, while generative construction can diverge from specified real websites. Capture-and-replay preserves observations, with interaction coverage constrained by captured content and replay capabilities.
  We present WebAnything, a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable Web environments from real URLs without per-site manual implementation or repair after initial setup and authorization. An Explorer-Builder collects browser-observable structures, resources, and interaction outcomes; an independent verifier checks frozen candidates and guides local repair or targeted source recapture.
  We construct 244 website artifacts across 14 application domains and 53 categories, supporting 12,984 executed and accepted tasks. Compared with human-assisted WebHarbor, WebAnything achieves higher aggregate scores on three fidelity metrics, with 12 wins, two ties, and no losses in a blind audit. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on 5,856 interaction trajectories improves REAL success by 9.9 percentage points, Odysseys-Easy Rubric Avg and Task Avg by 6.25 and 6.32 percentage points, and WebArena-Verified Overall success by 13.33 percentage points under the fixed harness. Code: https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Web-Anything

AI.tldr: WebAnything 是一个全自动框架，可从真实 URL 重建"源接地"、可复用的网站环境，无需逐站人工实现，用于 Web agent 的可复现训练与评测。
AI.motivation: Web agent 需要多样、可执行、可重置的网站环境以支持可复现的训练与评测。现有方案存在缺陷：人工辅助镜像（如 WebHarbor）需逐站工程；生成式构建可能与指定真实网站偏离；捕获-回放保真于观测，但交互覆盖受捕获内容与回放能力限制。
AI.method: 提出自动化流水线：Explorer-Builder 采集浏览器可观测结构、资源与交互结果；由独立验证器对冻结候选进行检查，指导局部修复或定向的源站重捕获；初始设置与授权后无需人工实现或修复。
AI.result: 构建覆盖 14 个应用领域、53 个类别的 244 个网站工件，支撑 12,984 个执行并通过验收的任务。与人工辅助的 WebHarbor 相比，三项保真度指标聚合得分更高，盲审中 12 胜 2 平 0 负。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上用 5,856 条交互轨迹微调，REAL 成功率提升 9.9 个百分点，Odysseys-Easy 的 Rubric Avg 与 Task Avg 分别提升 6.25 与 6.32 个百分点，固定 harness 下 WebArena-Verified 总体成功率提升 13.33 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自动化、源接地的环境重建可在保真度上超越人工辅助镜像，并能作为有效训练与评测环境显著提升 agent 表现。

title: Selective Transfer Learning for Groundwater Level Anomaly Forecasting: Accuracy-Risk Trade-offs
summary: This work studies context-aware selective transfer learning for multi-well groundwater anomaly forecasting in the Netherlands. Source-domain pretraining can raise average accuracy but is not uniformly reliable: it degrades performance on a substantial fraction of heterogeneous wells. Context-Aware Selective Learning (CASL) uses calibration-trained, constrained contextual blending of frozen no-transfer and fixed-transfer parents. Global Convex Blend uses the same parents with one calibration-fitted weight per seed. The corrected task requires nine consecutive observed monthly inputs and an exact three-calendar-month target, without interpolation. Evaluation covers 457 wells and 13,718 test windows under five predefined seeds, with the four-cell maxsim0.60 source pool frozen using Always-TL validation RMSE alone. Fixed transfer harms 18.38-51.86% of wells. CASL has 0.424-1.084% lower RMSE than No TL, partially rescuing 97.53-99.50% and fully rescuing 23.46-43.78% of fixed-harmed wells. Partial rescue can arise structurally from convex blending and does not establish contextual superiority. Global Convex Blend protects more wells in four seeds, while CASL has slightly lower pooled RMSE in four. Neither dominates: the results support an accuracy-risk trade-off on the fixed split, not rolling deployment validity.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究荷兰多井地下水异常预测的"上下文感知选择性迁移学习"（CASL），通过冻结的无迁移与固定迁移父模型的受约束上下文混合来降低负迁移风险；实验显示固定迁移会损害18.38–51.86%的井，CASL的RMSE较无迁移低0.424–1.084%并部分挽救97.53–99.50%的受损井，但全局凸混合在保护井数上更优，二者不存在支配关系，体现精度–风险权衡。
AI.motivation: 源域预训练虽能提升平均精度，但对异质井并不一致可靠——在相当比例的井上会造成负迁移，因此需要一种能在个体井层面控制风险的选择性迁移方法。
AI.method: 提出CASL：以校准集训练、对冻结的"无迁移"与"固定迁移"两个父模型施加受约束的上下文混合；对照方法Global Convex Blend使用相同父模型但每个种子仅拟合一个全局凸混合权重。任务设定要求连续9个月观测输入与精确3个日历月目标、不做插值；评估覆盖457口井、13,718个测试窗口、5个预定义种子，四单元maxsim0.60源池仅依据Always-TL验证RMSE冻结。
AI.result: 固定迁移损害18.38–51.86%的井。CASL较No TL的RMSE低0.424–1.084%，部分挽救97.53–99.50%、完全挽救23.46–43.78%的受损井。全局凸混合在4个种子中保护更多井，CASL在4个种子中汇总RMSE略低，二者互不支配。作者指出部分挽救可由凸混合的结构性效应产生，不能据以证明上下文优越性。
AI.conclusion: CASL在固定划分上实现了平均精度提升与负迁移缓解，但相较全局凸混合并无全面优势；结果支持"精度–风险权衡"的解释，而非滚动部署有效性，凸混合本身即可解释部分挽救效应。

title: Towards Reliable, Scalable, and Value-Aligned Generative Recommendation for Large-Scale Advertising
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) reformulates item retrieval as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs), offering a unified paradigm for personalized recommendation. GR4AD, as an industrial generative recommendation framework, has greatly improved advertising revenue while enabling efficient real-time serving in Kuaishou.However, continued deployment has exposed three limitations: deterministic SID assignment remains sensitive to semantic boundaries; conventional backbone scaling provides diminishing revenue gains under strict serving constraints; and sequence-level value optimization provides limited credit assignment to intermediate SID decisions, causing likelihood-based beam search to prematurely prune potentially high-value candidates. We present GR4AD-X, which addresses these limitations through reliable SID construction, serving-efficient capacity scaling, and unified value alignment. Specifically, GR4AD-X improves SID reliability through Multi-Path assignment. It expands model capacity along multiple complementary dimensions rather than relying solely on wider or deeper backbones, achieving a better effectiveness-efficiency trade-off under strict serving constraints. Finally, Unified Value-Guided Generation and Discrimination (UniVGD) aligns generation with commercial value through prefix-level reward optimization, value-guided beam pruning, and discriminative reranking within a unified model. Large-scale online A/B tests on the Kuaishou advertising platform demonstrate that GR4AD-X achieves a cumulative revenue improvement of 3.07% over the deployed GR4AD baseline while satisfying strict latency and throughput constraints.

AI.tldr: GR4AD-X 针对工业生成式推荐框架 GR4AD 的三个瓶颈，提出多路径 SID 构建、多维容量扩展与统一价值对齐（UniVGD），在快手广告线上 A/B 实验中相对基线累计提升收入 3.07%，并满足严格延迟与吞吐约束。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）将物品检索重构为离散语义标识（SID）的自回归生成，GR4AD 已在快手实现实时服务与收入提升，但持续部署暴露三方面问题：确定性 SID 分配对语义边界敏感；在严格服务约束下常规骨干网络规模化带来的收益递减；序列级价值优化对中间 SID 决策的信用分配不足，导致基于似然的束搜索过早剪枝高价值候选。
AI.method: 1）采用 Multi-Path 分配构建更可靠的 SID；2）沿多个互补维度扩展模型容量，而非仅加宽/加深骨干，以在严苛服务约束下取得更优效费比；3）提出统一价值引导的生成与判别框架 UniVGD，包含前缀级奖励优化、价值引导的束剪枝，以及统一模型内的判别式重排序。
AI.result: 快手广告平台大规模线上 A/B 测试显示，GR4AD-X 相较已部署的 GR4AD 基线实现累计收入提升 3.07%，同时满足严格的时延与吞吐约束。
AI.conclusion: 通过可靠的 SID 构建、面向服务效率的容量扩展与统一价值对齐，可有效突破工业级生成式推荐在语义离散化、规模化收益与信用分配上的瓶颈，在线上服务约束下取得稳定商业收益。

title: Mentorship, Interrupted: How GenAI Disrupts the GSoC Pipeline and Why Mentors Matter More
summary: Generative AI (GenAI) makes open source software (OSS) contributions cheaper to produce, and it makes them say less about the people who produced them. In OSS mentoring, that matters: mentors judge what newcomers understand from their work, and newcomers learn from mentors' feedback. We studied how GenAI is changing mentoring in Google Summer of Code (GSoC), a program in which today's mentees can become tomorrow's mentors. We screened every thread on GSoC's restricted mentors' mailing list from November 2022 through March 2026 and interviewed 15 mentors and organization administrators. GenAI helped with onboarding, coordination, and first-pass review, but proposals, entry contributions, and mentees' answers became weaker evidence of what newcomers could do. Mentors made up the difference by checking, and that checking drew on the same time and goodwill the program needs to renew itself; one organization had withdrawn from GSoC. Responses ranged from banning GenAI to accepting it, and the boundary an organization drew determined who did the checking. We propose AIM, a decision framework that links acceptable GenAI use, integration into the mentoring pipeline, and mentoring capacity, to help organizations choose responses they can sustain.

AI.tldr: 该文研究生成式AI（GenAI）如何改变Google Summer of Code（GSoC）中的开源导师制，发现GenAI虽有助于入门、协调与初审，却削弱了提案、入门贡献与新人回答作为能力证据的效力，导师需额外核查，进而消耗项目自我延续所需的时间与善意；作者提出AIM决策框架以帮助组织选择可持续的应对方式。
AI.motivation: GenAI降低了开源贡献的生产成本，也使其更难反映贡献者本人的真实能力。在开源导师制中，导师依据新人的作品判断其理解程度，新人则从导师反馈中学习，因此"作品是否还能作为能力信号"成为关键问题；同时GSoC中今日的学员可能成为明日的导师，导师制本身的可延续性也受到威胁。
AI.method: 质性研究：筛查2022年11月至2026年3月GSoC受限导师邮件列表上的全部帖子，并对15名导师与组织管理员进行访谈。
AI.result: GenAI在入门引导、协调沟通和初审环节带来帮助；但提案、入门贡献和新人的回答在反映新人实际能力方面的证据力下降。导师通过额外核查来弥补这一缺口，而核查占用了项目自我更新所需的时间与善意，已有组织因此退出GSoC。各组织应对方式从禁止GenAI到接受GenAI不等，其划定的边界决定了由谁承担核查工作。
AI.conclusion: GenAI对导师制的影响取决于组织如何划定可接受使用边界及其核查成本的分担。作者提出AIM决策框架，将可接受的GenAI使用、对导师流程的整合程度与导师制承载能力三者关联，帮助组织选择可持续的应对策略。

title: What Does an Ontology Catch? Curated, LLM-Generated and Data-Derived Ontologies as Checkers of LLM Agents over Knowledge Graphs
summary: LLM agents that answer questions over Web knowledge graphs are increasingly wrapped in checks derived from the graph's ontology, on the assumption that a formal schema makes a reliable judge. Yet a checker can be wrong as well: it can miss errors, and it can flag correct answers and push the agent into "fixing" them. Whether a curated ontology is worth its cost as such a judge, and how it compares with an ontology an LLM writes or a schema mined from the data, is unknown. We make the checker itself the object of study. Across curated, LLM-generated and data-derived ontologies, used as prompt context, as a checker, or both, and across open-weight and proprietary agents on public graphs and a private graph of nearly $10^{9}$ triples, we account for what ontology-derived checks catch and what they wrongly flag. We show how each source trades caught errors against false alarms, how a curated schema used as published can contradict its own data, which errors structural checks miss, and whether combining sources or giving the agent the checker's specific feedback pays off. On UniProt, the curated ontology flags more correct answers than either an ontology derived from the data or one an LLM derives from a summary of the data with masked identifiers. On real agent answers, its flags are only marginally more precise than random flags.

AI.tldr: 本文把"本体论检查器"本身作为研究对象，系统评估三种来源（人工策展、LLM生成、数据挖掘）的本体作为提示上下文或检查器时，对错误捕获与误报之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在Web知识图谱上问答时，普遍用图本体论派生的检查来把关，假设形式化模式是可靠裁判。但检查器本身也可能出错：漏检错误或误判正确答案并诱导智能体"修正"它们。精心策展的本体论作为裁判是否值得其成本、如何与LLM生成或数据派生的模式比较，此前未知。
AI.method: 将检查器作为研究对象：对比人工策展、LLM生成、数据派生三类本体，分别作为提示上下文、检查器或两者兼用；在开源与闭源智能体、公开图以及一个近10^9三元组的私有图上，量化统计本体派生检查所捕获与误报的情况；分析策展模式与自身数据的矛盾、结构性检查漏检的错误类型，并检验多源组合与向智能体提供检查器具体反馈是否有效。
AI.result: 不同来源在"捕获错误"与"误报"之间存在各自权衡；公开发布的策展模式可能与其自身数据相矛盾；结构性检查会漏检部分错误。在UniProt上，策展本体标注的正确答案数多于数据派生本体和基于掩码标识符的数据摘要所派生的LLM本体；而在真实智能体答案上，其标注的精确率仅略高于随机标注。
AI.conclusion: 形式化本体并不必然构成可靠裁判；策展模式作为检查器的成本效益被高估，其标志在真实答案上的精确率接近随机。需重新审视将本体论检查视为可靠把关的默认假设。

title: Anisotropic Trust Region Warping for Prior-Data Fitted Networks in Bayesian Optimisation
comment: Accepted at the 2026 NeurIPS Workshop on Optimization for Machine Learning (OPT). 18 pages, 12 figures
summary: Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) replace the hyperparameter refitting of Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates in Bayesian optimisation with a single forward pass, at the cost of a prior that is fixed at meta-training time. We show empirically that a PFN's predictive log-likelihood falls increasingly behind that of a refitted GP as the objective function's lengthscale grows beyond the mode of the PFN's meta-training prior, and that this deficit carries over to optimisation performance. To correct the mismatch without retraining the network, we introduce Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping. Per-dimension lengthscales are estimated by kernel target alignment, and an affine rescaling of the input space maps the objective onto the lengthscale the PFN expects, with a trust region around the anchor determining which observations are retained, leaving the PFN's $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot N^2)$ inference cost unchanged. On functions drawn from a Matérn-3/2 kernel, ATR warping improves optimisation performance of the PFN at both extremes of the lengthscale range. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/Trust-Region-Warping-For-PFNs.

AI.tldr: ATR warping 通过对输入空间做各向异性仿射重标定，将目标函数映射到 PFN 元训练先验期望的长度尺度，从而在无需重训练的情况下修正 PFN 与重拟合 GP 之间的先验失配，并提升贝叶斯优化性能。
AI.motivation: PFN 用单次前向传播替代 GP 代理模型在贝叶斯优化中的超参数重拟合，代价是先验在元训练时被固定。作者实证发现：当目标函数长度尺度偏离 PFN 元训练先验的众数时，PFN 的预测对数似然会逐渐落后于重拟合的 GP，且该缺陷会传导到优化性能。
AI.method: 提出 Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping：通过核目标对齐（kernel target alignment）估计逐维长度尺度，对输入空间做仿射重标度，使目标映射到 PFN 所期望的长度尺度；并以锚点周围的信赖域决定保留哪些观测。该方法无需重训练网络，PFN 的 O(d·N²) 推理开销保持不变。
AI.result: 在由 Matérn-3/2 核生成的函数上，ATR warping 在长度尺度范围的两个极端处均改善了 PFN 的优化性能。
AI.conclusion: 长度尺度先验失配是 PFN 代理模型的主要性能瓶颈之一，而 ATR warping 提供了一种轻量、免重训练且不增加推理复杂度的修正手段。

title: Quantum-Inspired Pairwise Ranking Aggregation via Active LLM Feedback
summary: Ranking aggregation from multiple retrievers is a powerful yet under-explored technique in modern retrieval and RAG systems. We introduce LLM-IRA, the first extension of the quantum-inspired interactive ranking aggregation framework to document reranking. By leveraging large language models (LLMs) solely for pairwise judgments on high-disagreement document pairs, our method learns fusion weights in a principled, interactive way. The final ranking is a simple, ultra-fast pointwise linear fusion of scores, no full pairwise matrix or expensive listwise prompting is required. Experiments on the BEIR benchmark and TREC Deep Learning tracks with an open-weight instruction-tuned judge (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) show that LLM-IRA matches or numerically exceeds strong static fusion baselines on 5 of 6 evaluated benchmarks. We report two weight-update variants: momentum blending and a full accumulated-history refit, which together reach statistical significance (Wilcoxon signed-rank, p<0.05) over the best unsupervised aggregator on 4 of 6 benchmarks (DL19 under momentum; DL20, DBpedia, and NFCorpus under accumulated refit, which is the stronger of the two configurations overall). On the benchmarks we profiled (DL19, DL20), it already clears the best unsupervised baseline within as few as 5 LLM calls per query, well before exhausting its typical ~25--30 call budget. LLM-IRA also achieves cost-effectiveness comparable to state-of-the-art zero-shot LLM rerankers at an order of magnitude fewer LLM calls, and requires no training data or model fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 LLM-IRA，将量子启发的交互式排序聚合框架扩展到文档重排：仅用 LLM 对高分歧文档对做成对判断，交互式学习融合权重，最终以超快的逐点线性融合生成排序。
AI.motivation: 多检索器排序聚合在检索与 RAG 中潜力大但研究不足；现有 LLM 重排器依赖昂贵列表式提示或大量成对比较，成本高。
AI.method: 将 quantum-inspired interactive ranking aggregation 扩展至文档重排：LLM（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）仅对高分歧文档对给出成对偏好；学习融合权重，提出两种权重更新变体——动量混合与全历史累积重拟合；最终排序为简单的逐点线性分数融合，无需完整成对矩阵或列表式提示。
AI.result: BEIR 与 TREC DL 上，6 个基准中 5 个达到或数值上超过强静态融合基线；相对最佳无监督聚合器，4/6 基准达到统计显著（Wilcoxon, p<0.05；DL19 靠动量，DL20/DBpedia/NFCorpus 靠累积重拟合，整体更强）；DL19/DL20 上每查询仅约 5 次 LLM 调用即超越最佳无监督基线，远低于约 25–30 次预算；成本效益与 SOTA 零样本 LLM 重排器相当，但 LLM 调用少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: LLM 仅作高分歧成对判断即可实现有原则的交互式权重学习与高效线性融合，无需训练数据或微调，兼顾效果与成本。

title: Skeleton Coding: Program Structure as a Specification for Agents
summary: Coding agents are typically provided end-to-end behavioral specifications that the code they produce should satisfy, such as tests and input--output examples. How many such specifications must a developer provide, and which ones, for the agent to produce the developer's intended program? We argue that this cannot be determined a priori, for it depends on the structure of the implementation, which is left to the agent to decide. An agent first commits to a structure---a decomposition into data types, modules, and functions---which fixes a class of candidate programs; behavioral specifications then select a program within that class. A set of tests that suffices for one structure may leave another badly underdetermined, requiring different edge cases or exponentially more examples. Since the structure is chosen by the agent, developers cannot ensure their specification is complete without reverse-engineering it from thousands of lines of generated code. To resolve this, we introduce Skeleton Coding, in which developers jointly specify the structure---in high-level, code-like format---alongside behavioral specifications. Theoretically, we model AI-assisted coding as a control problem, and show that skeletons can reduce exponentially the number of tests developers must supply to steer an agent toward an acceptable program. Empirically, across four models and three benchmarks, the best-performing skeleton specifications reduce mean test error by 48.4% relative to the best end-to-end behavioral specifications. Even when the agent can query a complete reference implementation, adding a skeleton reduces mean test error relatively by up to 27.0%. Skeletons also narrow the average gap between small and large models by about 52.4% while lowering implementation cost by 15--26x, and reduce code erosion by 24.7% on average.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Skeleton Coding：让开发者同时给出高层类代码的"结构骨架"与行为规格（测试/样例），并从控制论角度论证骨架可将所需测试数从指数级降至多项式级；实验中骨架规格相比最佳端到端规格平均降低测试误差 48.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体仅接收端到端行为规格（测试、输入-输出样例），但所需规格的数量与内容无法先验确定：智能体先选定实现结构（数据类型、模块、函数的分解），该结构决定候选程序类，测试只在该类内做选择；同一组测试对某结构充分，对另一结构可能严重欠定，需不同边界用例甚至指数级更多样例。由于结构由智能体自选，开发者要保证规格完备，必须反向解读数千行生成代码。
AI.method: 提出 Skeleton Coding：开发者以高层、类代码的形式与行为规格共同指定结构。理论上将 AI 辅助编码建模为控制问题，分析骨架对引导智能体至可接受程序所需测试数量的影响；实验在 4 个模型、3 个基准上比较骨架规格与端到端行为规格，并测试在可查询完整参考实现条件下的增益，以及模型规模差距、实现成本与代码侵蚀（code erosion）的影响。
AI.result: 最佳骨架规格相较最佳端到端行为规格平均降低测试误差 48.4%；即使智能体可查询完整参考实现，加入骨架仍使平均测试误差相对降低最多 27.0%；骨架使小模型与大模型之间的平均差距缩小约 52.4%，同时实现成本降低 15–26 倍，代码侵蚀平均减少 24.7%。
AI.conclusion: 规格完备性依赖实现结构，无法先验确定；通过显式共同指定结构骨架，可指数级减少所需测试、显著降低测试误差与成本、缓解模型规模差距并抑制代码侵蚀，为 AI 辅助编码提供了更可控的规格范式。

title: Measuring Where Intent Gets Lost in Agentic Smart Contract Synthesis
comment: ACM TheWebConf2027 8 pages main content 4 pages appendix
summary:
AI agents can now write software from a plain-English description, but code that runs is not the same as code that does what was asked. This gap matters most for smart contracts, the programs behind Web3 applications that move money on a blockchain and cannot be fixed once deployed. We ask how to check whether an AI-written contract behaves as it should, and where the requested behavior gets lost.
  We design an evaluation built on execution rather than opinion. We replay the same transactions on an AI-written contract and on the original it should reproduce and measure how often they agree. We test every grading tool on planted mistakes, compare against an answer key written without the description, and audit our own scorer until known wrong answers cannot pass. Common methods, such as AI judges and standard analysis tools, miss obvious mistakes, and scoring choices matter too. Checking only the functions every system includes hid about half the difference between pipelines.
  We then propose an elicitation-first architecture. Before writing code, the agent asks the client a short checklist of questions, checks the contract against an independently written executable answer key, and returns disagreements to the client instead of silently rewriting code. Asking first matters far more than reviewing or patching afterwards, across three AI models, while automated security fixes often break requested behavior. A few well-chosen questions recover much of what a short description omits, and their value can be estimated without the original contract. To our knowledge, this is the first study in smart contract synthesis to gather missing requirements before generation and check the result against an independently written executable model. The lessons extend to any setting where AI agents turn requests into programs. We release our tools, 600 tasks and all results.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以执行一致性为核心的评估方法，检验AI生成的智能合约是否真正实现需求，并提出“先澄清需求再生成”的elicitation-first架构，显著优于事后审查或补丁。
AI.motivation: AI智能体可依据自然语言描述生成软件，但“能运行的代码”不等于“符合要求的代码”。该差距在智能合约上尤为严重：合约转移链上资金且部署后不可修改，因此需要可靠的评估方法来判定AI所写合约是否按预期运行，以及需求在何处丢失。
AI.method: 1) 基于执行的评估：在同一组交易下，分别在AI生成合约与原合约上回放，度量行为一致率；2) 用植入错误测试所有评分工具，与"未看描述而独立编写的答案键"比对，并审计自身评分器直到已知错误无法通过；3) 提出elicitation-first架构：生成前让智能体向客户提出简短问题清单，并用独立编写的可执行答案键校验合约，将分歧反馈客户而非静默改写；4) 在三个AI模型上验证，覆盖600个任务。
AI.result: 常见方法（AI评审、标准分析工具）会漏掉明显错误，评分口径也会影响结论；仅检查所有系统共有的函数会掩盖约一半的流水线间差异。先提问带来的收益远大于事后审查与修补，且自动安全修复常破坏需求行为；少量高质量问题即可恢复简短描述所遗漏的大部分信息，且其价值可在没有原合约的情况下估计。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是智能合约合成领域首个在生成前收集缺失需求、并以独立编写的可执行模型校验结果的研究；其经验可推广到任何"AI智能体将请求转化为程序"的场景。作者开源了工具、600个任务及全部结果。

title: Spokes, not a Ring: Revisiting the Weekday Manifold in Language Models
summary: Recent work has hypothesised that large language models may represent some concepts as multi-dimensional manifolds instead of single directions. Using these manifolds to interpret or steer representations often assumes that moving along them corresponds to a continuous change in the represented concept. In this work, we test this continuous manifold assumption on the prototypical weekday manifold. Despite its striking circular geometry, we find that the weekday representations behave more like seven discrete states arranged in a circle than a continuous ring. First, we show that local sensitivity has seven minima aligned with the weekdays, producing a step-like mapping between representation and behaviour under on-manifold steering. Second, we test whether any concepts are represented along the manifold outside the seven discrete states, and find neither time of day, uncertainty, nor natural text populate the intermediate space. Together, these results challenge the continuous interpretation of the weekday manifold and motivate testing whether movement along other representation manifolds correspond to meaningful changes in model representations and behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文检验"连续流形假设"，发现星期几表征实为环形排列的七个离散状态，而非连续圆环。
AI.motivation: 近期研究假设大模型将某些概念表示为多维流形而非单一方向，并常将沿流形移动等同于概念的连续变化。作者检验这一"连续流形假设"是否成立。
AI.method: 以典型的星期几流形为对象：(1) 分析局部敏感性，考察其在流形上的极小值分布及在流形内引导（on-manifold steering）下表征与行为的映射；(2) 检验流形中间区域是否编码其他概念（时刻、不确定性、自然文本）。
AI.result: 局部敏感性存在七个极小值，与各星期对齐，使表征—行为映射呈阶梯状；中间空间不被时刻、不确定性或自然文本占据。
AI.conclusion: 星期几流形应解读为七个离散状态而非连续圆环，连续流形解释受质疑；需进一步检验其他表征流形的移动是否对应有意义的概念与行为变化。

title: PALATE: Pretrained Autoregressive LATent Embeddings
comment: Accepted to GRAIL @ CIKM 2026. 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Local-commerce and food-delivery marketplaces run large ads businesses: across hundreds of thousands of stores, merchants pay to be surfaced on browse and search surfaces, and a ranker decides which ads each consumer sees. Ranking well demands strong per-consumer personalization, yet a consumer's raw interaction history is sparse and high-cardinality. Our production ranker had personalized only through hand-engineered signals: aggregate engagement counts, categorical embeddings, and order-agnostic pooled history, with no learned per-consumer sequence representation. We learn one by training a GPT-style generative model of the consumer's engagement sequence to predict their next few engagements, and read its last-token hidden state as the consumer embedding. That single frozen vector becomes one shared personalization input for every ad surface: a daily job refreshes it, and each ranker consumes it as an ordinary dense feature. Offline it is the largest single-feature gain in our ranking-AUC ladder, a relative Eval-AUC gain of +0.59% on a browse-driven feed and +0.57% on a query-driven search surface. Online, it shipped as one component of bundled ranker retrains on both surfaces: Discovery (revenue +0.79%, conversion rate +1.17%) and Search (revenue +0.94%, conversion rate +1.50%). Three design choices adapt the generative objective to a repurchase-heavy marketplace, and are the core of our contribution: an exploration-weighted loss that up-weights businesses new to the consumer over ones already engaged; a two-stage curriculum: a click pretrain that keeps the representation broad and exploratory, then a conversion fine-tune that sharpens purchase intent; and a designed negative set that pairs a fixed popular-business pool and businesses shown but not ordered with random and in-batch negatives.
