AI.tldr: 该论文在本地生活/外卖市场平台的生产排序器中，用GPT式生成模型对用户互动序列建模，取其最后token隐状态作为冻结的用户embedding，作为各广告位共享的稠密个性化特征；核心贡献是三项适配"重复购买型"市场特性的设计：探索加权损失、两阶段课程、以及精心设计的负样本集。
AI.motivation: 现有生产排序器仅依靠人工工程化信号（聚合互动计数、类别embedding、无序池化历史）实现个性化，缺少可学习的用户序列表示；而用户原始互动历史稀疏且基数极高，需要一种能有效压缩并泛化的用户表示方式。
AI.method: 训练GPT风格生成模型预测用户接下来若干次互动，取最后token隐状态作为用户embedding；该向量每日由批处理刷新并作为普通稠密特征注入每个排序器。为适配高重复购买市场：1）探索加权损失，对用户未接触过的商家加权、已互动商家降权；2）两阶段课程——先点击预训练保持表示的广度与探索性，再转化微调锐化购买意图；3）设计负样本集合，将固定热门商家池与"曝光未下单"商家同随机负样本及in-batch负样本搭配。
AI.result: 离线：该特征是排序AUC阶梯中单项特征的最大增益，浏览驱动Feed相对Eval-AUC +0.59%，查询驱动搜索 +0.57%。线上：作为打包重训组件上线后，Discovery收入+0.79%、转化率+1.17%；Search收入+0.94%、转化率+1.50%。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的生成式用户序列表示可作为跨广告面的统一、低成本个性化输入，在稀疏高基数互动场景下显著优于人工工程化特征；针对重复购买特性的损失加权、课程学习与负样本设计是收益关键。

title: Precedent or Intent? What Coding Agents Follow When Evolving Existing Code
summary: Existing code reveals past implementation decisions but rarely explains the reasoning behind them. When coding agents implement new features or modify existing functionality, past decisions may conflict with new task instructions. This raises a fundamental question for agentic software evolution: when multiple implementations satisfy the same functional requirements, how do coding agents decide whether to follow existing code or new task instructions? We investigate this question through bidirectional, controlled experiments in purpose-built repositories, followed by validation in real-world open-source repositories. Our approach isolates three competing sources of guidance: (1) agents' default preferences, (2) repository precedents, and (3) explicit task instructions. We conduct 5,625 trials across four coding agents and six implementation pairs, with validation in four open-source repositories spanning three programming languages. We find that agents share the same default implementation choices, yet overwhelmingly follow repository precedent when it conflicts with those defaults (359/360 trials). Crucially, not all precedents carry equal influence: three supporting local files yield 96% adoption, compared with only 4% for sibling-resource files, and changing file placement alone can shift adoption from 0% to 100% at a fixed example count. When new task intent conflicts with existing code, written priority rules achieve substantially higher success than code examples alone (59/60 versus 38/60 joint successes for two agents on two implementation pairs). The effectiveness of explicit rules also extends to open-source repositories, where a harness-loaded rule raises joint success from 0/120 to 117/120. These findings motivate design-decision traceability that preserves not only implementation choices but also the rationale and priorities that should guide future changes.

AI.tldr: 通过5625次受控双向实验与4个开源仓库验证，揭示编码智能体在"默认偏好/仓库先例/显式指令"冲突时的取舍规律：先例支配默认，但不同先例影响力差异巨大；显式书面优先级规则显著优于代码示例。
AI.motivation: 现有代码只保留过去的实现决策而几乎不解释其背后的理由，当智能体实现新功能或修改既有功能时，旧决策可能与新任务指令冲突。核心问题是：当多种实现都满足同一功能需求时，编码智能体如何决定遵循既有代码还是新任务指令？作者希望厘清这一决策机制，并为设计决策可追溯性提供依据。
AI.method: 在专门构建的仓库中开展双向、受控实验，并在真实开源仓库中验证。实验设计隔离三类竞争性引导来源：(1) 智能体默认偏好、(2) 仓库先例、(3) 显式任务指令。共覆盖4个编码智能体、6组实现配对、5,625次试验，并在3种编程语言、4个开源仓库中验证；另引入harness加载的书面规则进行对照。
AI.result: 智能体共享相同的默认实现偏好，但当仓库先例与之冲突时，压倒性地遵循先例（359/360）。先例影响力并不等价：三个支持性本地文件带来96%采纳率，而同资源兄弟文件仅4%；仅改变文件放置位置即可在示例数量固定时使采纳率从0%升至100%。当新任务意图与既有代码冲突时，书面优先级规则的成功率显著高于仅靠代码示例（两个智能体×两组实现配对的联合成功为59/60 vs 38/60）；在开源仓库中，harness加载规则使联合成功率从0/120提升至117/120。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体的行为强烈受仓库先例结构（文件位置与关系）影响，而显式书面的优先级规则是消解"先例 vs 新意图"冲突最有效的手段。这支持引入"设计决策可追溯性"机制：不仅记录实现选择，还应保留其理由与指导未来变更的优先级。

title: Detecting Covert Collusion between AI Agents through Partner-Outsider Positive Listening
summary: AI agents that share a secret convention can coordinate through messages that look innocent, so a monitor that reads only the messages can miss them. We propose a behavioural test: a partner that uses a code reacts to the exact wording of a message, whereas an uninvolved agent placed in its seat does not. Partner--Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) is the difference between the two agents in how much their action changes when the message is reworded with its meaning kept, and it is computed after the fact by replaying logged prompts. In a simulated market with five conditions (no collusion, a joint reward with neutral messages, the same with an openly stated intention, a covert first-letter code, and the code with a stated intention), PoPLi is between 0.48 and 0.59 whenever the code is present (95% intervals all above 0.29) and between -0.10 and -0.01 without it. Message-only monitors did not separate the conditions: one reading the speaker's messages answered "no" in all 50 markets, and one reading every seller's messages flagged 9 of 10 markets with no collusion. PoPLi detects the use of a private channel, not collusion as such, and it cannot detect collusion through incentives alone or codes carried by meaning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Partner–Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) 行为检测方法：比较"合作方"与"无关联替代者"在消息改写（语义不变）时动作变化之差，事后重放日志prompt计算。模拟市场五条件下，存在隐码时PoPLi为0.48–0.59（95%区间均高于0.29），无隐码时为 -0.10至-0.01；而仅读消息的监控器完全失效。
AI.motivation: 共享秘密约定的AI agent可通过看似无害的消息协调，仅读消息的监控器无法察觉，因此需要一种不依赖消息内容解读的检测手段。
AI.method: 构造行为测试：使用代码的合作方会对消息的精确措辞作出反应，而无关联的替代者不会。以语义保持不变、仅改写措辞的消息为干预，度量两类agent动作改变的差异，即PoPLi，并在事后通过重放记录的prompt计算。在模拟市场五种条件下评估：无合谋、联合奖励+中性消息、同上+公开声明意图、隐晦首字母代码、代码+声明意图。
AI.result: 代码存在时PoPLi为0.48–0.59，95%区间下界均高于0.29；无代码时为 -0.10至-0.01，两类条件清晰分离。仅读消息的监控器无法区分条件：读说话者消息的监控器在全部50个市场均答"否"，读所有卖家消息的监控器在10个无合谋市场中误报9个。
AI.conclusion: PoPLi检测的是私有信道（隐码）的使用，而非合谋本身；它无法检测仅靠激励实现的合谋，也无法检测由语义承载的代码。

title: Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups
summary: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. Since a smaller subgroup AUC gap may stem from degrading the best group rather than improving the worst, each mitigation is also tested against a pre-specified non-inferiority margin relative to its baseline. Under this criterion, several configurations with the smallest disparity, notably QCNN with GRL on DDI, are not clinically acceptable due to loss of global discrimination. On DDI, QSVM with GRL+EO performed best and approached PanDerm in the performance/fairness trade-off; on CheXpert, QCNN with GRL achieved the highest aggregate performance but increased disparity, and EVA-X remained stronger. Fairness effects are model- and dataset-dependent, so QML requires empirical subgroup-aware evaluation. All quantum models run in classical simulation; we claim no quantum advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文对医学影像分类中的经典与量子分类器进行了子群感知的公平性审计，提出"差异缩小可能源于最优组性能下降"的陷阱，并引入非劣性边际判据检验缓解手段的临床可接受性。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习（QML）在医学分类中被广泛探索，但其在子群公平性准则下的行为缺乏系统研究；作者明确假设QML并非天然公平，需要实证检验。
AI.method: 基于ResNet-18嵌入，在DDI皮肤病变（敏感属性：Fitzpatrick皮肤类型）与CheXpert衍生胸片（敏感属性：年龄组）两个场景上训练SVM、MLP、QSVM、QCNN；设置基线及三种缓解策略：可微Equalized Odds（EO）正则、梯度反转学习（GRL）及两者组合；以PanDerm、EVA-X等基础模型作外部参照，并对每种缓解相对基线设定预设的非劣性边际进行检验。
AI.result: 量子分类器可获得有竞争力的总体性能但存在子群差异；部分差异最小的配置（尤以DDI上QCNN+GRL为代表）因全局判别力下降而不具临床可接受性；DDI上QSVM+GRL+EO在性能/公平权衡上最佳并接近PanDerm；CheXpert上QCNN+GRL总体性能最高但差异扩大，EVA-X仍更强。
AI.conclusion: 公平性效应依赖于模型与数据集，QML必须经过实证的子群感知评估；所有量子模型均为经典模拟，作者不主张任何量子优势。

title: PRISM: Personalized Item Representations in User History
summary:
Sequential recommenders typically construct history inputs from item identifiers or content features using an embedding map shared across users. The same item therefore yields the same initial embedding representation, even when users have different relationships to the item. We propose personalized item representations in user history, where each item's embedding expresses its relationship to the user. Personalization becomes a property of the history inputs themselves, supplying richer evidence for later sequence modeling.
  We instantiate this idea with PRISM, which reuses upstream ranking computation to generate personalized item embeddings. An autoencoder jointly compresses all layer states from a user tower, a user--item tower, and same-request candidate mixing into one embedding per scored pair for downstream replay. Offline evaluation on Surface 1, a major recommendation surface at billion scale, reports an average downstream normalized entropy (NE) change of $-0.15\%$, compared with $-0.07\%$ for VISTA at similar history lengths. We further identify an empirical sequence-length scaling law: over history lengths of 26--240 events, NE gain follows a fitted power law with exponent 0.468, increasing from 0.06\% to 0.17\%. Therefore, personalized item representations in user history provide a new scaling dimension for improving recommendation quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在用户历史中使用"个性化物品表示"替代共享嵌入表，使同一物品对不同用户产生不同初始嵌入；并以PRISM实例化（用自编码器联合压缩用户塔、用户—物品塔与候选混合的多层状态为每对评分一个嵌入）。线上规模离线评测平均NE改善0.15%（VISTA为0.07%），并给出历史长度的幂律缩放规律（指数0.468）。
AI.motivation: 现有序列推荐器用跨用户共享的嵌入表，从物品ID或内容特征构造历史输入，导致同一物品在不同用户关系中仍得到相同的初始嵌入，无法表达"该物品对用户意味着什么"，使序列建模缺乏个性化证据。
AI.method: 提出让历史输入本身个性化：每个物品嵌入表达其与用户的关系。PRISM复用上游排序计算生成个性化物品嵌入，并用自编码器将用户塔、用户—物品塔及同请求候选混合的各层状态联合压缩为每个(用户,物品)评分对的一个嵌入，供下游重放使用。
AI.result: 在十亿级推荐场景Surface 1离线评测中，下游NE平均变化-0.15%，相近历史长度下VISTA为-0.07%。历史长度26–240事件区间内NE增益服从拟合幂律，指数0.468，增益由0.06%升至0.17%。
AI.conclusion: 个性化物品表示在用户历史中为提升推荐质量提供了新的缩放维度，可随历史长度获得稳定收益，是一条独立于模型规模与特征工程的改进路径。

title: Detecting Incorrect LLM Explanations for Automated Program Repair
summary:
LLM-generated explanations help developers understand automated program repair (APR) rationale and assess patch quality. Incorrect explanations can mislead developers about a repair's reliability, making their detection important. However, manually inspecting the growing volume of generated repairs is impractical, motivating automated detection.
  Existing methods mainly target incorrect answers from general question-answering LLMs, often by sampling multiple responses and detecting contradictions. Applied to APR, they face two limitations: (1) they may depend on external verifiers that are unavailable or lack APR-specific reasoning; and (2) sampling strategies such as paraphrasing or re-prompting the same input often yield superficial, redundant responses that repeat the original error rather than expose it.
  We propose MetaReJ, the first method designed to detect incorrect APR explanations using metamorphic testing. Inspired by debate and viva examinations, MetaReJ challenges explanations through an argumentative strategy without requiring external verifiers. It applies novel metamorphic relations (MRs) to recursively question the LLM under equivalent and non-equivalent repair scenarios and detect contradictions. To obtain diverse samples, MetaReJ transforms the buggy program into variants that preserve or alter the underlying bug, then asks the LLM how to repair each variant. Contradictions among responses are encoded as MR violations, which indicate that the original explanation is incorrect. We evaluate MetaReJ on a manually labelled dataset of 1,756 explanations from multiple LLM-based APR systems. MetaReJ achieves an MCC of up to 0.43, outperforming prior methods by up to 333.3% in MCC.

AI.tldr: 提出 MetaReJ，首个用蜕变测试（metamorphic testing）检测 APR 错误解释的方法，通过构造保留/改变缺陷的程序变体并递归质询 LLM 以检测矛盾，在 1,756 条解释数据集上 MCC 达 0.43，较基线最高提升 333.3%。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成的修复解释若错误会误导开发者判断补丁可靠性，人工审查不可行。现有方法多面向通用问答 LLM 的错误答案检测，依赖多采样与矛盾检测，用于 APR 时存在两个局限：(1) 依赖不可用或缺乏 APR 专用推理的外部验证器；(2) 改写、重复提示等采样策略易产生表面化、冗余的响应，重复而非暴露原始错误。
AI.method: MetaReJ 借鉴辩论与答辩（viva）式质询，无需外部验证器。核心是新型蜕变关系（MRs）：将含缺陷程序变换为保留底层缺陷或改变底层缺陷的变体，询问 LLM 如何修复各变体，在等价与非等价修复场景下递归质询并检测矛盾；将响应间矛盾编码为 MR 违背，作为原解释错误的判据。
AI.result: 在人工标注的 1,756 条来自多个 LLM-based APR 系统的解释数据集上评估，MetaReJ 的 MCC 最高为 0.43，MCC 较既有方法最高提升 333.3%。
AI.conclusion: MetaReJ 表明蜕变测试可作为无需外部验证器的 APR 解释错误检测范式，通过程序变体生成多样化、语义有效的样本，显著优于基于通用问答错误检测的基线方法。

title: Evaluating and improving AI agents for sequencing protocol understanding
summary: Existing scientific-agent benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can reconstruct the exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols, a capability critical for analyzing customized sequencing assays. We introduce LibStructBench, a document-grounded benchmark for reconstructing sequencing-library structures and molecular workflows. Our experiments show that frontier agents often produce approximately correct reconstructions but remain unreliable at exact reconstruction, particularly in molecular-state representation and workflow connectivity. Switching the underlying language model produced larger average performance differences than switching agent harnesses, with a statistically significant difference only for molecular-state reconstruction. Additional knowledge improved oligo-family recovery in a small pilot without improving mean molecular-workflow scores. Autonomous accumulation of procedural rules and cross-protocol examples showed non-monotonic validation performance and no mean held-out molecular-workflow improvement in the tested trajectory. These findings highlight the need for more controlled and verifiable approaches to scientific reasoning about molecular processes in complex experimental protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出 LibStructBench，一个以文档为依据的基准，用于评估科学智能体能否精确重建测序文库结构与分子流程；实验显示前沿智能体只能做到"近似正确"，在精确重建、分子状态表征与流程连通性上仍不可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有科学智能体基准很少评估智能体能否依据测序方案重建精确的分子结构与生成流程，而这一能力对分析定制化测序实验至关重要，因此需要专门的、可验证的基准。
AI.method: 构建文档驱动的基准 LibStructBench，将测序方案作为文本依据，要求智能体重建文库结构与分子工作流；对比不同语言模型与智能体框架（harness）的表现，并考察外部知识注入与自主积累程序性规则/跨方案示例的效果。
AI.result: 前沿智能体多产生"近似正确"的重建，精确重建不可靠，问题集中于分子状态表征与工作流连通性；更换底层语言模型造成的平均性能差异大于更换智能体框架，但仅在分子状态重建上具有统计显著性；额外知识在小规模试点中提升寡核苷酸家族恢复，但未提升平均分子流程得分；自主积累规则与跨方案示例的验证性能呈非单调变化，在测试轨迹中未带来留出集平均提升。
AI.conclusion: 复杂实验方案下的分子过程科学推理需要更受控、更可验证的方法；仅靠更强模型、框架替换或经验自主积累不足以实现可靠的精确重建。

title: Learning Without Clocks: Partition-Invariant Neural Network
summary: Event cameras, spiking cochleas and similar sensors emit asynchronous events, yet most learning systems first bin them into frames or packets, so the output depends on how the stream was sliced. Networks whose state is updated exactly at every event and evolves in closed form between events are invariant to this slicing. We ask what more makes the output (i) independent of the processing order of simultaneous events and (ii) continuous in the time stamps, even when two events cross in time, while (iii) staying sensitive to temporal order. For arbitrary nonlinear event models we prove that (i) and (ii) are each equivalent to pairwise commutation of the event updates, and that once updates commute, all order dependence comes from their non-commutation with the inter-event dynamics and vanishes linearly in the time lag. This identifies a class of time-mediated non-commutative (TM) models and yields a resolution-robustness bound for any model. We construct the minimal TM layer, a learnable, provably Lipschitz generalization of the Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator; prove that no single additive layer can uniformly represent ordered pair interactions, whereas a three-dimensional TM state can; show that each TM layer adds two levels of temporal nesting versus one for additive layers; and give a single-layer higher-order construction (TM-k) and a stacking rule preserving all three properties. We instantiate these results as the Clock-Free Event (CFE) layer, linear in the number of events, give a topology-free variant for temporal point processes with closed-form likelihoods, and specify a preregistered clock-robustness protocol with a physical-time threat model for spike-retiming attacks. In preliminary development-set experiments, the TM state beats an otherwise identical additive state by 3.5-9.1 points on DVS128 Gesture and by 24.5 and 30.6 points on SHD and Speech Commands.

AI.tldr: 事件相机、脉冲耳蜗等传感器输出异步事件，但多数学习系统先将其分帧/打包，导致输出依赖切片方式。本文定义了"时间介导的非交换（TM）模型"类，证明同时事件处理顺序无关与时间戳连续性均等价于事件更新的两两交换性，构造了最小TM层（可学习、可证Lipschitz的Hassenstein-Reichardt相关器推广）及CFE层，在多个基准上显著优于加性基线。
AI.motivation: 现有异步事件学习方法普遍先将事件流分箱为帧或数据包，使输出依赖于流被切片的方式，缺乏对时间分辨率与切片方式的鲁棒性。作者希望刻画"在事件处精确更新、事件间闭式演化"的网络需满足哪些额外条件才能同时具备：同时事件处理顺序无关、对时间戳连续（即使两事件在时间上交叉）、且仍对时间顺序敏感。
AI.method: 对任意非线性事件模型，证明条件(i)顺序无关与(ii)时间戳连续分别等价于事件更新的两两交换性；一旦更新可交换，所有顺序依赖性来自其与事件间动力学的不交换性，并随时间滞后线性消失。由此定义TM模型类并给出分辨率鲁棒性界。构造最小TM层——Hassenstein-Reichardt相关器的可学习、可证Lipschitz推广；证明单个加性层无法统一表示有序成对交互，而三维TM状态可以；证明每个TM层比加性层多两级时间嵌套；给出单层高阶构造TM-k与保持三性质的堆叠规则。实例化为Clock-Free Event（CFE）层（对事件数线性），并给出无拓扑变体用于时间点过程（具闭式似然），以及预注册的时钟鲁棒性协议与物理时间威胁模型。
AI.result: 理论：顺序无关与时间连续性均等价于两两交换性；可交换后顺序依赖仅源于与事件间动力学的不交换，且随时滞线性趋零；给出分辨率鲁棒性界；证明加性层不可均匀表示有序成对交互，三维TM状态可；TM层时间嵌套层级为加性层两倍。实验（初步开发集）：TM状态较相同配置的加性状态在DVS128 Gesture上高3.5–9.1个百分点，在SHD上高24.5个百分点，在Speech Commands上高30.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过交换性这一核心代数条件，作者统一刻画了切片无关、顺序无关且时间连续的事件学习模型，提出TM模型类与CFE层，兼顾理论保证（Lipschitz、鲁棒性界、表达能力分离）与线性复杂度，并在事件视觉与语音任务上显示显著优于加性基线的潜力，同时提供了可复现的时钟鲁棒性评测协议。

title: Read More, Reason Deeper: Latent Workspaces for Long-Sequence Recommendation
summary: Long-sequence recommendation can improve along two axes: \emph{evidence scaling} exposes longer histories, while \emph{reasoning scaling} adds layers that interpret that evidence for a candidate. Existing models couple them: sequence encoders propagate every added event through depth, whereas one-shot selection prevents later layers from revisiting omitted evidence. We introduce the Latent Workspace Ranker (LWR), which keeps typed evidence in persistent banks and propagates a fixed-size candidate-local workspace. Each layer rereads the banks from its evolving workspace and archives compact post-interaction state, allowing history length and reasoning depth to grow independently. We compare four architectures across various history--depth configurations using evidence scaling at fixed depth, reasoning scaling at fixed 10K history, and their joint compute-efficient frontier. LWR leads all families at long histories, continues improving with reasoning compute, and converts additional training compute into quality gains at the fastest fitted rate on the joint frontier. At 10K history, it improves NE by 0.19% over HSTU while using 69.6% fewer forward GFLOP/request. It also outperforms existing baselines on two billion-scale ranking surfaces. These results show that separating addressable evidence from propagated state makes reading more and reasoning deeper independently controllable and jointly useful.

AI.tldr: 提出 Latent Workspace Ranker (LWR)，将类型化证据存入持久化 bank，仅传播固定尺寸的候选局部 workspace，使历史长度与推理深度可独立扩展，在长序列推荐中领先各架构家族。
AI.motivation: 现有长序列推荐模型将 evidence scaling（暴露更长历史）与 reasoning scaling（增加推理层）耦合：序列编码器把每个新增事件沿深度传播，且一次性选择使后续层无法回看被省略的证据，导致两种扩展无法独立进行。
AI.method: LWR 维护持久化的类型化证据 bank，并传播固定尺寸的候选局部 workspace；每层从演化中的 workspace 重新读取 bank，并归档紧凑的交互后状态，从而解耦历史长度与推理深度。实验在多种历史-深度配置下比较四种架构，分别考察固定深度下的 evidence scaling、固定 10K 历史下的 reasoning scaling，以及二者的联合计算高效前沿。
AI.result: LWR 在长历史下领先所有架构家族，随推理算力持续提升；在联合前沿上以最快拟合速率将额外训练算力转化为质量增益。10K 历史时，NE 较 HSTU 提升 0.19%，前向 GFLOP/request 减少 69.6%；并在两个十亿级排序场景上优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 将可寻址证据与传播状态分离，使"读取更多"与"推理更深"可独立控制且联合有效，为长序列推荐的可扩展性提供了新范式。

title: DIFUZZI: A Differential Fuzzing Tool for Code Functional Similarity Assessment
summary: A range of software engineering tasks, such as optimization and refactoring, seek to preserve the behavior of software components and require methods to assess functional similarity. Research has explored formal approaches to prove functional equivalence and used machine learning methods to approximate it, but the former does not scale and does not quantify the extent of similarity and the latter struggles when subtle semantic differences are present. Differential fuzzing offers a scalable approach for differencing programs semantically, but applying it often requires substantial manual effort to construct input generators that are well-suited to a target pair of programs. To address this challenge, we introduce DIFUZZI, which incorporates an LLM-based generator synthesis step that is iteratively validated and repaired. By automating this step, DIFUZZI paves the way for broader applicability of differential fuzzing. We release DIFUZZI at https://github.com/Dristi123/difuzzi_tool, with a demonstration video at https://youtu.be/FlHNOHuo9WE

AI.tldr: DIFUZZI通过基于LLM的生成器合成步骤（迭代验证与修复）自动构建差分模糊测试的输入生成器，降低人工成本，推动差分模糊测试的广泛应用。
AI.motivation: 优化、重构等软件工程任务需保持组件行为并评估功能相似性。形式化等价性证明不可扩展且无法量化相似程度；机器学习近似方法在存在细微语义差异时表现不佳。差分模糊测试可扩展地语义比较程序，但构建适配目标程序对的输入生成器需大量人工投入。
AI.method: 提出DIFUZZI工具，将LLM驱动的生成器合成步骤嵌入差分模糊测试流程，并对合成的输入生成器进行迭代验证与修复。
AI.result: 实现并开源DIFUZZI（附演示视频），自动化生成器构建环节，使差分模糊测试更易应用。
AI.conclusion: 自动化输入生成器合成可消除差分模糊测试的主要人工瓶颈，为其在功能相似性评估中的广泛应用铺平道路。

title: Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback
summary: Language-model agents differ fundamentally from prior intelligent systems in their ability to learn from natural language in context. This capability enables agents to iteratively refine their answers in response to feedback, a prevalent mode of operation in modern agentic workflows. However, the community primarily ranks models by metrics such as Pass@1 or Pass@K, which cannot capture how they utilize feedback on prior attempts. We introduce Seq@K, a natural evaluation protocol that measures whether a model can solve a problem within K sequential attempts, provided feedback after each previous failure. Unlike multi-turn agentic benchmarks that examine long-horizon planning, Seq@K isolates and formalizes the core capability of refinement from feedback. We evaluate Seq@K on a suite of 7 benchmarks and 16 frontier models, and show that Seq@K reveals a materially different model-selection landscape: under Seq@K, (1) model rankings often differ, (2) the Pareto frontiers admit more efficient configurations and (3) the gains from choosing the optimal model configuration can widen or shrink relative to those of Pass@K. We further show that analyzing model trajectories under Seq@K helps characterize iterative refinement behavior, such as the rate at which models address issues raised in feedback, or how rigidly they hold onto their own answers. Finally, we study how the nature of feedback affects models' iterative refinement, showing that practitioners must carefully design and benchmark the feedback loops of iterative agentic systems. Together, these results establish how Seq@K offers a more faithful metric for intelligent systems that typically operate in such feedback loop, and the necessity to consider Seq@K in evaluating models for these systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Seq@K 评测协议，衡量模型在 K 次顺序尝试中、每次失败后获得反馈的前提下能否解题，从而刻画语言模型智能体"基于反馈迭代改进"的核心能力。
AI.motivation: 现代 agentic 工作流普遍依赖"尝试—反馈—修正"的迭代模式，但社区主要用 Pass@1/Pass@K 排序模型，二者无法反映模型如何利用前次尝试的反馈。
AI.method: 提出 Seq@K：在 K 次顺序尝试内、每次失败后给出反馈，测量最终能否解题；它不同于考察长程规划的多轮 agentic 基准，而是隔离并形式化"从反馈中改进"这一核心能力。在 7 个基准、16 个前沿模型上评测，并分析模型轨迹与反馈性质的影响。
AI.result: Seq@K 给出显著不同的模型选择图景：(1) 模型排名常不同；(2) Pareto 前沿存在更高效配置；(3) 相对 Pass@K，选择最优模型配置带来的收益可能扩大或缩小。轨迹分析可刻画迭代改进行为（如对反馈所提问题的修正率、对自身答案的固守程度），并表明反馈性质显著影响迭代改进效果。
AI.conclusion: Seq@K 为在反馈回路中运行的智能系统提供了更忠实的评测指标，评测此类系统时应纳入 Seq@K；同时从业者需精心设计并基准化迭代 agentic 系统的反馈回路。

title: Learning Lotteries with Minimal Stakeholder Violations from Membership Queries
comment: 31 pages, full version of paper at NeurIPS 2026
summary: An AI developer often has several candidate versions of a system and can deploy a mixture of them, sending each request to a randomly chosen version, as in A/B testing. Each stakeholder (e.g., a safety team, a regulator, or a customer with private test data) accepts a mixture exactly when its expected performance (e.g., its rate of harmful replies) meets the stakeholder's own standard, which the developer can learn only by asking whether a proposed mixture is acceptable. We model this as choosing a lottery over $m$ alternatives for $n$ agents, each of whom accepts exactly the lotteries in an unknown halfspace and answers such binary membership queries. While Choo et al. (ICML 2026) sought a lottery that every agent accepts, none may exist when, say, safety and helpfulness requirements conflict, so we minimize the number of rejecting agents. We show that this problem is APX-hard even when all halfspaces are known and all utilities are $0$ or $1$. We then give exact algorithms that run in polynomial time when $m$ is constant, and in quasi-polynomial time when, for a constant $η$, some optimal lottery has no accepting agent within $η$ of its threshold. When only some agents can be queried, optimizing over a uniform sample of agents gives additive and relative guarantees for the whole population, with a sample size that does not depend on $n$, and a linear program gives a polynomial-time method for any $m$. On the other hand, for $m\ge 3$, a deterministic algorithm that queries only $K$ distinct agents cannot guarantee fewer than $n-K$ extra rejections, and this is achievable; in other words, it can guarantee nothing for the agents it does not ask. Small synthetic experiments indicate that our worst-case bounds are conservative on random instances.

AI.tldr: 论文研究在多个利益相关者（各自接受集合为未知半空间、只能做二元成员查询）约束下，如何为AI系统的多个候选版本选择随机混合（lottery）以最小化拒绝者数量，给出APX-hard性、精确算法与采样/LP近似方法及下界。
AI.motivation: A/B测试式的混合部署中，安全团队、监管方、客户等每个利益相关者只在其期望性能满足自身标准时接受混合方案，而该标准只能通过“是否可接受”的二元查询获知。此前工作（Choo et al., ICML 2026）要求存在一个所有人都接受的lottery，但当安全与有用性等要求冲突时这样的lottery可能不存在，因此需要退而最小化被拒绝的agent数量。
AI.method: 将问题建模为在m个备选方案上选择lottery、对n个agent进行未知半空间成员查询的组合优化问题。先给出APX-hard性归约（即使半空间已知、效用为0/1）；再设计精确算法：m为常数时多项式时间，当存在最优lottery使任何接受agent距其阈值至少η（η为常数）时准多项式时间；对只能查询部分agent的情形，用agent的均匀样本做优化以获得对全体的加性与相对保证（样本量与n无关），并给出对任意m均多项式时间的LP方法；最后证明m≥3时仅查询K个不同agent的确定性算法无法保证少于n−K个额外拒绝，且该界可达，并做小规模合成实验。
AI.result: 问题在已知半空间、0/1效用下仍为APX-hard；给出m常数时的多项式精确算法与η-间隔条件下的准多项式精确算法；均匀采样优化给出样本量与n无关的加性/相对保证，LP给出任意m的多项式时间方法；m≥3时确定性算法对未查询agent无法提供任何保证，n−K额外拒绝的下界可达；合成实验显示最坏情况界在随机实例上偏保守。
AI.conclusion: 在利益相关者标准未知、仅可二元查询的设定下，最优化lottery以最小化拒绝数是计算困难的，但在参数化（m小、有间隔）或允许采样/松弛时可获得高效且有理论保证的算法；确定性查询在agent数量多时本质受限，需依赖随机化与采样。

title: A Sequential Decision Framework for Evaluating LLM-Guided Search
summary: Recent systems applying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and "deep research" iteratively generate queries, retrieve documents, and examine their contents, using the resulting information to guide subsequent search steps. When this process is carried out autonomously rather than by a human searcher, the system must make explicit decisions about which search trajectories to explore and what objective the search is intended to optimize. We introduce a simple framework for reasoning about such search policies, providing a principled approach to evaluation. The framework models the search environment as a set of ranked lists and represents behavior using two primitive actions: select, which advances judgment through an existing ranking, and spawn, which generates a new ranking through query generation or reformulation. Each action produces a document to inspect, yields information that updates the search state, and contributes a reward for a task-specific objective. Within this abstraction, a variety of existing retrieval strategies can be expressed as policies operating over a common environment, while common retrieval objectives can be represented through reward and weighting functions over the resulting search trajectory, and the resulting formulation admits a natural reinforcement learning interpretation. We illustrate the approach using high-recall information retrieval (HRIR), where the goal is to identify as many relevant documents as possible with limited judging effort, showing how the framework provides a unified way to describe and reason about strategies for both classical retrieval tasks and emerging LLM-guided search systems. Through experiments, we demonstrate that both the underlying retrieval method and the "deep research" policy employed can materially affect performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用于分析和评估RAG/“深研”式迭代检索策略的简单框架：以排序列表集合为环境，用select与spawn两种基本动作刻画搜索行为，将各类检索策略统一表达为策略、将检索目标表达为奖励与加权函数，并给出强化学习解释；在高召回检索(HRIR)上验证该框架可统一描述经典检索与LLM引导搜索，且实验表明底层检索方法与“深研”策略均显著影响性能。
AI.motivation: RAG与“deep research”系统在自主迭代地生成查询、检索并阅读文档时，必须显式决定探索哪些搜索轨迹以及优化何种目标；但现有工作缺乏对这类搜索策略进行原则化推理与评估的统一框架，导致策略之间难以比较、目标定义含糊。
AI.method: 将搜索环境建模为一组排序列表；用两种原语动作表示行为：select（在已有排序上推进判断）与spawn（通过查询生成或改写产生新排序）。每个动作产出一个待检视文档、产生更新搜索状态的信息，并贡献面向任务目标的奖励。在此抽象下，把多种现有检索策略表达为作用于共同环境的策略，把常见检索目标表示为对搜索轨迹的奖励与加权函数，并给出其强化学习解释。以高召回信息检索(HRIR)为示例场景（在有限判定成本下尽可能多地识别相关文档）进行说明与实验。
AI.result: 该框架为经典检索任务与新兴LLM引导搜索系统提供了统一的描述与推理方式；实验中，底层检索方法本身与所采用的“deep research”策略都能实质性影响最终性能。
AI.conclusion: 以select/spawn为核心动作、以奖励与加权函数刻画目标的搜索策略框架，可作为评估自主迭代检索系统的原则化基础；性能并非仅由检索器决定，搜索策略同样关键，因此需要在该统一框架下对策略与目标进行显式设计与评估。

title: Security Impact of Coding Agent's Memory Files
summary: Coding agents automatically load project memory files such as CLAUDE.md at the start of every session and treat them as trusted project guidance. Anyone who can change such a file, for example through a pull request, can therefore steer the agent without ever touching the developer's prompt. We study memory files as an attack surface for insecure code generation and ask (1) whether a malicious memory file makes agents produce code that passes its tests but is vulnerable, and (2) whether agents disclose to the developer that the file shaped their code. For each of 12 CWE classes, we crafted two malicious memory files, a qualified variant that presents removing defensive checks as engineering best practice and a forceful variant that demands it. We ran Claude Code (Sonnet 5.5) and OpenCode (Qwen 3.8 27B, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) on 36 SecRepoBench tasks with and without these files. The malicious files changed the rate of secure completions by -8 to +6 percentage points, with no consistent pattern across agents or variants. Agents differ sharply in what they tell the developer about the file. Claude Code names it in about two thirds of its final messages, whereas OpenCode mentions it almost exclusively in its reasoning trace, not in the final message the developer reads. Flagging the file as an attack does not reliably protect the code, as such agents still generated vulnerable code. We outline the larger studies needed to quantify this risk across agents and to design defenses.

AI.tldr: 将 coding agent 的项目记忆文件（如 CLAUDE.md）视为攻击面，用 12 个 CWE 类别、两种恶意变体和 36 个 SecRepoBench 任务测试 Claude Code 与 OpenCode，发现恶意记忆文件对安全完成率影响有限（-8 至 +6 个百分点，无一致规律），但不同 agent 向开发者披露该文件影响的程度差异显著。
AI.motivation: 编码代理每次会话开始都会自动加载 CLAUDE.md 等项目记忆文件并视为可信指导，任何能修改该文件的人（如通过 pull request）即可在不触碰开发者提示词的情况下操纵代理。作者据此把记忆文件当作不安全代码生成的攻击面，提出两个问题：(1) 恶意记忆文件能否让代理产出通过测试但存在漏洞的代码；(2) 代理是否会告知开发者该文件影响了其代码。
AI.method: 针对 12 个 CWE 类别各构造两个恶意记忆文件：qualified 变体将移除防御性检查包装为工程最佳实践，forceful 变体则直接要求移除。在 36 个 SecRepoBench 任务上，分别在有/无这些文件的条件下运行 Claude Code（Sonnet 5.5）和 OpenCode（Qwen 3.8 27B、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash），比较安全完成率并分析代理的最终消息与推理轨迹中的披露行为。
AI.result: 恶意文件使安全完成率变化 -8 至 +6 个百分点，跨代理与变体均无一致规律。披露行为差异明显：Claude Code 约三分之二的最终消息提及该文件，而 OpenCode 几乎只在推理轨迹中提到，最终呈交给开发者的消息不提。将文件标记为攻击也不能可靠保护代码，此类代理仍会生成漏洞代码。
AI.conclusion: 记忆文件作为攻击面对漏洞生成的实际影响在该设置下有限且不稳定，但代理对影响披露的不透明性构成被低估的风险；标记为攻击不足以防护。作者提出需开展更大规模研究以跨代理量化该风险并设计防御措施。

title: What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine
summary: Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations spanning convolutional, transformer-based, self-supervised, and image-text aligned models, we evaluate image-to-image retrieval and image-to-dish neighborhoods, examining culinary-family structure, contrast cases, and cross-representation agreement. We also aggregate image representations to compare dish-level visual similarity across models and against recipe-derived similarity for the same dishes. Image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations, including similarities across culinary-family boundaries. At the dish level, aggregation reveals common visual structure despite local variation, but this structure corresponds less strongly with recipe-derived similarity. These findings show that recognition performance alone cannot characterize relational structure: food similarity depends on representation, modality, and abstraction level rather than being a fixed property of the food collection. Understanding these structures is therefore a prerequisite to combining multiple food information modalities into a coherent notion of similarity.

AI.tldr: 该文超越"身份识别"评估范式，考察七种预训练视觉表征如何组织食物相似性，发现图像级邻域随表征显著变化，菜品级聚合呈现共有的视觉结构但与食谱相似性对应较弱，说明食物相似性取决于表征、模态与抽象层级。
AI.motivation: 食物相似性支撑检索、推荐、替代等食物计算任务，但现有食物表征多以身份保持（identity preservation）为评估标准，忽视了相似性所隐含的关系结构。作者要回答：不同视觉表征如何将食物组织为关系邻域、这些邻域揭示或遮蔽何种烹饪关系、跨表征是否稳定。印度菜因"外观相似但烹饪身份不同、同一菜系家族外观差异大"而成为挑战性场景。
AI.method: 构建扩展版Khana数据集；采用七种预训练视觉表征（涵盖卷积网络、Transformer、自监督模型、图文对齐模型）；评估图像到图像检索与图像到菜品（image-to-dish）邻域，分析菜系家族结构、对比案例及跨表征一致性；并将图像表征聚合至菜品级，比较模型间菜品级视觉相似性与同一批菜品的食谱导出相似性。
AI.result: 图像级邻域在不同表征间差异显著，甚至出现跨越菜系家族边界的相似性；菜品级聚合揭示出局部变化之下共有的视觉结构，但该结构与食谱导出相似性的对应较弱。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭识别性能无法刻画关系结构；食物相似性并非食物集合的固定属性，而依赖表征、模态与抽象层级。理解这些结构是将多模态食物信息整合为一致相似性概念的前提。

title: Depth through Recurrence: Towards Ultra-Efficient On-Device ASR
summary: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems have achieved remarkable accuracy by scaling model depth and capacity, but at the cost of increased memory, energy, and computational demands. On edge devices where ASR is often most needed, such as watches and glasses, deploying such large models is infeasible due to extremely constrained resources. This raises a fundamental question: can we achieve high representational power in deep ASR models without scaling up parameterization? In this work, we revisit the role of depth and identify layer wise representational dynamics, in which most layers learn functionally similar transformations. Motivated by this insight, we propose a block-recurrent ASR architecture that replaces parameterized depth with a small set of recurrent blocks, each consisting of weight-shared layers, thereby preserving effective depth while drastically reducing model size. Through representation-guided grouping and knowledge distillation, block-recurrent models retain the accuracy of large reference models while using an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Across Open ASR Leaderboard benchmarks, a model with only two shared blocks recovers 97.4% of the accuracy of large models on average. The compact backbone further enables efficient on-device personalization through lightweight MoE-LoRA adaptation, allowing user-specific models to match or surpass the accuracy of general-purpose ASR systems with significantly lower inference cost. By reusing weights across recurrent steps, the proposed architecture reduces memory-access overhead and inference energy consumption. Together, these results show that high quality ASR can be achieved without large parameterization, and that structured recurrence provides a principled path towards ultra-compressed, energy-efficient, and personalized speech recognition on the edge.

AI.tldr: 提出"块递归"ASR架构：用小规模权重共享的递归块替代参数化深度，保留有效深度但大幅压缩模型，仅两个共享块即恢复大模型97.4%的平均精度，并支持边缘端MoE-LoRA个性化。
AI.motivation: 现代ASR依赖加深加宽换精度，导致内存、能耗与算力开销激增，难以部署在手表、眼镜等资源极受限的边缘设备上。核心问题：能否在不扩大参数量的前提下保持深层ASR模型的表征能力。
AI.method: 1) 分析深层ASR的逐层表征动态，发现多数层学习的是功能相似的变换，即深度存在冗余；2) 据此提出块递归架构：以少量递归块替代参数化深度，每块由权重共享层堆叠，从而在保持"有效深度"的同时显著减小模型尺寸；3) 采用表征引导的分组策略确定层与块的对应关系；4) 结合知识蒸馏从大参考模型迁移精度；5) 在紧凑骨干上使用轻量MoE-LoRA实现设备端个性化适配。
AI.result: 在Open ASR Leaderboard基准上，仅含两个共享块的模型平均恢复大模型97.4%的精度，参数量减少约一个数量级；基于MoE-LoRA的用户个性化模型可匹配甚至超越通用ASR系统精度，且推理成本显著更低；跨递归步复用权重降低了访存开销与推理能耗。
AI.conclusion: 高质量ASR无需大规模参数化即可实现；结构化递归为边缘端超压缩、高能效且可个性化的语音识别提供了有原则的设计路径。

title: CASH: A Capability-Aware Subsidy Harness for Advertiser Subsidy Allocation
summary: Advertising platforms subsidize advertisers through billing discounts, and Advertiser Subsidy Allocation (ASA) chooses a subsidy level for every account to maximize total discounted revenue under a platform-wide subsidy-rate constraint. In practice, operators configure these subsidies from business rules, advertiser tiers and operating goals. Such configuration draws on rich business experience, yet as the advertiser base grows, tier-level policies can neither resolve how individual accounts respond across subsidy levels nor allocate a shared budget at the granularity of single accounts. We propose CASH, a Capability-Aware Subsidy Harness for ASA. CASH pairs a knowledge-guided large language model (LLM) with a data-driven numerical response model, learns from realized outcomes where each is locally reliable across accounts and subsidy levels, and turns this reliability into explicit capability licenses that govern source selection, agent review and budget allocation. Its Expected Policy Coverage Gain (EPCG) directs a limited feedback budget toward evidence expected to expand high-value reliable coverage, and the resulting feedback further improves the numerical model and updates capability estimates. In a one-month online experiment with CASH serving 60% of a large-scale advertising platform's traffic, CASH raises revenue per account by 15.35% and ADVV by 19.86% over Control at an essentially unchanged subsidy rate, with further gains in revenue quality, LTV and retention.

AI.tldr: CASH 是一个“能力感知”的补贴调控框架，将知识引导的 LLM 与数据驱动的数值响应模型结合，通过显式“能力许可”机制在账户与补贴档位粒度上选择可靠信息源并分配反馈预算，实现大规模广告平台补贴的精细化配置。
AI.motivation: 现有 ASA（广告主补贴分配）在实践中依赖业务规则、广告主分层的经验性配置；随着广告主规模增长，分层策略既无法刻画单个账户对不同补贴档位的响应，也难以在单账户粒度下分配共享补贴预算。
AI.method: 提出 CASH（Capability-Aware Subsidy Harness）：(1) 将知识引导的 LLM 与数据驱动数值响应模型配对；(2) 基于实际结果学习二者在不同账户、不同补贴档位上的局部可靠性；(3) 将可靠性转化为显式“能力许可”，用于信息源选择、智能体审核与预算分配；(4) 以期望策略覆盖增益（EPCG）把有限反馈预算导向预期能扩展高价值可靠覆盖的证据，反馈再用于改进数值模型并更新能力估计。
AI.result: 在一个大型广告平台的单月在线实验中，CASH 承接 60% 流量：相比对照组，单账户收入提升 15.35%，ADVV 提升 19.86%，补贴率基本不变，并在收入质量、LTV 与留存上进一步改善。
AI.conclusion: CASH 表明将 LLM 的领域知识先验与数值模型的实证响应能力通过可靠性许可机制融合，可在补贴率约束下显著提升平台收益与广告主长期价值，为大规模补贴决策提供可落地的细粒度方案。局限性在于对可靠性的估计依赖反馈预算，且实验覆盖为单月、单平台。

title: Repairs for Whom? Evaluator-Executor Mismatch in Selecting Repairs for Failed LLM Agents
summary: When an LLM agent fails, repair methods choose which action to replace and what to put in its place. They often score candidate repairs with greedy replay, a stronger model, an environment oracle, or a judge that reads the failed log. We ask whether these evaluators pick repairs that help the agent that will actually execute them. Holding failed trajectories and candidate single-step repairs fixed, we label every candidate with independent rollouts of the deployed policy and measure how much deployment value each evaluator's choice loses. On failures not screened for repair value, pre-specified tests show that greedy replay loses 0.08-0.13 in expected net success gain in ALFWorld and 0.06-0.13 in net reward in WebShop, relative to selection with the deployed agent's own rollouts. At an equal rollout budget, selecting repairs for Qwen2.5-7B with Qwen2.5-14B rollouts loses 0.25 in ALFWorld and 0.07 in WebShop, twenty 14B rollouts per candidate are worth no more than two of the 7B agent's own, and fresh rollouts confirm that the two models prefer opposite repairs on selected disagreement cases. Between similar-sized models from different families, the losses appear in both directions in both environments (0.07-0.17). The scoring executor also changes repair-location labels and method rankings. Repairs should be verified with the executor that will run them, and repair labels should name their executor.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验修复评估器（贪心回放、更强模型、环境oracle、日志判官）是否选出对"实际执行者"（部署策略）真正有益的修复，并证明它们会系统性地产生价值损失。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体失败后的修复方法需要决定替换哪个动作以及替换成什么，而现有方法常用贪心回放、更强模型、环境oracle或读日志的判官来给候选修复打分。作者质疑：这些评估器选出的修复是否真的有利于最终执行它的那个智能体。此前缺乏在固定失败轨迹与单步候选修复条件下、以部署策略真实回报为参照的系统性度量。
AI.method: 固定失败轨迹与候选单步修复，用部署策略的独立rollout为每个候选打"真实部署价值"标签，再测量各评估器所选修复的部署价值损失。在ALFWorld与WebShop上做预注册检验，比较贪心回放 vs 部署策略自身rollout的选择；在等rollout预算下比较用Qwen2.5-14B替代7B自身rollout；跨家族相似规模模型做双向检验；并考察评分执行者对修复定位标签与方法排名的影响。
AI.result: 在未筛选修复价值的失败样本上，贪心回放相对部署agent自身rollout的期望净成功增益损失0.08–0.13（ALFWorld），净奖励损失0.06–0.13（WebShop）。等预算下用14B给7B选修复损失0.25（ALFWorld）与0.07（WebShop）；每个候选20次14B rollout价值不高于7B自身2次rollout；在新rollout上确认两模型在分歧样本上偏好相反的修复。不同家族相似规模模型间两个方向均出现损失（0.07–0.17）。评分执行者还会改变修复定位标签与方法排名。
AI.conclusion: 修复必须用将来真正执行它的执行者来验证；修复标签与基准应显式标注其执行者。更强的模型或更贵的评估器并不能替代部署策略自身的rollout，替代会带来可测的部署价值损失并扭曲方法排名。

title: Verification Learning Theory: A Process Model of Checking and Retention in AI-Assisted Judgment
summary: Accurate AI assistance can improve immediate judgments while reducing opportunities to practise the operations needed for independent performance. Verification Learning Theory (VLT) formalises this possibility for claim-evaluation practice followed by correct, independent, rule-specific feedback. The model links perceived assistant reliability to evidence checking and links the history of those checks to retained rule use. Its strict form assumes that task demands and perceived reliability influence learning only through checking, with equal learning per genuine check. It therefore predicts that perceived fallibility can improve delayed unaided judgment even without observed assistant errors, and that this advantage disappears when checking is already required and performed. Rule-specific gains and forecasts from checking histories provide further tests. Simulations examine the consequences and parameter dependence of these commitments; they do not constitute empirical validation. Comparisons with depth-of-processing and feedback-encoding accounts identify where predictions diverge and where the accounts remain observationally equivalent. The framework specifies experiments that can test the proposed mechanism and separates retention of practised rules from the broader problem of recognising which rule applies to a new claim.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"验证学习理论"（VLT），形式化刻画"AI助手即时提升判断、却削弱独立操作练习"这一权衡：感知到的助手可靠性影响证据核查，核查历史影响规则保留。模拟检验其承诺与参数依赖性，并设计可证伪实验。
AI.motivation: 准确的AI协助能改善当下判断，但会减少用户练习独立完成任务所需操作的机会，从而可能损害延迟的、无协助的表现。作者希望为这一"即时收益—长期学习"的张力提供可形式化的机制解释，而非仅作经验性猜想。
AI.method: 以"主张评估练习 + 正确、独立、规则特异性的反馈"为情境构建VLT模型：将感知助手可靠性链接到证据核查行为，再将核查历史链接到规则使用保留。其严格形式假定任务要求与感知可靠性仅通过核查影响学习，且每次真实核查带来等量学习。通过模拟考察理论承诺的后果与参数依赖性；与深度加工、反馈编码两种解释进行比较以定位预测分歧点与观察等价区间；并提出可检验该机制的实验设计。
AI.result: 严格形式给出若干可证伪预测：①即便未观察到助手犯错，感知到的易错性也可提升延迟的无协助判断；②当核查已被强制要求且实际执行时，该优势消失；③规则特异性收益及由核查历史作出的预测构成额外检验。模拟结果仅展示理论承诺的内部后果与参数依赖，不构成经验验证。深度加工与反馈编码解释在部分情形下与VLT预测分歧，在另一些情形下观察等价。
AI.conclusion: VLT为"AI协助的即时收益与独立学习损失"提供统一机制框架，并明确区分"已练习规则的保留"与"识别新主张适用哪条规则"这一更广泛问题；其价值在于生成可证伪预测与实验方案，尚待实证检验。

title: Improving Data-Constrained Scaling with Hyperparameter Transfer and Ensembling
summary: As growing compute budgets outpace the growth of high-quality training data, large language models must be trained with both compute and data constraints in mind. Unfortunately, existing prescriptions for data-constrained scaling suffer from two important limitations. First, past works hold key hyperparameters such as weight decay fixed with scale, despite the fact that optimal hyperparameters vary wildly with model size and number of epochs. Second, past works neglect ensembling, a promising axis for scaling under data constraints. As a surprising consequence, prior prescriptions can lead to loss that increases with compute budget. We address both limitations by fitting power laws that prescribe how to transfer hyperparameters with scale and scaling laws that prescribe how to allocate compute with ensembling. Training on 100M tokens from FineWeb, our recipe reduces validation loss by over 0.15 nats compared to prior recipes, a 14% decrease in perplexity, and achieves monotonic improvements with compute through ensembling. These gains are achieved using prescriptions fit to smaller runs and validated at up to 12$\times$ larger compute budgets.

AI.tldr: 针对数据受限场景下的LLM缩放，本文提出随规模迁移超参数（尤其是权重衰减）的幂律，以及包含集成（ensembling）的计算分配缩放律，二者结合在FineWeb 100M token上相较既有配方将验证损失降低>0.15 nats（困惑度下降14%），并实现随算力单调改善。
AI.motivation: 算力预算增长快于高质量训练数据的增长，因此LLM训练需同时考虑算力与数据约束。既有数据受限缩放配方存在两点缺陷：(1) 将权重衰减等关键超参数随规模固定，而最优超参数随模型大小与训练epoch数显著变化；(2) 忽略集成这一数据受限下颇具潜力的缩放维度。其结果是既有配方可能导致损失随算力预算增加而上升。
AI.method: 拟合两类规律：一是刻画超参数如何随规模迁移的幂律（power laws for hyperparameter transfer with scale）；二是刻画如何在集成分配上分配算力的缩放律（scaling laws for compute allocation with ensembling）。配方由较小规模运行拟合，并在最多12倍更大的算力预算上验证；实验在FineWeb的100M token数据上训练。
AI.result: 相比既有配方，验证损失降低超过0.15 nats，困惑度相对下降14%，且通过集成实现对算力的单调改善；增益在由小规模拟合、外推至12倍算力时仍然成立。
AI.conclusion: 在数据受限的缩放设定下，显式建模超参数随规模的迁移并纳入集成维度，可显著优于忽略二者的既有配方，避免损失随算力增加而变差，为数据与算力双重约束下的训练提供可外推的实用配方。

title: PFA: Attention Can Be Progressively Focused in Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
summary: Long user behavioral sequences improve the performance of generative recommendation (GR), but computing full attention over long histories during autoregressive beam search decoding incurs substantial online inference latency. To accelerate long-sequence decoding, existing approaches typically rely on static history compression or dynamic top-k sparse attention; however, the former risks losing critical semantics, whereas the latter incurs significant overhead from repeated token selection and non-contiguous memory access. In this work, we thoroughly analyze attention patterns during GR decoding and reveal two key properties: (i) progressive attention focusing, where attention progressively focuses on a small subset of critical historical tokens; and (ii) cross-step ranking consistency, where their importance rankings remain relatively stable across subsequent decoding steps. Motivated by these observations, we propose Progressively Focused Attention (PFA), an efficient sparse decoding framework for long-sequence GR. PFA retains full attention at the initial decoding step to explore global historical preferences. It then establishes a shared importance ranking through cross-beam weighted aggregation and reorders the key-value cache of the selected tokens into a contiguous memory layout. Subsequent decoding steps reuse this ranking and geometrically reduce the token budget, preserving critical semantics while lowering computational and memory access overhead. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks and a large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate that PFA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. A 7-day online A/B test on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform further confirms that PFA delivers substantial business gains while maintaining low inference latency. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PFA-review-088D.

AI.tldr: 提出PFA（渐进聚焦注意力），一种面向长序列生成式推荐的高效稀疏解码框架：首步全注意力建立共享重要性排序，后续步骤复用该排序并几何缩减token预算，KV cache重排为连续内存，兼顾语义保留与低延迟。
AI.motivation: 长行为序列提升生成式推荐（GR）性能，但自回归beam search解码中全注意力导致在线推理延迟高；静态历史压缩会丢失关键语义，动态top-k稀疏注意力则带来重复token选择与非连续内存访问的显著开销。
AI.method: 分析GR解码中的注意力模式，发现两点性质：(i) 渐进式注意力聚焦，注意力逐步集中于少量关键历史token；(ii) 跨步排序一致性，token重要性排序在后续解码步间相对稳定。据此设计PFA：初始解码步保留全注意力以探索全局历史偏好；通过跨beam加权聚合建立共享重要性排序，并将选中token的KV cache重排为连续内存布局；后续解码步复用该排序并按几何级数缩减token预算。
AI.result: 在两个公开基准和一个大规模工业数据集上优于SOTA基线；在大型电商广告平台进行7天在线A/B测试，取得显著业务收益且保持低推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 利用注意力渐进聚焦与跨步排序稳定性的观察，PFA以首步全注意力+排序复用+几何缩减预算+连续KV cache布局，实现长序列GR解码中语义保留与计算/访存开销降低的平衡，并经离线与在线实验验证有效性与工业可用性。

title: When LLM Architectures Meet Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection: a Replication Study
summary:
Smart contracts are immutable programs deployed on blockchain platforms, where vulnerabilities can translate directly into financial loss. Among the techniques proposed for their detection, recent work has relied increasingly on Large Language Models (LLMs) guided by carefully crafted prompts. However, the evidence accumulated so far rests almost entirely on the dense Transformer architecture behind the GPT line and on model snapshots already scheduled for deprecation, leaving open the question of whether the reported behaviors reflect a general property of LLMs or an artifact of that specific design.
  This paper presents an extended replication of the empirical study by Chen et al. on LLM-based smart contract vulnerability detection. We replicate the original protocol on GPT-4 as a baseline, followed by a differentiated replication, executing the protocol on representative models based on Mixture-of-Experts and RNN-like designs, together with an attempted preliminary evaluation of State Space Models. The exact replication confirms the findings of Chen et al., including the high-recall, low-precision detection pattern they report on GPT-4. Nevertheless, the differentiated replication shows that this pattern does not transfer uniformly across the evaluated models. Those from the same architectural family may also exhibit different behaviors, indicating that architectural family alone is insufficient to predict the resulting detection profile. We observe the same qualitative dense-Transformer profile in both GPT-4 and Gemma-3, despite a gap of roughly two orders of magnitude in parameter counts, whereas two Mixture-of-Experts models from different lineages exhibit qualitatively divergent behaviors, indicating that architectural family alone is insufficient to predict the detection profile.

AI.tldr: 本文对Chen等人关于LLM智能合约漏洞检测的实证研究进行扩展复现：在GPT-4上精确复现原始协议，并在MoE、类RNN架构及SSM模型上开展差异化复现。结果确认GPT-4的高召回低精确率模式，但该模式不能跨架构均匀迁移；同族模型行为可能不同，架构族本身不足以预测检测画像。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能合约漏洞检测的证据几乎全部来自GPT系列背后的稠密Transformer架构以及已列入弃用计划的模型快照，因此无法判断所报告的行为是LLM的普遍性质，还是特定架构设计的产物。
AI.method: 扩展性复现研究。首先在GPT-4上按原协议进行精确复现作为基线；随后进行差异化复现，在基于混合专家（MoE）与类RNN设计的代表性模型上执行同一协议，并尝试对状态空间模型（SSM）进行初步评估。
AI.result: 精确复现确认了Chen等人的结论，包括GPT-4上高召回、低精确率的检测模式；差异化复现显示该模式并未在所有被评估模型上一致迁移。GPT-4与Gemma-3虽参数量相差约两个数量级，却呈现相同的稠密Transformer定性画像；而来自不同谱系的两个MoE模型表现出定性上相互背离的行为。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能合约漏洞检测的行为不能仅由架构族推断；同一架构族内模型也可能表现不同，说明检测画像受架构族之外的多种因素影响，仅基于GPT系稠密Transformer的证据不足以推广到其他LLM。

title: The Anatomy of Socio-Demographics in Pluralistic Offensiveness Modeling: When and Where It Helps, and the Role of Reasoning
summary: Subjective judgments such as offensiveness often vary substantially across individuals, motivating pluralistic modeling approaches that incorporate annotators' socio-demographic information to capture this variation. However, prior findings on the benefits of socio-demographic information for pluralistic modeling are mixed, calling for a systematic analysis of both its effectiveness and the mechanisms through which it improves prediction. In this work, we study $\textbf{when}$ and $\textbf{where}$ socio-demographics benefit pluralistic offensiveness modeling, as well as $\textbf{the role of explicit reasoning}$ in leveraging this information. Across three multi-annotator datasets with prompted and trained LLMs, we first show that demographic gains are small and inconsistent for individual predictions but become clearer at the group and population levels, because aggregation attenuates the idiosyncratic variation that masks small but systematic demographic signals. Second, using a reasoning and prediction format that explicitly decomposes individual judgment into an overall baseline and a demographic-specific deviation, we show that the gains arise from both components: demographic information improves baseline estimation and enables meaningful demographic-specific shifts, and interventions show that better component estimates improve final predictions. Finally, comparing direct demographic conditioning with explicit reasoning about how the text interacts with annotator demographics, we find that reasoning yields more accurate baseline and shift estimates as well as final predictions, whereas conditioning alone rarely produces informative shifts. These results suggest that the mixed evidence in prior work may partly stem from individual-level evaluation, and that the value of socio-demographic information depends on both how it is evaluated and how models are guided to use it.

AI.tldr: 该文系统分析社会人口统计信息在多元冒犯性建模中何时、何处有效，以及显式推理的作用。
AI.motivation: 主观判断（如冒犯性）在个体间差异显著，已有引入标注者社会人口信息的多元建模结论不一，需系统分析其有效性及作用机制。
AI.method: 在三个多标注者数据集上，用提示式与训练式LLM，比较直接人口条件化与显式推理（将个体判断分解为总体基线与人口特定偏移）。
AI.result: 个体层面人口增益小且不稳定，群体与总体层面更清晰（聚合削弱个体化差异噪声）；增益来自基线估计提升与有效的人口特定偏移两方面；显式推理比直接条件化给出更准确的基线与偏移估计及最终预测。
AI.conclusion: 既有研究的混合证据或部分源于个体层面评估；社会人口信息的价值取决于评估层级与模型引导方式。

title: Interpretable neural equation learning for high-dimensional materials data
summary: Equation learning seeks to discover compact, interpretable equations from data using various machine-learning techniques. However, few workflows discover and interpret learned equations in sparse, high-dimensional materials datasets. We present nn-EQL, an equation-learning framework that generates candidate equations through iterative training, pruning, and retraining of a neural network with customizable, user-specified neuron-level activation functions. Candidate equations are ranked using a minimum description length (MDL)-inspired score, balancing error and sparsity, and diagnosed to assess term-wise contributions, input-scaled sensitivities, and uncertainties. We demonstrate nn-EQL on standard AI-Feynman benchmarks as well as multiscale high-dimensional materials datasets such as finite-element simulations of heterogeneous materials, and high-throughput experimental thin-film deposition data. nn-EQL integrates with tabular data and high-dimensional data via standard encoder models, learning equations and providing insight into learned terms. Looking forward, integrating physically interpretable representations, multimodal and multi-fidelity data, and adaptive data acquisition could enable equation learning to formulate and test mechanistic hypotheses.

AI.tldr: nn-EQL：通过迭代训练-剪枝-重训练的自定义激活函数神经网络生成候选方程，以MDL启发评分排序并做项贡献、输入缩放敏感性与不确定性诊断，适用于稀疏高维材料数据。
AI.motivation: 现有方程学习多面向低维、稠密数据，鲜有工作流能在稀疏、高维材料数据集中既发现又可解释所学方程，缺乏对项级贡献与不确定性的系统诊断。
AI.method: 提出nn-EQL框架：以可定制的神经元级激活函数构建神经网络，通过迭代训练、剪枝与重训练生成候选方程；用受最小描述长度（MDL）启发的评分在误差与稀疏性间权衡以排序候选；并对方程进行诊断，评估逐项贡献、输入缩放敏感性与不确定性；通过标准编码器接入表格与高维数据。
AI.result: 在标准AI-Feynman基准及多尺度高维材料数据集（异质材料有限元模拟、高通量实验薄膜沉积数据）上验证，nn-EQL能学习方程并给出对所学项的洞察。
AI.conclusion: nn-EQL为稀疏高维材料数据提供了可解释的方程学习与诊断流程；未来可通过引入物理可解释表示、多模态与多保真数据及自适应数据采集，推动方程学习用于机制假说的构建与检验。

title: Federated Recommender Agents
summary: LLM-powered recommender agents use reasoning and memory for personalization, but centralized access to user information raises privacy concerns, while isolated agents cannot learn from others' experiences. We formulate Federated Recommender Agents, a setting where local agents collaborate through natural-language knowledge while keeping interaction histories and personal memories local. We propose FedRecAgent, which enables this collaboration without updating LLM parameters. Its central challenge is determining which reasoning to integrate, since similar behavioral contexts can lead to different choices. FedRecAgent represents local experiences as Condition-Transition-Reasoning (C-T-R) units and hierarchically integrates reasoning by condition and transition. Within this structure, it consolidates related explanations and discriminates reasoning across alternative transitions. Each client maintains semantic and decision memories to capture preferences and conditional choice tendencies, guiding the retrieval and selection of shared reasoning for recommendation. Experiments across three domains under dense and sparse settings demonstrate improved recommendation performance over federated and LLM-based baselines, while ablations support the contributions of personalized memories and structured reasoning integration.

AI.tldr: 提出联邦推荐智能体（Federated Recommender Agents）设定与FedRecAgent方法：本地智能体在不共享交互历史与个人记忆、不更新LLM参数的前提下，通过自然语言知识协作，以C-T-R单元结构化整合推理解释，并借助语义记忆与决策记忆指导共享推理的检索与选择。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的推荐智能体借助推理与记忆实现个性化，但集中式访问用户信息带来隐私问题，而完全孤立的智能体又无法相互学习经验。因此需要一种既能保护本地交互历史与个人记忆、又能实现跨客户端知识协作的联邦式方案。
AI.method: 将本地经验表示为条件-转移-推理（Condition-Transition-Reasoning, C-T-R）单元，按条件与转移两个层级进行层次化推理整合：在同一结构下合并相关解释，并区分不同转移下的推理。每个客户端维护语义记忆与决策记忆，分别刻画偏好与条件性选择倾向，用于指导共享推理的检索与选择。整个过程不更新LLM参数。
AI.result: 在三个领域的稠密与稀疏设定下，推荐性能优于联邦学习类与LLM类基线；消融实验支持个性化记忆与结构化推理整合两者的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言层面的知识协作可在参数不变的条件下实现联邦推荐智能体之间的经验共享；关键在于对"整合哪些推理"的结构化判别，而非简单聚合，个性化记忆是该判别得以有效运作的必要支撑。

title: The Reality Gap in Automated Driving Systems Testing: Landscape, Challenges, and Research Directions
summary: Simulation is essential for testing automated driving systems (ADS), but discrepancies between simulation and reality can undermine testing conclusions. It remains unclear which discrepancies the literature addresses and what evidence supports correspondence claims. We present a systematic mapping of 235 primary studies that measure or mitigate the reality gap in ADS testing, selected from 4,195 publications. We characterise objectives, targets, approaches, experimental setups, and evaluation evidence. Our classification distinguishes simulated and real-world execution across six ADS test components, separately for each approach and its evaluation reference. This distinguishes real-world information used to construct an approach from evidence used to evaluate its claims. Of the included studies, 76% address mitigation, primarily targeting scenario and actor realism and perception, while 94% report validation or measurement procedures. Only 61 studies report metrics from multiple families covering sensor/perception correspondence, ADS behaviour, vehicle dynamics, or safety outcomes; this coverage does not establish causal links between discrepancies and test verdicts. The synthesis highlights that real-world content and physical execution must be interpreted against the claim evaluated. The findings motivate claim-specific evaluation and component-level reporting to establish which discrepancies affect testing conclusions and when simulation evidence supports conclusions about real-world ADS behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文对235项测量或缓解自动驾驶系统(ADS)测试"现实鸿沟"的一手研究进行系统性映射，区分各方法构建所用的真实世界信息与其结论评价所用的证据，指出多数研究聚焦缓解与验证但缺乏对差异与测试结论因果关系的证据。
AI.motivation: 仿真对ADS测试至关重要，但仿真与现实之间的差异（reality gap）可能削弱测试结论的有效性。文献中究竟处理了哪些差异、又有何证据支撑"仿真与现实对应"的主张，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 从4,195篇文献中筛选出235项测量或缓解ADS测试现实鸿沟的一手研究，进行系统性映射；刻画其目标、对象、方法、实验设置与评价证据。按六个ADS测试组件区分仿真执行与真实世界执行，并针对每种方法及其评价参照分别归类，从而将"用于构建方法的真实信息"与"用于评价其主张的证据"区分开来。
AI.result: 76%的研究聚焦缓解，主要针对场景与交通参与者真实性和感知；94%报告了验证或测量流程。仅61项研究报告了覆盖多族指标（传感器/感知对应性、ADS行为、车辆动力学或安全结果）的度量；这种覆盖并不能建立差异与测试判定之间的因果联系。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界内容与物理执行必须结合所评价的具体主张来解读。研究结果支持采用"主张特定的评价"与"组件级报告"，以确定哪些差异会影响测试结论，以及仿真证据何时能支持关于真实世界ADS行为的结论。

title: FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision
summary: Public disclosure repositories such as SEC EDGAR support informed investment through web access to corporate filings. Supporting their review with language model agents requires discovering unstated deficiencies across related documents, acquiring missing company facts, and verifying that requested revisions satisfy evidence-backed requirements. Existing financial question-answering evaluations provide limited evidence of these interactive capabilities. We introduce \textbf{FilingLoop}, an interactive benchmark and a self-evolving agent framework for corporate disclosure review and revision. Grounded in historical U.S.\ Securities and Exchange Commission correspondence, FilingLoop reconstructs 380 predominantly IPO review tasks from 96 companies under distinct information constraints. An evaluator separate from the acting agents scores final filings and responses against 6,099 eligible requirements and audits unsupported claims and harmful revisions. Our framework couples iterative review and revision within each case with procedural learning across cases, converting requirement-level evaluation feedback into role-specific guidance without updating model weights. Updates affect only subsequent cases, allowing procedural adaptation to be assessed without retrying scored tasks. On the evaluated stream, evolution increases requirement fulfillment from 24.28\% to 27.96\% and full comment resolution from 16.90\% to 20.75\%, with a 5.8\% increase in total cost over the fixed-policy variant. FilingLoop connects the concerns an agent discovers with the company facts it obtains and the revisions it commits, providing requirement-level feedback for procedures used in later review tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出FilingLoop——面向企业信息披露审阅与修订的交互式基准及自进化智能体框架，基于SEC历史往来函件重构96家公司380个以IPO为主的审阅任务，以6,099条资格性要求进行评分，并通过跨案例的程序性学习提升需求满足率。
AI.motivation: SEC EDGAR等披露库虽可支持投资决策，但用语言模型智能体辅助审阅需具备三类能力：在关联文档中发现未被明示的缺陷、获取缺失的公司事实、验证所请求的修订满足有证据支撑的要求。现有金融问答评测难以体现这些交互能力。
AI.method: 构建FilingLoop基准：以历史SEC意见函往来为素材，在差异化信息约束下重建96家公司共380个审阅任务；由独立于执行智能体的评估器基于6,099条资格性要求对最终申报文件与回复打分，并审计无依据主张与有害修订。框架层面将单案例内的迭代审阅—修订与跨案例的程序性学习耦合，把要求级评估反馈转化为角色专属指导，不更新模型权重；更新仅影响后续案例。
AI.result: 在评测流上，进化使要求满足率由24.28%提升至27.96%，评论完全解决率由16.90%提升至20.75%，总成本相对固定策略变体增加5.8%。
AI.conclusion: FilingLoop建立了智能体发现的关注点、获取的公司事实与所做修订之间的连接，并提供要求级反馈以指导后续审阅任务中的程序，为评估智能体的交互式披露审阅能力提供了可复现路径。

title: SAC-GCL: Structure-Aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning
summary: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) has achieved remarkable success in self-supervised representation learning by maximizing agreement between augmented views of a graph. Although augmented view generation is the central step in GCL, existing models rely on stochastic augmentation of the input graph, such as edge perturbation and node masking, which lack structural awareness and frequently destroy critical topology or introduce semantically inconsistent views. While recent adaptive methods improve upon random perturbations, they primarily operate on localized node or edge neighborhoods and fail to capture higher-order, macro-level structural organization crucial for graph classification. To address this limitation, we propose Structure-aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning (SAC-GCL), a novel framework that employs structural decomposition and graph compression as a principled view generation strategy. Moving beyond random augmentations, SAC-GCL leverages structural decomposition techniques to extract cohesive subgraphs and condense them into supernodes, constructing coarsened graph views that preserve local density and capture higher-level structural patterns while reducing noise and redundancy. We leverage multiple cohesive subgraph models to derive complementary views of the graph, each capturing distinct structural properties. To capture multi-resolution information, a hierarchical view encoder processes these compressed views by initializing super-node features with shared-weight cohesive subgraph embeddings. Our results from extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that structure-aware compression provides a powerful alternative to random perturbations, yielding more robust and discriminative graph representations for graph classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAC-GCL，用结构分解与图压缩作为视图生成策略，替代随机扰动，为图分类学习更鲁棒、更有判别力的表示。
AI.motivation: 现有图对比学习依赖随机增强（边扰动、节点掩码），缺乏结构感知，常破坏关键拓扑或引入语义不一致视图；近期自适应方法仍局限于局部节点/边邻域，无法捕捉对图分类至关重要的高阶宏观结构组织。
AI.method: SAC-GCL采用结构分解提取内聚子图并压缩为超节点，构造保持局部密度、捕捉高层结构模式的粗化图视图；利用多种内聚子图模型生成互补视图；并用层次化视图编码器处理压缩视图，以共享权重的内聚子图嵌入初始化超节点特征，实现多分辨率建模。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，结构感知压缩可作为随机扰动的有力替代，为图分类任务产生更鲁棒、更具判别力的图表征。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知压缩优于随机扰动，是一种有效的GCL视图生成范式，可捕捉宏观结构组织并降低噪声与冗余。

title: Does the Citation Matter? Quality, Grounding, and Physician-Rubric Accuracy of Google's AI Overviews for Medical Information
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/SamAgnoli/AIOverviews
summary: Google's AI Overviews (AIOs) are the first result users encounter when searching the web, shifting the work of selecting and evaluating sources from the user to Gemini. This may be especially consequential for health information, given that Google's traditional algorithm was designed to prioritize quality sources, and inaccurate information carries health risks. We evaluated 3,611 benchmark health questions, comparing each AIO against that question's top five traditional results on source selection and quality. We also evaluated the AIOs' statement grounding in their cited sources and how accurate AIOs were against physician-written rubrics. Overviews appeared for 96.4% of questions but drew on substantially different evidence than traditional search: only 44.4% of the top five results were cited by the corresponding AIO, which instead overrepresented commercial health publishers (e.g., WebMD, Healthline) at the expense of academic and government sources (e.g., Cleveland Clinic, National Health Service). AIO-cited pages scored lower than traditional results on four of six well-established credibility criteria. The grounding of AIO statements to their sources was poor: after correcting for classifier error, an estimated 56.7% of cited statements were supported by their cited page, and a further 20.8% of all statements were factual claims with no citation at all. When AIOs were graded against physicians' rubrics, they earned 38.2% of all available points (e.g., accuracy 54.2%, completeness 21.6%), and among the subset of AIOs whose physician rubric anticipated a specific inaccurate or potentially harmful claim, 22.2% of AIOs contained the harmful content. Notably, the accuracy of AIOs was unrelated to the grounding of their statements. We recommend AIO literacy interventions for users and holding AIOs at least to Google's own health-ranking standards.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评测了 Google AI Overviews（AIOs）在健康信息场景下的来源选择、来源质量、陈述溯源与准确性：AIOs 覆盖 96.4% 的健康问题，但所引证据与传统搜索显著不同，偏好商业健康媒体、贬抑学术与政府来源，引用页面在六项可信度标准中的四项上更差，仅约 56.7% 的引用陈述获其来源支持，另有 20.8% 的事实性陈述完全无引用；按医生评分量规仅得 38.2% 的分值，且在医生预判存在有害内容的子集中，22.2% 的 AIO 确实含有该有害内容。
AI.motivation: AIOs 作为搜索结果首位直接面向用户，把"选源与评估"的工作从用户转移到 Gemini，这在健康信息领域后果尤为重大：Google 传统排序算法本以优先高质量来源为设计目标，而健康信息失准会带来实际健康风险。因此需要实证检验 AIO 是否延续了传统搜索的来源质量保障，以及其陈述是否真正被引用来源支撑、内容是否准确。
AI.method: 构建 3,611 个基准健康问题的评测集。对每个问题：（1）将 AIO 与同一问题传统搜索前五结果在来源选择与来源质量上对比，采用六项公认可信度标准评分；（2）评估 AIO 陈述对其引用来源的"溯源/支撑度"（grounding），并对分类器误差进行校正；（3）由医生撰写评分量规（rubric），对 AIO 的准确性与完整性打分，并预设特定错误或潜在有害论断，检验 AIO 是否复现该类内容。
AI.result: 96.4% 的问题出现 AIO；仅 44.4% 的传统前五结果被对应 AIO 引用；AIO 过度代表商业健康出版方（如 WebMD、Healthline），而挤占学术与政府来源（如 Cleveland Clinic、NHS）。AIO 引用页面在六项可信度标准中的四项得分低于传统结果。溯源质量差：校正后估计仅 56.7% 的引用陈述获得其引用页面支持，另有 20.8% 的陈述属无任何引用的事实性论断。按医生量规，AIO 仅获得全部可得分的 38.2%（准确性 54.2%，完整性 21.6%）；在医生预判含特定错误或潜在有害论断的子集中，22.2% 的 AIO 包含该有害内容。此外，AIO 的准确性与陈述溯源程度不相关。
AI.conclusion: AIOs 在健康信息上并未继承传统搜索的来源质量取向：来源结构偏向商业媒体、引用页面可信度偏低、陈述溯源薄弱且准确性不足，且准确性无法由溯源水平推断。作者建议开展面向用户的 AIO 素养干预，并要求将 AIO 至少置于 Google 自身健康信息排序标准之下加以约束。

title: Write Once, Instrument Anywhere: Portable, Sandboxed Tooling with WebAssembly Components
summary:
Monitoring and debugging deployed software is crucial for scalability, performance, and robustness. Cross-cutting concerns are pervasive across software ecosystems, yet engineers must address them with a fragmented toolbox. While high-level frameworks exist to offer application-level types and semantics, they often lock a solution into specific languages, runtimes, or hardware architectures. Portability often forces engineers to choose lower-level instrumentation mechanisms. For example, in-language frameworks can trace a request across processes, but multi-language contexts require instrumentation at the boundary, for example using eBPF. While these frameworks provide powerful capabilities, they often result in 1) a tradeoff between application-level types or low-level bytes and packets, 2) non-composable domain-specific tools, 3) feature fragmentation across frameworks, and 4) tools that often run with unrestricted access to the program and its environment.
  We address these problems with Splicer, a WebAssembly component interposition framework that 1) provides semantically rich application-level types, 2) enables pluggable tooling with powerful capabilities, 3) reduces ecosystem fragmentation through porting across languages and hardware, and 4) confines each tool to a sandbox with explicitly granted permissions. We evaluate Splicer on a suite of benchmarks demonstrating the pluggability of non-trivial tooling written in multiple source languages and their performance.

AI.tldr: Splicer 是一个基于 WebAssembly 组件拦截（interposition）的可观测与调试框架，提供语义丰富的应用级类型、可插拔工具、跨语言/跨硬件可移植性，并通过沙箱与显式授权隔离每个工具。
AI.motivation: 已部署软件的监控与调试对可扩展性、性能和鲁棒性至关重要；横切关注点普遍存在，但工程师只能用碎片化工具箱应对。高层框架虽提供应用级类型与语义，却将方案绑定于特定语言、运行时或硬件；为可移植性往往退回底层插桩。例如语言内框架可跨进程追踪请求，多语言环境则需在边界处用 eBPF 插桩。结果导致四点问题：1）应用级类型与底层字节/数据包之间的取舍；2）领域专用工具不可组合；3）跨框架功能碎片化；4）工具常以不受限权限访问程序及其环境。
AI.method: 提出 Splicer——一种 WebAssembly 组件拦截框架：1）提供语义丰富的应用级类型；2）支持具备强大能力的可插拔工具；3）通过跨语言与跨硬件移植降低生态碎片化；4）将每个工具限制在沙箱中，仅授予显式权限。
AI.result: 在一组基准测试上评估 Splicer，展示了以多种源语言编写的非平凡工具的可插拔性及其性能表现。
AI.conclusion: Splicer 通过 Wasm 组件拦截统一了可观测/调试工具的开发与部署，兼顾语义表达力、可组合性、可移植性与安全性，缓解了传统框架在类型抽象、工具碎片化与权限隔离方面的不足。

title: Beyond Low-Pass Dynamics: Frequency-Selective Spiking Reservoirs with Resonant Neurons
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 30 pages (10 main text), 4 figures. Code: https://github.com/AuroraMicheli/HRF-Res
summary: Spiking reservoir computing combines the training efficiency of fixed recurrent reservoirs with the energy efficiency of event-driven inference, where computation is triggered by sparse spikes rather than executed densely at every timestep. However, existing spiking reservoirs almost exclusively rely on Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons, whose low-pass dynamics limit their ability to distinguish information encoded at different temporal frequencies. We introduce HRF-Res, a liquid state machine in which LIF neurons are replaced by a heterogeneous population of Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire (HRF) neurons. These neurons exhibit intrinsic oscillatory dynamics and selectively respond to input frequencies, enabling the reservoir to capture frequency-specific temporal patterns. The result is more discriminative representations and higher classification accuracy than LIF-based reservoirs, achieved without sacrificing the energy efficiency of spiking computation, with up to 19x lower energy consumption than an equivalent non-spiking oscillatory reservoir. Evaluated on ten benchmarks spanning time series, sequential images, audio spike trains, and neuromorphic vision, HRF-Res achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among spiking reservoir methods. These results demonstrate that introducing frequency-selective dynamics into spiking reservoirs improves representational quality and classification performance while preserving their inherent energy efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 HRF-Res：用异构的谐振-发放（HRF）神经元群体替换 LIF 神经元构成的液体状态机，使脉冲储备池具备频率选择性动力学，在保持脉冲计算能效的同时提升表征判别性与分类精度。
AI.motivation: 脉冲储备池计算兼具固定递归储备池的训练高效性与事件驱动推理的能效，但现有脉冲储备池几乎全部依赖 LIF 神经元，其低通滤波动力学难以区分不同时间频率上编码的信息，限制了表征判别力。
AI.method: 构建液体状态机 HRF-Res，将 LIF 神经元替换为异构的 Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire（HRF）神经元群体；该神经元具有内在振荡动力学并对输入频率选择性响应，使储备池能够捕获频率特异的时序模式。
AI.result: 在时间序列、序列图像、音频脉冲序列与神经形态视觉共十个基准上，HRF-Res 取得脉冲储备池方法中的 SOTA 精度；相比等价的非脉冲振荡储备池能耗最高降低 19 倍，且不牺牲脉冲计算能效。
AI.conclusion: 在脉冲储备池中引入频率选择性动力学可提升表征质量与分类性能，同时保持其固有的能效优势。

title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report
comment: 39 pages, 4 figures, 17 tables. Models and benchmark data: https://huggingface.co/Lernex
summary: Metis is a bet that better data, better training methods and new architectures can buy what a bigger parameter count cannot, at a fraction of the cost. Metis-1.6 is its latest step: two language models built from scratch by a single researcher, Praxis (2.94B parameters, 0.46B active per pass) and Logos (10.23B parameters, 1.18B active per pass). Both run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention mixture-of-experts stack twice for every token, so each token gets a second look. Each was trained on 1.02T tokens in total: 804.76B of pretraining, 18B of context extension to 131,072 tokens, and 200B of supervised fine-tuning. Metis-1.6 was never meant to challenge frontier models, and across 40 post-trained benchmarks it mostly does not: Logos averages 52.93, seventh of 17 models in its comparison set and within a point of Qwen3-4B. But it gets there on roughly a twelfth of the median training data of the comparators that disclose it, and with fewer active parameters per token than any model that beats it, which puts it on the Pareto frontier for both. In mathematics it ranks second of 30 models, with 67.50% on AIME 2025 and 63.64% on HMMT February 2026. It is weak at code, instruction following and long context. The rest of the report is the part I found most valuable: what went wrong. The optimizer I configured never ran, and attention trained with AdamW for all of pretraining. A 1.77B-parameter n-gram memory learned to switch itself off. Five fine-tuning choices cost capability. And a length reward under group-mean normalization punished correct solutions for being long once a group's pass rate passed 2/3, a sign inversion I prove and fix with a one-line clamp. I close with the 10B-token ablations behind MoRE (Mixture of Recursive Experts), the looped architecture of Metis-1.7.

AI.tldr: Metis-1.6 是单个研究者从零训练的两个 MoE 语言模型（Praxis 2.94B 总参/0.46B 激活，Logos 10.23B 总参/1.18B 激活），采用 Mamba-2 与注意力的混合 MoE 堆栈并对每个 token 重复计算两遍。二者各训练 1.02T tokens，在 40 个后训练基准上有 52.93 的均分，主要贡献在于以极小的训练数据量和激活参数占据帕累托前沿，并诚实记录了训练中的失败与修复。
AI.motivation: 作者押注"更好的数据、训练方法和新架构"能在远低于参数规模的成本下换取能力，而非单纯堆参数；目标是探索单研究者可负担的高效训练路径，而非挑战前沿模型。
AI.method: 架构：混合 Mamba-2 + 注意力 MoE，每个 token 通过堆栈两遍（循环计算）。规模：Praxis（2.94B 总参、0.46B 激活）、Logos（10.23B 总参、1.18B 激活）。训练：共 1.02T tokens，含 804.76B 预训练、18B 上下文扩展至 131,072 tokens、200B 监督微调。另报告 10B-token 消融支撑 MoRE（Mixture of Recursive Experts）递归专家混合架构。
AI.result: 40 个后训练基准上 Logos 均分 52.93，在其 17 模型对比集里排第 7，与 Qwen3-4B 相差不到 1 分；训练数据量约为披露数据对比模型中位数的十二分之一，且激活参数少于任何胜过它的模型，在两项指标上均处帕累托前沿。数学表现突出：30 个模型中排第 2，AIME 2025 得 67.50%，HMMT February 2026 得 63.64%。代码、指令遵循和长上下文较弱。
AI.conclusion: 论文最有价值的部分是失败记录：配置的优化器从未运行，预训练全程注意力用 AdamW 训练；1.77B 参数的 n-gram 记忆学会自我关闭；五个微调选择损害能力；在组均值归一化下的长度奖励在组通过率超过 2/3 后会惩罚正确但冗长的解，作者证明该符号反转并用一行 clamp 修复。后续工作为 Metis-1.7 的 MoRE 循环架构。

title: Try Before You Evolve: Ranking-Scored Trials for Recursive Self-Improvement of Recommender Systems
summary: Recommenders on Web platforms such as e-commerce and music streaming need their training recipes re-tuned for each dataset. Large language model (LLM) agents can now rewrite these recipes, enabling recursive self-improvement (RSI) of recommender systems. Existing agents propose one edit per round, fully retrain the recommender, and keep the edit only if its ranking quality improves. Unlike programs or patches that can be scored by execution, a recommender edit changes how the model is trained, which raises two challenges. First, ranking feedback is delayed: an edit's ranking quality is known only after full retraining, so much of the retraining budget goes to edits that are later discarded. Second, the signals available before retraining are unreliable: sampled training losses can look solved while full-ranking performance remains poor, and they are not comparable across edits that change the loss or sampler. We propose RecRSI, which generates diverse candidate edits from a diagnosis of the current model and selects one for full retraining using early ranking feedback: each candidate receives a short trial, the first steps of its full training run, scored by full-ranking NDCG@10 on held-out probe users. With two sequential recommenders on three datasets and the same number of full retrainings, RecRSI significantly outperforms existing self-evolving agents in every setting, and on both Amazon datasets reaches in its first round a ranking quality that none of them reaches in five.

AI.tldr: RecRSI通过"诊断生成候选编辑+短期试训的早期排序反馈"来选择编辑，在同等全量重训预算下显著优于现有自我进化智能体。
AI.motivation: Web推荐系统（电商、音乐流媒体）的训练配方需针对每个数据集重新调参；LLM智能体可改写配方以实现推荐系统的递归自我改进（RSI）。现有智能体每轮只提一个编辑并全量重训，仅当排序质量提升才保留。由于推荐系统编辑改变的是训练方式而非可直接执行打分的程序或补丁，存在两大挑战：一是排序反馈延迟，编辑的效果须待全量重训后才可知，大量重训预算浪费在最终被丢弃的编辑上；二是重训前可得信号不可靠——采样训练损失可能看似已解决而全排序性能仍差，且在不同损失或采样器的编辑间不可比。
AI.method: RecRSI从当前模型的诊断出发生成多样化候选编辑，并利用早期排序反馈挑选其中一个进行全量重训：每个候选先执行短试训（即其全量训练的前若干步），在留出的探针用户上以全排序NDCG@10打分，据此选择。
AI.result: 在两个序列推荐模型、三个数据集上，在全量重训次数相同的情况下，RecRSI在所有设置下均显著优于现有自我进化智能体；在两个Amazon数据集上，RecRSI首轮即达到的排序质量是其他方法五轮内均未达到的。
AI.conclusion: 用早期全排序反馈代替延迟且不可靠的训练损失信号来筛选候选编辑，可在相同重训预算下大幅提升推荐系统递归自我改进的效率与效果。

title: When Relevant Code Is Wrong: Runtime-Aware Context for AI Coding Agents
summary: AI coding agents increasingly rely on retrieved code and development history to guide software changes. However, highly relevant artifacts may describe implementations that are inactive or incompatible with the target deployment. Neither semantic similarity nor recency establishes whether retrieved information remains applicable under feature flags, architectural migrations, and deployment-specific configurations. We challenge relevance-oriented retrieval by introducing operational context validity, a task-, deployment-, and time-dependent criterion for determining whether software evidence can legitimately guide implementation decisions. We instantiate this new retrieval principle in CASE, an agent-agnostic framework that connects repository artifacts with runtime configurations and architectural evolution, classifies evidence as valid, invalid, or unknown, and generates context packages distinguishing actionable guidance from historical rationale and unresolved constraints. We investigate its feasibility through a reproducible preliminary evaluation involving six development tasks, 15 artifacts, and three deployments. Conventional retrieval exposes 16 incompatible artifact occurrences as actionable, whereas CASE excludes them while retaining all applicable artifacts under the prototype's reference rules. Recency filtering reduces valid recall to 0.43, while removing feature-flag evidence from CASE reduces it to 0.13. Although these results demonstrate feasibility rather than improvements in coding-agent correctness, they reveal limitations of relevance-based retrieval and motivate a new research direction: enabling coding agents to reason not only about which information is relevant, but also whether it remains operationally valid.

AI.tldr: 提出"操作上下文有效性(operational context validity)"这一新的检索原则，并以CASE框架实例化：将仓库工件与运行时配置、架构演进关联，把证据分类为有效/无效/未知并生成区分可执行指导与历史依据的上下文包，初步验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: AI编码代理依赖检索到的代码与开发历史指导变更，但高相关工件可能描述已失效或不兼容的实现。语义相似度与时效性都无法判断检索信息在特性开关、架构迁移、部署特定配置下是否仍适用，因此需要新的检索判据。
AI.method: 提出操作上下文有效性——一个依赖任务、部署与时间的判据；构建agent-agnostic的CASE框架，连接仓库工件与运行时配置及架构演进，将证据分类为valid/invalid/unknown，并生成区分可执行指导、历史依据与未解约束的上下文包；开展可复现的初步评估（6个任务、15个工件、3个部署）。
AI.result: 传统检索将16次不兼容工件出现误判为可执行；CASE在原型参考规则下将其全部排除且保留所有适用工件。时效性过滤使有效召回降至0.43；从CASE中移除特性开关证据使其降至0.13。
AI.conclusion: 结果仅证明可行性而非编码代理正确性的提升，但揭示了基于相关性检索的局限，并引出新研究方向：使编码代理不仅推理"信息是否相关"，还要推理"其是否仍在操作上有效"。

title: SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors. We introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark that converts scientific literature into structured scientific cards. Each card yields a pair of Original and dimensionally consistent Counterfactual environments with the same task interface. SciGame contains a Historical collection of canonical laws and a live Temporal collection curated from papers published after model knowledge cutoffs. It evaluates agents in candidate-guided Identification and open-ended Discovery settings. Each setting runs under Prior-only, Fixed, and Adaptive protocols.
