Experiments on five frontier models yield three findings. First, familiar priors hurt performance once the governing relation is altered. Second, adaptive experimentation helps the strongest models but harms weaker ones under limited budgets. Third, good explanations can hide quantitative failures. Recovering the exact symbolic form remains the main bottleneck, even when agents interpret evidence correctly. Current agents can investigate systems actively, but inducing exact laws in unfamiliar settings remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出SciGame基准，将科学文献转化为结构化"科学卡片"，每张卡片生成原始与量纲一致的"反事实"环境对照，评估LLM智能体从实验数据中归纳科学定律（识别与发现两种设定，Prior-only/Fixed/Adaptive三种协议）。
AI.motivation: 现有基准将定律推断与编程混淆、以数据拟合而非未见输入预测为评分标准、且未将经验证据与预训练先验分离，无法干净地衡量智能体真正的科学归纳能力。
AI.method: 构建SciGame受控基准：卡片含同任务接口的Original与量纲一致Counterfactual配对；设Historical（经典定律）与Temporal（模型知识截止后发表论文）两个集合；评估采用candidate-guided Identification与开放式Discovery两种设定，各在Prior-only、Fixed、Adaptive三种协议下运行，测试五个前沿模型。
AI.result: 三项发现：(1) 一旦支配关系被改变，熟悉的先验反而损害表现；(2) 自适应实验对最强模型有益，但在预算受限时对较弱模型有害；(3) 好的解释可能掩盖定量失败；即便证据解读正确，恢复精确符号形式仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体已能主动探究系统，但在陌生环境中诱导出精确定律仍是开放挑战；符号形式的精确恢复是核心难点。

title: TERRA: Task-Oriented Edge AI for Regional Fire Detection with Identity-Free Reporting
comment: Accepted for publication at the 16th International Conference on the Internet of Things (IoT 2026)
summary: Distributed fire-monitoring systems may involve many sensing devices reporting over a shared uplink, even though the operational objective is often to identify regions exhibiting evidence of fire rather than to recover device-specific measurements. We introduce TERRA (Task-Oriented Edge Representation and Regional Aggregation), an edge-AI framework that combines task-oriented local inference, identity-free region-tagged reporting, and permutation-invariant regional evidence aggregation. TERRA supports two reporting modes: TERRA-Score, in which each device communicates a quantized local fire probability, and TERRA-Feature, in which it communicates a compact learned representation for receiver-side aggregation using a permutation-invariant DeepSets model. Using all 15 numerical sensing modalities of the distributed indoor EN54 fire-alarm dataset as a proof-of-concept testbed, we evaluate regional inference for an episode-level fire-scenario target under repetition-disjoint three-fold cross-validation. We study representation size, task-payload quantization, report availability, and robustness to missed and false recovered messages. With nine reports and perfect message recovery, TERRA-Feature achieves mean AUPRC 0.990 using a 24-bit task payload, while TERRA-Score achieves 0.987 using only 6 bits; both attain an MDR of 1.81% at FAR $\leq$1%. TERRA-Feature achieves slightly higher AUPRC under reliable recovery, whereas the more compact TERRA-Score is less sensitive to increasing false-message contamination.

AI.tldr: 提出任务导向边缘AI框架TERRA，结合本地推理、免身份区域标签上报与置换不变区域证据聚合，在EN54火灾报警数据集上以极低任务载荷实现高精度区域级火灾场景判别。
AI.motivation: 分布式火灾监测系统中多设备共享上行链路，实际目标往往是识别存在火灾证据的区域，而非恢复每个设备的测量值，因此需要降低通信载荷、避免设备身份依赖，并保持对上报丢失/误报的鲁棒性。
AI.method: TERRA包含任务导向本地推理、免身份的区域标签上报和置换不变的区域证据聚合；两种模式：TERRA-Score上报量化本地火灾概率，TERRA-Feature上报紧凑学习表征并由接收端用置换不变的DeepSets聚合。使用EN54室内火灾报警数据集全部15种数值传感模态作为概念验证，在按重复片段不相交的三折交叉验证下评估区域级火灾场景目标，并考察表征尺寸、任务载荷量化、上报可用性及对漏报与误恢复消息的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 9条上报且消息完美恢复时，TERRA-Feature以24比特任务载荷取得平均AUPRC 0.990；TERRA-Score仅用6比特达到0.987；两者在FAR≤1%时MDR均为1.81%。可靠恢复条件下TERRA-Feature的AUPRC略高，而更紧凑的TERRA-Score对虚假消息污染增加更不敏感。
AI.conclusion: TERRA以任务导向、免身份、置换不变的区域聚合方式，在极低载荷下实现高精度区域火灾推断；TERRA-Feature偏向可靠链路下的精度上限，TERRA-Score则在受限带宽与噪声/污染信道中更具鲁棒性，二者可按链路条件权衡部署。

title: UGR: Unified Generative Ranking for Heterogeneous E-commerce Recommendation
summary: List-wise ranking in e-commerce recommendation must balance user utility and commercial value across organic content, ads, and candidates from other businesses, while modeling candidate interactions and sequential dependencies. Existing generative ranking methods typically learn from logged exposure sequences and operate on truncated candidate sets from a single business. Exposure-sequence learning may not fully exploit post-exposure feedback signals. Meanwhile, generative ranking over heterogeneous, multi-business candidates remains less explored, particularly when recommendation scores and advertising value must be jointly modeled under generalized second-price (GSP) auctions. We propose Unified Generative Ranking (UGR), which performs generative ranking over the full request-level multi-business heterogeneous candidate set, typically comprising around a thousand candidates in production, and directly generates multi-business ranking lists through candidate-aware autoregressive decoding. To go beyond exposure-sequence imitation, UGR introduces complementary feedback supervision through weighted supervised fine-tuning and permutation preference optimization, which respectively leverage observed post-exposure feedback and feedback-derived preferences among permutations. UGR uses a training-time advertising debiasing tower to model historical ad exposure effects and incorporates current ad value during serving while preserving the existing allocation and GSP pricing rules. Multi-value sequence retrieval produces candidate ranking lists, and the existing downstream evaluator selects the final list for exposure. Offline experiments demonstrate consistent gains in ranking quality, while online A/B tests on Taobao's Guess You Like recommendation service yield improvements of 1.76% in Core IPV, 3.29% in Transaction Volume, and 2.10% in GMV over the production baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出统一生成式排序框架UGR，在约千级请求级多业务异构候选集上直接生成排序列表，并以反馈监督增强与广告去偏塔在GSP拍卖规则下联合建模推荐分数与广告价值；淘宝线上A/B实现Core IPV +1.76%、交易量 +3.29%、GMV +2.10%。
AI.motivation: 电商列表级排序需在自然内容、广告及其他业务候选间平衡用户效用与商业价值，并建模候选交互与序列依赖。现有生成式排序多基于曝光序列学习、且局限于单一业务的截断候选集：曝光序列学习未能充分利用曝光后反馈信号；异构多业务候选上的生成式排序，尤其在GSP拍卖下联合建模推荐分数与广告价值的问题，研究不足。
AI.method: UGR在完整请求级多业务异构候选集（生产中约千级）上做生成式排序，通过候选感知的自回归解码直接生成多业务排序列表。为突破曝光序列模仿的局限，引入互补反馈监督：加权监督微调利用观测到的曝光后反馈，置换偏好优化利用由反馈导出的排列间偏好。训练期设置广告去偏塔建模历史广告曝光效应，服务期融入当前广告价值，同时保持既有分配与GSP定价规则。多价值序列检索生成候选排序列表，由既有下游评估器选出最终曝光列表。
AI.result: 离线实验在排序质量上取得一致提升；淘宝"猜你喜欢"在线A/B相对生产基线：Core IPV +1.76%，交易量 +3.29%，GMV +2.10%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了统一生成式排序在多业务异构候选与GSP拍卖约束下联合优化用户效用与商业价值的可行性与工业有效性，反馈监督与广告去偏设计可在不改变原有分配与定价机制的前提下带来显著业务收益。

title: Beyond Passing Tests: A Systematic Review and Controlled Re-evaluation of Techniques for Improving the Quality of LLM-Generated Code
comment: 55 pages, 5 figures, plus 120 pages of supplementary material
summary: Large language models pass most functional-correctness benchmarks, but passing tests says little about whether their code is readable, efficient or secure. Many techniques claim to improve these qualities, yet their evidence is scattered, usually covers one quality dimension and is rarely compared at an equal compute budget. We contribute a systematic review and a controlled re-evaluation. A systematic literature review of 628 primary studies (July 2021 to October 2026), with disclosed, author-reviewed LLM assistance, organizes the techniques by stage, signal source and quality target. Most studies measure only the dimension they target, gains often come with unchanged or unreported correctness, single automated quality signals are gamed, and compute, variance and contamination are rarely reported. A controlled re-evaluation runs ten techniques on four models at matched budgets on correctness, maintainability, efficiency and security benchmarks, extends it to thirteen current models and repository-level tasks, and compares 66 highlighted techniques head-to-head on Gemma 4 31B. At one call, quality prompting raises analyzer issue counts and leaves complexity and judge scores almost unchanged. At matched budgets, best-of-n sampling with an analyzer-weighted ranker matches or beats prompting, planning, self-refinement, a reviewer agent and retrieval on measures the ranker does not optimize, while an analyzer feedback loop and fine-tuning beat it only on analyzer issue counts. Large correctness losses on HumanEval+, a likely contaminated benchmark near its ceiling, do not appear on contests held after the models' training cutoffs. In the head-to-head, 1 of 66 techniques beats best-of-n on its primary target beyond the 95% interval, a rate consistent with chance. Gains should be reported against a budget-matched sampling baseline and on measures independent of the technique's own signal.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过系统综述（628篇原始研究）与受控再评估，检验各类"提升代码质量"技术的真实效果，发现多数增益仅体现在技术自身优化的指标上，且很少与同算力下的采样基线对比。
AI.motivation: LLM虽通过多数功能正确性基准，但测试通过并不代表代码可读、高效或安全。已有大量技术声称改善这些质量维度，但证据分散、通常只覆盖单一维度，且极少在同等算力预算下进行比较，因此需要系统性梳理与受控再评估。
AI.method: 1) 系统文献综述：覆盖2021年7月至2026年10月的628篇原始研究，在公开披露并经作者审核的LLM辅助下，按技术阶段、信号来源和质量目标进行归类；2) 受控再评估：在四个模型、匹配算力预算下对十种技术进行正确性、可维护性、效率与安全性基准测试，并扩展到十三个当前模型与仓库级任务；3) 在Gemma 4 31B上对66种被重点强调的技术进行正面对比。
AI.result: 单次调用下，质量提示（quality prompting）反而提高分析器问题计数，复杂度与评判分数几乎不变；在匹配预算下，带分析器加权排序的best-of-n采样在排序器未优化的指标上达到或超过提示、规划、自我精炼、评审代理与检索等方法，而分析器反馈回路和微调仅在分析器问题计数上占优；HumanEval+上的大幅正确性损失未在模型训练截止后举办的竞赛题目上出现（提示该基准可能已被污染且接近上限）；66种技术中仅1种在95%区间外超过best-of-n的主要目标，该比例与随机相当。
AI.conclusion: 多数质量提升技术的增益可在同等算力下由采样基线复现，且往往只体现在技术自身信号所优化的指标上。建议后续研究报告增益时须对照算力匹配的采样基线，并在与技术自身信号无关的度量上进行评估。

title: VerifiedLab: Harnessing Knowns for Unknowns
summary: Across human history, knowledge has undergone several transitions, from orality to writing and then to digital archives. At each transition, humans established new conventions to preserve knowledge for the new era. Nowadays, as research agents are increasingly deployed for laboratory experiments, knowledge is crossing another boundary: from records written for humans to those for machines. In this work, we introduce VerifiedLab, a multi-agent harness framework for this human-to-machine transition of knowledge. VerifiedLab transforms research output from passive artifacts into active systems that accelerate downstream use, adoption and prediction of future trends. In VerifiedLab, a team of AI scientists with distinct roles reasons over records verified field by field: a principal investigator plans, a librarian computes the evidence directly from the records, specialists draft, and a gate and a critic check each claim against the measured reliability of its data before the harness decides whether to release or withhold it. We demonstrate the efficacy of VerifiedLab through extensive experiments on perovskite solar cells: VerifiedLab recovers known physical trends, anticipates devices reported a year later, and lets AI scientists inherit the literature together with a measure of how far it can be trusted. By scaling the inference-time verification compute, VerifiedLab introduces a new pathway for knowledge dissemination and machine harness for AI co-scientists.

AI.tldr: 提出 VerifiedLab——面向"知识从人类记录转向机器记录"的多智能体校验框架，将研究产出从被动文档变为可被下游主动使用、并带可信度度量的系统，在钙钛矿太阳能电池上验证了其恢复已知规律、预测一年后器件与传递文献可信度的能力。
AI.motivation: 知识载体经历了口语→文字→数字档案的迁移，每次迁移都需建立新惯例。当前研究智能体大量参与实验，知识正跨越"为人类书写"到"为机器书写"的新边界，但现有研究产出仍是静态、被动、缺乏可信度标注的文档，无法被机器可靠继承与复用。
AI.method: 提出多智能体 harness 框架 VerifiedLab：由分工明确的 AI 科学家团队对逐字段校验过的记录进行推理——PI 负责规划，librarian 直接从原始记录计算证据，specialists 起草，gate 与 critic 依据数据的实测可靠性核查每条论断，最后由 harness 决定该知识是发布还是扣留（release/withhold）。通过扩展推理阶段的校验算力（inference-time verification compute）提升可靠性。
AI.result: 在钙钛矿太阳能电池数据上：VerifiedLab 能恢复已知物理趋势，能提前预测一年后才被报道的器件性能，并使 AI 科学家在继承文献的同时获得其可信度度量；随校验算力增加，性能可扩展。
AI.conclusion: 将研究知识重构为"带可信度度量的可执行系统"是可行的，为机器可读知识的传播范式与 AI 协同科学家（AI co-scientist）的 machine harness 提供了新路径。

title: Generative modeling for fusion: a large-scale benchmark of stellarator fast-ion simulations
summary: Stellarators offer a promising magnetic confinement approach for achieving controlled nuclear fusion. However, stellarator design remains challenging, as evaluating configuration performance requires computationally expensive, high-fidelity simulations. In particular, key performance metrics derived from guiding center simulations are costly to include directly in the design optimization loop, and are almost exclusively used as diagnostics. Machine learning has the potential to advance fusion research by enabling rapid generation and evaluation of new stellarator configurations. Effectively applying ML for fusion demands large-scale datasets that capture both design diversity and high-fidelity simulation outputs. In this work, we introduce the Benchmark of Stellarator Simulations (BoSS), a dataset of stellarator designs paired with guiding center simulation results and trajectories. The BoSS is the first large-scale dataset of guiding center simulations, containing simulation data for 180,000 distinct magnetohydrodynamic equilibria spanning a wide range of magnetic geometries and confinement properties. To exemplify the utility of ML to accelerate stellarator design, we formulate and address two sets of modeling tasks: generative modeling for designing stellarators with good particle confinement, and surrogate modeling for predicting stellarator heat deposition patterns and particle trajectories. The tasks reveal the potential impact ML can have in the stellarator field and important opportunities to improve the applicability of ML models in the sciences. Our baselines generate diverse, performant stellarators and provide useful surrogate predictions, and point to long-horizon trajectory forecasting and out-of-distribution generation as key directions for future work. The BoSS can be accessed through https://boss.flatironinstitute.org/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BoSS（Benchmark of Stellarator Simulations），首个大规模引导中心模拟数据集，覆盖 18 万个不同 MHD 平衡态，并用于生成式设计（好约束性能仿星器）与代理建模（预测热沉积模式与粒子轨迹）两类任务。
AI.motivation: 仿星器设计依赖昂贵的高保真模拟，引导中心模拟得出的关键性能指标几乎只作诊断用，难以进入优化回路；ML 有望加速设计，但缺乏同时覆盖设计多样性与高保真输出的大规模数据集。
AI.method: 构建 BoSS 数据集：将仿星器设计与其引导中心模拟结果和轨迹配对，涵盖 180,000 个 MHD 平衡态，磁几何与约束性质范围广泛；并设定两组基准任务——面向良好粒子约束的生成式建模，以及预测热沉积模式与粒子轨迹的代理建模。
AI.result: 基线方法可生成多样且性能优良的仿星器构型，并给出有用的代理预测；同时暴露出长时程轨迹预测与分布外生成是未来关键方向。
AI.conclusion: BoSS 展示了 ML 加速仿星器设计的潜力，并为科学领域 ML 模型的适用性改进提供了重要机会；数据集可通过 https://boss.flatironinstitute.org/ 获取。

title: RoFiGR: Coarse Routing, Fine Refinement via Level-Adaptive Distillation in Multimodal Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommenders predict an item's semantic identifier (SID) one code at a time. Early codes select broad branches, so a routing error can exclude relevant items before fine-grained prediction begins. In multimodal recommendation, these coarse decisions must reflect collaborative preferences as well as item semantics. We introduce RoFiGR, a two-tree recommender that uses collaborative information in both SID construction and generation. It aligns cumulative L1-L2 code vectors with frozen collaborative item embeddings and explicitly encodes item distance and source level in the serialized history. During generation, a sequential teacher supervises legal branches. Fixed coarse-level weights maintain routing supervision, while a bounded adaptive residual allocates additional weight according to teacher-student demand. On Instruments, Arts, and Games, RoFiGR improves all five ranking metrics over the evaluated external baselines. Five-seed paired tests with Holm correction support the main NDCG@10 improvements. Comparisons with alternative collaborative supervision objectives and tokenizers support the proposed design. Matched task and decoding analyses distinguish the effects of training exposure, stream fusion, and candidate budgets.

AI.tldr: RoFiGR：利用协同信息改进语义ID构建与生成的双树生成式推荐器，在多个数据集上提升全部排序指标。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐逐码预测SID，早期粗粒度码负责分支路由，一旦出错会在细粒度预测前就排除相关物品；而多模态推荐中这些粗粒度决策须同时反映协同偏好与物品语义。
AI.method: 构建双树结构，在SID构建与生成两阶段均注入协同信息：将累积L1–L2码向量与冻结的协同物品嵌入对齐；在序列化历史中显式编码物品距离与来源层级；生成时用序列教师监督合法分支，粗粒度权重固定以维持路由监督，并叠加有界自适应残差按师生需求分配额外权重。
AI.result: 在Instruments、Arts、Games上，五项排序指标均优于所评估的外部基线；五种子配对检验（Holm校正）支持主要NDCG@10提升；与替代协同监督目标及分词器的对比支持该设计；匹配任务与解码分析区分了训练暴露、流融合与候选预算的影响。
AI.conclusion: 将协同信息贯穿SID构建与生成、并对粗粒度路由施加针对性监督，可有效缓解级联路由误差，提升多模态生成式推荐性能。

title: Do Open-Source Video Ad Clients Follow VAST 4.3? An Empirical Study of Player Conformance
comment: 51 pages, 20 tables, 3 figures. Harness, test vectors and results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23581408
summary:
Context. Video ads reach streaming and connected-TV apps through VAST documents, and companies count ads from the HTTP requests the player's client library sends. A tracking error can leave playback intact and surface later as disagreeing counts.
  Objective. To measure how far open-source VAST clients meet the player duties of VAST 4.3, whether verdicts depend on the runtime, what generated inputs add, and when deviations were introduced.
  Method. A catalog of 108 requirements was extracted from the specification. Six open-source clients in eight configurations ran against 69 crafted test vectors and the IAB's sample tags, under Node.js and in five browsers on three engines, with every request recorded. Grids, fuzzing and a sweep over 36 releases extend the catalog; Google's closed IMA SDK is a comparison.
  Results. The open-source clients have 78 findings and 3 to 21 must-level deviations per configuration. None of the tested open-source clients that follow redirect (Wrapper) chains fills the required macros in a Wrapper's request; the archived IMA 3.794.0 configuration tested does. One library's timeout throws an exception no caller can catch, ending a Node.js process. In a pod (ads played back to back), one player credits a finishing ad's completion to the next ad, fixed in release 5.3.0. A library can conform under jsdom and deviate in every tested Chrome- and Safari-family browser.
  Conclusions. The tested clients diverge on the duties other companies use to count and diagnose ads. A shared conformance suite run in real browsers could expose most graded deviations; the harness and vectors are released.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了6个开源VAST客户端对IAB VAST 4.3播放器职责的符合性：抽取108条规范要求，构造69个测试向量，在Node.js与5款浏览器（3个引擎）的8种配置下运行并记录全部请求，辅以网格、模糊测试与36个版本扫描，并与闭源IMA SDK对比，共发现78项问题及每配置3–21项must级偏差。
AI.motivation: 视频广告通过VAST文档在流媒体与联网电视应用中投放，广告计数依赖客户端库发出的HTTP请求；跟踪错误可能不影响播放却导致后续计数不一致，而现有开源VAST客户端的规范符合性缺乏系统化、可复现的度量。
AI.method: 从VAST 4.3规范抽取108条要求的目录；6个开源客户端在8种配置下针对69个手工构造测试向量及IAB样例标签运行，环境为Node.js与5款浏览器/3个渲染引擎，逐条记录请求；用网格测试、模糊测试和对36个发布版本的扫描扩展目录；以Google闭源IMA SDK作为对照。
AI.result: 开源客户端共产生78项发现，每配置存在3–21项must级偏差；所有跟随跳转链（Wrapper）的被测开源客户端均未在Wrapper请求中填充必需宏，而归档的IMA 3.794.0配置可以做到；某库的timeout抛出无法被调用方捕获的异常，导致Node.js进程终止；在pod（连播）场景中，某播放器把结束广告的完成事件记到下一支广告上（5.3.0版本修复）；某库可在jsdom下符合规范，却在所有被测Chrome与Safari系浏览器中偏离。
AI.conclusion: 被测客户端在用于计数与诊断广告的职责上存在分歧；在真实浏览器中运行共享一致性测试套件可暴露大多数被判定的偏差；测试框架与测试向量已开源发布。

title: GARDEN: Generalist Autonomous Reward Design Through Evidence Navigation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables teams of agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles, to learn coordinated behavior, but what such teams learn is largely determined by their reward function. Because task success alone provides too little guidance for learning, intermediate rewards are usually designed by hand, and this effort must often be repeated whenever the environment or the team changes. Large language models (LLMs) can automate the effort by writing reward functions as code, yet the resulting rewards are typically designed and tested in a single setting. To enable their reuse across settings, GARDEN (Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation) is proposed, in which one reward program is developed for a family of related scenarios and transferred, unchanged, to scenarios that were not available during its design. During development, environment code, training records, and agent behavior are investigated by an LLM reward engineer, and draft rewards are tested in trial training runs, while the learning algorithm and the rule for selecting the final reward are held fixed. On unseen scenarios of the Overcooked and SMAX benchmarks, task returns were increased by 58.2% and 52.5% over the default rewards on two kitchen layouts, and the mean win rate in two combat scenarios was raised from 51.0% to 89.9%. Under matched candidate and probe budgets, this exceeded the 84.2% and 79.2% obtained with fixed diagnostic feedback and Eureka-inspired reward reflection. These results show that a single autonomously engineered reward can be reused effectively across related cooperative scenarios.

AI.tldr: GARDEN 用 LLM 作为"奖励工程师"，借助环境代码、训练记录与智能体行为的证据导航，为一个相关场景族开发单一奖励程序，并无须修改地迁移到设计时未见过的场景，在 Overcooked 与 SMAX 上显著优于默认奖励与基线方法。
AI.motivation: 合作式多智能体强化学习的成效高度依赖奖励函数；仅用任务成功信号指导不足，中间奖励多靠人工设计，且环境或团队变化后需重复设计。LLM 可自动编写奖励代码，但现有方法只针对单一设定设计并验证，缺乏跨场景复用能力。
AI.method: 提出 GARDEN（Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation）：针对一组相关场景族设计一个奖励程序，开发过程中由 LLM 奖励工程师检视环境代码、训练记录与智能体行为，借助试训练运行检验草稿奖励；学习算法与最终奖励的选取规则保持固定，实现"设计一次、原样迁移"到未见场景。
AI.result: 在 Overcooked 与 SMAX 的未见场景上，两个厨房布局的任务回报较默认奖励分别提升 58.2% 与 52.5%；两个对战场景的平均胜率由 51.0% 提升至 89.9%。在候选与探测预算匹配条件下，优于固定诊断反馈（84.2%）与受 Eureka 启发的奖励反思（79.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 单个自主工程化的奖励函数可有效复用于相关合作场景，说明基于证据导航的 LLM 奖励设计具备跨设定泛化能力。

title: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
comment: 34 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code and runs: https://github.com/marcoshernanz/muon-moe-routing
summary: Many open mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models train with Muon instead of AdamW. Most balance the load with a bias on each expert's routing score, adjusted after every step. Their recipes disagree on whether Muon should also train the router. In models with 55M and 108M active parameters, we measure how the optimizer changes the span of these biases, the largest minus the smallest in a layer. The span grows when all tokens favor the same experts, so it shows how hard a layer is to balance. At learning rates tuned on shorter runs, Muon raised the span of the first MoE layer at every seed, roughly doubling it on average, while the other layers changed much less. The rise came from Muon on the rest of the network, whichever optimizer trained the router. In those runs, the inputs to the first router shared a direction, and soon after the warmup its busiest expert averaged four to seven times its fair share. Over the first 3,000 steps, subtracting the batch mean from these inputs removed this overload while barely changing the loss. On the smaller model, halving Muon's learning rate removed most of the rise and slightly improved the loss. Moving only the router to AdamW made the loads shift more during the warmup and slightly raised the loss, so at this scale the results favor keeping the router on Muon.

AI.tldr: 在55M/108M激活参数的MoE语言模型上，作者测量了路由偏置的跨度（span），发现Muon相比AdamW使第一层MoE的路由偏置跨度在每个随机种子下都升高，平均约翻倍；该效应源于Muon训练网络其余部分而非路由器本身，且与第一层router输入共享同一方向、最忙专家在warmup后不久达到公平份额4–7倍的过载相关。减去输入批次均值可消除过载而几乎不改变loss；在小模型上减半Muon学习率可消除大部分升高并略改善loss；仅把router换成AdamW会导致warmup期间负载波动更大且loss略升。故在此规模下建议router保留Muon。
AI.motivation: 开源MoE模型多采用Muon（而非AdamW）训练，并普遍用专家路由分数上的偏置来平衡负载；但现有recipe对"路由器是否也应使用Muon训练"存在分歧。作者希望量化优化器如何影响负载均衡难度，并厘清分歧来源。
AI.method: 在55M和108M激活参数的MoE模型上，以逐层路由偏置的最大值与最小值之差（span）作为层负载均衡难度的度量，比较Muon与AdamW；通过消融分别控制router与网络其余部分的优化器、调整学习率（含小模型上减半）、分析第一层router输入的共享方向，并尝试减去输入批次均值作为干预。
AI.result: 在短程调优的学习率下，Muon在每个种子下都抬高了第一层MoE的span，平均约翻倍，其余层变化很小；升高来自Muon训练的其余网络而非router所用优化器。这些运行中第一层router输入共享同一方向，warmup后不久最忙专家平均达到公平份额的4–7倍。前3000步减去批次均值消除了过载而loss几乎不变；小模型上减半Muon学习率消除了大部分升高并略降loss；仅将router改用AdamW使warmup期负载波动更大、loss略升。
AI.conclusion: 在此规模下，路由器继续用Muon训练更优，负载问题的主要来源是Muon训练的网络主体对第一层router输入施加的共同方向偏置，可通过输入中心化或降低Muon学习率缓解。

title: GistRank: Gist-Compressed Listwise Ranking with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become a powerful tool for listwise relevance ranking, which can improve web search by comparing retrieved passages jointly. However, processing every candidate verbatim and generating a permutation autoregressively can make inference costly, every candidate must be serialized verbatim into the prompt and the input therefore grows linearly with both the number and the length of the passages. While sliding-window ranking handles context limits through repeated re-encoding of overlapping blocks, hard compression techniques sacrifice the fine-grained details required for accurate discriminative judgment. To better understand and mitigate this trade-off, we conduct a comprehensive study of soft compression for LLM-based listwise ranking. Our findings reveal that a vanilla gist representation is ill-suited to ranking for two reasons: strictly causal encoding weakens how thoroughly each gist token absorbs its passage, and the representation is never trained to expose the relative-preference structure that separates closely competing candidates. To this end, we propose GistRank, a three-stage training framework that equips a large language model with gist-compressed passage representations by learning faithful gist tokens under a semi-bidirectional attention scheme, instilling discriminative comparison through pairwise training, and adapting the model to the listwise objective. GistRank collapses each passage into only $K{=}4$ gist tokens, this gives 14$\times$ speedups over one-shot full-text ranking while reaching 59.17 average nDCG@10 over TREC DL19/20 and five BEIR subsets within 0.89 of the strongest full-context baseline. Overall, GistRank provides an effective means to enhance efficiency for searches in real-world environments.

AI.tldr: GistRank用三阶段训练让LLM以每段落仅4个gist token的软压缩表示做listwise排序，实现14×加速且nDCG@10仅差最强全上下文基线0.89。
AI.motivation: LLM listwise排序需将每个候选逐字序列化进prompt，输入随段落数量与长度线性增长，推理昂贵；滑动窗口需重复重编码重叠块，硬压缩丢失细粒度判别信息，软压缩的适用性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 先诊断vanilla gist表示的两大缺陷（严格因果编码使gist token吸收不充分；表示未经训练以暴露相对偏好结构），再提出三阶段训练框架：在半双向注意力下学习忠实gist token；通过pairwise训练注入判别性比较能力；最后适配listwise排序目标。
AI.result: 每段落压缩为K=4个gist token，相比一次性全文排序获得14×加速；在TREC DL19/20及五个BEIR子集上平均nDCG@10达59.17，与最强全上下文基线相差0.89以内。
AI.conclusion: 软压缩对LLM listwise排序有效，但需针对性训练；GistRank在保持接近全上下文精度的同时显著提升效率，适用于真实搜索场景。

title: PyReprism: A Shared Lexical Foundation for Polyglot Code Analysis
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, Submitted to SANER 2027 Tool Demo Track
summary: Empirical studies of polyglot repositories apply the same analyses to every language of a corpus, such as separating code from comments, computing metrics, normalizing identifiers, and screening for duplicated code. Assembling them from specialized tools introduces differences in language coverage, measurement conventions, and workflows. We present PYREPRISM, an open-source Python library and command-line tool that separates language-specific lexical processing from reusable analyses: each language declares its lexical surface, which yields a lossless stream of typed tokens, and every analysis is implemented once on that stream. Across 187 built-in languages, language-specific declarations have a median length of 16 lines, and no language overrides a shared analysis. Against a reference parser, comment and string classification reach F1 scores of 0.994 and 0.958 on 1,412 files in 12 languages that were never used to develop the tokenizer. In a study of a polyglot repository, one tool replaces three; with matched inputs and analysis operations, it takes 2.9s instead of 8.7s on one core. We also characterize where lexical analysis falls short, in complexity estimation and clone screening. Tool: https://github.com/unlv-evol/PyReprism Video: https://youtu.be/IXc-NP5t4GU

AI.tldr: PYREPRISM 是一个开源 Python 库与命令行工具，通过将语言特定的词法处理与可复用分析分离，实现对多语言仓库的统一分析。
AI.motivation: 多语言（polyglot）仓库的实证研究通常对语料库中的每种语言施加相同分析（分离代码与注释、计算度量、标识符规范化、重复代码筛查），但由多个专用工具拼装会带来语言覆盖、测量约定与工作流上的不一致差异。
AI.method: 采用词法层与分析法解耦的架构：每种语言仅声明其词法表面（lexical surface），生成无损的类型化 token 流；所有分析在该 token 流上只实现一次，语言声明不覆盖共享分析。
AI.result: 内置 187 种语言中，语言声明的中位长度为 16 行，且无语言重写共享分析；在与参考解析器对比中，对 12 种未参与分词器开发的语言、共 1,412 个文件，注释与字符串分类的 F1 分别达 0.994 与 0.958；在多语言仓库研究中，一个工具替代三个，匹配输入与分析操作下单核耗时 2.9s 对 8.7s。
AI.conclusion: 该工具以极低的语言接入成本实现了跨语言一致的分析，性能显著优于多工具组合，并刻画了词法分析在复杂度估计与克隆筛查方面的局限。

title: Understanding Large Language Models as Numerical Optimizers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as potential tools for numerical optimization. Despite promising results, their intrinsic optimization capabilities and limitations remain poorly understood, particularly in high dimensions. This paper investigates the ability of LLMs to exploit mathematical problem structures and generate feasible, near-optimal solutions. We develop an evaluation framework that distinguishes solution quality from execution failures, including numerical inaccuracies, constraint violations, and output-format errors. Using representative problems from convex optimization, fractional programming, and constrained projection, we assess LLM performance against deterministic reference solvers across different dimensions. Our results reveal that LLMs can capture useful optimization structures and produce near-optimal solutions, even when their outputs fail to satisfy numerical or formatting requirements. However, reliability deteriorates with increasing problem dimension and depends strongly on the underlying optimization structure. To further investigate the limitations, we deploy an iterative refinement mechanism that provides targeted feedback on feasibility and solution quality. The results demonstrate that iterative refinement substantially improves reliability and extends the range of problem dimensions over which LLMs produce valid solutions. Nevertheless, persistent numerical and structural errors limit their applicability as standalone optimizers. These findings provide insights into the capacity and limits of LLM-based optimization and motivate hybrid approaches that combine LLM reasoning with deterministic numerical verification.

AI.tldr: 本文构建评估框架，区分解质量与执行失败（数值误差、约束违反、格式错误），系统考察LLM在凸优化、分式规划、约束投影等问题上利用数学结构生成可行近优解的能力，并检验迭代精炼机制的作用。
AI.motivation: LLM作为数值优化工具已有初步成果，但其内在优化能力与局限（尤其高维情形）缺乏清晰认识，需明确其能否利用问题结构而非仅靠模式匹配。
AI.method: 将解质量与执行失败解耦的评估框架；选取凸优化、分式规划、约束投影的代表性问题；在不同维度下与确定性参考求解器对比；并引入基于可行性与解质量定向反馈的迭代精炼机制。
AI.result: LLM能捕捉有用的优化结构并给出近优解，即使输出不满足数值或格式要求；随维度增加可靠性下降，且强烈依赖优化结构类型；迭代精炼显著提升可靠性并扩展有效维度范围，但持续存在的数值与结构性错误仍限制其独立使用。
AI.conclusion: LLM具备一定的结构利用与近似优化能力，但不足以作为独立优化器；应发展结合LLM推理与确定性数值验证的混合方法。

title: Bi-Phase Training: Learning Efficiently From Scratch
summary: Pre-training foundational models is computationally expensive as models scale. In this work, we introduce Bi-Phase Training (BPT), a parameter-efficient pre-training method that preserves the high-rank learning dynamics observed in full-parameter optimization with substantially reduced trainable parameters. BPT parameterizes each weight update as a composition of constrained high-rank left/right transformations via trainable diagonal matrices and low-rank adapters whose updates are periodically merged into the frozen base weights, resulting in a compounding expansion of accessible directions during training. Across language-model pre-training from scratch (Qwen2.5 models from 100M to 1.5B parameters and OLMo-2-1B) on FineWeb-Edu (10B and 100B tokens), BPT achieves validation perplexity close to full-parameter baselines while using far fewer trainable parameters; e.g., at the 1.5B scale, BPT uses 66% fewer trainable parameters with only a small validation-perplexity gap. Additionally, a comprehensive evaluation across diverse downstream tasks shows that BPT preserves much of the full-parameterized model's downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 提出双阶段训练（BPT），一种参数高效预训练方法：通过可训练对角矩阵与低秩适配器构成高秩左右变换，并周期性合并进冻结基权重，以远少于全参数训练的参数量逼近全参数优化效果。
AI.motivation: 基础模型预训练随规模增长计算开销巨大；现有参数高效方法通常难以保持全参数优化中的高秩学习动态，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 将每次权重更新参数化为约束性高秩左/右变换的组合，由可训练对角矩阵与低秩适配器实现；适配器更新周期性合并进冻结基权重，使可及方向在训练中复利式扩张。
AI.result: 在FineWeb-Edu（10B与100B token）上从头预训练Qwen2.5（100M–1.5B）与OLMo-2-1B：验证困惑度接近全参数基线且可训练参数大幅减少；1.5B规模下减少66%可训练参数，仅有小幅度困惑度差距；多下游任务评估显示保留了大部分全参数模型性能。
AI.conclusion: BPT在显著降低可训练参数量的同时保持了高秩学习动态，预训练质量与下游表现接近全参数基线，是一种有效的参数高效预训练方案。

title: Efficient LLM-based Subgraph Retrieval for Multi-Hop Knowledge Base Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA) aims to find answer entities in the knowledge base that are multiple hops away from the entities in the question. Information retrieval-based (IR-based) methods extract a pivotal subgraph from the entire KB to locate candidate answers and then evaluate their plausibility through semantic matching with the question. However, we observed that the extracted subgraphs often include nodes that are weakly related or irrelevant to the question. Without a proper node filtering mechanism, the number of irrelevant nodes grows as the number of hops increases, leading to excessive consumption of computational resources. To address these challenges, this study introduces an efficient LLM-based subgraph retrieval method for multi-hop knowledge base question answering, M-ER. The framework leverages Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to transform subgraph exploration into a tree-structured search process. During the MCTS selection phase, nodes that are highly relevant to the question are prioritized for inclusion in the subgraph, eliminating the need to traverse all nodes in the KB. The framework further incorporates a large language model (LLM) to refine the search direction, ensuring that exploration remains focused on nodes relevant to the question. In addition, selected nodes are quantitatively scored, and these scores are fed back into the node selection process to effectively filter out irrelevant candidates, thereby improving the quality of the subgraph. This mechanism not only narrows the search space but also enhances the overall efficiency of multi-hop KBQA. Experiments on the WebQSP benchmark demonstrate that M-ER achieves 78.88\% on the Hits@1 metric, while also improving computational efficiency. These results not only validate the effectiveness of M-ER, but also offer a viable technical path to balance performance and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM引导蒙特卡洛树搜索的多跳KBQA子图检索框架M-ER，通过节点相关性优先选择与量化打分反馈过滤无关节点，在WebQSP上Hits@1达78.88%并提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: IR-based多跳KBQA从全库抽取的关键子图常包含弱相关或无关节点，且随着跳数增加无关节点数量膨胀，缺乏节点过滤机制导致计算资源过度消耗，需要在性能与计算效率之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 将子图探索转化为树结构搜索：用MCTS的选择阶段优先纳入与问题高度相关的节点，避免遍历全库节点；引入LLM精炼搜索方向，使探索聚焦于问题相关节点；对选中节点进行量化打分，并将分数反馈至节点选择过程以过滤无关候选，从而缩小搜索空间、提升子图质量。搜索后的候选答案通过语义匹配评估合理性。
AI.result: 在WebQSP基准上Hits@1达到78.88%，同时提升计算效率，验证了方法在性能与效率间的平衡能力。
AI.conclusion: M-ER验证了LLM引导的MCTS子图检索的有效性，为多跳KBQA在性能与计算效率之间提供了一条可行的技术路径。

title: Omission-Safe Conditional Contracts for Evidence-Closed CI Qualification
summary: Continuous-integration evidence is conditional: a workflow determines which jobs should run, while an archive records which jobs remain observable. Reconstructing requirements from those observations lets an omission erase its own obligation. We present a qualification method that compiles a pinned workflow into conditional job requirements independently of target presence, retains a fixed capture inventory, and checks source-complete derivation certificates with a separate implementation. For a fixed source, context, scope and binding universe, with sound obligations and applicability judgments that preserve established truth under information extension, withdrawing observation facts cannot create authorization. The implementation handles static matrices, dependency guards and bounded pinned reusable workflows, preserving unknown applicability and separating tolerated outcomes from evidence coverage. Both implementations match the 45 hand-specified authorization controls, reject 180 source-certificate attacks, and exhibit no authorization gain over 704 distinct proper development erasures. An explicitly witnessed 12-job platform run qualifies in both implementations; all 4,095 proper payload-subset erasures block authorization. A frozen collection spans 240 runs in eight workflow families across six projects. All 160 evaluation source certificates independently validate, but unavailable historical execution-source identities leave actual qualification open. Initial gate diagnoses agree on 155/160 runs; a preserved unknown-propagation repair yields 160/160 agreement in a retrospective rerun. The study establishes bounded source extraction and omission resistance, rather than natural-fault prevalence or producer authenticity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"资格判定"方法：将固定版本的CI工作流编译为与目标产物存在与否无关的条件式作业要求，保留固定采集清单，并用独立实现校验源代码完备的推导证书，从而在信息扩展下保持既有真值、确保撤回观测事实不能凭空产生授权。
AI.motivation: CI证据具有条件性：工作流决定"应运行哪些作业"，而归档仅记录"哪些作业仍可观测"。若仅凭观测反推要求，则某一观测的缺失会连带抹去其自身应承担的义务（omission erases its own obligation），导致对不完整证据的误判授权。
AI.method: 1) 将钉定（pinned）工作流编译为条件式作业要求，不依赖目标是否出现；2) 保留固定采集清单（capture inventory）；3) 用独立第二实现校验"源代码完备"的推导证书；4) 在固定源、上下文、范围与绑定全集下，要求义务与适用性判定具备单调性（信息扩展保持真值）；5) 实现覆盖静态矩阵、依赖守卫与有界钉定可复用工作流，保留"适用性未知"状态，并区分可容忍结果与证据覆盖。
AI.result: 两套实现均通过45项人工指定的授权控制，拒绝180例源证书攻击，在704例不同的正当开发期删改（proper development erasures）上未出现授权增益；一个带显式见证的12作业平台运行在两实现中均判定合格，其全部4,095个正当载荷子集删除均阻断授权。冻结数据集涵盖6个项目、8个工作流族、240次运行：160份评估源证书全部独立通过校验，但历史执行源身份不可得使实际资格判定保持开放；初始门控诊断在155/160次运行上一致，经"未知传播"修复后在回溯重跑中达到160/160一致。
AI.conclusion: 本研究确立了有界范围内的源提取能力与抗遗漏（omission-resistant）性质，而非自然故障流行度或生产者真实性方面的结论；实际资格判定仍受历史执行源身份缺失的开放性问题制约。

title: SkillMem: Compact External Skill Memory for Latent Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Latent multi-agent systems reduce inference cost by keeping intermediate reasoning and inter-agent communication in continuous representations.\ Reusable skills, however, are commonly supplied as text or stored as layer-wise Key-Value states or skill-specific model parameters, introducing repeated processing or substantial per-skill storage.\ We introduce \textbf{SkillMem}, which represents each reusable skill as a small external latent memory and makes it directly available during latent multi-agent reasoning.\ A role-conditioned cross-attention reader allows the same memory to guide different agents according to their roles and current hidden states.\ We train the skill memories and shared reader through behavioral distillation, matching the change in token predictions induced by a textual skill while keeping the backbone frozen.\ For our experiments, we obtain textual skills from paired successful and failed multi-agent trajectories, although existing skills can also be compiled directly.\ Across six benchmarks and Qwen3 models ranging from 4B to 14B parameters, SkillMem provides strong gains for smaller backbones while preserving efficient latent multi-agent inference across model scales.\ We use the same $8\times256$ memory configuration across all evaluated model scales, requiring 9.6\,KB of skill-specific storage per skill, including its retrieval embedding.\ For a library of 100 skills, SkillMem reduces total storage by more than $38\times$ compared with alternative skill representations and achieves up to a $4.23\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.\ These results show that compact procedural memories can be reused without sacrificing the efficiency of latent multi-agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: SkillMem 将可复用技能表示为小型外部潜在记忆，经角色条件交叉注意力读取器介入潜在多智能体推理；通过行为蒸馏训练、骨干冻结，以 8×256 配置实现每技能 9.6 KB 存储、100 技能库存储降 38× 以上、端到端推理加速最高 4.23×。
AI.motivation: 潜在多智能体系统通过将中间推理与智能体间通信保留在连续表示中降低推理成本，但可复用技能通常以文本形式提供，或存储为逐层 Key-Value 状态、技能专属模型参数，导致重复处理开销或显著的每技能存储成本。
AI.method: 将每个可复用技能编码为一小块外部潜在记忆，使其在潜在多智能体推理中可直接调用；采用角色条件交叉注意力读取器，依据智能体角色与当前隐状态让同一记忆对不同智能体产生差异化引导；技能记忆与共享读取器通过行为蒸馏训练，匹配文本技能所引起的 token 预测变化，同时保持骨干网络冻结。实验中文本技能由配对的成功/失败多智能体轨迹获取，亦支持直接编译已有技能。
AI.result: 在六个基准与 4B–14B 的 Qwen3 模型上，SkillMem 对较小骨干带来显著增益，并在各模型规模下保持高效的潜在多智能体推理；所有规模统一使用 8×256 记忆配置，含检索嵌入的每技能专属存储为 9.6 KB；100 技能库下总存储较替代技能表示降低 38× 以上，端到端推理加速最高 4.23×。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的程序性记忆可在不牺牲潜在多智能体推理效率的前提下实现复用，SkillMem 提供了低存储、可跨规模迁移的技能复用方案。

title: Finite-Step Geometry of Marginal-Preserving Velocity Fields in Generative Flows
summary: Generative flows can admit different velocity fields that induce the same continuous marginal evolution but behave differently after numerical discretization. We study this finite-step non-equivalence while keeping the marginal path and numerical method fixed. Projected modified equations characterize the component of local integration error that changes the marginal law and give sufficient conditions for higher marginal convergence order. For affine fixed-shape distributions, we characterize exact finite-step reachability and derive spectral obstructions and sharp nearest-reachable Wasserstein errors. For diffusion probability-flow ODEs, we construct skew-score perturbations that preserve the exact marginal path under exact scores and quantify their leakage under score error. Controlled Gaussian and mixture experiments recover the predicted order, reachability, and obstruction phenomena.

AI.tldr: 论文研究生成流在数值离散后"有限步不等价"现象：同一连续边缘路径可由不同速度场诱导，但离散化后行为不同。在固定边缘路径与数值方法下，用投影修正方程刻画改变边缘律的局部积分误差分量并给出更高边缘收敛阶的充分条件；对仿射固定形状分布给出精确有限步可达性、谱障碍与尖锐的最近可达Wasserstein误差；对扩散概率流ODE构造保持精确边缘路径的斜分数扰动并量化分数误差下的泄漏，实验验证了理论预测。
AI.motivation: 生成流的不同速度场可诱导相同的连续边缘演化，但在数值离散后表现不同，现有理论多关注连续极限而忽略有限步离散带来的不等价性，缺乏对固定边缘路径下离散误差如何改变边缘律的刻画。
AI.method: 在固定边缘路径与数值方法的前提下，引入投影修正方程分离出影响边缘律的局部积分误差分量；对仿射固定形状分布分析精确有限步可达性并推导谱障碍与最近可达Wasserstein误差；对扩散概率流ODE构造斜分数扰动并量化分数误差导致的扰动泄漏。
AI.result: 给出更高边缘收敛阶的充分条件；刻画仿射固定形状分布的精确有限步可达集及谱障碍与尖锐最近可达Wasserstein误差；构造保持精确边缘路径的斜分数扰动并界定分数误差下的泄漏；受控高斯与混合实验复现了预测的收敛阶、可达性与障碍现象。
AI.conclusion: 有限步离散下生成流的速度场选择并非等价，投影修正方程与可达性/Wasserstein分析提供了刻画与判据，斜分数扰动分析揭示了分数误差下的边缘偏差来源，为生成流数值设计提供理论指导。

title: R2QRec: Learning Recommendation Queries from Retrieval Feedback
summary: Query-based recommendation separates expressing user needs from locating matching items. Its central learning problem is how to turn item interactions into effective retrieval requests when interaction logs do not annotate queries. We present R2QRec, which uses a fixed retrieval system to construct query supervision and evaluate recommendation outcomes. Retrieval verification first selects generated expressions that recover observed items as supervised fine tuning targets, allowing retrieval behavior to determine the target wording. Policy refinement then evaluates generated query sets by the observed item's rank in their fused recommendation list. Log-rank feedback distinguishes outcomes beyond the recommendation cutoff, while a KL penalty constrains policy change relative to the supervised reference. The stages have distinct roles: verification identifies expressions to imitate, and policy refinement improves the combined ranking produced by newly generated queries. Only the query generator is trained; the retriever and item index remain fixed, and no query annotations or learned reward model are required. Across three public datasets, R2QRec achieves state-of-the-art overall recommendation performance among the evaluated methods. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed design and its generalization across generators and domains.

AI.tldr: R2QRec用固定检索系统构造查询监督并评估推荐结果，通过“检索验证式SFT”+“策略精炼（log-rank反馈+KL约束）”训练查询生成器，在三公开数据集上取得最优整体推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 基于查询的推荐将“表达用户需求”与“定位匹配物品”解耦，但交互日志不标注查询，核心难点在于如何把物品交互转化为有效的检索请求（查询）。现有方法缺乏可靠的查询监督信号，且难以在推荐截断之外区分生成查询的优劣。
AI.method: 两阶段框架，仅训练查询生成器，检索器与物品索引固定：(1) 检索验证：用固定检索系统筛选能召回已观测物品的生成查询表达式，作为SFT目标，使检索行为决定目标措辞；(2) 策略精炼：以观测物品在融合推荐列表中的排名（log-rank）作为反馈评估生成查询集合，KL惩罚约束相对SFT参考策略的偏移。无需查询标注与学习式奖励模型。
AI.result: 在三个公开数据集上，R2QRec在整体推荐性能上优于所评估的对比方法，达到SOTA；大量实验验证了设计的有效性以及在生成器与领域上的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 以检索系统本身作为监督与评价来源可有效替代人工查询标注和奖励模型；检索验证与策略精炼分工明确（前者确定“模仿何种表达”，后者优化“多查询融合排序”），训练轻量且具可迁移性。

title: QSoftCore: A Conceptual Foundation for Quantum Software Engineering
summary: Quantum software engineering (QSE) requires understanding application requirements, quantum programs and algorithms, quantum computation paradigms, executions, and deployment. However, relevant quantum computing (QC) concepts are often defined across physical, mathematical, and paradigm-specific levels of abstraction, making it difficult for the QSE community and hence proposed methods to refer to them consistently. To this end, we present QSoftCore, a conceptual model that reorganizes established QC concepts from a software engineering perspective and connects quantum applications, computational problems, algorithms, configurations, programs, and paradigm-specific computation specifications with state evolution, execution results, and backends. Our assessment against QSE literature across key software engineering activities indicates that QSoftCore provides shared QC referents for quantum computations, executions, deployment configurations, backends, and measurement evidence across the QSE lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 QSoftCore——一个从软件工程视角重组量子计算概念的概念模型，用以在量子软件工程生命周期中提供一致的概念指称。
AI.motivation: 量子软件工程（QSE）需要理解应用需求、量子程序与算法、量子计算范式、执行与部署。但量子计算（QC）概念常分散定义于物理、数学、范式特定等多个抽象层次，导致 QSE 社区难以一致地引用这些概念，也影响所提方法的概念一致性。
AI.method: 构建 QSoftCore 概念模型：以软件工程视角对既有 QC 概念进行重组，将量子应用、计算问题、算法、配置、程序及范式特定的计算规约，与状态演化、执行结果、后端等要素相互连接。
AI.result: 依据 QSE 文献中若干关键软件工程活动进行评估，结果表明 QSoftCore 能在 QSE 全生命周期中为量子计算、执行、部署配置、后端及测量证据提供共享的 QC 指称（referents）。
AI.conclusion: QSoftCore 通过统一的概念组织为 QSE 提供跨抽象层次的一致概念基础，有助于 QSE 社区及其方法在共享语义上引用量子计算相关概念。

title: GAUSS: A Workload-Aware Analytical and Monte-Carlo Simulator for LLM Inference Serving
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference has become an operational workload that fleets must provision, monitor, and bill against latency service-level objectives (SLOs). A single throughput number cannot answer the questions operators actually face, because generative serving couples two phases with very different service characteristics, continuous batching reshapes the effective service process, and user-visible tail latency can degrade long before aggregate throughput saturates. We present GAUSS, a workload-aware analytical and Monte-Carlo simulator that predicts the full distributions of time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-between-tokens (TBT), together with the sustainable request rate, for a given workload, engine, and accelerator. GAUSS pairs calibrated, phase-specific latency surfaces for prefill and decode with a Lindley-recurrence model of queueing under stochastic arrivals and estimates performance by ensemble Monte-Carlo sampling rather than by replaying a single trace. This lets GAUSS reason about workloads, routing policies, and hardware that have never been deployed, and to capture the latency tails that trace-driven simulators systematically under-sample. We describe the model and show how it supports operating-point selection, traffic segmentation, and shortest-remaining-processing-time scheduling capacity questions that trace-driven simulators cannot address.

AI.tldr: GAUSS 是一个面向 LLM 推理服务的负载感知解析+蒙特卡洛模拟器，可预测 TTFT 与 TBT 的完整分布及可持续请求率，无需依赖单条 trace 回放。
AI.motivation: 运营者需要为 LLM 推理配置、监控并按延迟 SLO 计费，但单一吞吐数字无法回答实际问题：生成式服务由服务特性迥异的 prefill 与 decode 两阶段耦合而成，连续批处理重塑了有效服务过程，且用户可感知的尾延迟在总吞吐饱和之前就已恶化。
AI.method: GAUSS 将针对 prefill 与 decode 分别校准的分阶段延迟曲面，与随机到达下基于 Lindley 递推的排队模型相结合；性能估计采用集成蒙特卡洛采样而非单 trace 回放，从而可对未见过的负载、路由策略与硬件进行推演，并捕获 trace 驱动模拟器系统性欠采样的延迟尾部。
AI.result: 模型可预测 TTFT 与 TBT 的完整分布及可持续请求率；文中展示了其在运行点选择、流量分段以及最短剩余处理时间（SRPT）调度容量问题上的支持能力，这些问题 trace 驱动模拟器无法处理。
AI.conclusion: GAUSS 以分阶段延迟建模加蒙特卡洛排队分析，为 LLM 推理服务提供了超越单点吞吐指标的、面向延迟分布尾部的容量与调度决策工具。

title: SAG-Sep: Sparse Augmented Graphs and Onion-Guided Search for Rounded Capacity Cut Separation
comment: 42 pages, 4 figures, 26 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). Code: https://github.com/henryleo180/SAG-Sep
summary: Rounded capacity cuts (RCCs) are among the most effective cuts for capacitated vehicle-routing relaxations, but exact separation is computationally prohibitive at scale. Existing heuristic and neural separators can be fast, but often fail to produce sufficiently many effective cuts within practical separation budgets. We introduce SAG-Sep, a separator that scores node membership in RCC-inducing subsets across vehicle-count levels from a fractional LP solution in a single encoder forward pass, avoiding the iterative predict-and-coarsen inference used by NeuralSEP-style separators. SAG-Sep encodes the LP solution as a Sparse Augmented Graph (SAG), adding flow-informed multi-hop edges that expose long-range routing structure without densifying attention. Beyond LP-aware sparse encoding, we observe that high-value exact RCCs are typically nested, organizing into onion-like subset families, and SAG-Sep's node scores track subset nesting depth. This motivates Onion-Sweep (OS), a training-free decoder that ranks customers by their scores, evaluates the RCC violation of every prefix of the ranking in one vectorized pass, and emits the most violated prefix of each replica together with a cross-replica family of nested proposals, converting independent node scores into structurally coordinated RCC candidates without a tuned threshold or probing band. On the NeuralSEP benchmark with N=1000 customer instances, SAG-Sep with OS reduces the average root gap by 17.7% relative to the strongest NeuralSEP baseline, while the single-pass SAG-Sep separator achieves a roughly 30-fold per-iteration neural separation speedup. Our findings suggest that LP-aware sparse encoding and the nested structure of high-value cuts are structural patterns worth leveraging in neural separation more broadly.

AI.tldr: 提出SAG-Sep分离器：将LP解编码为稀疏增广图并在单次前向传播中对各车辆数层级的节点打分，配合免训练的Onion-Sweep解码器将节点分数转化为嵌套RCC候选，在大规模实例上将根间隙降低17.7%并实现约30倍分离加速。
AI.motivation: 圆弧容量割（RCC）是CVRP松弛中最有效的割之一，但精确分离在大规模下计算代价过高；现有启发式与神经分离器虽快，却难以在实际分离预算内产生足够多有效割。此外，NeuralSEP类方法依赖迭代式predict-and-coarsen推理，效率受限。
AI.method: 1) SAG-Sep：将分数LP解编码为Sparse Augmented Graph，引入流量引导的多跳边以暴露长程路径结构而不致注意力稠密化，在单次编码器前向中输出节点属于RCC诱导子集的成员分数（覆盖多车辆数层级），避免迭代推理。2) 观察到高价值精确RCC通常呈嵌套的“洋葱式”子集族结构，且节点分数可追踪嵌套深度。3) Onion-Sweep（OS）：免训练解码器，按分数对客户排序，单次向量化评估所有前缀的RCC违反度，输出每个replica最违反的前缀及跨replica的嵌套族，无需调阈值或探测带。
AI.result: 在N=1000客户实例的NeuralSEP基准上，SAG-Sep+OS相对最强NeuralSEP基线将平均根间隙降低17.7%；单次前向的SAG-Sep分离器实现约30倍的单迭代神经分离加速。
AI.conclusion: LP感知的稀疏编码与高价值割的嵌套结构是神经分离中值得更广泛利用的结构性模式。

title: Beyond IPS: Reliable Counterfactual Evaluation in Multi-Stage Ad Systems without Logged Propensities
summary: Offline evaluation of ad-ranking policies in multi-stage delivery systems is challenging because action propensities are often unavailable, limiting inverse propensity scoring (IPS). Reward-model-based estimators such as the Direct Method (DM) avoid propensities but can be biased when candidate policies induce impression distributions that differ from the logged data. We formalize DM-based counterfactual replay and propose mixture-weighted reward modeling, which reweights logged data toward a mixture of candidate-policy distributions using density ratios from a multiclass domain classifier. We bound each candidate's value-estimation error by overlap, cold-start, and replay terms, and derive an asymptotic rule that uses the cold-start mass to decide whether to trust offline selection or route candidates to online A/B testing. On an ads-delivery simulator and on production traffic from a large-scale CTR ranking system, the mixture-weighted reward model improves policy selection over its unweighted counterpart in both settings, with the largest gains at low overlap in simulation. Combined with a doubly robust correction, it attains the highest Top-1 accuracy in production and at low and medium overlap in simulation.

AI.tldr: 针对多阶段广告投放系统中倾向缺失导致 IPS 不可用的问题，本文形式化基于 DM 的反事实回放，提出混合加权奖励建模（用多类域分类器密度比将日志数据重加权至候选策略分布的混合），并给出重叠、冷启动与回放三项误差上界及基于冷启动质量的信任/转线上 A/B 的渐近准则。仿真与生产流量上均优于无权版本，结合 DR 修正在 Top-1 准确率上最优。
AI.motivation: 多阶段投放系统中动作倾向（propensity）常不可得，IPS 类离线评估受限；DM 类奖励模型虽不需倾向，但当候选策略导致的曝光分布偏离日志分布时存在偏差。因此需要一种在无倾向条件下仍能稳健选择广告排序策略的离线评估方法，并明确何时可信、何时应转向线上 A/B。
AI.method: 形式化基于 DM 的反事实回放；提出混合加权奖励建模：训练多类域分类器获得密度比，将日志数据重加权到各候选策略分布的混合，从而降低分布偏移偏差；理论推导每个候选策略价值估计误差的分解上界（重叠项、冷启动项、回放项），并据此导出利用冷启动质量决定离线选择或路由到线上 A/B 的渐近规则；与双重稳健（DR）修正结合。
AI.result: 在广告投放仿真器与大规模 CTR 排序系统的生产流量上，混合加权奖励模型在策略选择上优于无权重的 DM；仿真中低重叠区间增益最大；与 DR 修正结合后在生产的 Top-1 准确率以及仿真低、中重叠区间取得最高表现。
AI.conclusion: 混合加权的奖励建模为缺乏倾向信息的多阶段广告排序策略离线评估提供了有理论误差界支撑的可行方案，并能通过冷启动质量量化何时信任离线结果、何时转线上验证；作为 DR 估计器的组件可进一步提升选择准确率。

title: Well-Specified and Well-Tested? Assessing SWE-bench-Style Datasets with a Self-Evolving Agent
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, driving the need for high-quality datasets for reliable training and evaluation. SWE-bench-style datasets (SWE datasets) are widely used to evaluate LLM-based coding agents on real-world software issues, where task clarity and test coverage directly affect whether instances are solvable and verifiable. However, quality issues persist in existing SWE datasets, and manual annotation is costly and labor-intensive, motivating LLM-based annotation. Existing approaches typically rely on static, overly general rubrics, limiting their ability to handle diverse and nuanced scenarios and often yielding high false positive rates. In contrast, human annotators draw on accumulated experience to make context-aware judgments. Inspired by this, we propose ExLabel, an LLM-based, self-evolving, experience-guided assistant for task clarity and test coverage assessment in SWE datasets. ExLabel maintains an evolving experience bank that distills cross-instance knowledge into stable yet adaptive judgment criteria and reuses relevant experience to guide the assessment of new instances. For systematic evaluation, we construct SWE-TQ, a new benchmark spanning eight programming languages, by cleaning human annotations from SWE-bench and Multi-SWE-bench. Experiments with three backbone LLMs show that ExLabel achieves the best F1 across all settings, with relative improvements of 44.2%/49.9% and 24.0%/18.4% over the best baseline for task clarity and test coverage assessment on the Python/Multilingual subsets, respectively. Moreover, a coding model fine-tuned on SWE-rebench data filtered by ExLabel resolves 66.2% of issues on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming the model trained on data filtered by the best baseline by 14.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ExLabel——一个基于 LLM、自我演化、经验引导的助手，用于 SWE 数据集中的任务清晰度与测试覆盖度评估，并构建跨八种编程语言的基准 SWE-TQ；实验结果在各项设置下 F1 最优，且经其筛选数据微调的模型在 SWE-bench Verified 上解决 66.2% 的问题。
AI.motivation: SWE-bench 类数据集广泛用于评估基于 LLM 的编码智能体，任务清晰度与测试覆盖度直接影响实例是否可解、可验证；但现有数据集存在质量问题，人工标注成本高，因此转向 LLM 标注。然而现有 LLM 标注方法依赖静态、过于笼统的评分准则，难以应对多样与细粒度场景，误报率高。人类标注者依靠积累经验做上下文感知判断，作者受此启发提出经验引导方案。
AI.method: ExLabel 维护一个持续演化的经验库，将跨实例知识蒸馏为稳定而可自适应的判断准则，并复用相关经验引导新实例的评估，从而实现自我演化。为系统评测，作者从 SWE-bench 与 Multi-SWE-bench 的人工标注中清洗数据，构建覆盖八种编程语言的新基准 SWE-TQ。
AI.result: 在三个骨干 LLM 上的实验表明，ExLabel 在所有设置下取得最佳 F1；在 Python/多语言子集上，任务清晰度与测试覆盖度评估相对最佳基线分别提升 44.2%/49.9% 与 24.0%/18.4%。此外，用 ExLabel 筛选的 SWE-rebench 数据微调的编码模型在 SWE-bench Verified 上解决 66.2% 的问题，比用最佳基线筛选数据训练的模型高 14.5%。
AI.conclusion: 经验引导与自我演化的标注机制显著优于静态评分准则方案，既能提升 SWE 数据集质量评估的准确性，也能通过数据筛选直接转化为下游编码智能体性能的提升，说明高质量数据筛选对训练与评测具有实质价值。

title: Algorithmic Bias from the Perspectives of Healthcare Professionals
summary: This paper focuses on algorithmic bias of machine learning and artificial intelligence applications in healthcare information systems. Based on the quantitative data and qualitative comments from a survey and interviews with healthcare professionals, who have different job roles (e.g., clinical vs. administrative), this study provides findings about the relationships between algorithmic bias, perceived fairness, and the intended acceptance and adoption of ML algorithms and algorithm generated outcomes. The results suggest that the opinions of healthcare professionals toward the causes of algorithmic bias, the criteria of algorithm assessment, the perceived fairness, and bias mitigation approaches may vary depending on their job roles, perspectives, tasks, and the algorithm characteristics. More research is needed to investigate algorithmic bias to ensure fairness and equality in healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于医护人员问卷与访谈数据，考察医疗信息系统中机器学习算法偏见与感知公平性及算法接受采纳意愿之间的关系，发现不同岗位人员的认知存在差异。
AI.motivation: 医疗信息系统中机器学习与人工智能应用日益普及，其算法偏见可能影响公平与平等，但医护人员对偏见成因、评估标准与缓解措施的看法尚缺乏实证研究。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：对具有不同岗位角色（如临床与行政）的医护人员开展问卷调查（定量数据）与访谈（定性评论），分析算法偏见、感知公平与对ML算法及其输出结果的预期接受与采纳之间的关系。
AI.result: 医护人员对算法偏见成因、算法评估标准、感知公平及偏见缓解方式的看法会因其岗位角色、视角、任务类型和算法特征而有所不同。
AI.conclusion: 需进一步研究算法偏见，以确保医疗领域的公平与平等。

title: Self-Supervised Latent Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series
summary: Time-series data play an important role in various tasks, such as weather forecasting, web traffic analysis, and speech recognition. Recently, pioneering studies have increasingly adopted Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) based encoders to learn time-series representations through latent-space prediction. However, they often overlook the underlying factors governing transitions between time-series observations. In this work, we hypothesize that explicitly modeling the information behind changes in time series can facilitate time-series modeling. Building on this hypothesis, we propose ACTS-WM, a self-supervised latent action-conditioned world model framework for time-series analysis. First, we introduce a latent action modeling approach that infers the underlying information behind time-series transitions as latent actions, without requiring explicit action annotations. We then develop a JEPA-based encoder and an action-conditioned world model to predict target time-series representations conditioned on the learned latent actions and task information. We evaluate ACTS-WM across 4 representative tasks on 22 datasets from diverse domains, covering univariate and multivariate forecasting and classification. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ACTS-WM can improve downstream performance over pretrained JEPA-based encoders by learning complementary representations.

AI.tldr: 提出ACTS-WM：自监督潜动作条件世界模型，通过无标注推断时序转移背后的潜动作，并以其与任务信息为条件做潜空间预测，提升时序表征与下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: JEPA类时序编码器仅在潜空间做预测，忽略了支配时序观测之间转移的潜在因素（驱动变化的隐含信息），限制了表征质量。
AI.method: 假设显式建模时序变化背后的信息有助于时序建模。方法包含三部分：(1) 潜动作建模，无需显式动作标注即可从时序转移中推断潜动作；(2) 基于JEPA的编码器；(3) 动作条件世界模型，以学到的潜动作和任务信息为条件预测目标时序表征；整体为自监督预训练框架。
AI.result: 在22个跨领域数据集的4类代表性任务（单变量/多变量预测与分类）上评估，ACTS-WM相较预训练JEPA编码器在下游性能上有一致提升，学到的表征具有互补性。
AI.conclusion: 显式潜动作条件建模是增强JEPA式时序表征的有效途径，可在无动作标注下推广到多种时序任务，并作为现有JEPA编码器的互补预训练方案。

title: xPRT: Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining
summary: Dense retrievers are a foundational component underlying modern RAG and search systems. Training these models typically requires a curated collection of annotated query-document pairs, which are prohibitively expensive to obtain outside a handful of well-resourced domains. This has motivated a line of work that leverages large-scale unsupervised retrieval pretraining from unlabelled text alone. Most such methods learn by optimizing a language modelling or contrastive learning objective over short spans within a document. This raises the question: how can we extract richer learning signals from a single document for retrieval pretraining? To address it, we introduce xPRT (Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining), an unsupervised framework that learns from the key information distributed across an entire document and the connections between its parts. We evaluate xPRT against five state-of-the-art objectives on MTEB English v2, continuing pretraining from a public unsupervised checkpoint while holding the corpus, schedule, and training procedure fixed. Across diverse tasks spanning all task types, we observe that xPRT consistently outperforms the strongest baseline by 3.2% on an average. Notably, in this continual pretraining setting, many baseline methods incur substantial performance regressions, whereas our method delivers the largest complementary gains over the initial pretrained checkpoint. Controlled ablations confirm that xPRT's performance gains stem from its proposed cross-passage signals. xPRT demonstrates that a single unlabelled document is a much richer source of retrieval signal than prior work assumed and offers complementary gains to what current retrievers already capture.

AI.tldr: xPRT是一种无监督检索预训练框架，通过对整篇文档中分布式关键信息及其各部分之间关联进行建模，从单个无标注文档中提取更丰富的检索学习信号。在MTEB English v2上，以固定语料、训练日程与流程持续预训练，xPRT在各类任务上平均超越最强基线3.2%，并在多基线出现性能回退的情形下取得针对初始检查点的最大互补增益。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索器是RAG与搜索系统的核心组件，但训练依赖昂贵的人工标注query-document对，且在少数资源充足领域之外难以获取。现有大规模无监督检索预训练方法多在文档内的短片段上优化语言建模或对比学习目标，学习信号受限。因此需要回答：如何从单篇文档中为检索预训练挖掘更丰富的学习信号。
AI.method: 提出xPRT（Cross-Passage Retrieval Pretraining）无监督框架：不再局限于文档内短片段，而是从分布在全文档的关键信息以及各片段之间的关联（跨段落信号）中学习。实验从公开无监督检查点出发进行持续预训练，在语料、训练日程和训练流程固定的条件下，与五种SOTA目标进行对比；并通过受控消融验证增益来源。
AI.result: 在MTEB English v2上覆盖所有任务类型的多样化任务中，xPRT平均超越最强基线3.2%。在持续预训练设置下，许多基线方法出现显著性能回退，而xPRT相对初始预训练检查点获得最大的互补增益。受控消融确认性能提升源于所提出的跨段落信号。
AI.conclusion: 单篇无标注文档所能提供的检索信号远比既有工作假设的更丰富；xPRT表明利用跨段落信息可从文档中获取更强、且与现有检索器已捕获能力互补的学习信号。

title: Soei: Structured Observability of Evidence and Intent for Multi-Agent AI Software Engineering
summary: AI coding agents now do long, multi-step and multi-session software work with little supervision. When a developer comes back to that work, the useful question is not what the model said but what was actually done, by whom, and whether it is finished. We study this in three parts. First, we verify Agenttrail, an open-source local observability tool for coding agents, against its source at commit e4ba2da: nine documented constants and mechanisms hold at file-and-line level, two event pipelines are never unified, and its Map service has an unauthenticated local mutation surface. Second, we run a prototype of our system on 45 real coding-agent sessions (102,233 records, 20,577 tool executions, 2,336 human-to-agent episodes). With a blind-audited classifier (precision 83.3% and 96.7%) we estimate that 23.4% (95% CI 17.1 to 35.7) of code-editing episodes end with no independent check after the last edit, and that 57.8% of to-dos the agent marked complete after editing had no proof in between. A 10-minute timing heuristic for session hand-offs recovers 6 of the 24 session pairs that content lineage links. 42% of sessions run longer than 24 hours, 48.1% of transcript bytes lie past a 2 MiB replay bound, and 1,326 records in 16 sessions contain credential-like strings. Third, we propose Soei (Structured Observability of Evidence and Intent): an acknowledgement-aware event schema, a hash-chained local ledger, a W3C PROV-aligned graph, calibrated inference for attribution and lineage, and a verification layer that keeps a claim of completion apart from proof. On the same corpus the ledger is 20% of raw size, holds no content or credentials, verifies at about 126k events/s, detects tampering and replays deterministically. We position the work against concurrent 2026 proposals and define autonomy levels with evidence gates and harness metrics baselined on our data.

AI.tldr: 论文研究编码智能体长时间、多会话软件工作的可观测性问题，验证开源工具Agenttrail，在45个真实会话上量化"编辑后缺乏独立校验"等风险，并提出Soei框架（含致谢感知事件模式、哈希链本地账本、W3C PROV对齐图、校准推断与验证层），将"完成声明"与"证据"分离。
AI.motivation: AI编码智能体已能少监督地完成长周期、多步骤、跨会话的软件工作；开发者回归时真正关心的不是模型说了什么，而是实际做了什么、由谁完成、是否真正完成。现有可观测工具与流程缺乏对"证据"的严格校验，审计性与可信度不足。
AI.method: 三部分：(1) 针对Agenttrail（commit e4ba2da）进行源码级核验，逐文件逐行检查9项常量与机制，分析双事件管线未统一、Map服务存在未认证本地变更面；(2) 在45个真实会话（102,233条记录、20,577次工具执行、2,336个人-智能体片段）上运行原型，采用盲审分类器（精确率83.3%/96.7%），统计编辑后无独立校验比例、标记完成但无证据比例、会话衔接时序启发式命中率、长会话占比、超2 MiB重放边界的字节占比、凭据样字符串分布；(3) 提出Soei：致谢感知事件模式、哈希链本地账本、PROV对齐图、面向归因与血缘的校准推断、区分完成声明与证明的验证层。
AI.result: 9项常量与机制在文件与行级成立；双事件管线未统一；Map服务存在未认证本地变更面。估计23.4%（95% CI 17.1–35.7）的代码编辑片段在最后一次编辑后无独立检查；57.8%标记完成的待办在编辑与完成之间无证据；10分钟时序启发式仅找回内容血缘所连24对会话中的6对；42%会话超过24小时；48.1%转写字节位于2 MiB重放边界之外；16个会话中1,326条记录含凭据样字符串。Soei账本为原始体积的20%，不含内容或凭据，校验速率约126k事件/秒，可检测篡改并确定性重放。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体的"完成"声明普遍缺乏可验证证据，现有可观测工具在一致性与安全性上存在缺陷。Soei通过结构化证据与意图记录、哈希链账本与校准推断，在保持隐私（无内容/凭据）和小体积的同时实现高效校验与确定性重放；论文还将工作与2026年同期提案对比，并基于自有数据定义带证据门控的自主性等级与评测指标基线。

title: Assessing Language Models for Scientific Applications: Inertial Confinement Fusion as a Use Case
summary: Advancing language models for specialized scientific applications requires evaluations of scientific fluency, physical reasoning, and quantitative analyses. Using inertial confinement fusion (ICF) as a test case, we have developed an expert-curated benchmark of 250 questions spanning qualitative reasoning, numerical calculation, symbolic derivation, and equation formulation. Responses have been evaluated using deterministic numerical and symbolic checks together with language-model judges. We compared a variety of out-of-the-box closed-source and open-source large language models with Prospero, a model specialized through combined domain-adaptive pretraining and supervised fine-tuning for ICF. We also conducted initial retrieval-assisted evaluations. Prospero improved its aggregate score by 10.7 percentage points over its base model, with gains across all question types. Frontier models achieved the highest aggregate scores, but critical physics errors persisted, particularly in numerical calculations. We note that domain-specific performance can improve through specialization, but benchmark gains alone do not establish scientific reliability. Retrieval improved performance for a smaller model but yielded no statistically significant improvement for a frontier model. Two scientific stress tests further illustrate useful capabilities and the need for expert assessment of physical assumptions and model validity. Based on these findings, we recommend evaluating existing domain capabilities and retrieval benefits before committing to substantial additional specialization.

AI.tldr: 以惯性约束聚变(ICF)为测试场景构建250题专家标注基准,结合确定性数值/符号校验与LLM评判,比较通用闭源/开源模型与领域特化模型Prospero;Prospero较其基座提升10.7个百分点,前沿模型总分最高但仍存在关键物理错误,检索仅对较小模型有显著增益,且基准分数不等于科学可靠性。
AI.motivation: 面向专门科学应用的语言模型需要评估其科学流利度、物理推理与定量分析能力,而现有评测缺少专家级、涵盖计算与推导的领域基准,因此需要一个可控测试场景来量化领域能力并指导是否值得投入大规模领域特化。
AI.method: 以ICF为案例,构建250题专家整理基准,覆盖定性推理、数值计算、符号推导与方程构建四类;采用确定性数值/符号检查与语言模型评判相结合的评分方式;对比多款开箱即用的闭源与开源LLM与经领域自适应预训练+监督微调得到的Prospero,并进行初步的检索增强评估及两项科学压力测试。
AI.result: Prospero总分较基座模型提升10.7个百分点,且在全部题型上均有增益;前沿模型总分最高,但在数值计算等环节仍持续出现关键物理错误;检索增强对较小模型有效,对前沿模型的提升无统计显著性;两项科学压力测试展示了可用能力,同时暴露需专家审查物理假设与模型适用性。
AI.conclusion: 领域特化可提升领域内表现,但基准分数提升不能证明科学可靠性;建议在投入大规模额外特化前,先评估现有领域能力与检索收益,并将专家对物理假设与模型有效性的判断纳入评测流程。

title: Application of PDE emulators for a multi-material, multi-physics simulation problem
comment: Accepted at ICMLA 2026, Rochester, MI, USA
summary: Machine learning (ML) architectures are being developed for fast emulation of numerical simulators to accelerate both scientific discovery and engineering design. While these approaches are well-tested on popular PDE (partial differential equation) benchmarks, it is necessary to evaluate their performance on datasets that more accurately reflect industrial and engineering applications. We evaluate several computer vision-based architectures trained as surrogate models on a challenging computational physics task involving multiple materials, revealing significant implementation challenges for adapting certain pre-trained models, including transformer-based architectures. For such multi-physics multi-material datasets, our results underscore the importance of learning algorithms designed for sparse and imbalanced data, techniques for adapting spatial encodings and physical consistency metrics, in addition to methods for reducing the cost of generating sufficient training data.

AI.tldr: 该文在含多材料的多物理计算物理任务上评估了多种基于计算机视觉的代理模型（含Transformer架构），揭示了预训练模型适配中的实现挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有ML代理模型多在热门PDE基准上验证，缺乏对更贴近工业与工程应用（多材料、多物理）场景的性能评估。
AI.method: 将多种计算机视觉类架构训练为代理模型，并在具有挑战性的多材料计算物理数据集上进行评估，分析预训练模型（尤以Transformer类）的适配难点。
AI.result: 发现适配某些预训练模型（包括Transformer架构）存在显著实现挑战；在多物理多材料数据上，稀疏与不平衡数据学习算法、空间编码与物理一致性度量调整对性能提升至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 面向工程应用需重视针对稀疏、不平衡数据的学习算法、空间编码与物理一致性度量设计，以及降低训练数据生成成本的方法。

title: Decompose, Estimate, Select: Coverage-Aware Context Construction for Long-Form RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds a language model's output in retrieved evidence, but for complex questions spanning multiple aspects of an information need, relevance-based retrieval may return redundant evidence while leaving some aspects unsupported. We propose a coverage-aware retrieval pipeline that decomposes queries into subquestions, ranks candidates with a coverage-trained bi-encoder, predicts a document\,$\times$\,subquestion coverage matrix with a cross-encoder, and selects documents by greedy maximum-marginal coverage. On TREC RAG 2024, our approach improves $α$-nDCG@10, which rewards newly covered nuggets and discounts redundant evidence, from $0.625$ to $0.702$, approaching the $0.718$ gold-nugget upper bound without sacrificing relevance. We then find that ground-truth oracle retrieval, despite substantially higher retrieval coverage, delivers no more nugget coverage to the answer than our estimated selection. This suggests that answer completeness depends not only on what evidence is retrieved, but also on how effectively the generator uses it. To address this, we introduce a \emph{grounded self-feedback loop} in which the model identifies underused evidence from its first answer and generates again without gold supervision, raising $V_{\mathrm{strict}}$, the fraction of vital reference nuggets fully supported by the answer, by $0.086$ over two passes while largely preserving faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 提出覆盖感知的RAG检索流程（子问题分解、覆盖度训练的双编码器、交叉编码器预测文档×子问题覆盖矩阵、贪心最大边际覆盖选择），并引入grounded self-feedback loop以提升答案完备性。
AI.motivation: 面向多方面的复杂信息需求时，基于相关性的检索会返回冗余证据，同时导致部分方面缺乏支撑。
AI.method: 1) 将查询分解为子问题；2) 用覆盖度训练的双编码器对候选排序；3) 用交叉编码器预测文档×子问题覆盖矩阵；4) 贪心最大边际覆盖进行文档选择。此外提出grounded self-feedback loop：模型识别首轮答案中未被充分利用的证据，在无金标监督下再次生成。
AI.result: TREC RAG 2024上α-nDCG@10由0.625提升至0.702，接近金标nugget上界0.718，且不牺牲相关性；oracle检索虽覆盖度更高，但给答案带来的nugget覆盖并不优于估计选择；自反馈循环两轮使V_strict提升0.086，并基本保持忠实性。
AI.conclusion: 答案完备性不仅取决于检索到的证据，还取决于生成器对证据的有效利用；覆盖感知选择与自反馈生成可共同提升多面向问题的答案完备性。

title: Program Bindings Inside Code Models
summary: Code language models complete, review, and repair programs without exposing the program structure encoded in their hidden states. In this paper, we test whether the hidden states of a code model can be described and edited using the information a compiler front end computes. For each token of a Python program, standard analyzers provide its position in the abstract syntax tree, its scope, its definition-use links, and its syntactic category. We fit a decomposition that expresses every hidden state of a frozen model as a sum of one term per token, each combining the token with this structural label, and we replace the model's own states with the decomposition at every layer while it predicts the output of a small program. If the model still answers correctly, the decomposition preserves the information the model uses. We apply this test to 14 open models, seven of them trained for code, and compare against a baseline decomposition of the same size built from token positions. The static-analysis decomposition preserves the model's answers better than the positional one in 10 of the 14 models, including six of the seven code models, and deleting the definition-use links from it removes most of that advantage on the two models tested. Editing the decomposition, for instance rebinding the argument of a call, makes StarCoder2-15B produce the answer of the edited program in 90 of 100 cases, compared with 19 for the positional baseline. The Qwen2.5 family is the exception on several measures. For most of the models tested, standard static analysis therefore provides both a description of what the hidden states encode about a program and a way to change it without retraining.

AI.tldr: 将代码模型隐藏状态分解为"token × 编译前端结构标签（AST位置、作用域、定义-使用链、句法类别）"的加和项，可在不重训练的情况下描述并编辑程序结构信息。
AI.motivation: 代码语言模型能完成、审查与修复程序，却不暴露隐藏状态中编码的程序结构。作者希望检验编译器前端所计算的信息能否用来描述和编辑代码模型的隐藏状态，从而获得可解释、可干预的内部表示。
AI.method: 对Python程序每个token用标准分析器标注AST位置、作用域、定义-使用链与句法类别；拟合一个分解，将冻结模型每一层的每个隐藏状态表示为"每token一项、token与其结构标签结合"的加和；在模型预测小程序输出时用该分解替换各层原有状态，若仍答对则认为分解保留了模型所用信息。与基于token位置的同规模分解作基线对比，测试14个开源模型（7个代码专用）。并通过删除分解中的定义-使用链、以及编辑分解（如重绑定调用实参）来验证因果作用。
AI.result: 静态分析分解在14个模型中的10个（含7个代码模型中的6个）比位置基线更好地保持模型答案；在两个受测模型上删除定义-使用链后该优势大部分消失。编辑分解使StarCoder2-15B在100例中有90例输出被编辑程序的答案（位置基线仅19例）。Qwen2.5系列在多项指标上是例外。
AI.conclusion: 对多数受测模型，标准静态分析既提供了隐藏状态关于程序所编码内容的描述，也提供了无需重训练即可改变该内容的手段；Qwen2.5家族为例外。

title: PromptSense: Sentiment-Aware Mental Health Chatbot with Dynamic Prompting
summary: Current Large Language Models (LLMs)-based mental health chatbots often lack sufficient empathy, contextual awareness, and safety mechanisms, potentially leading to ineffective or harmful interactions. This paper proposes a novel framework that integrates sentiment and depression analysis with a rule-based filtering mechanism prior to model inference. By dynamically constructing prompts based on emotional and risk-related insights, the framework aims to significantly improve the contextual relevance, empathy, and risk-aware of model-generated responses. We evaluated four model strategies and two prompt engineered variants across qualitative metrics such as empathy, helpfulness, clarity, relevance, safety, as well as toxicity assessments using the Perspective API. Experimental results indicate that the prompt engineering approaches outperforms DSFT and RLAIF by 1.8\% and 1.1\% respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在模型推理前融合情感/抑郁分析与规则过滤机制、动态构建提示词的框架，以提升心理健康聊天机器人的共情性、情境感知与风险意识；四种模型策略与两种提示词工程变体对比评估显示提示词工程优于DSFT（1.8%）与RLAIF（1.1%）。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的心理健康聊天机器人普遍缺乏足够的共情能力、上下文感知能力和安全机制，可能导致无效甚至有害的交互，因此需要在推理阶段之前引入情绪与风险感知来增强响应的相关性与安全性。
AI.method: 在模型推理前整合情感分析与抑郁分析，并配合基于规则的过滤机制；依据情绪与风险相关洞察动态构建提示词（prompt），驱动模型生成更具情境相关性、共情性和风险意识的回复。实验设计上比较四种模型策略（含DSFT、RLAIF及提示词工程方案）与两种提示词工程变体，采用共情、有用性、清晰度、相关性、安全性等定性指标，并用Perspective API进行毒性评估。
AI.result: 提示词工程方法在综合评估指标上优于DSFT约1.8%、优于RLAIF约1.1%；定性指标与毒性评估用于支撑这一比较结论。
AI.conclusion: 将情感/抑郁分析与规则过滤前置、并以动态提示词注入情绪与风险信息，是提升心理健康LLM聊天机器人共情性、情境感知与安全性的有效途径，且提示词工程在成本与效果上相较DSFT、RLAIF具有优势。

title: Sometimes less is more: Investigating inductive biases of MLPs and Transformers on noisy k-parity features
summary: We empirically investigate how MLPs and Transformers differ when trained on data sets containing one or more features encoded by noisy k-parity. Noisy k-parity gives us hard synthetic data sets in which we can control the predictivity and availability of every feature. Across a range of data distributions, data scales and model sizes, we find large differences in the training dynamics and inductive biases of the two architectures: Transformers are more robust to noisy features but struggle to learn complex, low-availability features, whereas MLPs show the opposite trend and improve steadily with more data. We also find that, under a fixed training budget, increasing the number of unique training examples can slow Transformer optimisation enough to reduce final accuracy, so that a smaller data set performs better. Training-accuracy results show this is an optimisation-speed effect; it shrinks, but does not vanish, when the budget is scaled with the data set size. By giving precise control over feature predictivity and availability, this testbed offers a clear starting point for understanding when and why Transformers and MLPs learn differently, and for designing data and training budgets that exploit those differences.

AI.tldr: 本文以含噪k-parity构造的合成数据集为测试平台，实证比较MLP与Transformer的训练动力学与归纳偏置差异：Transformer对噪声特征更鲁棒但难以学习复杂低可用性特征，MLP相反；固定训练预算下增加样本数反而可能降低Transformer最终精度，属优化速度效应。
AI.motivation: 现有工作难以精确控制单个特征的可预测性与可用性，因而无法清晰归因Transformer与MLP在某类任务上表现差异的来源。作者希望建立一个可控的合成测试平台，以厘清两种架构何时、为何学习行为不同。
AI.method: 采用含噪k-parity生成合成数据集，可对每个特征的可预测性与可用性（availability）进行精细控制；在该平台上覆盖多种数据分布、数据规模与模型规模，系统比较MLP与Transformer的训练动力学与归纳偏置，并考察固定训练预算与随数据规模缩放的预算两种设定。
AI.result: 两类架构差异显著：Transformer对噪声特征更鲁棒，但对复杂、低可用性特征学习困难；MLP呈相反趋势，且随数据量增加稳定提升。固定训练预算下，增加唯一训练样本数会拖慢Transformer优化，导致最终精度下降（小数据集反而更优）；训练精度结果表明这是优化速度效应，预算随数据规模缩放时该效应减弱但不消失。
AI.conclusion: 含噪k-parity提供了一个可精确控制特征可预测性与可用性的清晰测试平台，为理解Transformer与MLP学习差异的成因、以及据此设计数据分布与训练预算提供了起点。

title: When Static Reachability Says No: Checking Joern-Based Negative Verdicts for Python Against Execution
summary: A negative reachability verdict removes a finding from human review. We check such verdicts against execution. Our pipeline, SourceLens, maps Semgrep findings to a Python program's call graph, whose edges a query takes from the calls that Joern links in its code property graph. We ran two command-line programs from the PyCG macro-benchmark, in which the benchmark's manual call graph and Joern disagree, under coverage and recorded the calls between their functions. On these edges, 123 functions of asciinema are unreachable from the program's entry points. The project's own integration script executes 86 of them, and all our runs 113. In Sublist3r, 19 of 24 are executed. The latest Joern release gives the same verdicts. The missing calls go through values, such as classes and functions passed around, or have no call expression, as in with blocks and property reads. In asciinema, four missing edges make 50 of the 113 executed functions reachable. The manual call graphs also lack observed calls, in asciinema many of them property reads and with blocks, which the benchmark may not count as calls. A rule that turns negative verdicts into unknown recovers 62 of the 113 and 15 of the 19, mostly through dunder and private method names. It recovers 0 of the 5 security findings with a negative verdict, all in executed functions. Its selectivity cannot be measured, as only 10 and 5 negative verdicts were not executed, and under library entry-point models it degrades every negative verdict.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验静态分析中"不可达"（negative reachability）结论的可靠性：SourceLens 将 Semgrep 发现映射到由 Joern 提供调用边的 Python 调用图，并用实际执行验证这些不可达结论，发现大量被判定不可达的函数实际被执行，进而提出将不可达结论降级为"未知"的规则。
AI.motivation: 负面可达性结论会把安全发现从人工审查中剔除，一旦误判则可能漏掉真实漏洞。然而这类结论本身很少被对照真实执行进行验证，其可靠性缺乏实证依据。
AI.method: 构建 SourceLens 流水线：将 Semgrep 发现映射到 Python 程序调用图，图中边取自 Joern 在其代码属性图（CPG）中链接的调用关系。选取 PyCG 宏基准中人工调用图与 Joern 不一致的两个命令行程序（asciinema、Sublist3r），在覆盖率下运行并记录函数间实际调用，对比不可达判定与实际执行情况；同时测试最新 Joern 版本，并提出把负面结论转为 unknown 的规则。
AI.result: asciinema 中 123 个函数被判为从入口不可达，但项目自带集成脚本实际执行了其中 86 个，全部运行执行了 113 个；Sublist3r 中 24 个有 19 个被执行。缺失的调用主要经由值传递（类、函数对象）或缺少调用表达式（with 块、属性读取）。asciinema 中仅 4 条缺失边即可使 113 个已执行函数中的 50 个变为可达。"不可达→未知"规则通过 dunder 与私有方法名恢复 113 中的 62 个、19 中的 15 个，但对 5 个带负面结论的安全发现恢复 0 个（且均位于已执行函数中）；由于未被执行的反例仅 10 和 5 个，选择性无法测量，且在库入口点模型下该规则会使所有负面结论退化。
AI.conclusion: 负面可达性结论在实践中明显不可靠，主要源于调用图中遗漏的隐式调用路径；将其降级为"未知"可恢复部分误判但无法覆盖关键安全发现，且选择性难以评估。因此不应仅依据静态不可达结论自动剔除安全发现。

title: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in LLMs: A Case Study in the Challenges of Procedural Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) appear to represent and reason about a large range of phenomena. In particular, recent studies have examined whether LLMs can accurately reason about causation. One of the most commonly used benchmarks for evaluating formal causal reasoning in LLMs is CLadder, a framework for procedural generation of benchmark data sets that was released in 2023. Experiments with CLadder appear to indicate that LLMs can perform formal causal reasoning in a large percentage of generated examples. In this paper, we examine what can be reliably inferred when LLMs perform well on test sets produced by CLadder. We identify several examples of superficial and highly predictive patterns that the CLadder generator embeds in data sets it generates. We find that even simple models such as random forests perform well on CLadder-generated data sets after training on a sample of generated data. We also find that the performance of many commercial LLMs on CLadder test sets is extremely brittle and that removing large sections of the text that are critical for formal causal reasoning has almost no effect on performance. Given these results, the most likely hypothesis for the strong performance of state-of-the-art LLMs on CLadder is that they are exploiting superficial patterns learned from exposure to training data from the generator. Any inference that LLMs are exhibiting more complex causal reasoning must rule out this hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑CLadder基准的有效性：CLadder生成的数据集嵌入了大量表层且高度可预测的模式，简单模型（如随机森林）即可取得良好表现，商用LLM在CLadder上的表现极为脆弱，删去因果推理关键文本几无影响，因此LLM的高分很可能源于对生成器训练数据中表层模式的利用，而非真正的形式因果推理能力。
AI.motivation: CLadder（2023年发布的程序化生成基准）实验显示LLM能在很大比例的生成样例上完成形式因果推理，这一结论被广泛引用。作者旨在澄清：LLM在CLadder测试集上的良好表现究竟能可靠地推断出什么。
AI.method: 剖析CLadder生成器中嵌入的表层、高预测性模式；用简单模型（随机森林）在少量生成数据上训练后测试其表现；对多个商用LLM进行鲁棒性测试，删除文本中对形式因果推理至关重要的部分，观察性能变化。
AI.result: 随机森林等简单模型在CLadder生成数据上表现良好；多个商用LLM在CLadder测试集上表现极度脆弱（brittle），移除大段关键文本后性能几乎不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 最可能的假设是：SOTA LLM在CLadder上的强劲表现来自对生成器训练数据中表层模式的利用。任何声称LLM具备更复杂因果推理能力的推断，都必须先排除这一假设。

title: Separability Is Not Alignability: Representations for Spectrum-to-Molecule Retrieval
