comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Representations for the Physical Sciences (RPS). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=kqgbNulQ8A
summary: Identifying a small molecule from its tandem mass spectrum is limited by paired data. Foundation models offer a way around this scarcity: pretrain a spectrum encoder on unlabeled spectra and a molecule encoder on a large corpus of structures, then align the two frozen representations, as in vision-language and as the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests. We audit this route on MassSpecGym with spectrum encoders retrained free of test-fold contamination. Alignment needs a metric relating distinct molecules, but the objectives that produce spectrum encoders never see molecular structure: we prove that some predictive objectives fix molecular identity without fixing that metric. Moreover, we find that a candidate-based objective rewards a spectrum-independent prior over the benchmark's decoys, which we isolate. What ultimately addresses data scarcity is not architectural: simulated spectra surpass frozen geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了"先分别预训练谱图编码器与分子编码器、再对齐两个冻结表征"这一范式在质谱小分子鉴定中的有效性，发现对齐目标存在理论缺陷且被诱饵先验利用，最终指出真正解决数据稀缺的是模拟谱图而非冻结表征几何。
AI.motivation: 串联质谱鉴定小分子受限于配对的谱图-结构数据稀缺。受视觉-语言模型与Platonic Representation Hypothesis启发，一种流行思路是用无标注谱图预训练谱图编码器、用大规模结构语料预训练分子编码器，再对齐两个冻结表征，从而绕开配对数据瓶颈。本文要检验这条路径是否真正成立。
AI.method: 在MassSpecGym基准上进行审计，并重新训练谱图编码器以排除测试折数据污染。理论分析方面：证明存在某些预测性目标在固定分子身份的同时并不固定对齐所需的分子间度量；实证分析方面：识别并分离出候选式目标（candidate-based objective）对基准诱饵（decoys）的谱图无关先验偏好；对照实验方面：将冻结几何对齐与模拟谱图增强（simulated spectra）进行比较。
AI.result: (1) 对齐需要定义不同分子之间关系的度量，但产生谱图编码器的目标从未接触分子结构，因此该度量无法被谱图侧目标所约束；(2) 部分预测性目标虽能锁定分子身份，却不锁定该度量，导致对齐在理论上不充分；(3) 候选式目标会奖励一种与谱图无关的、针对基准诱饵的先验，并已被单独隔离验证；(4) 模拟谱图的效果超过冻结表征几何的对齐方案。
AI.conclusion: 数据稀缺的解决之道并非架构层面的对齐策略，而是模拟谱图。所谓"冻结双编码器+对齐"的捷径在质谱分子鉴定中存在原理性缺口，需要更审慎地评估其宣称的收益。

title: Lost in the Latent Space: How Code Embeddings Represent Functional Intent and Implementation Fidelity
summary: Code embedding models have become a key building block for many software engineering applications, yet their internal representations remain poorly understood. Existing evaluations tend to focus on downstream task performance, offering limited insight into whether a single embedding can support both functional abstraction and implementation-sensitive analysis. To address this gap, we present a large-scale empirical study of 14 state-of-the-art code embedding models. We evaluate their representational behavior through three complementary analyses: supervised probing for functional abstraction and implementation fidelity, zero-shot retrieval experiments to assess geometric similarity, and controlled perturbation experiments that measure embedding responses to semantics-preserving code transformations. The results reveal a consistent abstraction-fidelity tension: models that better preserve stylistic and structural signals tend to do so at the expense of semantic generalization, while models with similar retrieval performance can nevertheless respond very differently to the same implementation changes. Overall, our findings suggest that a single universal code representation remains out of reach, motivating more representation-aware evaluation, selection, and deployment of code embedding models in software engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文对14个先进代码嵌入模型进行大规模实证研究，通过监督探针、零样本检索和受控扰动三类分析揭示其表征行为，发现存在一致的"抽象—保真"张力，即单一通用代码表征难以兼顾功能抽象与实现敏感分析。
AI.motivation: 现有代码嵌入模型评估多聚焦下游任务性能，难以判断单一嵌入能否同时支撑功能抽象与实现敏感分析，其内部表征理解不足。
AI.method: 对14个SOTA代码嵌入模型开展大规模实证研究，采用三类互补分析：（1）监督探针评估功能抽象与实现保真度；（2）零样本检索实验评估几何相似性；（3）受控扰动实验测量嵌入对语义保持代码变换的响应。
AI.result: 发现一致的抽象—保真张力：更好保留风格与结构信号的模型往往以语义泛化为代价；检索性能相近的模型对相同实现变更的响应可能差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 单一通用代码表征仍难以实现，需在软件工程中对代码嵌入模型采取更具表征意识的评估、选择与部署方式。

title: AI-Driven Digital Twin Framework for Warehouse Logistics Automation Optimization
comment: ICRA 2026 Workshop Advances and Challenges in AI-Driven Automation and Robotic System Integration with Digital Twins
summary: In recent years, warehouse logistics optimization has increasingly focused on intelligent, data-driven systems to enhance operational efficiency. Conventional static product placement strategies are being progressively replaced by dynamic slotting approaches that can adapt to real-time variations in warehouse conditions. In this work, we present a novel framework that employs a reinforcement learning agent integrated within a FlexSim-based Digital Twin environment for real-time product placement optimization. The proposed agent continuously learns from streaming operational data, enabling it to reduce picking time while improving overall system throughput. The simulation environment models a four-zone warehouse layout with forklift-based material handling and leverages the Asset Administration Shell framework to ensure seamless interaction between the learning agent, physical asset, and the digital twin. Experimental evaluation demonstrates substantial performance gains, with the proposed approach achieving a 29.66\% reduction in average picking time, a 35.42\% increase in throughput, and an 18.54\% decrease in travel distance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种将强化学习智能体与基于FlexSim的数字孪生环境集成的框架，用于仓储货位（产品放置）的实时动态优化；在四区域、叉车搬运的仓库模型中，借助资产管理壳（AAS）实现智能体、物理资产与数字孪生的交互，实验显示平均拣选时间降低29.66%、吞吐量提升35.42%、行走距离减少18.54%。
AI.motivation: 仓储物流优化日益强调智能化与数据驱动，传统静态货位分配策略难以应对仓库实时状态变化，因此需要能依据流式运行数据自适应调整的动态货位（dynamic slotting）方法。
AI.method: 构建数字孪生驱动的实时货位优化框架：以FlexSim搭建四区域仓库布局并模拟叉车搬运作业；强化学习智能体持续从流式运行数据中学习货位决策；通过资产管理壳（Asset Administration Shell）标准化接口保证学习智能体、物理资产与数字孪生之间的无缝交互与信息映射。
AI.result: 实验评估显示显著性能提升：平均拣选时间下降29.66%，系统吞吐量提升35.42%，行走距离减少18.54%。
AI.conclusion: 将强化学习与数字孪生、AAS互操作机制结合，可有效实现实时动态货位优化，缩短拣选时间、提高吞吐并降低搬运行走距离，为智能仓储运营提供可行方案。

title: Predicting Sparse Observables in Parameterized Unsteady Flows Using Coarse-Mesh Graph Neural Networks
summary: Full-order surrogates for high-dimensional nonlinear flows are often unnecessary when applications require only selected degrees of freedom. We propose reduced-order models that bypass full-state reconstruction by deploying graph neural networks (GNNs) directly on coarse meshes. Applied to parameterized 2D/3D confined cylinder flows and an unevenly heated cavity over Reynolds/Rayleigh-number ranges, the models generalize to unseen conditions and accurately predict sparse probe locations and integrated quantities. Coarse-mesh GNNs match or outperform finer-mesh surrogates while reducing training time and memory, even for 3D chaotic dynamics. A dynamics-informed adaptive sampling strategy guided by frequency-spectrum variations reduces maximum errors by an order of magnitude versus uniform sampling at negligible cost. Coarse-mesh training also makes noise-augmented multi-step unrolling practical, improving long-horizon autoregressive predictions. The approach outperforms parametric DMD, sparse MLPs, U-Nets, and Fourier neural operators at lower cost, and enables system identification and state estimation from sparse observations. These results show that coarse-mesh representations, adaptive sampling, and noise-augmented unrolled training form an efficient framework for reduced-order modeling of parameterized unsteady flows without solver-resolution reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出直接在粗网格上部署图神经网络(GNN)的降阶模型，跳过全状态重构，仅预测所需自由度；配合动力学信息的自适应采样与噪声增强的多步展开训练，在参数化2D/3D受限圆柱绕流及非均匀加热方腔流上实现高效、准确的稀疏探针与积分量预测。
AI.motivation: 高维非线性流动的全阶代理模型往往不必要：许多应用只关心少数选定自由度。传统降阶模型仍依赖全状态重构（重建到求解器分辨率），带来额外计算与内存开销。
AI.method: 在粗网格上直接训练GNN代理，不进行全状态重构；引入由频谱变化引导的动力学信息自适应采样策略；粗网格训练使噪声增强的多步展开(unrolling)训练变得可行，改善长时域自回归预测。
AI.result: 在2D/3D受限圆柱绕流（Reynolds数范围）与非均匀加热方腔（Rayleigh数范围）上泛化到未见工况，准确预测稀疏探针值与积分量；粗网格GNN匹配或优于细网格代理，同时降低训练时间与内存，即使在3D混沌动力学下亦然；自适应采样相比均匀采样将最大误差降低一个数量级且开销可忽略；性能优于参数化DMD、稀疏MLP、U-Net与傅里叶神经算子且成本更低；并支持稀疏观测下的系统辨识与状态估计。
AI.conclusion: 粗网格表示、自适应采样与噪声增强展开训练共同构成一个高效框架，可在不重构求解器分辨率全状态的前提下，实现参数化非定常流动的降阶建模。

title: Leaving, Staying, or Living There? Duration Commonsense Reasoning with Human-LLM Co-annotations
summary: Gardening in the backyard implies living there, while checking into an Airbnb more likely means staying for a few days. Such duration judgments are important for understanding human mobility, travel behavior, and social context. However, duration is rarely stated explicitly in social media posts and must instead be inferred from noisy textual, visual, and contextual cues. In this paper, we investigate whether vision-language models possess such duration commonsense. We create a new corpus of geotagged tweets co-annotated by humans and LLMs to serve as a testbed for this task. We find that state-of-the-art models struggle with duration inference, even when guided by multi-turn Chain-of-Thought prompting. Error analyses further reveal that models often fail to integrate critical contextual information, or they overly rely on prominent visual details while overlooking subtle hashtags and semantic nuances. These findings underscore the significant challenges remaining in context-aware multimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）是否具备"停留时长"常识推理能力，构建了地理标记推文的人工与LLM联合标注语料，发现现有SOTA模型即使采用多轮思维链提示也难以胜任该任务。
AI.motivation: 时长判断对理解人类移动性、出行行为与社会情境至关重要，但社交媒体帖子很少显式陈述时长，需从含噪的文本、视觉与情境线索中推断，因此有必要考察VLM是否具备此类常识推理能力。
AI.method: 构建新的地理标记推文语料库，由人类与LLM共同标注，作为时长推断任务的测试平台；在多种SOTA视觉语言模型上评测，并引入多轮Chain-of-Thought提示作为增强基线，随后进行错误分析。
AI.result: SOTA模型在时长推断上表现不佳，即便有多轮CoT提示辅助仍难以胜任；错误分析显示模型常无法整合关键情境信息，或过度依赖显著的视觉细节而忽视隐含的标签（hashtags）与语义细微差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究凸显了上下文感知多模态理解仍面临的显著挑战，表明视觉语言模型在时长常识推理方面存在明显不足。

title: Early Prediction of Cross-Service Implementation Scope: Evidence and Limits from Multiple Microservice Projects
summary: Microservice architectures aim to localize change, yet feature requests may require implementation across service boundaries. We investigate how well such downstream scope can be anticipated before implementation begins. Using issue--pull-request--commit traceability and implementation evidence corrected through targeted human adjudication, we reconstruct 866 repository-traceable feature requests from 13 open-source microservice projects and map their implementations to validated service boundaries. Cross-service changes occur in 101 requests (11.7%) and exhibit broader implementation footprints, particularly higher code churn, but no clear difference in lead time. Pre-implementation evidence provides limited cross-project predictive signal: the strongest leave-one-system-out model reaches a project-macro Macro-F1 of 0.484, but its advantage over the majority baseline is not significant after Holm correction and is sensitive to small evaluation folds. A local LLM offers no reliable improvement over classical models. Downstream workload is substantially harder to estimate, as learned models do not consistently outperform training-fold median baselines. A simple service-mention heuristic also performs comparably to learned scope triage. These findings show that early feature-request evidence is more useful for lightweight cross-service scope triage than for automated scope determination or precise workload estimation.

AI.tldr: 该论文实证考察微服务项目能否在实现前预判“跨服务”特性需求的下游范围。基于866个可追溯特性需求（13个项目），发现11.7%为跨服务变更，代码改动更大但交付周期无差异；实现前证据的预测信号有限，本地LLM与简单服务提及启发式均无明显优势。
AI.motivation: 微服务架构以“变更局部化”为目标，但特性需求可能需跨服务边界实现。作者希望检验此类下游范围能否在实现开始前被提前预判，从而为范围分诊与工作量估算提供依据。
AI.method: 利用issue–pull request–commit可追溯性，并结合经定向人工裁决校正的实现证据；从13个开源微服务项目中重建866个仓库可追溯的特性需求，将其实现映射到经验证的服务边界。随后评估实现前证据对跨服务范围的预测能力（留一系统交叉验证、项目宏平均Macro-F1、与多数类基线比较并作Holm校正），对比经典模型与本地LLM，并检验下游工作量估计，另设“服务提及”启发式基线。
AI.result: 101个需求（11.7%）存在跨服务变更，其实现足迹更广，尤其代码变动量更高，但交付周期无显著差异。实现前证据的跨项目预测信号有限：最强留一系统模型的宏平均Macro-F1为0.484，经Holm校正后相对多数类基线的优势不显著，且对小规模评估折敏感。本地LLM未带来可靠提升；工作量估计中学习模型未稳定优于训练折中位数基线；简单服务提及启发式与学习式范围分诊表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 实现前的特性需求证据更适合用于轻量级的跨服务范围分诊，而非自动化的范围判定或精确工作量估计。研究提示应将此类信号定位为辅助性人工决策支持，并对小样本交叉验证下的模型收益保持审慎。

title: Too Hard, Too Easy, Just Right: Performance-Driven Challenge Adaptation in Virtual Reality Firefighter Training
summary: Effective firefighter training requires practice under dynamic and stressful emergency conditions, yet real-world live-fire exercises are costly, risky, and difficult to scale. Virtual Reality (VR) offers a safe and controllable alternative, but many existing VR firefighter training systems rely on fixed scenarios or provide limited difficulty adaptation, making it difficult to maintain an appropriate level of challenge for skill development as trainees' performance changes over time. To address this limitation, we present ProACT, a performance-driven adaptive training system that regulates scenario difficulty through closed-loop interactions between trainee performance and simulated fire dynamics. Specifically, ProACT combines a global module that continuously adjusts scene-level fire spread dynamics in real time based on trainee performance with a local module that periodically updates object-level flammability across the environment. Our evaluation shows that ProACT improves both objective training performance and subjective user experience compared with existing adaptive and non-adaptive baselines. We further discuss how adaptive immersive environments can extend beyond firefighting to broader training domains.

AI.tldr: ProACT：一种基于受训者表现驱动、通过闭环调节火势动态的自适应VR消防训练系统。
AI.motivation: 真实实火演练成本高、风险大、难扩展；现有VR消防训练系统多为固定场景、难度适应性有限，难以随受训者能力变化维持合适挑战水平。
AI.method: 提出ProACT性能驱动自适应训练系统，通过受训者表现与模拟火灾动态的闭环交互调节场景难度：全局模块依据表现实时调整场景级火势蔓延动态；局部模块周期性更新环境中物体级可燃性。
AI.result: 与现有自适应及非自适应基线相比，ProACT在客观训练绩效与主观用户体验两方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 表现驱动的闭环自适应可有效提升VR训练效果，该思路可推广至消防以外的更广泛训练领域。

title: Deep learning for non-transvenous ICD screening: tailored neural network architectures, extended experiments, and explainability
summary: This paper studies two non-transvenous implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), namely the Subcutaneous ICD (S-ICD) and the Extravascular ICD (EV-ICD). Both avoid the complications of transvenous leads but are prone to oversensing, which can trigger inappropriate shocks associated with increased mortality. Oversensing risk is predicted by the ratio of T- or P-wave amplitude to R-wave amplitude (T:R, P:R), and these ratios vary over a 24-hour period. Yet S-ICD screening uses a single 10-second electrocardiogram (ECG) segment, and the EV-ICD has no formal screening protocol whatsoever. We present a 24-hour ambulatory screening framework for both devices which includes the first T:R analysis in an EV-ICD cohort and the first full evaluation of P:R prediction. We introduce AmpRatioNet, a family of 1D convolutional neural network architectures operating directly on the ECG signal, and benchmark it against the best existing approach - based on 2D phase space reconstruction images. Evaluation uses 4,605 clinician-annotated 10-second segments from 89 patients, with patient-level 10-fold cross-validation and bootstrap confidence intervals. AmpRatioNet-SE demonstrates superior performance on every metric in each setting with no device- or ratio-specific redesign. An explainability analysis against interpretable classical peak labelling algorithms shows that AmpRatioNet-SE's increase in error on oversensing-prone segments is up to 14 times smaller than theirs. Segment-level predictions are aggregated into a 24-hour timeline, extending S-ICD screening beyond 10 seconds and offering a plausible EV-ICD screening pathway pending device-level validation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种24小时动态筛查框架与AmpRatioNet一维卷积网络，用于S-ICD与EV-ICD对T波/P波过感知风险的预测，性能全面优于基于二维相空间重构图像的现有方法。
AI.motivation: S-ICD与EV-ICD虽规避了经静脉导线并发症，但易发生过感知并触发不适当放电、增加死亡率。过感知风险由T:R、P:R振幅比预测，而该比值在24小时内波动：S-ICD筛查仅用单段10秒心电图，EV-ICD则无正式筛查流程。
AI.method: 构建面向两类设备的24小时动态筛查框架，首次在EV-ICD队列中开展T:R分析，并首次完整评估P:R预测；提出AmpRatioNet系列一维CNN架构，直接作用于心电信号，与基于二维相空间重构图像的最佳现有方法进行基准对比。采用89名患者的4,605段经临床医生标注的10秒片段，实施患者级10折交叉验证与自助法置信区间，并针对可解释的经典峰值标注算法做可解释性分析。
AI.result: AmpRatioNet-SE在各设定下所有指标均最优，且无需针对设备或比值进行专门重设计；在易过感知片段上，其误差增幅最多比经典峰值标注算法小14倍。片段级预测可聚合为24小时时间线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将S-ICD筛查从10秒拓展至24小时，并为EV-ICD提供了在器械级验证前可行的筛查路径。

title: Contextual Embeddings Beyond the Gold Chunk
summary:
Contextual embeddings represent chunks of a document with respect to the document's global context. These models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that a relevant document contains only a single relevant chunk. In this work, we argue that in real-world use cases a retriever should not only find answers spread over several chunks but also surface the evidence needed to verify them. To address this, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-context, a family of contextual embedding models trained by distilling graded chunk-level relevance from a query-aware context compression model. This removes the need for gold-chunk labels and makes the training targets independent of the chunking. We utilize a vision-language backbone for training and release pplx-embed-v2-context in 9B and 0.6B sizes with compatible embedding spaces. On the evaluation side, we introduce two benchmarks that label both the chunks that answer a query and the evidence needed to verify the answer. Context-bench is a controlled diagnostic, and Q2D-Chunk is built from real-world search queries. To encourage further research, we also publish Q2D-Chunk as a public leaderboard. Our 9B model sets a new state of the art on both benchmarks and ConTEB.
  We find that the visual retrieval capabilities of our 9B model transfer from its vision-language base model and propose to extend chunking to image inputs. We demonstrate that our models achieve state-of-the-art performance among dense retrievers on visual ViDoRe-V3 and that performance improves with granular image chunking.

AI.tldr: 提出 pplx-embed-v2-context 上下文嵌入模型族（9B/0.6B，共享嵌入空间），通过从查询感知上下文压缩模型蒸馏分级块级相关性进行训练，无需金标块标签；并发布 Context-bench 与 Q2D-Chunk 两个同时标注"答案块"与"验证证据块"的基准，9B 模型在两者及 ConTEB 上取得 SOTA，并将视觉检索能力迁移至图像分块（ViDoRe-V3 SOTA）。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文嵌入模型在训练与评测中默认"单个文档仅含一个相关块"，而真实检索场景要求检索器既能定位分散在多个块中的答案，又能返回验证答案所需的证据。为此需要新的训练信号来源与配套评测基准。
AI.method: 1) 以查询感知上下文压缩模型产生的分级块级相关性作为监督，蒸馏至上下文嵌入模型（免金标块标签，训练目标与分块方式解耦）；2) 采用视觉-语言骨干网络训练，发布 9B 与 0.6B 两个尺寸且嵌入空间兼容；3) 构建两个基准：Context-bench（受控诊断）与 Q2D-Chunk（真实搜索查询，并公开为排行榜）；4) 将分块扩展到图像输入，利用骨干的视觉检索能力迁移。
AI.result: 9B 模型在 Context-bench、Q2D-Chunk 及 ConTEB 上均刷新 SOTA；在视觉 ViDoRe-V3 上取得稠密检索器中的 SOTA，且性能随图像分块粒度细化而提升；0.6B 版本提供轻量选项。
AI.conclusion: 检索器应同时覆盖多块答案与支撑证据，蒸馏式分级相关性训练可在免标注条件下实现该目标；视觉-语言骨干使视觉检索能力自然迁移，图像分块细化可进一步增益，为多块检索与多模态检索研究提供模型与基准。

title: STORY2DIFF: A Dataset Linking Real-World User Stories to Code Changes
comment: Submitted to the ICSE 2027 Demonstrations and Data Showcase track
summary: Research on requirements-to-code tasks needs examples in which a genuine requirement is paired with the change that implemented it. Existing user-story collections, however, largely contain isolated or synthetic text. To address this limitation, we present STORY2DIFF, a dataset of 7,785 English user stories linked to merged pull requests from January 2017 to July 2026. The dataset is mined from a set of 982 public Java and Python repositories. Each record in the dataset combines the original issue, extracted Connextra elements, the associated pull request and commit metadata, a file-level diff capturing the code changes introduced by the associated pull request, and the affected files before and after the change. The tool we built to mine STORY2DIFF can be used to repeat the automatic extraction of the records, using different parameters (e.g., a different timeframe). The dataset can support a variety of tasks, including requirement discovery, traceability, change- impact estimation, and requirements-aware code generation. Dataset: https://github.com/riganelli/user-story-mining-pipeline/ releases/tag/V4.0.1. Video: https://youtu.be/qOhXUeyeiTQ.

AI.tldr: 提出STORY2DIFF数据集，包含7,785条英文用户故事与合并PR的关联记录，用于需求-代码任务研究。
AI.motivation: 需求到代码（requirements-to-code）任务需要真实需求与其实现变更配对的样本，但现有用户故事数据集多为孤立或合成文本，缺乏与代码变更的实证关联。
AI.method: 从982个公开Java与Python仓库中挖掘2017年1月至2026年7月的合并PR，将用户故事与PR关联；每条记录整合原始issue、抽取的Connextra要素、PR与commit元数据、文件级diff以及变更前后受影响文件；并提供可复用、可参数化（如调整时间范围）的自动挖掘工具管线。
AI.result: 构建了包含7,785条英文用户故事的数据集，每条均链接到已合并PR及其代码变更信息，并公开发布工具与数据（V4.0.1）。
AI.conclusion: STORY2DIFF弥补了真实需求-实现配对样本的缺失，可支撑需求发现、可追溯性、变更影响评估与需求感知代码生成等任务，且挖掘流程可复现扩展。

title: Post-Training Large Language Models with LLMON
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) treat all context tokens uniformly, lacking explicit separation between executable instructions and passive data. This leads to prompt injection vulnerabilities, ambiguous instruction binding, and unreliable execution control. We present a post-training methodology using LLMON (LLM Object Notation), a framework that enables separating instructions from data and requires explicit identifier-based execution. We construct a large-scale structured training corpus of 4.6B tokens spanning general, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and tool-calling data, augmented with distractor-infused variants in which competing instructions and irrelevant data segments are present in context but not referenced. Post-training two Granite-4.1 base models (3B and 8B) through supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning, we show that LLMON-structured supervision reduces attack success rates on indirect prompt-injection benchmarks from 53-100% to 0.02-5.6% while preserving general capabilities. We further introduce attention-based interpretability metrics that diagnose failure modes at individual transformer layers for structured inputs, revealing how our approach reshapes internal attention patterns. Our results demonstrate that explicit execution semantics can be taught through standard post-training without architectural modification.

AI.tldr: 提出 LLMON（LLM Object Notation）结构化表示与后训练方法，将指令与数据显式分离并要求基于标识符的显式执行，使 Granite-4.1 3B/8B 在间接提示注入上的攻击成功率从 53–100% 降至 0.02–5.6%，同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 对上下文 token 一视同仁，缺少可执行指令与被动数据的显式区分，导致提示注入漏洞、指令绑定歧义与执行控制不可靠。
AI.method: 构建 4.6B token 的大规模结构化训练语料（覆盖通用、RAG、工具调用），并加入含干扰指令与无关数据片段但不被引用的 distractor 变体；对 Granite-4.1 3B 与 8B 基座依次进行 SFT 与强化学习后训练；另引入基于注意力的可解释性指标，逐层诊断结构化输入下的失效模式。
AI.result: 间接提示注入基准上的攻击成功率由 53–100% 降至 0.02–5.6%，通用能力得以保持；注意力指标揭示该方法重塑了模型内部的注意力模式。
AI.conclusion: 显式执行语义可通过标准后训练习得，无需修改模型架构。

title: Towards Generalizing Pretrained All-Atom Representations to Unified Binder Design
summary: PairFormer-based all-atom models demonstrate strong capabilities in biomolecular binder design. However, existing methods often use all-atom representations for modality-specific binder design, such as protein and peptide design. In contrast, recent geometric latent diffusion models pursue unified binder design by representing molecular blocks from different modalities in a shared latent space. These complementary strengths motivate us to investigate how to generalize the use of pretrained all-atom representations to unified binder design. We introduce PairFuse, a parameter-efficient method that enables this generalization through representation fusion. Specifically, we use lightweight layerwise adapters to integrate pretrained all-atom representations into an independently pretrained geometric latent diffusion model. Our adapters integrate pretrained all-atom representations through two mechanisms: enriching the diffusion model's molecular block features and incorporating pairwise structural information into the geometric diffusion model's denoiser. Theoretically, we prove that the augmented denoiser preserves geometry and pairwise attention fusion provides additional attention expressivity beyond feature-only fusion. Experimentally, across antibody, peptide, and small molecule binder-design benchmarks, PairFuse achieves stronger performance than the pretrained diffusion model and existing representation-fusion baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 PairFuse，一种参数高效的表征融合方法，将预训练的全原子（PairFormer）表征推广到统一的几何隐空间扩散黏结剂设计框架中。
AI.motivation: 全原子模型（PairFormer）在特定模态（蛋白、多肽）黏结剂设计中表现强，但局限于逐模态；而几何隐扩散模型可跨模态统一设计。二者优势互补，因此研究如何把预训练全原子表征推广至统一黏结剂设计。
AI.method: 使用轻量级逐层适配器（layerwise adapters），将独立预训练的几何隐扩散模型与预训练全原子表征对接。适配器通过两种机制融合：一是丰富扩散模型的分子块特征；二是将成对结构信息注入几何扩散模型的去噪器（denoiser）。
AI.result: 理论证明：增强后的去噪器保持几何性质，且成对注意力融合比仅特征融合具有更强的注意力表达能力。实验在抗体、多肽、小分子三类黏结剂设计基准上，性能优于原始预训练扩散模型与现有表征融合基线。
AI.conclusion: PairFuse 以参数高效的方式实现了全原子表征向统一黏结剂设计的有效迁移，兼顾几何一致性与表达力，并在多模态任务上取得一致提升。

title: PR4Code: A Pull Requests Dataset for AI Code Generation
summary: AI-driven code generation is evolving from handling small, localized code-completion tasks toward supporting the implementation of full software features. To support this transition, this paper introduces PR4Code, a dataset of 4,508 Java and 8,831 Python curated Pull Requests (PRs) collected from GitHub, each enriched with metadata, commit histories, and detailed code changes. Unlike resources focused on isolated code fragments, PR4Code captures the feature implementation process, delivering a large and diverse collection of real-world development tasks that can be used to assess AI-driven solutions. Our analysis reveals substantial variability in PR structure, commit granularity, and textual content. In addition, we release scripts to regenerate and update the dataset, ensuring reproducibility and maintainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PR4Code数据集，包含来自GitHub的4,508个Java与8,831个Python真实Pull Request，附带元数据、提交历史与细粒度代码变更，用于支撑AI从局部补全走向完整特性实现的评测。
AI.motivation: AI代码生成正从小的局部代码补全任务向支持完整软件特性实现演进，而现有资源多聚焦孤立代码片段，缺乏能够刻画特性实现全过程的大规模真实开发任务集合，难以评估AI驱动的端到端解决方案。
AI.method: 从GitHub采集并筛选Java与Python的真实Pull Request，构建含元数据、提交历史（commit histories）与详细代码变更的数据集；对PR结构、提交粒度与文本内容进行统计分析；并发布可重新生成与更新数据集的脚本以保证可复现性与可维护性。
AI.result: 构建了4,508个Java与8,831个Python PR的语料库；分析显示PR在结构、提交粒度与文本内容上存在显著差异（substantial variability），数据集规模大且任务多样，可用于评估AI驱动的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: PR4Code为特性级代码生成研究提供了大规模、多样化的真实开发任务基准，弥补片段式资源的不足，并通过开源脚本保障数据集的可复现与持续维护。

title: Decompose, Don't Expand: Capability-Independent AI Systems by Construction
summary: A recurring design choice in building AI systems is whether, when a task is too hard for a model, to expand the model (make it larger, better-prompted, fine-tuned), or to decompose the task (extract the parts that admit a deterministic solution to a host, leaving the model only the irreducibly fuzzy residue). We make three claims. First, that many tasks commonly delegated whole to a model are in fact deterministic tasks with a small generative core. Second, and our central empirical result, that decomposing such a task yields a measurable and desirable property we call parity by construction: on the extracted sub-tasks the model-size performance curve becomes flat, because no model performs them at all. We measure this across nine models spanning a 494M-parameter local checkpoint to a frontier Opus-class model, a thirty-fold parameter range on the local family alone: once the host resolves the context, operation selection scores identically for all nine models and selector resolution for eight of nine, while the one task that does not decompose, labelling, remains sloped across the same range. Because the task leaves the model, a stock checkpoint suffices: no task-specific training and no fine-tuning. Third, that this is a general design discipline, not a domain trick: we show the same move recurring across physics setup, motion retargeting, and object-model editing, and in a Web-CLI tool family (same author, so not an independent replication). We give a method for locating the cut, the construction that makes a cut exist (a deterministic surface and a closed grammar over it), and a way to make the residue safe (resolve the deterministic context; verify the generative output), position the work against neuro-symbolic AI, tool-augmented language models, and generate-and-verify approaches, and are explicit about what is measured (one domain) versus illustrative (the rest).

AI.tldr: 论文提出：许多被整体交给大模型的任务实际上是"确定性任务 + 小型生成核心"，将其分解并交给宿主执行可产生"构造性同质（parity by construction）"——被抽取的子任务上模型规模-性能曲线变平。
AI.motivation: AI系统设计的常见抉择是"扩展模型"（更大、更好提示、微调）还是"分解任务"（把可确定性求解的部分交给宿主，仅留不可约的模糊残差给模型）。作者要论证后者是一种通用设计纪律而非领域技巧。
AI.method: 给出三项主张：(1) 大量整体委托给模型的任务实为确定性任务+小生成核心；(2) 分解带来"parity by construction"；(3) 该纪律具通用性。方法上提供：定位切分点的方法、使切分可行的构造（确定性表面 + 其上的封闭文法）、以及使残差安全的方式（解析确定性上下文、验证生成输出）。实验跨九个模型（494M本地检查点到前沿Opus级），本地族参数跨度30倍，覆盖物理搭建、动作重定向、对象模型编辑及Web-CLI工具族。
AI.result: 宿主解析上下文后，操作选择在九个模型上得分完全相同，选择器解析在九分之八上相同；而唯一不可分解的"标注"任务在同一参数范围内仍呈斜率。因任务离开模型，现成检查点即可胜任，无需任务特定训练或微调。
AI.conclusion: 任务分解是通用设计纪律：通过构造确定性表面与封闭文法创造切分，并以"解析确定性上下文+验证生成输出"保障残差安全。作者将其与神经符号AI、工具增强语言模型、生成-验证方法对照，并明确区分实测（单一领域）与示意（其余案例，且Web-CLI族同作者、非独立复现）。

title: Preserving Safety During Sequential Fine-Tuning: A Factorial and Geometric Analysis of Replay
summary: Benign fine-tuning can erode safety alignment in large language models, and sequential adaptation substantially compounds this risk. Prior work mitigates this erosion by replaying harmful-prompt refusals and benign-compliance examples, while other work instead matches base-model logits via distillation. However, the individual contributions of supervised exposure and distillation to safety behavior and refusal geometry during sequential adaptation remain unclear. We factor these two strategies apart and study their behavioral and geometric effects during sequential LoRA fine-tuning of Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B across diverse task sequences (code generation, German-language summarization, and science question-answering). Behaviorally, supervised replay exposure yields the largest reduction in HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) on Mistral, averaging 51.1 points below base, but at a substantial over-refusal cost, averaging 53.4 points above base on OR-Bench-hard. Logit distillation, without any supervised replay loss, largely prevents safety erosion at a fraction of this cost: an average 5.4-point ASR reduction against only a 5.1-point rise in over-refusal. Llama shows the same asymmetry between the two strategies. Combining exposure and distillation moderates exposure's over-refusal while leaving downstream task scores largely unaffected. Geometrically, the two models diverge: on Mistral, distillation preserves the base refusal direction more closely than exposure does, whereas on Llama, refusal behavior after exposure largely survives ablation of the extracted refusal direction. This dissociation between models indicates that preserving the base refusal direction is not a reliable proxy for behavioral safety.

AI.tldr: 本文解耦“监督式回放暴露”与“logit蒸馏”两种安全保持策略，在Mistral-7B与Llama-3-8B的顺序LoRA微调中比较其行为与几何效应，发现蒸馏以极小的过度拒答代价即可大幅抑制安全侵蚀，且“保留基座拒答方向”并非行为安全的可靠代理。
AI.motivation: 良性微调会侵蚀大模型的安全对齐，顺序适配进一步放大该风险。已有工作分别采用回放有害提示拒答/良性合规样本来缓解，或用蒸馏匹配基座logit，但二者对安全行为与拒答几何的各自贡献尚不清楚。
AI.method: 将监督暴露与蒸馏两种策略因子化分离，在Mistral-7B与Llama-3-8B上进行顺序LoRA微调，任务序列涵盖代码生成、德语摘要与科学问答；行为层面用HarmBench攻击成功率(ASR)与OR-Bench-hard过度拒答衡量，几何层面提取拒答方向并做消融分析。
AI.result: 监督式回放在Mistral上使ASR较基座平均降低51.1点，但过度拒答平均升高53.4点；仅用logit蒸馏（无监督回放损失）平均降ASR 5.4点，过度拒答仅升5.1点。Llama呈相同的不对称性。二者结合可缓和暴露带来的过度拒答，且下游任务分数基本不受影响。几何上，Mistral中蒸馏比暴露更贴近地保留基座拒答方向；Llama中暴露后的拒答行为在消融所提取拒答方向后仍基本存续。
AI.conclusion: 蒸馏是兼顾安全与可用性的高效策略，而监督回放存在显著的过度拒答代价；两模型间的几何解离表明，保留基座拒答方向不能作为行为安全的可靠代理指标。

title: From Intent to Improvement: Agentic Dataset Search for Better Model Training
summary: Finding training data in million-scale machine learning repositories is a Web search problem where text relevance is not enough. A query couples a semantic training goal with constraints such as task, license, and training stage, and the metadata that would verify them are often missing. Text retrieval ranks dataset cards by similarity but cannot enforce hard constraints or follow the relations that reach a sparsely described dataset. Free-form tool-calling agents are more flexible, but the same model that picks a dataset also declares it a match, and nothing checks that the query's constraints are actually met. Neither approach establishes that the data it returns will improve model training. To address it, we propose AgenticDS, a contract-governed agentic framework in which every language model decision instantiates a typed object before deterministic code consumes it. The framework compiles a query into a typed search plan, executes it through admissible deterministic operators over hybrid retrieval and bounded graph expansion, and verifies the provenance-grounded evidence before accepting a ranking or emitting a typed diagnosis that permits only local repairs. On HuDS-Bench, a new benchmark of 200 queries with 24,908 graded judgments pooled over 15 systems, AgenticDS improves NDCG@10 by 25.7\% over the strongest dense--sparse hybrid and by 18.9\% over a commercial LLM agent. A controlled search-to-train study further shows that the datasets it retrieves give the best downstream accuracy in mathematics, code, and medicine. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/nju-websoft/AgenticDS.

AI.tldr: 提出合同治理的智能体框架 AgenticDS，将查询编译为带类型的检索计划，经确定性算子执行并校验证据，在 HuDS-Bench 上显著提升数据集检索质量并改善下游训练。
AI.motivation: 百万级模型仓库中寻找训练数据本质是 Web 检索问题，单纯文本相关性不足：查询同时绑定语义训练目标与任务、许可、训练阶段等约束，而验证这些约束的元数据常缺失；稠密/稀疏文本检索无法强制硬约束或沿关系到达稀疏描述的数据集；自由形态工具调用智能体虽灵活，但选数据与判定匹配由同一模型完成、缺乏约束满足校验，且两者都无法保证返回数据能提升训练。
AI.method: AgenticDS 采用合同治理（contract-governed）机制：每个语言模型决策须先实例化为带类型对象，再由确定性代码消费。流程为：把查询编译为带类型的检索计划；通过可容许的确定性算子在混合检索与有界图扩展上执行；在接受排序前对溯源证据进行校验，否则输出仅允许局部修复的带类型诊断。
AI.result: 在 HuDS-Bench（200 条查询、15 个系统汇总的 24,908 条分级判断）上，NDCG@10 相比最强稠密—稀疏混合检索提升 25.7%，相比商用 LLM 智能体提升 18.9%；受控的检索到训练研究表明，其检索的数据在数学、代码、医学上取得最佳下游准确率。
AI.conclusion: 以类型化合同约束 LLM 决策、以确定性代码执行与证据校验替代模型自证匹配，可同时提升数据集检索排序质量与下游训练效果；代码与数据已公开。

title: ExploreRepair: Evidence-Specialized Agents for Vulnerability Repair under Information Constraints
summary: Automated vulnerability repair must often operate with incomplete vulnerability information: developers may lack an accurate vulnerability classification or a provided proof-of-vulnerability (PoV) test, yet still need to produce a repair. Without detailed information, a key challenge is to explore multiple plausible interpretations of the vulnerability before committing to a repair. To address this challenge, we propose ExploreRepair, a vulnerability repair framework that reconciles the vulnerability observations and repair implementations from a team of exploration agents. We first collect these observations and repair implementations from three agents, each tasked with exploring a specific dimension of the vulnerability. Then, a Lesson Aggregator and a Patch Aggregator independently synthesize repairs from these observations and concrete implementations before a final Aggregator reconciles their proposals without benchmark feedback. On PatchEval, ExploreRepair achieves repair success rates of 39.6% and 71.6% with GPT-5.6-Luna and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, respectively, exceeding EvoRepair, a state-of-the-art vulnerability repair approach, by 16.0 and 25.4 percentage points. On VulnLoc+, it achieves success rates of 51.4% and 62.9%, respectively, exceeding LoopRepair's variant without PoV tests by 20.0 and 17.1 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出ExploreRepair：多智能体探索+聚合的漏洞自动修复框架，在漏洞信息不完整（缺准确分类或PoV测试）时仍能生成修复，显著超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 实际漏洞修复常面临信息不完整：开发者可能缺少准确的漏洞分类，也没有可用的PoV（proof-of-vulnerability）测试，但仍需产出补丁。在此条件下，关键挑战是需要在确定修复方案前，探索对漏洞的多种合理理解，避免过早锁定单一（可能错误的）解释。
AI.method: 1) 三个探索型智能体，各自沿漏洞的一个特定维度进行探索，输出漏洞观察（observations）与具体修复实现（repair implementations）；2) 使用Lesson Aggregator与Patch Aggregator分别从"观察/经验"与"具体补丁实现"两条路径独立综合修复方案；3) 最终Aggregator在不依赖基准反馈（benchmark feedback）的情况下协调二者的提案，达成一致修复。
AI.result: PatchEval上，配GPT-5.6-Luna与DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的修复成功率分别为39.6%与71.6%，比SOTA方法EvoRepair高16.0与25.4个百分点；VulnLoc+上成功率分别为51.4%与62.9%，比无PoV测试的LoopRepair变体高20.0与17.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 面向信息不完整场景，多智能体按维度探索并对"经验层"与"补丁层"提案进行无反馈聚合，是提升漏洞自动修复成功率的有效范式；ExploreRepair在两个基准与两种模型上均取得一致性显著增益。

title: SkillCT: A Multidimensional Benchmark and Execution-Free Baseline for Agent Skill Assessment
summary: Agent skills package instructions, scripts, and resources for specialized tasks and are increasingly distributed through public Web repositories. However, existing skill benchmarks primarily focus on downstream task execution, insufficiently assessing specification quality, behavioral robustness, semantic alignment, and responsibility boundaries. Their reliance on task-specific tools, environments, and repeated executions limits scalability and pre-deployment assessment. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillCT, a benchmark that broadens skill assessment from downstream utility to a multidimensional characterization of skill quality. SkillCT evaluates skills across nine complementary dimensions spanning three aspects: Static Assessment, which captures intrinsic properties of the skill specification; Dynamic Assessment, which measures whether the induced behavior remains stable across backbone models and request variations; and Human-Assisted Assessment, which examines behavior-chain consistency and task granularity. These dimensions provide a broader view of skill quality than execution success. Applying SkillCT to a public skill corpus establishes a reference benchmark for analyzing quality weaknesses and relationships across dimensions. Building on this benchmark, we propose an execution-free quality evaluation baseline that predicts the multidimensional quality profiles of unseen skills by retrieving and leveraging similar reference skills, without executing the skills under evaluation. This reduces token consumption and evaluation time, while preserving consistency with the full assessment. Furthermore, SkillCT-guided optimization improves downstream task success and execution efficiency, demonstrating its value for skill refinement. These findings highlight the effectiveness of SkillCT in supporting scalable skill assessment, optimization, and repository maintenance.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillCT基准，将Agent技能评估从"下游任务执行"扩展为覆盖静态、动态、人工辅助三方面的九维质量刻画，并给出免执行的质量评估基线与技能优化方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent技能基准主要关注下游任务执行效果，对规格质量、行为鲁棒性、语义对齐与责任边界评估不足；且依赖任务特定工具、环境与重复执行，难以规模化与部署前评估。
AI.method: 构建SkillCT基准，九个互补维度分属三方面：静态评估（技能规格的内在属性）、动态评估（跨骨干模型与请求变化下的行为稳定性）、人工辅助评估（行为链一致性与任务粒度）。在公开技能语料上建立参考基准，并基于检索相似参考技能提出免执行的多维质量画像预测基线，同时利用SkillCT指导技能优化。
AI.result: 在公开技能语料上建立参考基准，揭示质量弱点与维度间关系；免执行基线在不运行被测技能的前提下与完整评估保持一致性，同时降低token消耗与评估时间；SkillCT引导的优化提升下游任务成功率与执行效率。
AI.conclusion: SkillCT有效支撑可规模化的技能评估、优化与仓库维护，为部署前的技能质量分析提供参考。

title: Are Seismic Foundation Models More Than Glorified Feature Extractors?
summary: Earthquake sequences are stochastic on two separated timescales: the seismic waves of any individual earthquake propagate over seconds to minutes, while the earthquakes themselves arrive as a sparse, self-exciting occurrence process, with inter-event intervals from seconds to months. Respecting both scales in one training objective is the open challenge. Foundation models (FMs) for seismic waveforms instead import their learning targets from audio and vision, where every target is computed from a single fixed-length window. Such a window holds one realization of the wave propagation (an earthquake trace), never the occurrence process that decides when earthquakes happen. We develop nine model designs sharing one Mamba encoder-decoder, trained on a fixed corpus of 3M windows, varying the self-supervised objective, quantization bottleneck and mixer; the two key comparisons are architecture-matched, varying the objective alone. Each checkpoint is evaluated frozen on three downstream tasks. Varying the target redistributes downstream skill rather than raising it, and no checkpoint wins everywhere. Adding masking pressure to our strongest classifier re-specializes it rather than making it a generalist: it gains 6.9 points of few-shot P-wave picking precision and loses 9.6 points of few-shot classification accuracy. By the standard imported from language and vision, these models are feature extractors rather than FMs. Controls on capacity, architecture, and domain proximity do not explain why skill moves rather than rises. Against task-specific baselines the advantage is regime-dependent: our checkpoints beat them few-shot on classification and ground-motion prediction, and trail them on full data. We argue the binding constraint is the target, and that settling the question requires a learning target defined across events, the timescale that makes seismicity stochastic in the first place.

AI.tldr: 论文系统比较九种基于同一Mamba编解码器的地震波形自监督模型，发现改变预训练目标只是"重新分配"下游技能而非提升整体能力，模型按语言/视觉标准仅属特征提取器而非基础模型，瓶颈在于学习目标未覆盖跨事件的发震时间尺度。
AI.motivation: 地震序列在秒—分钟（波传播）与秒—月（自激型发震过程）两个分离的时间尺度上随机；现有地震波形基础模型直接沿用音频/视觉的学习目标，均在单一固定长度窗口内计算标签，只能捕获一次波传播实现，无法覆盖决定"何时发震"的发生过程。如何在单一训练目标中同时尊重两个尺度是开放问题。
AI.method: 构建九个模型设计，共享同一Mamba编解码器，在300万窗口的固定语料上训练，系统性改变自监督目标、量化瓶颈与混合器；两项关键比较在架构匹配条件下仅改变目标。各检查点冻结后在三个下游任务上评测（少样本与小样本、P波拾取、分类、地面运动预测等），并做容量、架构、领域邻近性等对照实验。
AI.result: 改变目标使下游技能重新分配而非整体提升，无检查点全面占优；对最强分类器加入掩码压力后其专精化：少样本P波拾取精确率+6.9点，少样本分类准确率−9.6点。容量、架构与领域邻近性对照均无法解释"技能迁移而非上升"。相对任务专用基线优势依情形而定：少样本分类与地面运动预测占优，全数据条件下落后。
AI.conclusion: 按语言/视觉引入的标准，这些模型是特征提取器而非基础模型；核心约束在于学习目标本身，要解决该问题需定义跨事件、即覆盖使地震活动具有随机性的时间尺度的学习目标。

title: Heterogeneous Co-Evolution Learning for Tool-Efficient Search Agents with Zero Labels
summary: Deep search agents extend language models by interleaving reasoning with external retrieval. However, effective search-agent training requires addressing two challenges beyond final-answer optimization. First, the capability frontier of agents is largely determined by training questions, whereas fixed or labeled task collections cannot adapt as agents improve. Second, outcome-only reinforcement learning treats all successful trajectories equally, even when some correct answers rely on redundant searches, creating an inherent tension between answer accuracy and tool efficiency. To address these issues, we introduce \textsc{ZEST-Search}, a zero-label and tool-efficient framework for search-agent training via heterogeneous co-evolution. Starting from unlabeled reference questions, \textsc{ZEST-Search} constructs validated search tasks online through an answer-first and evidence-path-guided generation process. A heterogeneous proposer adaptively constructs training tasks around the solver's evolving capability boundary, while the solver learns search-augmented reasoning through reinforcement learning. To jointly optimize task difficulty and search efficiency, \textsc{ZEST-Search} employs an intermediate-difficulty reward for the proposer and a task-local tool-aware reward for the solver, encouraging informative tasks and correct answers with fewer redundant searches. Experiments on seven general-domain and multi-hop question answering benchmarks demonstrate that \textsc{ZEST-Search} consistently improves search-agent performance while achieving higher tool efficiency without labeled search-training data or expert search trajectories. Further analyses show that heterogeneous generation, adaptive difficulty control, and tool-aware optimization enable more effective search-agent training.

AI.tldr: 提出 ZEST-Search：一个零标注、工具高效的搜索智能体训练框架，用"提出者-求解者"异构协同进化在线生成任务并进行强化学习。
AI.motivation: 深度搜索智能体的训练存在两大挑战：(1) 固定或已标注的任务集合无法随智能体能力提升而自适应，训练问题决定了能力上限；(2) 仅用最终答案的强化学习对所有成功轨迹一视同仁，即使部分正确解答依赖冗余检索，导致答案准确率与工具效率之间存在固有张力。
AI.method: 从无标注参考问题出发，通过"答案优先 + 证据路径引导"的生成流程在线构建经校验的搜索任务；异构提出者(proposer)围绕求解者(solver)不断演进的能力边界自适应生成任务，求解者通过强化学习学习搜索增强推理。奖励设计上，为提出者设置"中等难度"奖励，为求解者设置任务局部的"工具感知"奖励，以鼓励有信息量的任务以及更少冗余检索下的正确答案。
AI.result: 在七个通用领域与多跳问答基准上，ZEST-Search 在无标注搜索训练数据和专家搜索轨迹的条件下，稳定提升搜索智能体性能并获得更高的工具效率。消融分析表明，异构生成、自适应难度控制与工具感知优化均对训练有效性有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过异构协同进化与双重奖励设计，ZEST-Search 在零标注设定下同时优化任务难度与检索效率，为搜索智能体的可扩展自训练提供了一条有效路径。

title: UPPAAi: Towards LLM-Assisted Modeling, Verification, Analysis and Synthesis
summary: For more than three decades, UPPAAL has supported the modelling and analysis of real-time and cyber-physical systems. Yet building a suitable model, formalising the intended properties, choosing analysis techniques and interpreting counterexamples remain iterative tasks that demand substantial expertise. Large language models (LLMs) can offer plausible explanations and even solutions, but they are not necessarily correct. We present UPPAAI, an extension of UPPAAL in which users construct, explain, debug and specify models in dialogue with an LLM. The guiding principle is that the user requests, the LLM proposes, explains and orchestrates, and UPPAAL verifies. UPPAAI exposes the UPPAAL editor, queries and verifier through a Tools API. We report on seven case studies, from explaining to a newcomer to learning a controller, covering timed automata, stochastic hybrid automata and strategy learning. LLMs proved to be extremely helpful in not just generating solutions but also pro-actively suggesting relevant UPPAAL features it was not asked about.

AI.tldr: 提出UPPAAI，将UPPAAL的编辑器、查询与验证器封装为Tools API，与LLM对话式协作建模、调试与规约，原则为"用户请求、LLM提议与编排、UPPAAL验证"，并在7个覆盖定时自动机、随机混合自动机与策略学习的案例中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: UPPAAL三十余年来支撑实时与信息物理系统的建模与分析，但构建合适模型、形式化目标性质、选择分析技术以及解释反例仍是高度依赖专家经验的迭代任务。LLM虽能给出看似合理的解释与方案，却不保证正确性，因此需要一种机制将LLM的生成能力与UPPAAL的形式化验证能力结合。
AI.method: 以UPPAAL为扩展基础开发UPPAAI，通过Tools API暴露UPPAAL编辑器、查询接口与验证器；用户以对话方式构造、解释、调试和规约模型，LLM负责提议、解释与流程编排，由UPPAAL执行验证以保证正确性。
AI.result: 开展7个案例研究，涵盖面向新手的模型解释、控制器学习，涉及定时自动机、随机混合自动机与策略学习。实验显示LLM不仅有助于生成解决方案，还会主动建议用户未询问但相关的UPPAAL特性。
AI.conclusion: LLM与形式化验证工具的分工协作模式（LLM提议、UPPAAL裁决）可行且实用，能显著降低UPPAAL建模与分析的门槛；未来可进一步扩展对话式工作流与工具接口能力。

title: BridgeRouter: Gain-Aware Instance Routing over Cross-Modal Bridge Portfolios
summary: Lightweight representation bridges make pretrained, task-adapted EEG foundation models executable on other biosignal modalities without retraining their backbones. However, selecting a single bridge pathway globally assigns every instance to the same transfer route and ignores complementary errors across routes. We therefore formulate multi-bridge transfer as an instance-level algorithm-selection problem and introduce BridgeRouter, a gain-aware router over a portfolio of frozen cross-modal pathways. A validation-selected Single Best Solver (SBS) serves as a protected default route. During training, task labels are used to compute the reduction in negative log-likelihood provided by each alternative route relative to the SBS, and a lightweight MLP predicts these route-specific gains from a target-modality representation extracted by a frozen encoder. At inference, BridgeRouter observes only the target modality, requires neither EEG, task labels, nor predictions from all candidate routes, and executes exactly one bridge pathway: the route with the largest predicted gain when that gain exceeds a validation-calibrated threshold, and the SBS otherwise. We evaluate seven EEG foundation-model bridge pathways for EMG-based freezing-of-gait detection on FOG and ECG-based sleep classification on ISRUC. Across five seeds, BridgeRouter achieves $81.38\pm1.11\%$ balanced accuracy on FOG, improving over the BIOT SBS by $11.49$ percentage points, and $62.92\pm2.17\%$ on ISRUC, improving over the CBraMod SBS by $3.83$ points. Per-instance bridge oracles reach $99.96\%$ and $78.61\%$, respectively, revealing substantial remaining portfolio headroom. These results show that anchor-relative gain prediction can convert complementary cross-modal bridge behavior into deployable instance-level routing improvements while retaining single-route inference.

AI.tldr: BridgeRouter将多桥接跨模态迁移形式化为实例级算法选择问题，用基于增益预测的轻量路由器从冻结跨模态桥接组合中为每个样本选择单一最优路径。
AI.motivation: 轻量桥接可使预训练EEG基础模型免重训地迁移到其他生物信号模态，但全局选择单一桥接路径会把所有实例分配到同一迁移路线，忽略了不同路线间互补的误差。
AI.method: 将多桥接迁移建模为实例级算法选择：以验证集选出的Single Best Solver（SBS）为默认保护路线；训练时用任务标签计算各备选路线相对SBS的负对数似然降低量，由轻量MLP从冻结编码器提取的目标模态表示预测各路线的增益；推理时仅输入目标模态，执行预测增益最大且超过验证集校准阈值的路线，否则回退SBS。
AI.result: 在FOG数据集EMG步态冻结检测上，7条EEG基础模型桥接路径中BridgeRouter五种子平衡准确率达81.38±1.11%，较BIOT SBS提升11.49个百分点；ISRUC ECG睡眠分类达62.92±2.17%，较CBraMod SBS提升3.83个百分点；实例级桥接oracle分别达99.96%与78.61%，显示组合仍有较大提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 锚点相对增益预测能将互补的跨模态桥接行为转化为可部署的实例级路由增益，同时保持单路线推理的低开销特性。

title: Measured or Real? When Model-Derived Measurements Can Be Corrected or Compared
summary: Numbers computed from trained models, such as an example's difficulty or a model's benchmark lead, change with seed and prompt. We ask when such measurements can be corrected or compared. Noise shrinks correlations, and the textbook correction divides by the square root of two estimated reliabilities. On two CIFAR-100 difficulty scores, it returned correlations above one in 70 of 100 classes. We prove that its mean squared error is infinite even when the correlation and the reliabilities use separate seeds. Our rule corrects only when both reliabilities pass a significance test, then divides by their upper confidence bounds. Its output is always bounded, and its coverage guarantees assume Gaussian noise. It helps once reliability is well estimated, more than halving the error with 500 simulated units. Prompt settings can reverse rankings. On ARC, Qwen2-1.5B trails Llama-3.2-3B by 3.8 points with no examples in the prompt and leads by 16.6 with two. Across four benchmarks, averaging the two settings names one winner for 15 of 16 such reversals. We compare models within each setting, controlling family-wise error asymptotically in the number of items for a fixed prompt grid. Aligning embedding coordinates across seeds raises held-out per-dimension reliability from 0.003 to 0.813.

AI.tldr: 论文研究从已训练模型计算出的测量指标（如样本难度、模型基准领先度）在种子与提示变化下的可靠性与可比较性问题，提出基于置信上界的有界校正规则与提示网格内的统计比较框架。
AI.motivation: 从训练模型计算出的量（难度分、基准领先度）会随随机种子与提示而变化。经典"除以两估计信度平方根"的衰减校正会让噪声收缩相关性，甚至产生超过1的相关，使此类测量无法安全地校正或跨条件比较。
AI.method: 1) 证明教科书式衰减校正（除以√(r₁r₂)）即便相关性估计与信度估计使用不同种子，其均方误差仍为无穷；2) 提出仅在两个信度均通过显著性检验时进行校正、并除以信度置信上界的规则，输出恒有界，覆盖性保证以高斯噪声为前提；3) 对提示设定导致的排名反转，提出在每个提示设定内比较模型、以固定提示网格下项目数渐近控制族错误率；4) 跨种子对齐嵌入坐标以提升逐维信度。
AI.result: 在两个CIFAR-100难度分数上，经典校正使100个类别中有70个相关系数超过1。新规则在500个模拟单元下误差减半以上。ARC上Qwen2-1.5B在零示例提示下落后Llama-3.2-3B 3.8分、在两示例下反超16.6分；四个基准中共16次此类反转，对两设定取平均可对15次给出唯一胜者。跨种子对齐嵌入使留出集逐维信度从0.003升至0.813。
AI.conclusion: 模型衍生测量并非可直接校正或比较的稳定量：经典衰减校正不可靠且MSE无穷，应采用有界、带显著性门控的置信上界校正；提示设定可反转模型排名，应在设定内比较并渐近控制族错误率，而非简单合并提示条件。

title: Unraveling the Efficacy of Neuron Coverage Criteria on Testing Large Language Models
comment: Published in ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM), 2026. 35 pages
summary: Neuron coverage criteria aim to assess test suite quality and guide test input generation, but their effectiveness for Transformer-based language models remains unclear. We evaluate six criteria, including four established and two recent criteria, across encoder-only, decoder-only, and encoder-decoder models. Our evaluation examines error-revealing capability, distribution diversity, sample fairness (category diversity), and guidance for test input generation. The results reveal uneven effectiveness. Erroneous samples provide only 0.32% additional coverage over noise samples, indicating limited sensitivity to adversarial errors. By contrast, coverage criteria effectively assess distribution diversity and sample fairness in 26 and 30 of 33 configurations, respectively. Incorporating neuron-wise coverage guidance into test input generation increases adversarial sample production by only 4.56%. These findings suggest that existing coverage criteria can serve as an antidote for assessing diversity but remain largely a placebo for revealing adversarial errors, particularly when used individually. Their practical value therefore depends on whether these limited benefits justify the computational overhead of testing large Transformer-based models. Our study highlights the need for more robust and efficient coverage criteria tailored to these models, with stronger error-revealing capability and greater value for test generation.

AI.tldr: 系统评测六种神经元覆盖准则在仅编码器、仅解码器和编码器-解码器三类Transformer语言模型上的有效性，发现覆盖准则能有效评估分布多样性与样本公平性，但对揭示对抗错误的敏感性和对测试输入生成的指导作用有限。
AI.motivation: 神经元覆盖准则常用于评估测试集质量和指导测试输入生成，但其对基于Transformer的语言模型是否有效尚不明确，因此需要系统性的实证评估。
AI.method: 选取六种覆盖准则（四种经典准则与两种近期准则），在encoder-only、decoder-only和encoder-decoder三类模型上进行评测，从错误揭示能力、分布多样性、样本公平性（类别多样性）以及对测试输入生成的指导能力四个维度进行分析。
AI.result: 效果不均衡：错误样本相比噪声样本仅带来0.32%的额外覆盖率，说明对对抗性错误敏感性有限；而在33种配置中，覆盖准则分别有26和30种配置能有效评估分布多样性与样本公平性；将神经元级覆盖引导融入测试输入生成，对抗样本产出仅提升4.56%。
AI.conclusion: 现有覆盖准则可作为评估多样性的"解药"，但在揭示对抗错误方面基本是"安慰剂"，单独使用时尤甚。其实际价值取决于有限收益能否抵消测试大型Transformer模型的计算开销，亟需设计针对此类模型、具备更强错误揭示能力且对测试生成更有价值的鲁棒高效覆盖准则。

title: DecompGym: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Designing Decomposition Algorithms
summary: Benders decomposition and column generation solve large optimization problems by passing cuts, columns, and dual values between a master problem and subproblems, and are hard to implement correctly. Large language models now automate parts of algorithm design, which points toward agents that build decomposition solvers for new problems. As a first step toward such agents, we study how well current coding agents design and implement these two algorithms, and how they fail. We introduce DecompGym, 81 instances from nine problem families (five Benders, four column generation), in which an agent writes a solver for a prescribed method. Each solver must meet three criteria: execution within a 60-second time limit; numerical feasibility together with a method audit, in which an LLM judge reads the solver's code; and an objective within 1% of the stored optimal objective. We evaluate 12 GPT, Claude, and Gemini models running in coding-agent tools. Over up to ten attempts, we compare independent regeneration with reflection, which first diagnoses the failure. On the first attempt, two models solve every instance and seven solve more than 90%. Most Benders failures (48 of 62) are missing or suboptimal solutions. The most common column-generation failure is a method-audit rejection. Output checks alone would accept 93 of the 108 attempts that fail the method audit. The most common rejection, an optimalif, occurs 96 times, 92 of them in one model.Reflection turns 66% of retries into successes, compared with 39% for regeneration, and it repairs method-audit failures, for which the judge names the defecective gaps. Agents for decomposition therefore need checks on how a solver reaches its answer and feedback that locates the error. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/SIKAI-C/DecompGym.

AI.tldr: 提出DecompGym基准（9个问题族、81个实例），评估12个编码智能体设计并实现Benders分解与列生成的正确性及失败模式，发现反思式重试优于独立重生成，且方法审计（检查求解过程）不可被输出检查替代。
AI.motivation: Benders分解与列生成需在主问题与子问题间传递割、列与对偶值，实现难度高、易出错；LLM已能自动化部分算法设计，走向"为���问题构建分解求解器"的智能体前，需先弄清当前编码智能体在实现这两类算法上的能力边界与失败机制。
AI.method: 构建DecompGym：81个实例、9个问题族（5类Benders、4类列生成），智能体需针对指定方法编写求解器。三重判定标准：①60秒内完成执行；②数值可行且通过方法审计（由LLM评委阅读求解器代码）；③目标值在存储最优值1%以内。评测12个GPT/Claude/Gemini模型在编码智能体工具中的表现，最多10次尝试，比较"独立重生成"与"反思（先诊断失败再重写）"两种重试策略。
AI.result: 首次尝试中两个模型解决全部实例，七个模型解决率超90%。Benders失败62例中48例为缺失解或次优解；列生成最常见失败为方法审计不通过。仅做输出检查会误接受108个审计失败尝试中的93个。最常见拒因"optimalif"出现96次，其中92次集中于单一模型。反思重试成功率66%，独立重生成仅39%；反思可修复方法审计失败，因评委能指名缺陷所在。
AI.conclusion: 分解算法智能体既需要检验"求解器如何得到答案"（过程/方法审计），也需要能定位错误的反馈信号；仅靠结果正确性检查不足。基准开源。

title: Detecting Brain Cancer Progression Through Signatures of Wearable Accelerometry Data
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 TS-LIMITS Workshop
summary: Glioblastoma and other high-grade gliomas (HGG) have a poor prognosis and are associated with progressive functional decline. The standard of care to assess progressive disease is contrast-enhanced MRI, which is expensive, claustrophobic, and performed only once every 2-3 months. Wearable accelerometers offer a non-invasive alternative for continuously monitoring patient function between clinic visits. However, accelerometry data streams are typically noisy and highly patient-specific, making conventional time series methods and summary statistics poorly suited to detecting clinically meaningful change. This work aims to classify stable versus progressive disease states by applying rough path signatures for feature extraction from wrist-worn accelerometer data. We convert accelerometer recordings from HGG patients enrolled in the BrainWear study into walking-path segments and use signature kernel maximum mean discrepancy (SigMMD) to quantify change in patients' walking behaviour. We overcome the challenge of inter-patient heterogeneity by adjusting for the natural variation in a patient's walking during stable tumour periods. This patient-specific normalisation substantially improves separation, yielding a candidate biomarker of tumour progression. Our results provide proof-of-concept evidence that signature-based analysis of wearable accelerometry can distinguish stable from progressive disease states, motivating larger longitudinal studies of continuous wearable monitoring as a digital biomarker in neuro-oncology.

AI.tldr: 提出用粗糙路径签名（rough path signature）从腕戴加速度计数据中提取特征，并借助签名核MMD（SigMMD）量化患者步行行为变化，经个体化基线归一化后可将高级别胶质瘤患者的稳定期与进展期区分开，作为肿瘤进展的候选数字生物标志物。
AI.motivation: 高级别胶质瘤（HGG）预后差且功能进行性衰退；现行评估进展的标准为增强MRI，费用高、有幽闭恐惧问题，且每2–3个月才做一次。可穿戴加速度计可无创连续监测诊间功能状态，但其数据噪声大、高度个体化，常规时间序列方法与汇总统计难以捕捉有临床意义的变化。
AI.method: 基于BrainWear研究，将HGG患者的腕戴加速度计记录切分为步行路径片段；采用粗糙路径签名做特征提取，并用签名核最大均值差异（SigMMD）度量患者步行行为的变化；针对患者间异质性，利用患者在肿瘤稳定期的自然步行波动进行个体化归一化。
AI.result: 个体化归一化显著提升了稳定与进展两类状态的可分性，所形成的指标可作为肿瘤进展的候选生物标志物；签名分析能够区分稳定与进展疾病状态。
AI.conclusion: 结果为“基于签名的可穿戴加速度计分析可区分稳定与进展疾病状态”提供了概念验证证据，支持在神经肿瘤学中开展更大规模纵向研究，将连续可穿戴监测发展为数字生物标志物。

title: When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications
summary: To succeed in real-world long-horizon software development, coding agents must satisfy multi-dimensional task specifications, such as interface compatibility and error handling, and do so without breaking existing dependencies. However, current works lack specification in both quantity and diversity, often emphasizing primary goals while ignoring complex constraints. Synthesizing tasks to bridge this gap presents two challenges: naively adding specifications risks reducing tasks to trivial checklists rather than compelling joint reasoning, and verifying these subtle interactions risks overlooking hidden flaws or rejecting valid alternatives. To address these challenges, we introduce CodeSpecWeave, a framework for synthesizing tasks with rich, interdependent specifications. Grounded in real developer seeds, a synthesis agent iteratively develops both coupled task requirements and executable tests, while a review agent audits solution trajectories from multiple models to guarantee test reliability. Using this pipeline, we construct 4,670 training tasks across 2,865 repositories. Applying Reinforcement learning on these tasks significantly improves performance over the base model on DeepSWE-v1.1, largely outperforming existing baselines. Furthermore, we curate CodeSpecWeave-Bench, a rigorous benchmark comprising 100 tasks and 1,044 specifications, which clearly separates frontier models and reveals significant headroom in handling interdependent engineering constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出 CodeSpecWeave 框架，从真实开发者种子出发合成具有丰富、相互依赖规格的编程任务，并用 RL 训练与构建基准验证其对复杂工程约束能力的提升。
AI.motivation: 真实长时程软件开发要求编码智能体同时满足多维规格（如接口兼容、错误处理）且不破坏既有依赖，但现有工作合成的任务规格在数量与多样性上不足，往往只强调主目标而忽略复杂约束。
AI.method: 合成任务的难点有二：naively 叠加规格会使任务退化为琐碎清单而非联合推理；验证规格间微妙交互时易漏检缺陷或误拒合法解法。CodeSpecWeave 以真实开发者种子为基础，由合成智能体迭代地同时生成耦合任务需求与可执行测试，再由审查智能体审计多模型解答轨迹以保证测试可靠性。
AI.result: 构建覆盖 2,865 个仓库的 4,670 个训练任务；在这些任务上做 RL 后于 DeepSWE-v1.1 上较基座模型显著提升，大幅超越现有基线。另构建 CodeSpecWeave-Bench（100 个任务、1,044 条规格），能清晰区分前沿模型并揭示处理相互依赖工程约束的显著提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 通过"合成—审查"双智能体闭环生成高耦合规格任务，既能有效提升编码智能体的长时程工程能力，也能提供具有区分度的严格评测基准。

title: Prototype-Guided Dynamic Domain Modulation and a Large-Scale Multi-SKU Benchmark for Shampoo Bottle Surface Defect Detection
summary: Industrial shampoo-bottle surface defect detection must operate across many stock keeping units (SKUs), where differences in bottle geometry, material, label layout, reflectance, and imaging conditions can substantially alter the appearance of the same defect. Existing industrial defect datasets rarely provide both instance-level defect annotations and product-variant identities, making it difficult to study SKU-aware detection under realistic manufacturing conditions. We introduce Bottle-SKU, a large-scale multi-SKU benchmark for shampoo bottle surface defect detection. Bottle-SKU contains 13,119 images, 20,419 instance-level bounding boxes, seven defect categories, and 48 bottle SKUs, enabling evaluation of both shared defect recognition and SKU-specific appearance variation. To address the challenge of SKU-specific appearance variation, we propose Prototype-Guided Dynamic Domain Modulation (ProDMM). ProDMM constructs a visual prototype for each SKU from training images and predicts a soft SKU distribution for each input. The resulting prototype-conditioned representation dynamically generates low-rank Query/Value modulation for the visual backbone and residual conditioning for defect-text-to-visual attention, while preserving the pretrained Grounding DINO detection pathway. The model is trained jointly with detection, SKU-domain classification, and modulation-regularization objectives. Experiments on Bottle-SKU and the public GC10-DET-SKU metallic surface defect dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of prototype-guided domain conditioning for industrial surface defect detection.

AI.tldr: 提出大规模多SKU洗发水瓶表面缺陷检测基准Bottle-SKU与原型引导动态域调制方法ProDMM。
AI.motivation: 工业洗发水瓶缺陷检测需跨多个SKU运行，瓶体几何、材料、标签布局、反射率与成像条件差异会显著改变同一缺陷的外观；现有工业缺陷数据集很少同时提供实例级缺陷标注与产品变体身份，难以研究真实制造条件下的SKU感知检测。
AI.method: 构建Bottle-SKU基准（13,119张图像、20,419个实例级框、7类缺陷、48个SKU）；提出ProDMM：为每个SKU由训练图像构建视觉原型，对输入预测软SKU分布，据此生成原型条件表征，对视觉主干动态注入低秩Query/Value调制，并对缺陷文本-视觉注意力施加残差条件化，同时保留预训练Grounding DINO检测通路；联合检测、SKU域分类与调制正则目标训练。
AI.result: 在Bottle-SKU与公开GC10-DET-SKU金属表面缺陷数据集上的实验验证了原型引导域条件化对工业表面缺陷检测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 同时具备实例级标注与SKU身份的多SKU基准可支撑真实工况下的SKU感知检测研究；以SKU视觉原型驱动的软域调制、在不破坏预训练检测通路的前提下适配外观变异，是提升工业表面缺陷检测性能的有效范式。

title: Learning from Relative Action Credit for Escaping Local Minima
summary: Reinforcement learning holds the promise of robots that learn manipulation skills from interaction alone, without pretrained priors or demonstration data. In practice, on-policy methods such as PPO routinely stall on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks: dense reward shaping carries the policy through stages, yet stitching them together and discovering sparsely rewarded events rarely succeeds. We trace this failure to the missing action discrimination in state-value credit assignment: a state-value critic judges progress only by episode outcomes, so when the policy converges to a partial solution all outcomes coincide, and improvement stops because no action can prove better than another. We therefore extend PPO with an action conditioned value critic which, can compare the executed action with alternatives sampled at the same state and aid the learning signal. Combined with Generalized Advantage Estimation and a bound on exploration noise, we show how the extended algorithm escapes the plateau and completes precise peg insertion within a training budget where PPO with identical exploration fails.

AI.tldr: 作者指出PPO在长时序、接触丰富任务中停滞的根源在于状态值critic缺乏动作判别能力，提出动作条件值critic（比较执行动作与同状态采样替代动作），结合GAE与探索噪声约束，使算法能突破局部平台，在相同训练预算下完成精密插销任务。
AI.motivation: 强化学习本应让机器人仅靠交互学习操作技能（无需预训练先验或示教数据），但PPO等on-policy方法在长时序、接触丰富任务上常停滞：稠密奖励塑形虽能引导分阶段推进，却难以将各阶段拼接并发现稀疏奖励事件。作者将失败归因于状态值信用分配中缺失的动作判别性——状态值critic仅以回合结果评判进展，当策略收敛到部分解时所有结果趋同，无法区分动作优劣，改进停滞。
AI.method: 扩展PPO，引入动作条件值critic：在给定状态下将已执行动作与采样的替代动作进行比较，提供更具判别性的学习信号；并与广义优势估计（GAE）结合，同时对探索噪声施加约束。
AI.result: 扩展算法能够逃离平台期，在与PPO（相同探索设置）失败相当的训练预算内完成精密插销（peg insertion）任务。
AI.conclusion: 状态值critic缺乏动作判别性是on-policy RL在长时序接触任务中停滞的关键原因；动作条件值critic配合GAE与探索噪声约束可有效突破该瓶颈，实现精密装配类技能的纯交互学习。

title: When Modernization Breaks Working Code: A Single-File Study of LLMs on Legacy PHP
summary: Pasting a legacy file into an LLM and asking it to "modernize this" is an easy shortcut. But is the result better than leaving the code alone? In this paper, we study this single-file setting with five LLMs, each asked to modernize 100 WordPress 4.0 PHP files to PHP 8.3 while preserving behavior, with no project context or execution feedback. We evaluate every output with 630 hidden behavioral checks and 511 Rector-detected modernization findings. We compare against two baselines: the unchanged originals and the rule-based tool Rector. Often, the answer is no. Untouched, 83 files already pass every check; the best LLM leaves only 59. Each model breaks 32-51 working files while repairing at most 10, whereas Rector breaks 7 and repairs 6. Most of this damage is unnecessary. Only 37 findings (7 percent) require a change under PHP 8.3, yet in compatible files with no required change, the LLMs break 36-60 percent (Rector: 8 percent). The model with the highest modernization score is no more compatible than its closest competitors. Most regressed checks come from files that no longer load at all, often because of type declarations PHP itself rejects. These are errors that need no project context to avoid. Evaluations of LLM-based modernization should therefore measure against a no-change baseline and report modernization and behavioral preservation separately.

AI.tldr: 本文用5个LLM对100个WordPress 4.0 PHP文件做单文件"现代化"至PHP 8.3，并以"不作修改"和Rector为基线，发现LLM现代化常使代码变差：多数改动非必要，且大量破坏原本可正常运行的代码。
AI.motivation: "把遗留代码丢给LLM说'现代化一下'"已成为常见捷径，但其结果是否优于保持原样尚缺乏严格实证；且现有LLM现代化评测往往只报现代化得分，忽视行为保持。
AI.method: 单文件设定：5个LLM各自将100个WordPress 4.0 PHP文件现代化到PHP 8.3，要求保持行为，无项目上下文与执行反馈。评估用630项隐藏行为检查与511项Rector检测的现代化发现；基线为未修改原文与规则工具Rector。
AI.result: 原文未改动时有83个文件通过全部检查，最佳LLM仅余59个；各模型破坏32–51个原本可用的文件，最多修复10个，而Rector破坏7个、修复6个。仅37项（7%）发现是PHP 8.3下必需改动，但在无需改动的兼容文件中LLM仍破坏36%–60%（Rector为8%）。现代化得分最高的模型行为兼容性并不更优。大部分回退源于文件无法加载，常因类型声明被PHP拒绝。
AI.conclusion: LLM单文件现代化常劣于不改；多数改动属不必要且引入本可避免的错误。评测LLM现代化应以"不修改"为基线，并分别报告现代化程度与行为保持。

title: From Natural Language to Real Schematics: An Automated Workflow for Power Electronics Schematic Synthesis
summary: Designing power electronics converters traditionally requires intensive human expertise across topology sizing, commercial component selection, circuit simulation verification, and schematic drafting. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in electronic design automation (EDA), applying standalone LLMs directly to board-level power electronics schematic synthesis suffers from severe engineering hallucinations, including inaccurate analytical sizing, fabricated or mismatched component part numbers, violated voltage derating margins, and broken topological connectivity. In this paper, we propose a Bounded Dual-Loop Automated Schematic Synthesis Framework that translates natural language specifications into verified, editable KiCad schematics and manufacturing deliverables. Our workflow integrates six stages across three functional columns: (1) requirement parsing and knowledge-driven power stage synthesis covering non-isolated (Buck, Boost) and isolated/resonant (Flyback, DAB, half-bridge LLC) topologies; (2) contract- and evidence-coordinated component selection grounded in distributor APIs and OEM datasheets, coupled with closed-loop ngspice transient verification and stress feedback; and (3) modular control hardware integration and multi-format deliverable generation featuring native KiCad netlist round-trip verification. End-to-end case studies on a 24-36V to 12V,2A Buck converter (29 positions, 83 verified terminals) and an isolated 48V to 24V, 0.5A, Dual-Active Bridge (DAB) converter (87 positions, 341 verified terminals), alongside comparative evaluations against a Vanilla LLM baseline, demonstrate that our framework improves component verification coverage from 22.2 to 98.6, nominal value consistency from 0 to 97.7, and SPICE simulation pass rates from 0 to 100.

AI.tldr: 提出“有界双环自动原理图综合框架”，将自然语言规格转化为经校验、可编辑的KiCad原理图与制造交付物，通过知识驱动功率级综合、合同/证据协调的元件选型、闭环ngspice瞬态验证等六阶段流程，把元件核验覆盖率从22.2%提升至98.6%、标称值一致性从0提升至97.7%、SPICE仿真通过率从0提升至100%。
AI.motivation: 传统功率电子变换器设计高度依赖人工经验，需覆盖拓扑定容、商用元件选型、电路仿真验证与原理图绘制。尽管LLM在EDA中展现潜力，但单独使用LLM直接进行板级功率电子原理图综合时存在严重“工程幻觉”：解析定容不准确、元件料号虚构或不匹配、违反电压降额裕度、拓扑连接断裂，因此需要引入约束与多环节协同的框架加以“有界”控制。
AI.method: 框架以三条功能列、六个阶段组织：(1)需求解析与知识驱动功率级综合，覆盖非隔离（Buck、Boost）与隔离/谐振（Flyback、DAB、半桥LLC）拓扑；(2)基于分销商API与OEM数据手册的“合同—证据”协同元件选型，并耦合ngspice瞬态验证与应力反馈构成闭环；(3)模块化控制硬件集成与多格式交付物生成，含原生KiCad网表往返验证。同时与Vanilla LLM基线进行对比评估。
AI.result: 端到端案例包括24–36V转12V/2A Buck变换器（29个位号、83个经核验端子）与隔离型48V转24V/0.5A双有源桥（DAB）变换器（87个位号、341个经核验端子）。相对Vanilla LLM基线，元件核验覆盖率由22.2提升至98.6，标称值一致性由0提升至97.7，SPICE仿真通过率由0提升至100。
AI.conclusion: 将有界双环机制与证据驱动的元件选型、闭环仿真反馈及网表往返校验相结合，可有效抑制LLM在板级功率电子原理图综合中的工程幻觉，输出经核验且可编辑的KiCad原理图与制造交付物；但评估仍限于两类拓扑的少量案例，跨拓扑泛化性与设计效率等需进一步验证。

title: Integral Probability Boundaries
summary: Bounds based on Integral Probability Metrics (IPMs) are ubiquitous in machine learning and statistics, appearing, e.g., in generalization, alignment, fairness, and privacy. IPMs reduce the discrepancy between two distributions to a single worst-case gap between expectations. This compression is costly: for rare events, safety failures, or under-represented groups, IPM-based bounds are loose or vacuous. We introduce a non-linear generalization of IPMs, which we term Integral Probability Boundaries (IPBs). Unlike IPMs, IPBs provide bounds that are tight at the extremes. We derive their basic properties and present algorithms for estimating them in practically relevant settings. We demonstrate the usage of IPBs in both theoretical and practical applications for alignment, judge-free performance estimation, and fairness, where they enable us to obtain sharp bounds on performance and fairness gaps, e.g., 15 p.p. more precise estimates on fairness gaps for rare groups in a realistic generative modeling task, compared to the state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出积分概率边界（Integral Probability Boundaries, IPBs），作为积分概率度量（IPMs）的非线性推广，在分布比较的极端情形下也能给出紧的界，并在对齐、无评判器性能估计和公平性任务中取得更精确的结果。
AI.motivation: IPMs 将两分布差异压缩为期望之间的单一最坏情形差距，这一压缩代价高昂：对稀有事件、安全失效或代表性不足的群体，基于 IPM 的界往往宽松甚至无效（vacuous），需要一种在极端处仍紧的界定工具。
AI.method: 提出 IPMs 的非线性推广——积分概率边界（IPBs）；推导其基本性质，并给出在实际相关场景中估计 IPBs 的算法。
AI.result: 在对齐、无评判器性能估计（judge-free performance estimation）与公平性任务中验证 IPBs 的理论与实践价值；例如在真实生成建模任务中，对稀有群体的公平性差距估计比现有最优方法精确约 15 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: IPBs 克服了 IPMs 在稀有事件与少数群体上界不紧的缺陷，可得到性能与公平性差距的紧界，是一种有实用价值的非线性的分布差异度量框架。

title: Manual binding and semi-automated interface generation for efficient simulation backends with user-friendly frontends: A~demonstration for epidemic use cases
summary:
Challenges and chances of mathematical software are directly entangled with the programming language used. Depending on the background of developers and users, conflicts between different goals may arise. While several, e.g., scripting languages allow a low barrier and user-friendly entry to mathematical modeling and simulation, corresponding implementations will most likely not allow timely outcomes for detailed simulations.
  In infectious disease modeling, while several large-scale software frameworks rely on C or C++ implementations, most models are implemented in Python or R. While the latter allow for fast prototyping and more interactive development, it has been shown for several applications that C or C++ implementations outperform plain Python or R implementations by factors between one and three orders of magnitude. In particular, in times of pandemics, the urgent need for swift estimation of the system's dynamics makes the use of large-scale models in these noncompiled languages prohibitive.
  In order to create synergies and close the gap between scientists from the application and the computational domain, binding libraries allow to execute entire, compiled software frameworks from languages such as Python. However, with iterative model development, extension, or addition of new models, implementing bindings can represent another relevant barrier to developers of the C or C++ backends. In this paper, we show how a large-scale software framework with a multitude of infectious disease models can be efficiently exposed to Python. In addition, we suggest a semi-automated way to generate interface code by analyzing generic C++ code through abstract syntax trees, enabling a modularized approach working with intermediate representations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大型传染病建模框架C/C++后端与Python前端之间的性能-易用性矛盾，提出通过抽象语法树分析通用C++代码、半自动生成绑定接口的方法，将多模型框架高效暴露给Python，并采用模块化中间表示降低维护成本。
AI.motivation: 数学软件的语言选择在开发者与用户背景不同时产生目标冲突：脚本语言（Python/R）门槛低、适合交互式建模与快速原型，但对精细仿真难以按时完成；C/C++实现可快1–3个数量级，尤其疫情期间对动力学快速估计的紧迫需求使其难以承受非编译语言的开销。而现有绑定库虽可让Python调用已编译框架，但在模型迭代开发、扩展与新增时，手工实现绑定又成为C/C++后端开发者的新障碍。
AI.method: 以大型传染病软件框架（含多种疾病模型）为对象，将其高效暴露给Python；提出半自动化接口代码生成流程：解析通用C++代码的抽象语法树（AST），基于中间表示（intermediate representations）进行模块化处理，从而生成绑定接口。
AI.result: 实现了大型多模型传染病建模框架向Python的高效暴露，并以半自动方式生成接口代码，避免逐一手写绑定；模块化、基于中间表示的方法使接口生成可复用、可随模型迭代扩展。
AI.conclusion: 绑定库可弥合应用科学与计算领域之间的鸿沟，而基于AST的半自动绑定生成能消除迭代开发中手工绑定的障碍，兼顾Python的易用性与C/C++的性能，为大规模传染病建模提供可持续的工程方案。

title: GAAC: Lossless KV Compression for Bandwidth-Efficient LLM Inference on Personal Devices
summary: Weight-only, lossy quantization substantially reduces the storage and memory requirements for serving large language models (LLMs), but the growing key-value (KV) cache remains a bottleneck for long-context inference on personal devices. We present Group-Adaptive Additive Codec (GAAC), a lossless KV compression and serving system that exploits exponent redundancy to reduce storage and accelerate attention without introducing KV approximation. GAAC encodes BF16 exponents using calibrated per-channel base-plus-offset codes over contiguous ranges. GAAC adapts code widths across small groups while preserving KV values bit-for-bit. A fused attention kernel reconstructs KV tiles on the fly, avoiding full-cache decompression. Block-wise compression and fixed-capacity slots support incremental cache updates and paged serving. Across five tested models, GAAC achieves 1.405-1.407$\times$ lossless BF16 KV compression. We also study compression performance on low-precision tensors FP8 E4M3 caches ( 1.09-1.14$\times$) and E5M2 caches (1.25-1.30$\times$). On NVIDIA DGX Spark, GAAC accelerates decode attention at a 64K-token context by 1.19-1.27$\times$ and end-to-end W4A16 decode steps by 1.04-1.15$\times$. In serving, it reduces resident KV memory by approximately 26% and increases aggregate throughput by 13-29% under comparable KV-memory budgets. On Apple M4, GAAC achieves 1.02-1.25$\times$ attention speedups, demonstrating portability beyond NVIDIA GPUs.

AI.tldr: GAAC 是一个无损 KV cache 压缩与推理服务系统，利用 BF16 指数冗余进行分组自适应加法编码，在保持比特级一致的前提下实现压缩、加速注意力并降低显存占用。
AI.motivation: 仅权重量化虽已显著降低 LLM 存储与显存需求，但长上下文推理时 KV cache 持续增长，成为个人设备上的主要瓶颈，且现有方法多引入 KV 近似误差。
AI.method: 对 BF16 指数采用按通道校准的 base-plus-offset 码，在连续区间上进行编码；在小分组内自适应码宽；设计融合注意力核函数在片上重建 KV tile，避免全量解压；采用分块压缩与定容量槽位支持增量更新与分页服务。并评估 FP8 E4M3/E5M2 低精度张量上的压缩表现。
AI.result: 五个模型上实现 1.405–1.407× 无损 BF16 KV 压缩；FP8 E4M3 为 1.09–1.14×，E5M2 为 1.25–1.30×。DGX Spark 上 64K 上下文解码注意力加速 1.19–1.27×，W4A16 端到端解码步加速 1.04–1.15×；服务场景常驻 KV 显存降低约 26%，同等 KV 显存预算下总吞吐提升 13–29%；Apple M4 上注意力加速 1.02–1.25×。
AI.conclusion: 指数冗余可作为无损 KV 压缩的有效切入点，配合融合内核与分页机制可同时获得存储节省、吞吐提升与跨平台（NVIDIA GPU 与 Apple M4）可移植性。

title: Measuring Deep Learning Performance - An Empirical Study of Performance Distributions Across Architectures and Tasks
summary: Context: Non-determinism in deep learning algorithm design and implementation leads to performance variation, meaning model performance is not a single value, but rather a distribution. These model performance distributions are underexplored despite their impact on robustness. Objective: We investigate the robustness of deep learning performance to sources of non-determinism, specifically focusing on how performance distributions differ across various architectures and tasks. Method: We conducted 186 experiments on image classification and time series forecasting architectures. Each experiment was run 100 times with different random seeds to generate performance distributions, resulting in 18,600 runs. Robustness was quantified using metrics for spread, symmetry, and tail risk. Results: Performance distributions are frequently non-Gaussian, particularly in time series forecasting. Model size does not systematically affect robustness -- larger image classification models show fewer outliers but not lower spread, while smaller time series models show lower spread but more extreme underperformers. Training duration does not scale linearly; early stopping effectively balances performance and robustness. Mean performance does not predict robustness - time series forecasting shows moderate correlation while image classification shows none. Time series models produce nearly three times more underperforming outliers than image classification models, indicating substantially higher tail risk. Conclusions: Tail risk poses serious concerns for Trustworthy AI in high-stakes applications. Models performing well on average may exhibit long tails and extreme outliers revealed only through distributional analysis. Mean performance alone should not guide model selection; assessment of spread, symmetry, and tail risk is essential for reliable model assessment where consistent performance is critical.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过18,600次重复实验揭示深度学习模型性能并非单值而是分布，性能分布常呈非高斯形态，均值表现无法预测鲁棒性，尾部风险（尤以时间序列预测为甚）对可信AI构成隐患。
AI.motivation: 深度学习算法设计与实现中的非确定性导致性能波动，使模型性能表现为一个分布而非单一数值；然而这类性能分布对鲁棒性的影响长期被忽视，亟需系统研究不同架构与任务下性能分布的差异。
AI.method: 在图像分类与时间序列预测架构上开展186组实验，每组以100个不同随机种子重复运行以构建性能分布，共18,600次运行；采用离散度（spread）、对称性与尾部风险三类指标量化鲁棒性。
AI.result: 性能分布常呈非高斯，时间序列预测尤为明显；模型规模对鲁棒性无系统性影响——较大图像分类模型离群值更少但离散度未降低，较小时间序列模型离散度更低但极端低表现更多；训练时长非线性的收益，早停可平衡性能与鲁棒性；均值性能不能预测鲁棒性（时间序列呈中等相关，图像分类无相关）；时间序列模型的低表现离群值约为图像分类的三倍，尾部风险显著更高。
AI.conclusion: 尾部风险对高风险应用中的可信AI构成严重隐患：均值表现良好的模型仍可能存在长尾与极端离群；仅凭均值性能不应作为模型选择依据，需结合离散度、对称性与尾部风险进行分布层面的评估，以确保性能一致性要求场景下的可靠评估。

title: Disparity Laundering: Consensus Without Fairness in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/wangxiaoyang0412/disparity-laundering . Committed to EACL 2027
summary: Clinical large language models are increasingly fielded as multi-agent teams, on the assumption that deliberation averages out individual error. It does not average out bias. Across a full factorial of five model families and four aggregation topologies on 120 real MIMIC-IV emergency cases under counterfactual demographic swaps, no configuration neutralizes the disparity: all 20 cells commit the direction of their agents' independent answers, giving Black patients more acute triage. Every model has a topology that amplifies its baseline gap, but which one varies by model, so no design is reliably safe or reliably amplifying: the disparity is relocated, never removed. Late-stage fixes fail: fairness instructions and demographic masking leave the gap untouched, and per-agent self-debiasing widens it, because the bias is already encoded in the agents' ordinary clinical numbers. We call this disparity laundering; the audits now applied to clinical AI, per model, per output, per version, can certify the parts but never the committed decision. Interventions close the gap exactly when they make counterfactual versions visible inside the system and pool them, through deliberation, into the committed decision. A diverse-perspective ensemble does both while keeping the team, with no retraining or architectural change: the disparity falls by 67 to 94% where all five perspectives pool at every round, and the one topology that never pools them is the one it cannot reliably repair. Medical multi-agent systems do not filter demographic bias; they launder it into plausible decisions no single-version audit can catch, and the only defense is to make the bias visible.

AI.tldr: 临床多智能体系统并不能"平均掉"人口学偏差,而是将其"洗白(disparity laundering)"进看似合理的决策;只有在系统内部让反事实版本可见并汇聚,才能有效缩小差距。
AI.motivation: 临床大语言模型正被部署为多智能体团队,其假设是"审议可平均掉个体错误"。作者要检验该假设是否也适用于人口学偏差,即聚合拓扑能否中和分诊中的群体间差距。
AI.method: 在120个真实MIMIC-IV急诊病例上,对5个模型家族×4种聚合拓扑做全因子实验(共20个配置),施加反事实人口学替换(如将患者种族替换)以测量分诊差异;并测试三类"晚期修复"干预:公平性指令、人口学掩蔽、单智能体自去偏;最后评估多样化视角集成(diverse-perspective ensemble)等干预。
AI.result: 全部20个配置都沿袭其智能体独立答案的偏差方向(对Black患者给出更急的分诊);每个模型都存在会放大基线差距的拓扑,但具体是哪个拓扑因模型而异,故无设计可被可靠判定为安全或放大。公平性指令与人口学掩蔽对差距无影响,单智能体自去偏反而扩大差距。多样化视角集成在五视角每轮均汇聚时使差距下降67–94%,而从不汇聚视角的拓扑无法可靠修复。
AI.conclusion: 医学多智能体系统不"过滤"人口学偏差,而是将其洗白为单版本审计无法察觉的合理决策;按模型/按输出/按版本的审计只能认证局部而不能认证最终决策。有效干预的充分条件是在系统内部使反事实版本可见并将其通过审议汇聚进最终决策;多样化视角集成满足此条件且无需重训练或架构改动。核心结论:唯一防御是让偏差可见。

title: CADENCE: Distributional Next-Transaction Forecasting for Business Cash-Flow Underwriting
summary: Recurring cash flows are the backbone of cash-flow underwriting: they separate durable revenue from one-off deposits, expose standing obligations, and ultimately determine ability to pay.
