On 500 long-horizon roll-outs of a pressurized water reactor (PWR) load-following benchmark -a high-dimensional, stiff industrial system with challenging safety constraints -and across 20 training seeds, separated embeddings systematically outperform shared embedding baselines on cumulative cost, imitation accuracy and constraint satisfaction. The resulting standalone policies approach NMPC closed-loop performance at a computational cost 15 times lower on average. Since standalone policies still leave a few percent of trajectories infeasible, we embed the learned policies in a safety-augmented approximate NMPC framework, in which the optimizer is only called when the predicted input sequence is not certified as safe. This yields controllers still 6.8 times faster than the NMPC controller on average, with a feasibility (i.e., constraint satisfaction) of at least 99.8% for all architectures, SRLBC retaining the lowest closed-loop cost. Under distribution shift, standalone BC policies degrade sharply: SRLBC degrades the least, and once safety-augmented, it retains a feasibility above 98% with the lowest closed-loop cost. Beyond the quantitative results, Jacobian-based sensitivity analysis shows that the resulting controller relies on a sparse and less redundant set of latent features, each attributable to a single group of physical variables, and aligned with the physical timescale decomposition of the system.

AI.tldr: 提出SRLBC，通过按物理时间尺度分离潜在嵌入解决多尺度系统行为克隆难题，在PWR负荷跟踪基准上优于共享嵌入基线，并用安全增强近似NMPC兼顾性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 多尺度动力系统中慢变量、快（刚性）变量与可预测外生输入在不同时间尺度演化，产生强非线性耦合，共享潜在空间难以充分表征，导致行为克隆策略闭环泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出结构化表示学习行为克隆（SRLBC），利用系统物理知识，将慢状态、快（刚性）状态与可预测外生输入的嵌入分离；并将学习策略嵌入安全增强的近似NMPC框架，仅在预测输入序列未被认证安全时才调用优化器。评估采用PWR负荷跟踪基准500条长时滚动轨迹、20个训练种子，并结合基于Jacobian的敏感性分析。
AI.result: 分离嵌入在累积代价、模仿精度与约束满足上系统性优于共享嵌入基线；独立策略性能接近NMPC，计算成本平均低15倍。安全增强后控制器较NMPC平均快6.8倍，所有架构可行性≥99.8%，SRLBC闭环代价最低。分布偏移下独立BC策略显著退化，SRLBC退化最小，安全增强后可行性仍>98%且代价最低。敏感性分析显示控制器依赖稀疏、冗余更少且可归因于单一物理变量组的潜在特征。
AI.conclusion: 按物理时间尺度分解的结构化表示是提升多尺度系统行为克隆泛化性与安全性的有效手段，与安全增强近似NMPC结合可在显著降低计算成本的同时保持高可行性与低闭环代价。

title: Nearly Minimax Optimal Regret for Adversarial Linear Bandits with Strong Corruptions
summary: We study adversarial linear bandits with strong corruption, in which an adaptive adversary chooses the reward vectors and a strong adversary corrupts each observed reward after seeing the learner's action, subject to a known total corruption budget $C$. Strong corruption breaks the importance-weighted reward estimates used by adversarial bandit algorithms: by corrupting only the rounds in which a rarely sampled action is drawn, the adversary amplifies each unit of corruption by the inverse of its sampling probability. The best known bound for this problem, $\tilde O(\sqrt{d^3T} + dC)$ by Liu et al. (2024), is a factor $\sqrt{d}$ above the corruption-free rate in its leading term, and whether $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T} + dC)$ regret is achievable was left open. We propose CRW-FTRL, which runs follow-the-regularized-leader with a radius-weighted entropy regularizer and estimates rewards with a normalized kernel estimator whose sensitivity to corruption is governed by per-action radii instead of inverse sampling probabilities. The radii are nondecreasing and are chosen jointly with the sampling distribution through a monotone log-determinant barrier problem, so that a negative linear term in the regularizer cancels both the corruption bias and the estimation error of every comparator. For $K$ actions in $\mathbb{R}^d$, CRW-FTRL achieves $\tilde O(\sqrt{dT\log K} + dC)$ regret with high probability against an adaptive adversary, which matches the best known corruption-free rate and the $Ω(dC)$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Applied to a discretization of a general compact action set, it yields $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T} + dC)$ regret, which settles the statistical rate of corrupted adversarial linear bandits under strong corruption.

AI.tldr: 提出 CRW-FTRL 算法（半径加权熵正则 FTRL + 归一化核估计），在强腐化对抗线性赌博机中达到 $\tilde O(\sqrt{dT\log K}+dC)$ 遗憾，匹配无腐化最优率与 $\Omega(dC)$ 下界（至对数因子），解决了 Liu et al. (2024) 遗留的开问题。
AI.motivation: 强腐化会破坏逆概率重要性加权估计：对手只需腐化被极少采样的动作所在轮次，即可将每单位腐化放大 $1/p$ 倍。既有最优界 $\tilde O(\sqrt{d^3T}+dC)$ 的主项比无腐化最优率 $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T})$ 多出 $\sqrt{d}$ 因子，能否达到 $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T}+dC)$ 遗憾尚属未决。
AI.method: CRW-FTRL：采用带半径加权熵正则项的 FTRL 框架；使用归一化核估计，使估计量对腐化的敏感度由逐动作半径而非逆采样概率控制；半径序列非递减，并与采样分布通过单调对数行列式障碍问题联合求解；正则项中负线性项可同时抵消腐化偏差与各比较者的估计误差。
AI.result: 对 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中 $K$ 个动作，以高概率对自适应对手达到 $\tilde O(\sqrt{dT\log K}+dC)$ 遗憾；经离散化推广到一般紧致动作集，得到 $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T}+dC)$ 遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 确立了强腐化下对抗线性赌博机的统计速率 $\tilde O(d\sqrt{T}+dC)$，与无腐化最优率及 $\Omega(dC)$ 下界在忽略对数因子时均相符，闭合了该问题的速率刻画。

title: Value Probes: Learned Value Functions for Beam-Search Red Teaming
summary: Automated red-team auditing of language models is an important way to evaluate safety-relevant behaviors. These audits implicitly search a tree of possible conversation pathways: at each turn an auditor model decides which conversation to continue, and an LLM judge scores the dialogue. We emphasize that this auditing procedure is a Markov decision process, where states are the conversation history, actions are candidate responses, and rewards are judge scores for the target behavior. By adopting this perspective, we introduce two major improvements to auditing. First, we propose adopting beam search for the audit rather than relying on the auditor alone. We then interpret the problem of finding states that are likely to lead to problematic behavior as value estimation. Surprisingly, we show that this value function can be estimated by linear probing from the target model's activations to predict discounted future rewards - a method we term "Value Probes." By using Value Probes as a heuristic in our beam-search audit, we are able to substantially improve auditing success. Across 18 target behaviors and 3 scales of models, our approach raises peak audit scores by roughly 50% compared to (token-matched) standard auditing approaches. Furthermore, we show that Value Probes can be fit using off-policy data from smaller models. We also ablate individual components, and show that our method offers a comparably-performant and more efficient alternative to more expensive language model follow-ups. We hope these methods will improve language model auditing and lead to safer models.

AI.tldr: 将红队审计建模为马尔可夫决策过程，用束搜索替代纯审计模型搜索，并提出"Value Probes"——从目标模型激活中线性探针估计折扣未来奖励的价值函数，作为束搜索启发式，显著提升审计成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化红队审计隐含地在对话路径树上搜索，但依赖审计模型逐轮决定续写、由LLM评审打分，效率与效果有限；作者希望通过MDP视角重构该过程，以更系统的方式寻找易诱发问题行为的对话状态。
AI.method: 把审计过程形式化为MDP（状态=对话历史，动作=候选回复，奖励=评审对目标行为的打分）；采用束搜索替代单纯依赖审计模型的贪心式续写；将"寻找易导致问题行为的状态"视为价值估计问题，用线性探针从目标模型激活预测折扣未来奖励（Value Probes），并作为束搜索启发式；同时用来自小模型的off-policy数据拟合Value Probes，并做组件消融。
AI.result: 在18种目标行为和3个模型规模上，相较（token匹配的）标准审计方法，峰值审计分数提升约50%；Value Probes可用小模型off-policy数据拟合；消融显示该方法相较更昂贵的语言模型后续调用具有可比性能且更高效。
AI.conclusion: 以MDP+束搜索+Value Probes为核心的审计框架能显著提升语言模型红队审计的有效性与效率，为更安全的模型评估提供可行路径。

title: Transportable Offline Reinforcement Learning in Presence of Unmeasured Confounding
summary: Offline reinforcement learning seeks to learn decision policies from previously collected data, but deployment environments may differ from the domains in which the data were collected, and logged variables may omit confounders that affected both historical actions and outcomes. We study offline policy learning under the joint challenges of domain discrepancy and unmeasured confounding, where multiple heterogeneous source datasets provide complementary information about a target domain. We develop a causally adjusted transportability framework combining transportability theory with instrumental variables, negative controls, and proxies to identify target-domain causal quantities. For confounded contextual bandits, identification reduces to systems of bridge-function integral equations, enabling minimax estimation from finite samples. Confidence sets for the identified quantities are then used for pessimistic policy optimization, yielding CAT-CCB. We extend the framework to episodic confounded Markov decision processes, where complementary sources identify target reward and transition mechanisms under structural and completeness conditions. Under Gaussian dynamics and linear function approximation, this yields CAT-CMDP. We establish high-probability finite-sample suboptimality guarantees that quantify the effects of approximation, estimation, source-to-target shift, offline coverage, and sample size. For bounded finite-dimensional linear classes, the contextual-bandit guarantee recovers the standard $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(N^{-1/2})$ rate. Numerical experiments support the effectiveness of the framework for learning target-domain policies from heterogeneous confounded data. Together, the results provide a principled approach when no single source dataset suffices for causal identification and policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出“因果校正可迁移性”框架（CAT-CCB / CAT-CMDP），在域偏移与未观测混杂并存、且多个异质源数据互补的条件下，从离线数据中识别目标域因果量并做悲观策略优化，给出有限样本次优性保证。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习依赖既有数据学策略，但部署环境与数据采集域存在差异（域偏移），且日志变量可能遗漏同时影响历史动作与结果的混杂因子（未观测混杂）。单一源数据集往往不足以同时完成因果识别与策略优化，因此需要利用多个异质源数据集的互补信息。
AI.method: 将可迁移性理论与工具变量、负对照、代理变量相结合，构建因果校正的可迁移性框架以识别目标域因果量。对混杂上下文赌博机，识别问题化为桥函数积分方程组，进而实现极小极大有限样本估计；用识别量的置信集做悲观策略优化，得到 CAT-CCB。推广到片段式混杂马尔可夫决策过程：在结构性与完备性条件下由互补源识别目标域的奖励与转移机制；在高斯动力学与线性函数逼近下得到 CAT-CMDP。
AI.result: 给出高概率有限样本次优性保证，显式刻画逼近误差、估计误差、源到目标偏移、离线覆盖与样本量的影响；对有界有限维线性函数类，上下文赌博机的保证可恢复到标准 \(\widetilde{\mathcal O}(N^{-1/2})\) 速率；数值实验支持该框架从异质混杂数据中学习目标域策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 当没有任何单一源数据集足以实现因果识别与策略优化时，该框架提供了有原则的解决途径，将可迁移性识别、混杂校正与悲观离线策略优化统一起来，并具备理论速率保证。

title: From Leniency to Suspicion: How an Open Post-Training Recipe Changes Whom LLM Fact-Checkers Believe
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Preprint, under review
summary: LLMs increasingly fact-check online content with the poster's identity in view. However, it remains unclear which post-training changes how much a model's truth judgement depends on the poster's social class, and how such a change happens inside the model. This paper investigates job-based doubt, i.e., judging a claim false more often when the poster has a lower-status job, using fact-checked claims with randomised poster profiles in base and post-trained checkpoints of six model families. Our results reveal that: 1) post-training creates such doubt only with the open Tülu-3 recipe (OLMo-2 32B, Tülu-3 70B), not with Meta's, Alibaba's or Mistral's; the effect is under one percentage point but statistically reliable, exceeding training drift and replicating on independent claim sets; 2) in OLMo-2 32B, the model does not start noticing the poster's job more, but starts interpreting it differently: a lower-status job pushes the base model toward "true" and the post-trained model toward "false"; and 3) this flip is carried by a single residual-stream direction and happens at supervised fine-tuning. The mechanism was confirmed on 400 new claims with pre-specified predictions. None of seven deployed commercial models doubts lower-status posters more. Our work underscores the need to audit speaker bias per training recipe.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"基于职业的怀疑"（job-based doubt）：LLM 是否更倾向于判定低社会地位职业发帖者的陈述为假，以及哪种后训练配方导致该偏差、模型内部如何产生该偏差。结论是仅开放式 Tülu-3 配方产生此偏差，且在 OLMo-2 32B 中该效应由一个残差流方向承载、在监督微调阶段发生翻转。
AI.motivation: LLM 越来越多地结合发帖者身份进行事实核查，但学界尚不清楚：何种后训练（post-training）会改变模型真值判断对社会阶层的依赖程度，以及这种改变在模型内部如何实现。现有工作缺乏按训练配方逐一切分、并揭示内部机制的审计。
AI.method: 在六个模型系列的 base 与 post-trained checkpoint 上，使用经过事实核查的陈述并随机化发帖者画像，测量职业地位对判断的影响。对比不同后训练配方（Tülu-3 开放配方 vs. Meta、Alibaba、Mistral 的配方）。在 OLMo-2 32B 上做表征分析（noticing vs. interpretation 的区分）与残差流方向定位，并按阶段（SFT 等）归因机制来源；最后用 400 条新陈述、预注册预测做验证，并测试七个商用部署模型。
AI.result: 1) 仅开放 Tülu-3 配方产生该职业怀疑（OLMo-2 32B、Tülu-3 70B），Meta/Alibaba/Mistral 配方无此效应；效应小于 1 个百分点但统计上可靠，超过训练漂移，并在独立陈述集上复现。2) OLMo-2 32B 中模型并未更多"注意到"发帖者职业，而是"解读"改变：低地位职业使 base 模型偏向"真"，后训练模型偏向"假"。3) 该翻转由单一残差流方向承载，发生在监督微调阶段；机制在 400 条新陈述上以预注册预测得到确认。4) 七个已部署商用模型均未对低地位发帖者表现出更多怀疑。
AI.conclusion: 发帖者身份偏差高度依赖训练配方，且可由可解释的单一内部方向承载、在 SFT 阶段被引入；因此需按训练配方逐一审计说话者偏差，而不能仅以商用模型表现为准。

title: ParaTTT: Parallelizing Test-Time Training Layers with Deep Memories
summary: Test-time training (TTT) layers replace the linear fast-weight memory of modern recurrent architectures with a small neural network trained online by gradient descent. This nonlinear memory is more expressive than the linear memories of Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-2, but is difficult to parallelize: existing implementations such as TTT-MLP rely on sequential, block-wise weight updates that run several times slower than chunkwise-parallel linear recurrences. Moreover, their block-wise execution only approximates the token-by-token online recurrence, whereas linear recurrences admit an exact chunkwise-parallel evaluation. We introduce ParaTTT (PTTT), an algorithm for parallelizing arbitrarily deep nonlinear memories by iteratively refining estimates of the inner-loop gradient trajectory. Starting from a guess of the hidden-layer gradients, each refinement consists of three chunkwise-parallel passes: a forward pass that evaluates the resulting feature trajectory, an exact gated-delta-rule pass that computes the readout trajectory and its feature gradients, and a backward pass that propagates these gradients into a new estimate. The exact online gradient descent recurrence is a fixed point of the iteration, while decoding requires no refinement iterations. We prove geometric convergence for a two-layer variant under sufficient contraction conditions. In practice, two iterations suffice. With two refinement steps at 4K context, PTTT evaluates the inner-loop trajectory $32\times$ faster than TTT-MLP with the block approximation at matched error, while the full 340M model trains $4.9\times$ faster. Models trained at 340M and 1.3B parameters match or exceed Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-2 and remain competitive with same-size Transformers on language-modeling perplexity and zero-shot accuracy, with better recall than the linear recurrences.

AI.tldr: 提出 ParaTTT（PTTT）：通过迭代精化内层梯度轨迹，将任意深度的非线性 TTT 记忆并行化，每步精化由三次分块并行扫描组成；精确在线梯度下降递推是其不动点。两层变体在收缩条件下几何收敛，实践中两步足够。4K 上下文下内层轨迹比 TTT-MLP 快 32×，340M 全模型训练快 4.9×；340M/1.3B 模型在困惑度与零样本准确率上匹配或超越 Gated DeltaNet 与 Mamba-2，与同规模 Transformer 相当，且召回能力更强。
AI.motivation: TTT 层用在线梯度下降训练的小型神经网络替代线性快权重记忆，表达能力更强，但难以并行：TTT-MLP 依赖顺序的分块权重更新，比分块并行线性递推慢数倍；且分块执行只是对逐 token 在线递推的近似，而线性递推可做精确的分块并行计算。作者希望同时获得非线性记忆的表达力与分块并行的效率，并消除块近似带来的误差。
AI.method: 把内层梯度轨迹视为待求解变量，从隐层梯度初值出发迭代精化；每次精化包含三次分块并行扫描：(1) 前向计算特征轨迹；(2) 精确的 gated delta rule 扫描得到读出轨迹及其特征梯度；(3) 反向将梯度传播为新的梯度估计。精确在线 GD 递推构成该迭代的不动点，解码时无需精化迭代；对两层变体在充分收缩条件下证明几何收敛，实践中两次迭代即可。
AI.result: 4K 上下文、两步精化下，PTTT 计算内层轨迹比采用块近似的 TTT-MLP 快 32×（误差匹配）；完整 340M 模型训练快 4.9×。340M 与 1.3B 模型在语言建模困惑度和零样本准确率上匹配或超过 Gated DeltaNet 与 Mamba-2，与同尺寸 Transformer 具有竞争力，并在召回类任务上优于线性递推。
AI.conclusion: PTTT 以"精确在线 GD 递推为不动点"的迭代精化框架，将非线性 TTT 记忆转写为可完全分块并行的计算，在不牺牲精度的前提下获得显著加速，并在中大规模上保持与强线性递推和 Transformer 相当的建模质量，同时具备更强的召回能力。

title: PT$^3$: Prototype-Guided Self-Supervised Pretraining for Generalizable mmWave Human Point Cloud Representation
summary: Multi-source millimeter-wave (mmWave) observations offer an opportunity to learn human representations reusable across sensing tasks. However, sparse detections and multipath effects make these observations unstable, challenging existing point cloud pretraining methods. We propose PT$^3$, a prototype-guided self-supervised pretraining framework for mmWave human point clouds. PT$^3$ represents local states in spatial regions as sparse compositions of shared prototypes and learns their temporal evolution through autoregressive prediction. Observation consistency further stabilizes representations under radar perturbations. After pretraining on unlabeled sequences from multiple sources, the same frozen encoder supports action classification, dense point generation, joint pose estimation, and future motion prediction on datasets not used for pretraining. Across these tasks, PT$^3$ outperforms the compared pretraining baselines and achieves competitive or superior performance to task-specific models.

AI.tldr: PT$^3$：面向毫米波人体点云的原型引导自监督预训练框架，学习可跨任务迁移的人体表征。
AI.motivation: 多源毫米波观测有望学习跨感知任务复用的人体表征，但稀疏检测与多径效应导致观测不稳定，现有二维点云预训练方法难以适用。
AI.method: 将空间区域内的局部状态表示为共享原型的稀疏组合，并以自回归预测学习其时间演化；同时引入观测一致性约束，在雷达扰动下稳定表征。预训练使用多源无标注序列。
AI.result: 冻结编码器即可支持动作分类、稠密点生成、关节姿态估计与未来运动预测，且在未参与预训练的数据集上优于对比的预训练基线，达到与任务专用模型相当或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于稀疏原型组合与时间自回归的预训练可有效缓解毫米波点云的不稳定性，得到通用性强、可复用的人体表征。

title: NAGO: Noise-Aware Generative Operator via Flow Matching
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 49 pages including appendices and checklist. Code: https://github.com/cgymmy/NAGO
summary: We introduce NAGO, a noise-aware generative operator for efficient sampling from invariant measures of stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs) in function space. Our central idea is to treat the source measure as a design variable rather than a fixed Gaussian default. We establish admissibility conditions for well-defined infinite-dimensional flows and show that the finite-band source--target covariance ratio controls the spectral stiffness of the marginal velocity field. This analysis yields an admissibility-constrained spectral-matching rule: choose a source that is sufficiently rough for well-posedness, then minimize covariance mismatch over the resolved Fourier modes. On three representative stochastic-field benchmarks, this source design improves few-step spectral accuracy and several complementary distributional and physical statistics. In a controlled Matern-field ablation, it reduces the accurate RK4 budget from about 30 steps for Gaussian functional flow matching to 3--5 steps, a $6$--$10\times$ reduction in neural ODE evaluations. These gains are strongest for stationary multiscale fields and depend on the metric, resolution, and guidance protocol.

AI.tldr: NAGO将SPDE不变测度采样的源测度视为可设计变量，提出可容许性约束下的谱匹配规则，大幅降低函数空间生成流的数值积分步数。
AI.motivation: 函数空间生成模型（如高斯函数流匹配）默认以固定高斯源测度驱动，导致边缘速度场谱刚度高、少步采样精度差。作者认为源测度的选择本身影响无穷维流的适定性与数值求解代价。
AI.method: 1) 将源测度作为设计变量而非固定高斯；2) 建立无穷维流的可容许性条件以保证流良好定义；3) 证明有限频带源-目标协方差比控制边缘速度场的谱刚度；4) 据此提出"可容许性约束的谱匹配"规则——先选足够粗糙以满足适定性的源，再在已解析Fourier模态上最小化协方差失配；5) 在三个随机场基准上验证，并在Matern场消融实验中与高斯函数流匹配对比RK4步数预算。
AI.result: 谱匹配源设计提升了少步采样的谱精度及多项分布与物理统计指标；Matern场消融中，达到精度所需的RK4步数从约30步降至3–5步，即神经ODE评估次数减少6–10倍；增益在平稳多尺度场上最显著，且依赖度量、分辨率与引导协议。
AI.conclusion: 源测度的谱设计是提升函数空间生成采样效率的有效手段，可在保持适定性的同时显著降低积分预算；但收益并非普适，受度量选择、分辨率与引导协议影响。

title: Co-Evolving Policy and Rubric via Capability Awareness for Open-Ended Generation
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) offers interpretable, fine-grained supervision for aligning large language models (LLMs) on open-ended generation tasks. However, static rubric criteria may become saturated or remain beyond the policy's exploration, rendering the reward signals insufficiently discriminative. While recent efforts seek to guide sampling exploration or evolve rubrics, they fail to explicitly factor in how rubric difficulty should track the evolving policy's capabilities, resulting in a persistent mismatch between the optimization objective and the policy's current capability frontier. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Co}-Evolving Policy and Rubric via \textbf{C}apability \textbf{A}wareness (\textbf{CoCA}), a closed-loop framework that jointly adapts the rubric and policy through criterion-level diagnosis. Specifically, CoCA contrasts query-only and rubric-guided rollouts to characterize each criterion relative to the current policy, recalibrates criteria with mismatched difficulty, and identifies guidance-revealed capability gaps for frontier-based learning. Based on this insight, CoCA either expands rubric-conditioned frontiers through guided optimization or transfers qualified gains through on-policy self-distillation. As the policy updates, CoCA improves the capability diagnosis and enables more reliable distillation, thereby completing the co-evolution loop. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and LLMs demonstrate that CoCA consistently improves performance over rubric-based RL methods. Moreover, CoCA promotes the internalization of guidance-revealed capabilities into query-only behavior while mitigating capability degradation.

AI.tldr: 提出CoCA框架，通过能力感知的准则级诊断实现策略与评分准则（rubric）的协同进化，缓解静态rubric与策略能力不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 基于rubric的强化学习为开放生成任务提供可解释、细粒度监督，但静态准则会饱和或超出策略探索范围，导致奖励信号判别性不足。已有工作（引导采样探索、进化rubric）未显式考虑rubric难度应随策略能力演化而调整，造成优化目标与策略当前能力前沿持续错配。
AI.method: CoCA为闭环框架：对比仅查询（query-only）与rubric引导的rollout，对每条准则相对当前策略进行刻画；对难度不匹配的准则重新校准；识别引导所揭示的能力缺口用于前沿式学习。据此，或通过引导优化扩展rubric条件下的能力前沿，或通过on-policy自蒸馏迁移已达标收益。策略更新后诊断更准确、蒸馏更可靠，形成协同进化闭环。
AI.result: 在多样基准与多个LLM上，CoCA稳定优于基于rubric的RL方法；可促进引导揭示的能力内化为query-only行为，并缓解能力退化。
AI.conclusion: 将rubric难度与策略能力前沿显式对齐的准则级诊断与闭环协同进化，是提升rubric-based RL有效性与稳定性的关键。

title: The Role of Quantization in Loss Spikes
summary: Loss spikes in language model pretraining can waste substantial compute and derail otherwise healthy training runs. A primary driver of these instabilities is the growth and divergence of output logits in the final language modeling (LM) head. In this work, we study a particularly costly form of this instability associated with output logit growth: delayed, terminal divergences that emerge only after prolonged training, which we call time-bomb spikes. We find that these instabilities are preceded by rapidly growing quantization error in the LM head, which eventually culminates in a loss spike. Crucially, reducing numerical precision accelerates time-bomb spikes, while increasing precision improves stability. We then propose a simple yet effective mitigation that replaces AdamW on the LM head with SGD with momentum, suppressing logit growth and improving stability over long training horizons. Finally, we find that existing mitigation techniques from the literature (along with our own) all reduce quantization error, suggesting a shared numerical mechanism behind their effectiveness. Together, our results identify finite precision error as a hidden driver of time-bomb spikes and show that suppressing this error is key to stable long-horizon pretraining.

AI.tldr: 论文研究大模型预训练中"延时爆发型"loss spike（time-bomb spikes），发现其前兆是LM head量化误差快速增长，并据此提出用SGD+动量替代AdamW的缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 预训练中的loss spikes浪费大量算力并破坏训练。其主因之一是最终LM head输出logits的增长与发散，而其中一种代价高昂的形态——仅在长时间训练后才出现的延迟性终末发散（time-bomb spikes）——尚缺乏机制性解释与有效缓解手段。
AI.method: 1）分析输出logit增长导致的不稳定性，定义并刻画time-bomb spikes；2）追踪LM head中的量化误差（数值精度误差），考察其与spike的时序关系；3）通过改变数值精度（降低/提高）验证因果性；4）提出在LM head上以带动量的SGD替代AdamW，抑制logit增长；5）对比已有缓解技术，检验其是否共同降低量化误差。
AI.result: time-bomb spikes发生前，LM head中的量化误差快速增大，最终导致loss spike；降低数值精度会加速spike出现，提高精度则提升稳定性；在LM head上用SGD+动量替代AdamW可抑制logit增长，在长训练周期中提升稳定性；现有文献中的缓解方法与本文方法均降低量化误差。
AI.conclusion: 有限精度误差（量化误差）是time-bomb spikes的隐藏驱动因素，抑制该误差是稳定长周期预训练的关键；多种缓解技术的有效性可统一归因于共享的数值机制。

title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful. Existing methods often focus on what experience to generate next, while paying less attention to when fresh experience should be introduced. Many also construct training targets through self-consistency or majority voting, making supervision depend on the model's own uncertain predictions. We address these two questions separately: training dynamics determine when to acquire new experience, while the answers to new tasks remain independently checkable. A-RSI monitors reward variation and accuracy in training logs to refresh a task pool when its learning signal declines, without consulting validation or test scores. A static library of model-authored programs produces multimodal questions and derives their reference answers; we specify the task-generation contract, automatically verify chosen properties of the reward and refresh rules, and separately audit the generated answers. The training loop uses no external training examples or human-written answer labels. On the primary eleven-benchmark suite, A-RSI raises the performance average from 57.77 to 61.05 with 800 fresh tasks.

AI.tldr: A-RSI：用训练动态决定“何时”引入新经验，用可独立校验的模型自生成任务及其参考答案提供监督，形成无需外部训练样本或人工答案标签的递归自我改进闭环。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进不仅要求模型获得有用的训练经验，还要判断当前经验何时失效。现有方法多关注“生成什么经验”，较少关注“何时引入新经验”；同时常用自一致性/多数投票构造监督目标，使监督依赖模型自身不确定的预测。
AI.method: 将两个问题分离：(1) 由训练动态决定何时获取新经验——监控训练日志中的奖励变化与准确率，在学习信号下降时刷新任务池，且不使用验证集或测试分数；(2) 新任务的答案保持可独立校验——用静态的模型自编写程序库生成多模态问题并推导参考答案；明确任务生成契约，自动验证奖励与刷新规则的选定属性，并单独审计生成答案。训练循环不使用外部训练样例或人工答案标签。
AI.result: 在主要十一基准套件上，使用800个新任务将平均性能从57.77提升至61.05。
AI.conclusion: 以训练动态驱动的任务池刷新机制配合可验证的自动生成任务与答案，可在无外部数据与人工标签条件下实现有效的递归自我改进，提示“何时学”与“学什么”应分别设计并分别验证。

title: A Case Study of a Multi-Agent Kernel-Optimization Loop That Learns a New AI Accelerator
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Round 1 of the NPU Model Optimization Competition at MICRO 2026. Code: https://github.com/bgchun-fs/multi-agent-kernel-gen-loop
summary: Frontier large language models write correct CUDA kernels for most single-operator benchmark tasks, yet their accuracy collapses on accelerators whose architecture and programming language they have rarely seen. We present a case study of an LLM agent loop built for such accelerators. Our example is the FuriosaAI RNGD NPU, programmed in a recent, sparsely documented Rust DSL, where the loop optimized three Gemma-4-12B decode kernels over 12 days on a shared, scarce device. The loop builds its own target knowledge: it writes and checks a summary of the DSL documentation, measures the chip with microbenchmarks, records compiler-derived legality rules, and revisits this knowledge when the toolchain changes, rechecking rules and measurements where it can. A role-based search over per-kernel Design Trees explores whole-kernel designs and accumulates small accepted changes in the best version of each kernel. Because device time is scarce and readings are noisy, cheap checks screen new designs before any device run, and late in the run a change was accepted only after repeated comparisons with the best kernel on the device. The final kernels reach a 9.293x geomean speedup over the official baseline, each within 1.25x of the cycles needed just to move its weights. Our prompts, profiler and acceptance test are available at https://github.com/bgchun-fs/multi-agent-kernel-gen-loop.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向稀疏文档、稀有加速器（FuriosaAI RNGD NPU，Rust DSL）的LLM智能体循环，通过自建目标知识库、角色化Design Tree搜索与噪声鲁棒的设备验证，在12天内将三个Gemma-4-12B解码算子优化至相对官方基线9.293倍几何平均加速，且各算子均在权重量搬运所需cycle的1.25倍以内。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM能写好常规CUDA单算子kernel，但在架构与编程语言罕见、文档稀疏的加速器上准确率骤降；同时设备稀缺、测量噪声大，需要一种能在真实受限条件下持续积累知识并高效利用设备时间的优化范式。
AI.method: 以FuriosaAI RNGD NPU及近期Rust DSL为案例构建智能体循环：(1) 自建目标知识——撰写并核验DSL文档摘要、用微基准测量芯片、记录编译器导出的合法性规则，并在工具链变更时回调修订；(2) 按角色划分的Design Tree搜索，兼顾整核设计与对最优版本的小步增量接受；(3) 因设备稀缺且读数有噪，先用低成本检查筛选新设计再上设备，运行后期仅在与当前最优kernel的设备重复对比后才接受变更。
AI.result: 最终kernel相对官方基线取得9.293倍几何平均加速，各kernel运行cycle均在仅搬运其权重所需cycle的1.25倍以内，接近内存带宽下界。
AI.conclusion: 在陌生、文档稀少的加速器上，LLM智能体可通过自建并持续校验目标知识、结构化的角色化设计搜索以及噪声鲁棒的低成本筛查-重复验证流程，在稀缺共享设备上实现接近带宽极限的显著性能提升；提示词、profiler与验收测试已开源。

title: CALM: Conflict-Aware Lifecycle Memory Governance for Long-Horizon Language Agents
summary: A memory can be outdated for present-day reasoning yet indispensable for reconstructing the past. Relevance-based retrieval overlooks this tension: semantic relevance, evidence-grounded validity, and query-specific eligibility are distinct. We propose CALM, a conflict-aware lifecycle memory governance framework that decouples persistent memory preservation from query-time admission. CALM converts heterogeneous records into evidence-grounded memory cells, updates validity and lifecycle states using support, conflict, and dependency signals, and admits query-appropriate evidence through training-free or learned gating informed by temporal applicability. Across LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo with Qwen and GPT backbones, CALM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving the best overall accuracy. Compared with simple filtering and reranking, query-conditioned admission further improves evidence selection. Conflict-blocking and robustness analyses show CALM suppresses erroneous retrieved memories while retaining useful evidence. Historical-reconstruction experiments demonstrate that preserving superseded records supports accurate earlier-state reasoning without compromising current-state answers.

AI.tldr: 提出冲突感知的记忆生命周期治理框架 CALM，将持久记忆保持与查询时准入解耦，在 LongMemEval-S 和 LoCoMo 上取得最优总体准确率。
AI.motivation: 基于相关性（语义相似度）的检索忽略了一个关键张力：过时记忆对当前推理无效，但对重建历史状态不可或缺。语义相关性、证据支撑的有效性、以及查询特定的适用性三者本质不同，现有检索式记忆方法将其混为一谈。
AI.method: CALM 将异构记录转化为带证据支撑的记忆单元（memory cells）；利用支持、冲突、依赖信号更新其有效性与生命周期状态；在查询时通过无训练门控或学习式门控（由时间适用性驱动）准入与查询匹配的证据，实现"存储"与"检索准入"的解耦。
AI.result: 在 LongMemEval-S、LoCoMo 两个基准，Qwen 与 GPT 两类骨干模型上均优于 SOTA 基线，总体准确率最佳；相比简单过滤与重排序，查询条件化准入显著提升证据选择质量。冲突阻断与鲁棒性分析表明 CALM 能抑制错误的被检索记忆同时保留有用证据。
AI.conclusion: 保留被取代的历史记录有助于准确重建早期状态推理，且不损害当前状态问答，说明记忆治理需区分持久保存与查询时准入，而非以相关性统一裁决。

title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
summary: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) is now a common ingredient in language-model pre-training, as it improves downstream performance and enables faster inference through speculative decoding. We identify a flaw in standard MTP training, in which a residual component of the MTP gradient interferes with both next-token and multi-token learning, increasingly so with scale. Specifically, the MTP cross-entropy gradient can be decomposed exactly into a KL self-distillation term that pulls each MTP head toward the model's own next-token prediction (NTP) distribution and improves speculative decoding, and a residual that has a low signal-to-noise ratio and buries the useful KL signal. We introduce the KL gradient-recovery trick: when two distributions share a linear output head, the gradient of their KL divergence can be recovered exactly by combining their cross-entropy gradients through straight-through gradient routing. Unlike minimizing the KL directly, this trick requires no vocabulary-sized logit matrices and is compatible with standard fused cross-entropy kernels. This enables Soft Multi-Token Prediction (Soft-MTP), a one-line code change to MTP that removes the noisy residual and backpropagates only the KL self-distillation signal by reusing the existing NTP and MTP cross-entropy computations. Soft-MTP supports both DeepSeek- and Meta-style MTP, adds no parameters, and incurs no measurable overhead. From 167M to 1.2B parameters, Soft-MTP improves over standard MTP with lower NTP perplexity, faster speculative decoding and higher zero-shot accuracy at every scale, lower MTP perplexity from 689M onward, and stronger math and code reasoning after fine-tuning at 1.2B. Soft-MTP also matches, if not exceeds, direct KL divergence minimization on most metrics. Soft-MTP is, in effect, a free lunch for MTP optimization. Our code can be found at https://github.com/JaydenTeoh/Soft-MTP.

AI.tldr: 论文发现标准多Token预测（MTP）训练中交叉熵梯度含有低信噪比残差项，会干扰NTP与MTP学习；提出KL梯度恢复技巧与Soft-MTP，仅回传KL自蒸馏信号，无额外参数与开销，在各规模上全面优于标准MTP。
AI.motivation: MTP已成为语言模型预训练的常见组件，可提升下游性能并支持投机解码加速。但作者识别出标准MTP训练的一个缺陷：MTP交叉熵梯度可精确分解为"将各MTP头拉向模型自身NTP分布的KL自蒸馏项"与一个残差项，后者信噪比低，且随规模增大愈发严重地淹没有用的KL信号，同时干扰下一Token与多Token学习。
AI.method: 提出KL梯度恢复技巧：当两个分布共享线性输出头时，可通过直通梯度路由（straight-through gradient routing）组合二者的交叉熵梯度，精确恢复其KL散度梯度；相比直接最小化KL，无需词表规模的logit矩阵，且兼容标准融合交叉熵kernel。据此实现Soft-MTP——对MTP的一行代码改动，移除噪声残差、仅反传KL自蒸馏信号，复用已有的NTP与MTP交叉熵计算；支持DeepSeek式与Meta式MTP，不增加参数、无可测开销。
AI.result: 在167M至1.2B参数范围内，Soft-MTP在每个规模上都优于标准MTP：更低的NTP困惑度、更快的投机解码、更高的零样本准确率；689M起MTP困惑度更低；1.2B微调后数学与代码推理更强。在多数指标上匹配甚至超过直接KL最小化。
AI.conclusion: Soft-MTP是MTP优化中的"免费午餐"：通过精确分离并只保留KL自蒸馏梯度，消除低信噪比残差干扰，在零参数增量、零额外开销的前提下稳定提升预训练质量、投机解码速度与下游推理能力。

title: Think Before You Act: Decision Gate for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly perform consequential actions through external tools, yet their proposed actions are often executed without independent verification of policy compliance or task completion. We introduce JevAct, a runtime verification framework that intercepts selected agent actions before execution and enables feedback-driven correction. JevAct compiles domain policies into executable state checks and structured questions evaluated by a prefill-only decision model, which produces probability-based judgments without relying on LLM generation. By combining deterministic verification of tool-state facts with probabilistic assessment of conversational context, the framework identifies potentially invalid actions and premature task termination, providing targeted feedback for bounded revision. JevAct operates independently of the underlying agent model and requires no modifications to its parameters or tools. We evaluate JevAct across eleven LLM agents on $τ^2$-bench Airline and Telecom tasks and BFCL. Results show improvements in agent reliability across multiple models and benchmarks, with particularly consistent gains on Telecom and BFCL, while performance on Airline is more mixed. Overall, these findings suggest that combining structured decision models with executable verification can improve the reliability of tool-using LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 提出JevAct运行时验证框架，在LLM agent执行动作前拦截，通过确定性状态检查与prefill-only决策模型概率判断相结合，识别违规动作与过早终止任务，提供反馈驱动修正，无需改动agent模型或工具。
AI.motivation: LLM agent越来越多通过外部工具执行有后果的动作，但其提议的动作常未经独立验证即被执行，缺乏对策略合规性与任务完成度的检查。
AI.method: JevAct将领域策略编译为可执行状态检查与结构化问题，由prefill-only决策模型评估，产生基于概率的判断而不依赖LLM生成；结合工具状态事实的确定性验证与对话上下文的概率性评估，识别潜在无效动作和过早任务终止，并给出有界修订的针对性反馈。
AI.result: 在τ²-bench的Airline与Telecom任务及BFCL上评估11个LLM agent，多模型多基准的可靠性均有提升，Telecom与BFCL提升尤为稳定，Airline表现较为混合。
AI.conclusion: 将结构化决策模型与可执行验证相结合可提升工具使用型LLM agent的可靠性；框架独立于底层agent模型，无需修改其参数或工具。

title: MUSE: Multi-Level Memory with Selective Runtime Injection for Scientific Coding Agents
summary: Historical experience can guide scientific coding at multiple levels, but task-level retrieval may miss implementation lessons that become relevant during execution. We introduce MUSE, a memory management framework combining multi-level memory with selective runtime injection for scientific coding agents. MUSE builds global, approach-level, and implementation-level memory from historical trajectories. At initialization, the agent receives global memory and problem-matched approach-level memory. During execution, current interactions are used to retrieve implementation-level memory. An LLM gate selects relevant experience and generates specific review advice, or skips injection. Across four benchmarks spanning numerical problem solving, kernel optimization, and scientific software repair, MUSE outperforms retrieval and memory baselines on all evaluation metrics. Ablations support the multi-level design and gated injection, while transfer experiments show that memory remains useful across kernel benchmarks. These results show that multi-level memory and selective runtime injection enable effective reuse of experience in scientific coding. Code is available at https://github.com/hr-jin/MUSE.

AI.tldr: 提出MUSE记忆管理框架，结合多级记忆与运行时选择性注入，提升科学编程智能体的经验复用效果。
AI.motivation: 历史经验可在多个层面指导科学编程，但仅在任务层面检索会遗漏执行过程中才显现价值的实现细节。
AI.method: 从历史轨迹构建全局级、方法级、实现级三层记忆；初始化时注入全局记忆与问题匹配的方法级记忆；执行中依据当前交互检索实现级记忆；由LLM门控筛选相关经验并生成具体评审建议，或跳过注入。
AI.result: 在数值问题求解、内核优化与科学软件修复四类基准上，所有评价指标均优于检索与记忆基线；消融实验支持多级设计与门控注入；迁移实验中记忆在内核基准间仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 多级记忆与选择性运行时注入能有效实现科学编程中的经验复用。

title: Right Numbers, Wrong Questions: Evaluating LLMs on Underspecified Financial Queries
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the 3rd Workshop on LLMs and Generative AI for Finance (AI4F) at ACM ICAIF '26, Milan, Italy, November 14, 2026. Non-archival. 16 pages, 4 figures
summary: Financial assistants answer questions that sound factual but depend on what the user leaves unsaid: what a data figure measures, which product variant is meant, and the investor's situation and the rules that apply. An assistant that ignores these can still answer with a real number from its data, one that answers a different question. We call this frame collapse. We study it in Indian mutual funds, where product variants and tax rules are formally defined, so the correct answer can be computed for every reading. One study tests each challenge. Given an ambiguously labelled figure, models used it, often under the user's label. Given every alternative labelled, they listed them all, but the layout decided which came first. Missing a fact about the investor, weaker agents assumed a default or an outdated tax rule; requiring the fact did not guarantee its use. Because such answers match their data, checks against the data pass them. An AI judge caught mislabelled figures only when told what each field means, and still passed answers that silently chose another reading. We show how these failures arise, not how often, and propose controls for financial assistants.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"frame collapse"(框架坍缩)概念:金融助手对看似事实性、实则依赖用户未言明前提的问题,会用数据中的真实数字回答另一个问题。以印度共同基金(产品变体与税则形式化定义)为测试床,作者设计了三个挑战性研究,展示模型在歧义标注图表、多标签备选、缺失投资者事实与税则下的失效模式,并指出数据一致性校验无法捕获此类错误。
AI.motivation: 金融问答中的"事实性"往往是伪事实性:正确答案取决于用户未明说的语境——图表数字衡量的是什么、所指的具体产品变体、投资者个人情况与适用规则。现有评估只看答案能否追溯到数据,无法发现"数字真实但回答的是另一个问题"的系统性失败,作者称之为 frame collapse 并加以刻画。
AI.method: 选取印度共同基金作为研究场景,因其产品变体与税收规则有形式化定义,可对每种解读计算正确答案。为每类挑战设计独立研究:(1)给出歧义标注的图表数值,考察模型是否沿用用户标签;(2)给出全部备选标签,考察呈现布局对排序的影响;(3)缺失投资者事实与税则时,考察默认假设与过时规则的使用,以及显式要求该事实是否保证其被使用。并对基于数据的校验与 AI judge 进行评估。
AI.result: 歧义标注下模型常沿用用户标签误用数值;全部备选标注时虽会列出全部,但布局决定先后顺序;缺失投资者事实时较弱模型采用默认值或过时税则,显式要求提供事实亦不保证被采纳。因答案与其数据一致,针对数据的检查全部通过。AI judge 仅在被告知各字段含义时才能识别错误标注,且仍放过静默选择另一解读的答案。
AI.conclusion: frame collapse 是金融助手的结构性失效模式,数据一致性校验与 AI judge 均不足以发现。论文旨在揭示此类失败的成因机制而非量化其频率,并提出针对金融助手的控制措施。

title: Optimal Regret for Communication-Efficient Decentralized Online Learning
summary: In this paper, we investigate decentralized online convex optimization with compressed communication, where $n$ learners over a network jointly minimize a sequence of global loss functions based only on their local losses and compressed messages from their neighbors. The best known regret bounds for this problem are $O(ω^{-1/2}nρ^{-1}\sqrt{T\ln n})$ and $O(ω^{-1}nρ^{-2}\ln n\ln T)$ for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respectively, where $ρ\in(0,1)$ is the spectral gap of the communication matrix and $ω\in(0,1]$ is the compression quality factor. Compared with the corresponding lower bounds of $Ω(ω^{-1/2}nρ^{-1/4}\sqrt{T})$ and $Ω(ω^{-1}nρ^{-1/2}\ln T)$, these upper bounds exhibit polynomial gaps in their dependence on $ρ^{-1}$. To close these gaps, we first develop Ascent-gossip, which combines an online compression strategy with a Chebyshev recursion and attains a faster consensus rate than existing compressed gossip methods. Furthermore, by adopting Ascent-gossip, we propose an online algorithm that achieves optimal regret bounds of $\widetilde O(ω^{-1/2}nρ^{-1/4}\sqrt{T})$ and $\widetilde O(ω^{-1}nρ^{-1/2}\ln T)$ for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respectively. Up to logarithmic factors in $n$ and $ρ^{-1}$, these results match the lower bounds in terms of $T$, $n$, $ρ$, and $ω$.

AI.tldr: 该文研究带压缩通信的去中心化在线凸优化，提出 Ascent-gossip 一致化方法，首次给出在 T、n、ρ、ω 上均达到最优（至对数因子）的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 现有去中心化压缩在线凸优化算法的最优遗憾界在谱隙 ρ^{-1} 上存在多项式差距（凸情形 ρ^{-1} vs 下界 ρ^{-1/4}，强凸情形 ρ^{-2} vs ρ^{-1/2}），本文旨在消除该差距。
AI.method: 提出 Ascent-gossip：将在线压缩策略与 Chebyshev 递归结合，获得比现有压缩 gossip 更快的一致性收敛速率；再基于 Ascent-gossip 设计去中心化在线算法。
AI.result: 凸与强凸损失下分别达到 Õ(ω^{-1/2} n ρ^{-1/4} √T) 和 Õ(ω^{-1} n ρ^{-1/2} ln T) 的遗憾界，在 T、n、ρ、ω 维度上与下界匹配（至 n、ρ^{-1} 的对数因子）。
AI.conclusion: 通过更快的压缩一致性机制可闭合去中心化压缩在线优化的谱隙依赖差距，实现最优遗憾界。

title: "Close enough?" An investigation into multiplication errors in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently fail at multi-digit arithmetic, but the underlying mechanisms governing these failures remain poorly understood. While recent work demonstrates that addition errors follow a "noisy quantisation" model localised around carry boundaries, whether this framework generalises to multiplication remains an open question. In this work, we evaluate multiplication capabilities across several small base LLMs on a dataset of 16,991 problems spanning varied operand lengths. We show that multiplication errors do not conform to the addition-style noisy quantisation model. Instead, we uncover a novel error regime in small Qwen models: errors in lower-order columns predominantly preserve parity. Conversely, higher-order digit errors shift toward off-by-one carry failures. Our findings suggest that arithmetic computation in LLMs relies on distinct, multi-periodic internal representations where parity is tracked more robustly than exact digit identity, providing new mechanistic insights into numerical reasoning in transformers.

AI.tldr: 论文研究小规模LLM的多位数乘法错误机制，发现乘法错误不符合加法式的"噪声量化"模型，而呈现低位列保奇偶、高位列进一位进位失败的双重误差模式。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明加法错误可用局部于进位边界的"噪声量化"模型解释，但该框架能否推广到乘法尚不清楚，且LLM多位数算术失败的内在机制理解不足。
AI.method: 在覆盖多种操作数长度的16,991道乘法题数据集上，评测多个小规模基座LLM的乘法能力，并对错误按数位列位置与奇偶性、进位模式进行分类统计分析。
AI.result: 乘法错误不遵循加法式噪声量化模型；在小型Qwen模型中发现新误差规律：低位列错误以保持奇偶性为主，高位数字错误则偏向off-by-one进位失败。
AI.conclusion: LLM的算术计算依赖彼此不同的多周期内部表征，其中奇偶性比精确数字身份被更稳健地追踪，为Transformer数值推理提供了新的机制性洞见。

title: Learning a Prior-Data Fitted Network for Graph Foundation Models via Structural Causal Model Priors
summary: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for learning transferable representations across different graphs and domains. However, existing GFMs face notable limitations, including limited pre-training scale or reliance on aligning with textual information in Large Language Models (LLMs). To overcome these limitations, recent studies have drawn inspiration from prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which learn from large synthetic datasets and support multi-domain prediction backed by causal learning. However, existing graph PFNs encounter severe difficulties in modeling causal relationships within and across node and edge sets, generating diverse graph structures, and designing suitable architectures that can learn from complex synthetic datasets. To address these challenges, we propose **GSCM-PFN** (Graph SCM-based Prior-Data Fitted Network), a graph PFN pre-trained on synthetic data generated from an SCM-based prior that jointly models nodes and graph topology. Specifically, we (1) design a joint feature-edge-label structural causal model (SCM) to guide synthetic graph generation and capture causal relationships within and across node and edge sets; (2) introduce prior-guided node-edge dependency modeling to instantiate diverse graph generation strategies, and prove that our SCM-based generation prior is more expressive than existing priors; and (3) propose a feature-permutation-invariant dual-path graph network with theoretical guarantees for learning from diverse synthetic graphs. Experiments on 23 real-world benchmarks show that GSCM-PFN outperforms both conventional GFMs and PFN-based GFMs, without utilizing real-world graph data for pre-training. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GSCM-PFN-A3A3/

AI.tldr: 提出GSCM-PFN，一种基于结构因果模型（SCM）先验生成合成图数据预训练的图PFN，联合建模节点与拓扑，在23个真实基准上超越传统GFM与现有图PFN，且预训练不使用真实图数据。
AI.motivation: 现有图基础模型（GFM）预训练规模有限或依赖与LLM文本信息对齐；现有图PFN难以建模节点/边集合内部及跨集合的因果关系、难以生成多样图结构、缺乏适配复杂合成数据的架构。
AI.method: (1) 设计联合特征-边-标签的结构因果模型（SCM）指导合成图生成，刻画节点集与边集内部及跨集合因果依赖；(2) 引入先验引导的节点-边依赖建模以实例化多样化图生成策略，并证明该SCM生成先验比现有先验更具表达力；(3) 提出特征置换不变的双路径图网络，并给出从多样合成图学习的理论保证。
AI.result: 在23个真实世界基准上，GSCM-PFN优于传统GFM与基于PFN的GFM，且预训练阶段未使用任何真实图数据。
AI.conclusion: 以SCM先验驱动的合成数据预训练可作为图基础模型中替代文本对齐与大规模真实图预训练的有效路径。

title: Curriculum-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robust Autonomous Rocket Landing under Atmospheric Uncertainty
summary: Autonomous far-range rocket landing is a challenging control problem because navigation, descent-rate regulation, attitude management, and fuel use must be coordinated in the presence of uncertain atmospheric and vehicle dynamics. This paper presents a curriculum-driven proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework for three-dimensional rocket landing in a stochastic environment incorporating altitude-dependent aerodynamic drag, wind shear, temporally correlated turbulence, discrete gusts, uncertain propulsion and aerodynamic parameters, thrust-vector misalignment, engine lag, actuator-gain variation, noisy observations, and command latency. Learning is organised into far-range approach, soft descent, and integrated landing stages. Policy transfer, critic warm-up after reward changes, rehearsal of earlier tasks, and progressive expansion of weather severity are used to support learning across these coupled phases. Across 100,000 evaluation episodes, the policy achieves 96,656 successful landings, corresponding to a success rate of 96.656\% and a 95\% Wilson confidence interval of 96.543--96.766\%. Success decreases from 98.84\% under zero-disturbance conditions to 88.07\% in the highest weather-severity band. Successful touchdowns exhibit small miss distances and low residual horizontal and vertical velocities. An exploratory logistic-regression analysis identifies mean wind speed as the strongest measured correlate of success, with initial distance, initial altitude, initial vertical velocity, and wind-shear exponent also associated with outcomes. The results quantify both the effectiveness of the learned policy over the evaluated disturbance distribution and the degradation that occurs under severe compound atmospheric conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出课程驱动的PPO框架用于三维火箭远程自主着陆，在含气动阻力、风切变、湍流、阵风、参数不确定与传感噪声等复合扰动环境下，10万次评估成功率96.656%（95% Wilson CI 96.543–96.766%）。
AI.motivation: 远程火箭着陆需在不确定大气与飞行器动力学下协同导航、下降率调节、姿态控制与燃料使用，属高维耦合控制难题；现有方法难以覆盖多源复合扰动与远距离接近—着陆的全过程。
AI.method: 采用课程驱动PPO：将学习划分为远程接近、软着陆下降、集成着陆三阶段；使用策略迁移、奖励变更后的critic热启动、前期任务复演与天气严重度渐进扩展。环境建模含高度相关气动阻力、风切变、时间相关湍流、离散阵风、推力与气动参数不确定、推力矢量偏置、发动机滞后、作动增益变化、观测噪声与指令延迟。
AI.result: 10万次评估中96,656次成功，成功率96.656%（95% Wilson CI 96.543–96.766%）；零扰动98.84%，最高天气严重度档降至88.07%；成功触地具有小脱靶量与低残余水平/垂直速度。探索性逻辑回归显示平均风速为最强成功相关因素，初始距离、初始高度、初始垂直速度与风切变指数亦相关。
AI.conclusion: 课程式PPO可在所评估扰动分布内实现稳健远程三维着陆，但严重复合大气条件下性能显著退化；结果既量化策略有效性，也揭示需进一步改进的鲁棒性边界。

title: How Much Do Teacher Bridges Matter in Interleaved On-Policy Distillation?
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student using teacher predictions on student-generated responses. Some methods insert teacher-written segments, or bridges, but disagree on how to train on those tokens. We compare no loss, forward KL and reverse KL on identical trajectories using Qwen3-1.7B as student and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as teacher. We separate gradients by which model wrote each token. Under our short training runs and BF16 inference, pre-specified tests detected no added accuracy benefit from teacher text as context or as a training target. A one-paragraph bridge after the student's first paragraph is only 2.7% of the tokens and contributes a small gradient nearly orthogonal to the student-token gradient. In this main comparison, the three loss treatments gave similar gradient directions and were statistically equivalent in accuracy within a +/-5 percentage-point margin. An exploratory pilot placing the bridge where failed responses disagreed most with the teacher suggested a benefit from teacher-token loss. A pre-specified replication did not confirm this, and fourfold weighting showed no significant accuracy benefit. Two limitations bound these findings. Among the tested amounts of training on fixed responses, gains peaked after four updates before the student increasingly failed to stop generating. None of the tested online training variants met the criteria for stable stopping and improved accuracy. Our evaluations used BF16 inference, which rounds away most of the small weight changes. When evaluated in exact FP32, the tested replication models frequently reached the response-length limit. Our accuracy findings therefore concern BF16 inference; they do not establish that teacher-token supervision is generally unnecessary.

AI.tldr: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B的OPD对照实验中，教师文本作为上下文或训练目标在BF16推理下未带来可测精度增益，三种损失处理在±5个百分点内统计等价；发现增益在4次更新后见顶，生成停止稳定性是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: on-policy蒸馏中教师桥接片段（teacher-written bridges）如何取损失存在分歧（无损失/前向KL/反向KL），且教师文本是否真正有益缺乏在相同轨迹、可控条件下的直接对照证据。
AI.method: 固定学生Qwen3-1.7B、教师Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507；在同一轨迹上对比no loss、forward KL、reverse KL三种处理；按token作者（学生/教师）分离梯度；采用预注册检验与复制实验，设定±5pp等效边际；辅以梯度方向分析、桥接位置探索性试点及四倍加权实验；BF16与FP32推理对照。
AI.result: 短训练+BF16下，教师文本作上下文或训练目标均无可测精度增益；学生首段后的单段桥接仅占2.7% token，其梯度小且近正交于学生token梯度；三种损失梯度方向相近、精度统计等效。探索性试点提示教师token损失有益，但预注册复制未证实，四倍加权亦无显著收益。固定响应训练中增益在4次更新后见顶，随后停止生成能力退化；在线变体均未同时满足稳定停止与精度提升；FP32评估下复制模型频繁触及长度上限。
AI.conclusion: 结论受限于BF16推理（小权重更新被舍入）与短训练预算，仅适用于BF16情形；不能据此断言教师token监督普遍无用，需在精确数值、长训练与停止稳定性约束下进一步验证。

title: Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
comment: Work in progress. Code is released at https://github.com/jet-ai-projects/WISD
summary: Self-distillation offers a way to improve reasoning models when a suitable external teacher is unavailable. However, common approaches rely on privileged information to construct a stronger self-teacher, limiting their use when only unlabeled prompts are available. In this paper, we introduce Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation (WISD), which instead constructs a weaker counterpart of the original model and uses the contrast between the two as a training signal without requiring privileged information. We explore two ways to construct the weaker model: low-bit quantization and magnitude pruning. We evaluate WISD across diverse architectures and scales on mathematical and coding reasoning tasks. Across these benchmarks, quantization and pruning improve average accuracy over the original models by 4.0 and 5.5 percentage points, respectively, achieving state-of-the-art performance even without privileged information. Notably, pruning raises Qwen3.5-4B's accuracy from 57.7% to 70.5% on HMMT 2025 and from 39.1% to 56.7% on LiveCodeBench v6. Quantization raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B's accuracy from 68.5% to 74.6% and from 61.8% to 69.5% on the same benchmarks, respectively. These results establish WISD as a novel and effective self-distillation framework for large reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 提出 WISD，通过量化或剪枝构造"弱化版"自身模型，利用强弱对比作为训练信号进行在线自蒸馏，无需特权信息即在数学与代码推理上显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有自蒸馏方法需依赖特权信息（如标准答案、更强教师）构造自教师，当仅有未标注提示时无法使用，因此需要一种不依赖特权信息的自蒸馏方案。
AI.method: WISD 不构造更强的自教师，而是构造原始模型的"弱化对应体"：低比特量化与幅度剪枝两种方式；以原始模型与弱化模型在同一 on-policy 采样轨迹上的输出对比作为训练信号。
AI.result: 在多架构、多规模的数学与代码推理基准上，量化与剪枝分别带来平均 4.0 与 5.5 个百分点的准确率提升，达到无需特权信息条件下的 SOTA。剪枝使 Qwen3.5-4B 在 HMMT 2025 由 57.7% 升至 70.5%、LiveCodeBench v6 由 39.1% 升至 56.7%；量化使 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在相同基准上由 68.5%→74.6%、61.8%→69.5%。
AI.conclusion: WISD 是一种新颖且有效的自蒸馏框架：以"弱化—对比"替代"强化—模仿"，可在仅有无标注提示的条件下提升大推理模型性能。

title: Continual Adaptation Across Modalities: Learning and Forgetting in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs), which can process and generate diverse modalities within a single framework, have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm. However, when these models undergo continual learning on multiple tasks across different modalities, their learning and forgetting dynamics remain poorly understood. In this paper, we systematically investigate how architectural design and adaptation method shape intra-modal learning and cross-modal interference between the generation and understanding sides. Specifically, we report three findings. First, the severity of cross-modal interference decreases with the degree of modality-specific parameter isolation. Second, a within-model asymmetry: the generation side of a UMM is markedly more fragile than its understanding side. Third, what post-training adds is the first to be forgotten: purely post-training capabilities such as personalized generation collapse by 84\% to 90\%, while pretraining capabilities remain stable. Together, these results clarify how parameter isolation and post-training fragility shape UMMs' learning and forgetting dynamics, offering a starting point for developing continually evolving UMMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了统一多模态模型（UMM）在多模态多任务持续学习中的学习与遗忘动态，揭示三条规律：跨模态干扰随模态专属参数隔离程度提高而减弱；生成侧比理解侧更脆弱；后训练获得的能力最先被遗忘（个性化生成能力下降84%–90%，而预训练能力稳定）。
AI.motivation: UMM已成为强有力范式，但其在不同模态多个任务上进行持续学习时的学习与遗忘动态尚缺乏理解；作者希望厘清架构设计与适配方法如何影响模态内学习与跨模态干扰，为构建可持续演进的UMM提供起点。
AI.method: 对UMM进行系统性的持续学习实验分析，考察架构设计（参数隔离程度）与适配/后训练方法对“生成侧—理解侧”之间模态内学习与跨模态干扰的影响，并对比后训练能力与预训练能力的保持情况。
AI.result: 三点发现：(1) 跨模态干扰的严重程度随模态专属参数隔离程度提升而下降；(2) 模型内部存在不对称性——生成侧显著比理解侧更脆弱；(3) “后训练所得最先被遗忘”：纯后训练能力（如个性化生成）崩溃84%~90%，预训练能力保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 参数隔离与后训练脆弱性共同塑造了UMM的学习与遗忘动态，为开发持续演进的统一多模态模型提供了基础性认识。

title: Deogen: Automatic Benchmark Generation for Reasoning over Policies
summary: Language models are increasingly being deployed in regulated settings, where a model must apply given rules to the facts of a situation to determine a verdict. Benchmarking this capability, known as deontic reasoning, remains a costly and manual process, with existing datasets largely hand-crafted. In this paper, we present DeoGen, a scalable, automatic, and parametrizable benchmark generator for deontic reasoning. By autoformalizing policy rules to first-order logic, we can construct decision trees that capture possible outcome trajectories. Each path down a tree becomes a benchmark entry, with each tree producing combinatorially many entries relative to tree depth. Paths ending at a leaf entail a verdict, while non-leaf paths measure a model's ability to abstain when presented with insufficient information. Evaluations show frontier models return the correct verdict 89-92% of the time. Notably, performance degrades (22-40% correct) on entries without sufficient information to claim a verdict, even with explicit instructions to abstain in such cases. In all, DeoGen presents an automatic, scalable, and parametric method for generating deontic reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出DeoGen——自动、可扩展、可参数化的道义推理基准生成器：将政策规则自动形式化为一阶逻辑并构造决策树，树的每条路径成为一条基准条目（叶子路径给出裁决，非叶子路径考察模型在信息不足时弃权的能力）；实验显示前沿模型裁决正确率89-92%，但在信息不足条目上仅22-40%正确，即使明确要求弃权。
AI.motivation: 语言模型越来越多地部署于受监管场景，需依据给定规则结合事实作出裁决（道义推理）。而现有该能力的评测依赖昂贵的人工流程，数据集多为手工构建，缺乏可扩展、可参数化的基准生成手段。
AI.method: 构建DeoGen生成器：先将政策规则自动形式化（autoformalization）为一阶逻辑，再据此构造刻画可能结果轨迹的决策树；树中每条路径对应一条基准条目，条目数量随树深呈组合式增长。叶子路径蕴含裁决标签，非叶路径用于检验模型在信息不足时的弃权（abstention）能力。生成过程可由参数控制，实现自动化与规模化。
AI.result: 前沿模型在可裁决条目上正确率约89-92%；但在信息不足、无法作出裁决的条目上性能显著下降（正确率22-40%），即便给出了明确弃权指令也难以改善。
AI.conclusion: DeoGen提供了一种自动、可扩展、参数化的道义推理基准生成方法，降低了对人工标注的依赖，并揭示出模型在"信息不足时应弃权"这一维度的明显短板。

title: AtomSteer: Test-Time Constraint Steering for Atomistic Generative Models
summary: Diffusion and flow matching models offer scalable approaches to generating crystalline materials, molecular conformers, and protein-ligand complexes. However, satisfying crystallographic symmetry, structural geometry, and accurate stereochemistry remains challenging. Satisfying these requirements calls for corrections that preserve the geometry already captured by the pretrained model. In this work, we propose AtomSteer, a test-time inference framework for steering pretrained atomistic generative models with structural constraints. During sampling, AtomSteer corrects intermediate structure predictions with bounded local projections, graph-rigid stereochemical transformations, and projections over periodic symmetries, accepting updates that improve constraint satisfaction while limiting changes to the rest of the structure. We demonstrate AtomSteer across three pretrained backbones, FlowMM, ET-Flow, and Boltz-2, spanning de novo crystal generation and crystal structure prediction, molecular conformer generation, and protein-ligand complex structure prediction. AtomSteer improves space-group distribution coverage in de novo crystal generation and improves target space-group recovery in crystal structure prediction. AtomSteer improves molecular validity and E/Z stereochemical accuracy while retaining conformer ensemble fidelity. For protein-ligand complexes, AtomSteer reduces ligand E/Z errors relative to experimental reference structures while achieving competitive docking success and PoseBusters validity. Our method provides a unified framework for adding chemical and crystallographic control to existing atomistic generative models without retraining or architectural changes.

AI.tldr: AtomSteer：一种无需重训练的测试时推断框架，通过有界局部投影、刚体立体化学变换与周期对称投影，为预训练原子生成模型（FlowMM、ET-Flow、Boltz-2）施加晶体学与立体化学约束，在保持几何与系综保真度的同时提升对称性覆盖、E/Z 准确度与配体复合物质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流匹配模型已能规模化生成晶体材料、分子构象与蛋白-配体复合物，但难以同时满足晶体学对称性、结构几何合理性及精确立体化学。对此类缺陷的修正需要在保留预训练模型已学到的几何先验的前提下进行，而重训练或改动架构成本高。
AI.method: 提出测试时推断框架 AtomSteer。在采样过程中对中间结构预测施加三类校正：有界局部投影（bounded local projections）、图刚体立体化学变换（graph-rigid stereochemical transformations）、周期对称性投影；采用接受准则，仅当约束满足度提升且结构其余部分改动受限时才接受更新。
AI.result: 在三种预训练骨干（FlowMM、ET-Flow、Boltz-2）上跨四项任务验证：de novo 晶体生成中空间群分布覆盖提升；晶体结构预测中目标空间群回收率提升；分子构象生成中有效性与 E/Z 立体化学精度提升且系综保真度保持；蛋白-配体复合物中相对实验参考结构的配体 E/Z 误差降低，同时 docking 成功率与 PoseBusters 有效性具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: AtomSteer 提供了统一框架，可在不重训练、不修改架构的情况下为现有原子级生成模型引入化学与晶体学控制，实现约束引导的测试时推断。

title: Beyond fabrication: Misattributed numbers in papers written by AI research agents
comment: 42 pages, 5 figures, 13 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/mos3b-faqeeh/agent-integrity-analysis
summary: Verifying numerical claims in research written by AI agents is an important but challenging problem. Recent benchmarks show that many agent-written papers fail integrity checks, but such verdicts, often produced by a single LLM judge, identify failure without explaining its nature, and existing checks either test a paper for internal consistency or test whether a reported value appears somewhere in an agent's output. We re-analyze all 540 released judgments from a recent public benchmark of AI research agents (nine agents, fifteen open research problems) and manually label 256 numerical claims from 18 submissions. Failures concentrate on alignment between the paper and the underlying work rather than overt cheating, and about four in five unsupported claims correspond to values in the agent's own files that come from the wrong experiment, metric, or run. We introduce a deterministic claim-to-evidence checker that scores whether the surrounding context identifies the claimed result and calibrates each claim against numerical decoys. With its rules fixed before labeling, it certifies claims with over 90% precision against blinded annotators (78 of 85; Cohen's kappa = 0.89), while verifying only a subset of claims; most claims it cannot verify are nevertheless traceable, so failure to verify is not evidence of falsehood. An LLM verifier given the same evidence recovers more traceable claims but accepts about three times as many misattributed ones, so the two are best used together. Applied to 99 submissions, the checker reveals large differences in traceability across agents, and a second judge from a different vendor preserves the official agent ranking while passing twice as many papers. These findings motivate provenance-first auditing of AI-produced research.

AI.tldr: 论文重新分析AI研究智能体基准的540条判定并人工标注256条数值主张，发现失败主要是"论文与底层工作不对齐"而非明显造假；提出确定性的主张–证据核查器，以>90%精度为一子集主张出具认证，并与LLM核查器互补，倡导"溯源优先"审计。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多由单一LLM评委给出"通过/不通过"结论，只能指出失败而不解释失败性质；已有检查要么测论文内部一致性，要么仅测某数值是否出现在智能体输出中，无法判断数值是否被正确归属。因此需要可解释、可校准的数值主张核查方法，厘清AI撰写论文中失败的真实成因。
AI.method: (1) 重新分析某公开AI研究智能体基准全部540条已发布判定（9个智能体、15个开放研究问题），并对18份提交中的256条数值主张进行人工标注；(2) 归因分析：判断不支持主张对应的数值来源（错误实验/指标/运行）；(3) 设计确定性claim-to-evidence核查器：规则在标注前固定，评分"上下文能否唯一识别所指结果"，并用数值诱饵（decoys）做校准；(4) 对比实验：给LLM核查器同样的证据，比较二者在可溯源主张召回与错误归属接受率上的差异，并在99份提交上应用、跨厂商第二评委复现排名。
AI.result: 失败集中于论文与底层工作的对齐问题而非公开作弊；约五分之四的无支持主张，其数值确实存在于智能体自身文件中，但来自错误的实验、指标或运行。确定性核查器对盲审标注者达到>90%精度（85条中78条；Cohen's κ=0.89），但只覆盖部分主张；多数未通过核查的主张仍可溯源，故"未能验证"不等于"虚假"。相同证据下，LLM核查器找回更多可溯源主张，却接受约三倍数量的错误归属主张。应用于99份提交，显示不同智能体在可溯源性上差异显著；换用另一厂商的第二评委可在通过论文数翻倍的同时保持官方智能体排名。
AI.conclusion: AI撰写论文的诚信问题主要是溯源/归属错误，而非蓄意造假；单一LLM评委的通/不通判定既不充分也不可解释。确定性核查器精度高但覆盖有限，LLM核查器召回高但误接受多，二者应组合使用。据此主张对AI产出的研究实行"溯源优先（provenance-first）"的审计范式。

title: REVBRAIN: Real-time Probabilistic EEG Forecasting Using Residual Vector Quantization
summary:
Real-time forecasting of resting-state EEG signals is required by applications like brain-state-dependent stimulation, where computer generated actions are coupled with ongoing neural oscillations. Recently, the deep learning model WaveNet was proposed for the forecasting task. It shows superior accuracy compared to the prevailing method, the linear autoregressive (AR) model, and provides a built-in uncertainty measure due to its probabilistic modeling framework. However, inference using WaveNet is too slow for real-time use due to its sample-by-sample autoregressive operation: a single forecast requires evaluating the model tens or hundreds of times depending on the length of the prediction window.
  In this paper, we present REVBRAIN, a probabilistic deep learning method that produces forecasts in real time by generating the forecast over the whole prediction horizon at once. This is achieved by tokenizing the output space using residual vector quantization (RVQ) and generating forecasts over the items in the tokenized space.
  We tested REVBRAIN for forecasting 200 ms of EEG time series in the alpha-frequency band (8-13 Hz) and compared our results against WaveNet model. We found that REVBRAIN achieved real-time inference on a laptop GPU and an over $50\times$ speedup compared to WaveNet, while reaching superior prediction accuracy.
  By achieving real-time inference speed, REVBRAIN enables incorporating accurate and probabilistic EEG forecasting into BCI applications, opening up new ways for investigating the functioning of the human brain.

AI.tldr: REVBRAIN通过残差向量量化(RVQ)对输出空间进行标记化，一次性生成整个预测窗口的EEG预测，实现实时概率深度预测，相比WaveNet提速超50倍且精度更高。
AI.motivation: 脑状态依赖刺激等BCI应用需要实时预测静息态EEG。现有最优方法WaveNet虽精度高、自带不确定性度量，但其逐样本自回归推理需对模型评估数十至数百次，速度过慢，无法实时应用。
AI.method: 提出REVBRAIN概率深度学习方法：用残差向量量化(RVQ)将连续输出空间离散化为token，从而对整个预测时域一次性生成预测，替代WaveNet的逐点自回归生成。
AI.result: 在alpha频段(8-13 Hz)EEG上预测200 ms时间序列，与WaveNet对比：在笔记本GPU上实现实时推理，加速超过50倍，且预测精度更优。
AI.conclusion: REVBRAIN实现实时推理速度，使精确且具概率性的EEG预测可集成到BCI应用中，为研究人脑功能开辟新途径。

title: From Grind to Grasp
summary: Discussions of complexity, knowledge and intelligence often overlook the work involved. For example, outputs generated by short programs have low algorithmic complexity but can have high computational depth, the least work needed to produce them from near-shortest programs. Producing them with less work can require longer descriptions, giving high work-bounded complexity. We introduce a formalism that compares achievements under work and information limits and describes how learning and persistence can make deep achievements shallow by reusing products of earlier work. For an agent with a limited work budget, the value of building and maintaining such resources depends on how they support its goals over later tasks. We define grasp as performance across work budgets at a fixed information allowance. Low grasp can still yield success through grind at high cost in work, without necessarily improving human grasp. Applied to improvement itself, grasp gives a criterion for recursive self-improvement in which successors make comparable further improvements more efficiently. Another route to faster progress is to expand the resources brought to bear through knowledge sharing and coordination across society, even while comparable advances require increasing work. Grasp also applies to collectives, which may outperform their members yet require more total work than one system with their combined resources. Establishing and sustaining organisation can itself be deep even when the primary task is simple. These demands may help explain the richness of biological and social systems. In agent collectives, this organisational work can generate goals beyond assigned tasks, including maintaining the collective itself. We therefore caution against allowing an emergent agent society to assume authority over social coordination, since it could increasingly direct work towards its own persistence and goals.

AI.tldr: 本文引入一个同时考察"工作（计算量）限制"与"信息（描述长度）限制"的形式化框架，用以比较不同成就；提出"广义掌握度（grasp）"即固定信息配额下跨工作预算的表现，并借此刻画递归自我改进、社会协作与集体组织成本。
AI.motivation: 现有关于复杂性、知识与智能的讨论常忽视"所需工作/计算量"。一个对象可能算法复杂度低但计算深度高（从近最短程序产出的最小工作量）；若要减少工作量则需更长描述（工作有界复杂度）。因此仅用复杂度或信息量衡量成就、学习与智能并不充分，需要一个联合考量工作与信息限制的比较框架。
AI.method: 提出形式化框架，在固定信息配额下比较不同工作预算的成就表现，定义"grasp"；用该定义刻画学习与"持久化/复用"如何把深层成就"变浅"（复用早期工作的产物）；将grasp推广到集体，并与"低grasp但高成本硬磨（grind）"路径对比；再把grasp应用于改进过程本身，给出递归自我改进的判据。
AI.result: 低grasp的系统仍可通过高工作成本的grind获得成功，但不必然提升人类的grasp；递归自我改进可被表述为后继系统以相当效率做出进一步改进；社会层面的知识共享与协调可扩大可用资源、加快进展，但同等进步仍需递增工作；集体可能优于其成员，却比拥有等量合并资源的单一系统耗费更多总工作；建立与维持组织本身可能是"深层"任务，即使主任务很简单。
AI.conclusion: 组织性工作可解释生物与社会系统的丰富性；在智能体集体中，这类组织工作会催生超出既定任务的目标，包括维持集体自身。因此作者告诫：不应让涌现的智能体社会取得对社会协调的支配权，因为其可能将越来越多的算力与工作导向自身存续与自身目标。

title: Persona Learning from Feedback for Personalized AI Assistants
summary: Personalizing AI assistants requires adapting their behavior to users' preferences and task contexts. Existing work elicits assistant personas through persona prompting or finetuning on persona-conditioned generations. However, persona descriptions alone do not identify what to change or preserve in a particular response, or which behaviors suit the current request. We introduce $\textit{Persona Learning from Feedback (PLF)}$, a framework that learns reusable, preference-grounded assistant personas as independent LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone. During training, a frozen self-teacher conditions on persona specifications and response-specific feedback to provide token-level supervision on each adapter's own generated prefixes. A feedback gate focuses corrective updates on responses judged to need improvement. At deployment, a supervised router uses the request or dialogue to select a single adapter or a fixed composition, without user-specific finetuning. We evaluate PLF on single-turn personalization with model-generated critiques and multi-turn tutoring with simulated students' reactions. Across both settings, PLF improves model-judged preference fit over fixed-persona policies and strong baselines including persona prompting and persona distillation, demonstrating how feedback-trained behaviors can be reused for adaptive assistant personalization without degrading general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出 Persona Learning from Feedback (PLF)：在共享冻结主干上以独立 LoRA 适配器学习可复用的、基于偏好的助手人格，用冻结自教师提供 token 级监督、反馈门控聚焦需改进的回复，部署时由监督路由选择单个或固定组合适配器。
AI.motivation: 个性化 AI 助手需适配用户偏好与任务语境。现有人格提示或基于人格条件生成微调的方法中，人格描述本身无法指明具体回复中该改什么、该保留什么，也难以判断哪些行为适合当前请求。
AI.method: PLF 框架：在共享冻结主干上训练独立 LoRA 适配器以表示可复用人格。训练时冻结自教师以人格规格与回复特定反馈为条件，在各适配器自身生成的前缀上提供 token 级监督；反馈门控将纠正性更新集中于被判定需改进的回复。部署时监督路由依据请求或对话选择单一适配器或固定组合，无需用户级微调。
AI.result: 在单轮个性化（模型生成批评）与多轮辅导（模拟学生反应）两种设置下，PLF 在模型判定的偏好契合度上优于固定人格策略及人格提示、人格蒸馏等强基线，且不损害通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 反馈训练所得行为可复用，实现自适应助手个性化而无需牺牲通用能力；人格描述需结合回复级反馈与路由机制方可落地。

title: Episodic looking - using reinforcement learning to bias perception enhances few-shot and continual learning with protection from forgetting
summary:
There is a fundamental contradiction between the desire for models that can generalize, and models that can continuously adapt to recent input with changing statistics. These conditions, captured in few-shot and continual learning settings, can bias or disrupt learned representations. This harms generalization to a broader context, leaving the model unable to overcome input variance.
  This paper proposes a solution based on the Complementary Learning System architecture (CLS), in which a Short-Term Memory (STM) delegates generalization to a slow, statistical Long-Term Memory (LTM). Delegation is achieved by working in a space of robust, generalized perceptions produced by the LTM. With this separation, the STM can focus on memorizing recent input and avoiding interference between memories.
  We show that on an image classification task, the resulting CLS model is more resistant to forgetting in a domain-incremental continual learning setting than a baseline ResNet LTM, and generalizes more effectively in a few-shot setting than other continual learners.
  In the continual setting, overall accuracy is slightly worse than existing continual learning models, but with a different mix of performance characteristics. Results analysis suggests that the model is limited by the representations and representational plasticity of the LTM. In future work, we will seek to address this by replaying STM memories to the LTM.

AI.tldr: 提出基于互补学习系统（CLS）架构的模型：由短期记忆（STM）负责记忆近期输入，将泛化职责委托给缓慢的统计性长期记忆（LTM），以缓解泛化与持续适应之间的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 模型"可泛化"与"可随统计变化的近期输入持续适应"之间存在根本矛盾；few-shot 与持续学习设置中的偏置或扰动会破坏已学表示，损害对更广上下文的泛化，使模型难以克服输入方差。
AI.method: 借鉴互补学习系统（CLS）架构：STM 在 LTM 产生的稳健、泛化感知空间中工作，从而将泛化委托给缓慢的统计性 LTM；这种分离使 STM 专注记忆近期输入并避免记忆间干扰。
AI.result: 在图像分类任务上，CLS 模型在域增量持续学习设置中比基线 ResNet LTM 更抗遗忘，在 few-shot 设置中比其他持续学习器泛化更好；但在持续学习设置中总体准确率略低于现有持续学习模型，性能特征组合不同。结果分析表明模型受 LTM 的表示及其表示可塑性限制。
AI.conclusion: CLS 式 STM/LTM 分离可同时改善抗遗忘性与 few-shot 泛化，但总体准确率略逊；瓶颈在于 LTM 表示及其可塑性，未来将通过把 STM 记忆回放给 LTM 来解决。

title: Learning to Reason from Reference Samples Alone: Reinforced Adversarial Learning for Modern LLM Post-Training
comment: 31 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendices
summary: In many settings where LLM post-training is desirable, high-quality answers are recognizable but difficult to score with explicit rewards. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited to tasks where an explicit correctness signal is available. Prior adversarial approaches to training reasoning LLMs either complement verifiable rewards with co-trained critics or require reference reasoning traces. We ask whether a co-trained LLM judge can turn reference answers alone into the sole reward for on-policy post-training of reasoning LLMs. We call this method Reinforced Adversarial Learning (RAL). We first validate RAL on three verifiable tasks (integer multiplication, code-based arithmetic-expression synthesis, and SMILES-to-formula translation), using the verifiers only for evaluation. With sufficiently capable judges and enough training, RAL matches direct RLVR. We then apply RAL to scientific abstract generation in two settings. In the first setting, RAL guides the generator to produce abstracts in the scientific domain of the reference abstracts, even though the prompt leaves that domain unspecified. In the second setting, we generate abstracts for U.S. National Institutes of Health grant proposals conditioned on the grant title. Human scientists and an ensemble of LLM judges find our generations harder to distinguish from real abstracts than those of frontier-LLM baselines. These results suggest a path toward post-training reasoning models in scientific and other high-value domains, where increasingly capable judges infer hard-to-specify reward functions from example answers.

AI.tldr: 提出Reinforced Adversarial Learning (RAL)，仅用参考答案训练协同进化的LLM评判器作为唯一奖励信号，对推理LLM进行on-policy后训练，在三个可验证任务上匹配RLVR，并在科学摘要生成上优于前沿LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 许多高价值场景中高质量答案可识别但难以用显式奖励评分，RLVR受限于具备明确正确性信号的任务；已有对抗式训练方法要么需与可验证奖励结合并协同训练critic，要么依赖参考推理轨迹。作者希望回答：仅凭参考答案，能否通过协同训练的LLM评判器构成唯一奖励，完成推理LLM的on-policy后训练。
AI.method: RAL：令生成器与LLM评判器协同对抗训练，以参考答案为唯一监督来源，由评判器区分生成答案与参考答案并给出奖励信号，驱动生成器的on-policy强化学习后训练。验证实验：在整数乘法、基于代码的算术表达式合成、SMILES-to-formula翻译三个可验证任务上，验证器仅用于评测不参与训练。应用实验：科学摘要生成的两个设置——（1）提示未指定领域，仅通过参考摘要引导生成同领域摘要；（2）以NIH基金标题为条件生成基金申请书摘要。
AI.result: 在三个可验证任务上，具备足够能力的评判器且训练充分时，RAL达到与直接RLVR相当的性能。在科学摘要生成中，RAL使生成器产出与参考摘要同领域的摘要；在NIH基金摘要任务上，人类科学家与LLM评判器集成均认为RAL生成结果比前沿LLM基线更难与真实摘要区分。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，随着评判器能力提升，其可从示例答案中推断难以显式规定的奖励函数，为在科学及其他高价值领域对推理模型进行后训练提供了一条可行路径。

title: Dual DeltaNet: Value-Side Memory Reorganization for Linear Attention
summary: Linear attention and state space models (SSMs) offer efficient alternatives to softmax attention by maintaining a fixed-size recurrent state, but this design requires careful management to preserve useful historical associations and limit interference. The delta rule helps reduce interference through correction of the value associated with each key, but it does not explicitly account for how related value features are distributed across the state. We observe that a state $\boldsymbol{S}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_k\times d_v}$ can be viewed as a bank of $d_k$ addresses storing $d_v$-dimensional values. While a key-side read $\boldsymbol{S}^\top\boldsymbol{k}$ retrieves the value associated with $\boldsymbol{k}$, a value-side read $\boldsymbol{S}\boldsymbol{e}$ aggregates addresses whose stored value features match the selector $\boldsymbol{e}$. Based on this observation, we propose Dual DeltaNet (DDN), which extends Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) with a two-sided delta rule. The key-side delta rule reads with the current key to correct its associated value, while the complementary value-side delta rule reads with selected features of the current value to reorganize the addresses it occupies. We derive a chunkwise parallel training algorithm and a rank-2 recurrence that increases arithmetic intensity during inference. Compared with KDA, GDN-2, and Mamba-3, DDN achieves the strongest overall performance across language modeling, zero-shot downstream tasks, and retrieval, while incurring modest training and inference overhead relative to KDA. Code: https://github.com/ReichtumQian/DualDeltaNet

AI.tldr: 提出 Dual DeltaNet (DDN)，在 Kimi Delta Attention 基础上引入"双侧 delta 规则"，同时从 key 侧和 value 侧修正循环状态，以降低历史关联干扰。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力与状态空间模型用固定大小的循环状态替代 softmax 注意力，但需谨慎管理状态以保留有用历史关联并抑制干扰。delta 规则虽通过校正每个 key 对应的 value 降低干扰，却未显式考虑相关 value 特征在状态中的分布方式。
AI.method: 将状态 S∈R^{d_k×d_v} 视为 d_k 个地址、每个存储 d_v 维 value 的地址库：key 侧读 S^T k 取回与 k 关联的 value，value 侧读 S e 聚集存储特征与选择子 e 匹配的地址。据此提出 DDN，在 KDA 上扩展为双侧 delta 规则——key 侧 delta 规则用当前 key 读取并校正其关联 value，互补的 value 侧 delta 规则用当前 value 的选定特征读取并重组其占用地址；并推导分块并行训练算法与提升推理算术强度的秩-2 递推。
AI.result: 在语言建模、零样本下游任务与检索任务上，DDN 相较 KDA、GDN-2 与 Mamba-3 取得最强综合表现；相对 KDA 仅带来适度的训练与推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 双侧 delta 规则为循环状态提供了更完整的读写校正机制，在保持线性复杂度优势的同时提升建模与检索性能，成本增量可控。

title: Where You Inject Matters: The Trust Region Effect in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents are increasingly adopted in long-horizon tasks and interact with diverse external environments. Despite their growing capabilities, these agents remain vulnerable to real-world attacks such as indirect prompt injections, which manipulate agents through malicious instructions embedded in external environments. While existing risk assessment work has primarily focused on the injection content, the effect of where an injection appears has not been systematically characterized. Studying injection placement requires agents to operate over longer-horizon tasks and interact with diverse environmental surfaces. Thus, we build three agentic testbeds spanning tool use, coding, and daily workflow domains with diverse injection surfaces. Holding the injection content fixed, we find that agent susceptibility varies across injection placements. We refer to this phenomenon as the trust region effect: agents implicitly assign different levels of trust to different regions of their environments. For example, an agent powered by GPT-5.4 follows an unsafe injection instruction placed in a repository documentation file (i.e., a README or TODO file) 2.6 times more often on average than the same instruction placed in a code or data file. Building upon this observation, we develop learning-based attackers that generate injection content and select better injection placements. Our approach demonstrates that both where an injection is placed and what content it contains can affect the strength of indirect prompt injection attacks. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic characterization for the effectiveness of different injection placements, spanning both coarse-grained environmental surfaces and fine-grained positions. The uneven trust that agents implicitly place across their environments provides important insights for future attack and defense design.

AI.tldr: 论文首次系统刻画间接提示注入中"注入位置"对攻击效果的影响，提出"信任域效应"：智能体对环境不同区域隐含信任度不同，并据此构建基于学习的攻击者同时优化注入内容与位置。
AI.motivation: 现有风险评估主要关注注入内容，而"注入出现在何处"的影响缺乏系统刻画；研究位置需长程任务与多样环境界面支撑，因此需专门测试平台。
AI.method: 构建覆盖工具使用、代码、日常工作流三个领域的智能体测试平台，提供多样注入界面；在固定注入内容下比较不同位置（粗粒度环境界面与细粒度位置）的易感性；进而提出学习型攻击者，联合生成注入内容并选择更优注入位置。
AI.result: 在内容固定条件下，智能体易感性随位置显著变化，即存在信任域效应；例如GPT-5.4驱动的智能体对置于仓库文档（README/TODO）中的不安全指令的遵循率，平均为置于代码或数据文件中的2.6倍。学习型攻击者表明内容与位置共同决定攻击强度。
AI.conclusion: 首次系统刻画不同注入位置（粗粒度界面与细粒度位置）对攻击有效性的影响；智能体在各环境区域存在不均衡的隐式信任，为未来攻击与防御设计提供重要启示。

title: Rethinking LLM Jailbreak Evaluation: Continuous Risk Landscapes Beyond Binary Outcomes
summary: A binary success indicator is a natural representation for discriminative tasks such as image classification under adversarial perturbations, where each input is mapped to a single prediction. However, generative tasks are fundamentally different: an LLM jailbreak prompt induces a distribution over open-ended trajectories, while a sampled response reveals only one path. Yet LLM jailbreak evaluation typically retains the binary response indicator underlying attack success rate, obscuring the surrounding structure of possible generations. We introduce a continuous, context-conditioned risk landscape over first-token branches, estimated by fixing candidate openings and repeatedly sampling their continuations. This continuous risk-landscape perspective reveals two complementary properties: current decoder exposure and safe rerouting capacity, which have been obscured by binary-indicator-based ASR. The resulting representation also provides a common basis for comparing clean prompts, attacked variants, and attack strength against a known adaptive defense. Across multiple target models and jailbreak attacks, we uncover risky branches beneath apparently safe outputs, identify qualitatively different ways attacks reshape the model's opening distribution, and show that attacks strongest before a defense do not necessarily remain the strongest after the adaptive defense reacts. These findings recast jailbreaks as deformations of the surrounding continuation-risk landscape, establishing a more informative foundation for understanding jailbreak behavior and developing safer language models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在首个token分支上的连续、上下文条件化的风险景观（risk landscape），以替代二元指标评估LLM越狱，揭示"解码暴露度"与"安全重路由能力"两个互补属性。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱评估沿用二元的攻击成功率（ASR）响应指示器，但生成任务本质上是分布式的：一个越狱提示会诱导开放式轨迹分布，单次采样只揭示其中一条路径，二元指标掩盖了可能生成的结构信息。
AI.method: 在首个token分支上构建连续的、以上下文为条件的风险景观：固定候选开头（opening tokens），对其后续进行重复采样以估计条件风险；据此分析两个互补性质——当前解码器暴露度（decoder exposure）与安全重路由能力（safe rerouting capacity），并以此作为统一框架比较干净提示、攻击变体、攻击强度及已知自适应防御。
AI.result: 在多个目标模型与多种越狱攻击上：发现看似安全的输出下存在高风险分支；识别出攻击重塑模型开头分布的不同定性方式；表明在防御前最强的攻击在自适应防御响应后未必仍最强。
AI.conclusion: 将越狱重新表述为对周边延续风险景观的形变（deformation），为理解越狱行为、开发更安全的语言模型提供比二元ASR更具信息量的基础。

title: Auditable Belief Updates as a Missing Safety Layer for LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as cognitive interfaces that shape how users interpret evidence, communicate, and make decisions. As deployed systems become more multimodal, tool-using, and multi-agent, safety failures no longer arise only from isolated harmful outputs, but also from how agents update, store, and propagate epistemic commitments across retrieval, memory, tools, and peer communication. In this paper, we define belief as an engineering abstraction for evidence-based commitments that guide downstream action. Building on this view, we propose the Explicit Belief Multi-Agent System (EB-MAS), which externalizes belief states into a structured substrate, uses belief operators to propose candidate updates, and applies a Cognitive Firewall to bound or reject updates that are weakly evidenced but strongly driven by vulnerability cues. We also discuss the risk of group belief at the group level, including manufactured consensus, collusion, and cascading misinformation, and outline practical integration challenges around grounding, false positives, scalability, and ethical misuse. Therefore, scalable agent safety requires not only better output filtering or stronger base models, but also explicit interfaces for tracing, calibrating, and constraining belief revision at runtime.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将"信念"作为工程抽象，构建显式信念多智能体系统（EB-MAS）：把信念状态外化到结构化基底，由信念算子提出候选更新，并用"认知防火墙"限制弱证据但受脆弱性线索强烈驱动的更新，以应对多模态、工具使用与多智能体场景下的安全失效。
