AI.method: MulClip仅使用比较、取绝对值、乘法和减法构造带曲率的响应；其截断阈值不置于极值处，而置于响应越过极值后回零的位置，使单一函数同时具备单调段与非单调折叠段。使用哪一段由常规超参数搜索（如输入尺度）决定，无需任务特定的阈值调参。在硬件上测量状态更新时间，并与tanh及11种tanh近似比较；在PC上进行NARMA-20与8位奇偶校验评估，并做端侧推理一致性验证。
AI.result: 硬件实测状态更新时间为tanh的0.34倍，短于所评估的11种tanh近似。PC评估中，三阶MulClip在NARMA-20上NMSE比tanh低22%（其预激活处于单调段）；在8位奇偶校验上，将无折叠单调裁剪变体的准确率0.76–0.78提升至0.97–0.98。两任务的端侧推理结果与PC几乎一致。
AI.conclusion: MulClip以极低计算代价同时提供单调与折叠两种响应区间，兼顾硬件效率与表达能力，适用于MCU上的储备池计算；折叠机制对需要非线性判别能力的任务（如奇偶校验）收益显著，而单调段足以胜任NARMA-20类任务。

title: Hybrid AI Patterns: Thirteen Ways to Couple Language Models with Rules, and How to Choose Among Them
summary: Language models handle text well, and rule engines give conclusions with proofs. Systems that combine the two are usually described by example, and the same coupling turns up under different names in agent frameworks, guardrail toolkits and neuro-symbolic research. This document defines thirteen patterns for coupling a language model with an executable rule language, in the catalogue form introduced for object-oriented design: intent, motivation, applicability, participants, collaborations, consequences, implementation, known uses and related patterns. Four patterns concern what crosses the boundary between model and rules, five who controls whom, three how the model takes part in the reasoning, and one how knowledge is kept over time. Five invariants hold for every combination, and five failure patterns name the couplings that break them. We relate the catalogue to published pattern catalogues and taxonomies of hybrid and neuro-symbolic systems and show where they overlap with it. A decision guide leads from a problem to a pattern. It rests on our measurements, including the cases in which a model alone did as well as the hybrid or better, and it reports what each design cost.

AI.tldr: 本文以GoF目录形式提出13个"语言模型—可执行规则语言"耦合模式，涵盖跨界内容、控制权、模型参与推理方式与知识持久化四类，并给出5条不变量、5种失效模式、与已有分类体系的对照及一个基于实测的选择指南。
AI.motivation: 语言模型擅长处理文本，规则引擎能给出带证明的结论；二者结合的混合系统目前多以示例方式零散描述，同一耦合结构在智能体框架、护栏工具包与神经符号研究中以不同名称反复出现，缺乏统一的模式语言与设计指导。
AI.method: 沿用面向对象设计的模式目录体例（意图、动机、适用性、参与者、协作、后果、实现、已知用例、相关模式），系统整理13个耦合模式：4个关于模型与规则之间传递什么、5个关于谁控制谁、3个关于模型如何参与推理、1个关于知识如何跨时间保持；提炼5条不变量与5种破坏这些不变量的失效模式；与已有混合/神经符号系统目录和分类法进行映射对照；并基于实测（含模型单用持平或更优的案例及各类设计成本）构建从问题到模式的选择指南。
AI.result: 形成一套可复用的13模式目录，明确了每个耦合的参与者、协作与后果；给出5条适用于所有组合的不变量与5个对应的失效模式；完成与现有模式目录及分类法的重叠关系分析；提供由问题直达模式的选择指南，并量化各设计方案的成本以及纯模型方案在某些情形下不劣于甚至优于混合方案的经验证据。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型与规则引擎的耦合可被系统化为命名模式而非个案示例；模式目录配合不变量、失效模式与成本数据，能指导设计者按问题选型并识别脆弱耦合，同时提醒混合并非默认更优。

title: More Is Better? Exploring Latent Correspondence in Federated Hypergraph Learning
summary: Federated hypergraph learning with latent cross-client hyperedge correspondence poses fundamental identifiability and computational challenges, as the same local release can correspond to multiple global hypergraph structures. We characterize the tractability of recovering these latent correspondences, showing tractable pairwise assignment but generally intractable multi-client hyperedge matching. Building on this characterization, we derive a cross-entropy decomposition that reveals when local prediction can outperform predictors fitted with additional cross-client information. Motivated by this principle, we introduce Federated Adaptive Spectral Training with Representation Alignment (FedASTRA), which learns correspondence-invariant diffusion representations through adaptive heat diffusion and masked latent prediction while communicating model parameters only. We establish its asymptotic optimality with respect to the permitted local information and prove global population-risk convergence under explicit conditions on recovery, representation, and update alignment. Experiments on eight real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedASTRA against identifier-free federated graph and hypergraph methods. On ogbn-papers100M, FedASTRA reaches the performance-communication Pareto frontier, achieving 50.07 Accuracy and 29.73 Macro-F1 while communicating only 59.60 MiB per round.

AI.tldr: 论文研究联邦超图学习中潜在跨客户端超边对应关系的可识别性与计算复杂性，提出FedASTRA方法，仅通过传输模型参数学习对应不变扩散表示，并在理论最优性与实验效率上取得优势。
AI.motivation: 同一本地超图发布可能对应多种全局超图结构，导致跨客户端超边对应关系潜在且难以识别；需要在可解性边界不清、且无法共享标识信息（identifier-free）的前提下，解决联邦超图表示学习问题。
AI.method: 首先刻画潜在对应关系的可追踪性：成对分配可解，而多客户端超边匹配一般不可解；据此推导交叉熵分解，揭示本地预测何时优于使用额外跨客户端信息的预测。提出FedASTRA，采用自适应热扩散与掩码潜在预测学习对应不变的扩散表示，每轮仅通信模型参数。
AI.result: 在允许的本地信息范围内证明其渐近最优性，并在恢复、表示与更新对齐的显式条件下证明全局总体风险收敛；在八个真实数据集上优于无标识联邦图与超图方法；在ogbn-papers100M上达到性能-通信Pareto前沿，50.07 Accuracy与29.73 Macro-F1，每轮通信仅59.60 MiB。
AI.conclusion: 联邦超图学习中的潜在超边对应关系在成对层面可处理、多客户端层面本质困难；FedASTRA通过对应不变表示学习与参数级通信，在理论上具备最优性与收敛保证，在实践中实现高效且具竞争力的性能-通信权衡。

title: Safe Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning: Zero Constraint Violation and Primal-Averaging Convergence
summary: Many applications of multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) require policies that balance conflicting objectives while satisfying safety constraints. We study safe MORL with zero constraint violation throughout learning, covering both cumulative and stepwise constraints. A key challenge is to explore sufficiently under unknown dynamics and constraint costs without violating the constraints. For a given preference over objectives, we develop an algorithm to learn a safe Pareto optimal policy by combining optimistic reward estimates with pessimistic cost bounds. With high probability, every policy executed over $T$ episodes incurs zero constraint violation. The algorithm returns a safe Markov policy induced by the averaged occupancy measure and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ suboptimality gap under smooth Tchebycheff scalarization. We further develop a preference-free algorithm that first explores safely without a prespecified preference and then computes a safe policy for any given preference without further interaction. Over $T$ exploration episodes and $K$ planning iterations, it retains the same safety guarantee and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T}+1/\sqrt{K})$ suboptimality gap. Both algorithms require knowledge of a policy that strictly satisfies the constraints and its costs. We then relax these requirements, incurring at most constant cumulative violation. To our knowledge, we provide the first sample-efficient MORL algorithms that guarantee safety for every executed policy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究零约束违背的安全多目标强化学习，提出乐观奖励+悲观代价的算法，在平滑Tchebycheff标量化下达到Õ(1/√T)次优间隙，并扩展至无偏好与弱化安全假设两种设定。
AI.motivation: MORL应用中需在满足安全约束的同时平衡冲突目标，而未知动力学与未知代价下的充分探索极易导致约束违背，现有方法缺乏对每条执行策略的安全性保证。
AI.method: 对给定偏好，将乐观奖励估计与悲观代价界结合，构建安全探索的MORL算法；证明每条执行策略零违背，返回由平均占用测度诱导的安全马尔可夫策略。进一步提出无偏好算法：先安全探索、后离线规划任意偏好。最后放松"已知严格可行策略及其代价"的假设，允许常数级累计违背。
AI.result: 偏好已知算法：T回合内以高概率零约束违背，次优间隙Õ(1/√T)。无偏好算法：T回合探索+K次规划，保持同等安全性，间隙Õ(1/√T+1/√K)。弱化假设版本累计违背仅为常数。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首批对每条执行策略均保证安全且样本高效的MORL算法，兼顾累积与逐步约束，并支持偏好无关的通用规划。

title: Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution of Policy and Rubric
summary: Rubric-based rewards provide fine-grained, interpretable supervision for open-ended reinforcement learning, where holistic scalar rewards struggle to capture multidimensional response quality. Static rubrics can lose discriminative power as the policy distribution evolves, while existing policy--rubric co-evolution methods rely on globally prescribed update schedules that ignore heterogeneous reward informativeness. We introduce RACE, a Reward-Adaptive Co-Evolution framework. At the group level, per-rollout-group training-signal routing classifies groups as informative, diversity-collapsed, or rubric-failed, updating the policy only with informative groups while caching rubric failures. At the phase level, event-triggered phase switching enters rubric optimization upon persistent reward saturation and returns when rubric-reward improvement plateaus. Rubric phases train the generator on cached pairs using a frozen judge and a scale-normalized pairwise-margin reward. Across both levels, online threshold adaptation adjusts routing and switching thresholds through proportional control. Under a unified evaluation protocol, RACE achieves the highest average performance and outperforms the strongest fixed-alternation baseline on all eight tasks, while improving rubric discrimination.

AI.tldr: RACE：一种奖励自适应协同进化框架，通过组级信号路由与事件触发阶段切换，动态决定策略更新与评分标准（rubric）优化时机，提升开放任务强化学习效果。
AI.motivation: 整体式标量奖励难以刻画多维响应质量，因而采用基于rubric的细粒度可解释奖励；但静态rubric随策略分布演化会丧失区分度，而现有策略—rubric协同进化方法依赖全局预设的更新调度，忽视各奖励信息的异质有效性。
AI.method: 提出RACE框架。组级：对每个 rollout 组进行训练信号路由，将组分类为信息有效、多样性坍缩或rubric失效，仅用有效组更新策略并缓存rubric失败样本。阶段级：采用事件触发的阶段切换，当奖励持续饱和时进入rubric优化阶段，当rubric—奖励提升趋于平台期时返回。rubric阶段在冻结评判器下，以尺度归一化的成对间隔奖励训练生成器。两级均通过比例控制在线自适应调整路由与切换阈值。
AI.result: 在统一评测协议下，RACE取得最高平均性能，在全部八项任务上均优于最强的固定交替基线，同时提升了rubric区分度。
AI.conclusion: 以信息有效性驱动的自适应路由与事件触发协同进化，可替代全局固定调度，在多任务上稳定优于固定交替策略，并改善rubric判别能力。

title: Dobb: Shard-Local Preconditioning in Block-Diagonal Eigenbases
summary: Training language models whose parameters and optimizer state exceed a single node's memory requires sharding these tensors across devices. Under tensor parallelism (TP) or fully sharded data parallelism (FSDP), matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon introduce communication to perform global matrix operations across shards. We propose Dobb (Distributed Optimizer with Block-diagonal Eigenbases), a matrix-aware optimizer designed to compute updates locally within parameter shards. Dobb approximates the input-activation second moment with diagonal blocks and tracks a complete basis within each block. It projects momentum into these bases, applies sign normalization to the coefficients, and reconstructs the update. When each block lies within one shard under TP or FSDP, Dobb applies its matrix update locally, requiring no communication beyond data-parallel synchronization of the activation second moments. We benchmark Dobb against Dion, a distributed matrix-aware optimizer designed to retain the benefits of orthonormalized updates while reducing communication. On GPT-2 XL (1.56B parameters), Dobb with 16 blocks reaches a validation loss of 2.476, compared with 2.511 for Dion at rank fraction 1/16. Under FSDP on 32 H100 GPUs, Dobb reduces the amortized optimizer-call time from 124.1 ms for Dion to 9.2 ms.

AI.tldr: Dobb是一种分块对角特征基分布式矩阵感知优化器，将矩阵更新限制在参数分片内本地完成，在GPT-2 XL上取得更低验证损失，并将FSDP下的优化器调用时间从124.1 ms降至9.2 ms。
AI.motivation: 当参数与优化器状态超出单节点内存时，需在TP/FSDP下跨设备分片；Muon等矩阵感知优化器需在分片上执行全局矩阵运算，因而引入额外通信开销。
AI.method: 用分块对角矩阵近似输入激活二阶矩，在每个块内跟踪完整特征基，将动量投影到该基上，对系数做符号归一化后重构更新。当每个块位于单个分片内时，更新可完全本地化，除激活二阶矩的数据并行同步外无需额外通信。
AI.result: 与Dion对比：GPT-2 XL（1.56B）上16块配置验证损失2.476（Dion为2.511，秩比例1/16）；FSDP + 32×H100下摊销优化器调用时间由124.1 ms降至9.2 ms。
AI.conclusion: 分块对角特征基近似可在保持矩阵感知更新收益的同时消除跨分片通信，显著提升分布式训练效率并改善收敛质量。

title: DynaRev: Benchmarking Web Agents under Dynamic Goal Revision
summary: Web agents are typically evaluated with goals fully specified before execution and fixed thereafter, whereas real users often revise their requirements during interaction. To study such interactions, we introduce DynaRev, a benchmark of 181 tasks to evaluate web agents under dynamic goal revision. DynaRev uses semantic milestones to deliver revisions at task-defined stages, covers additive revisions, unconditional overrides, and runtime-conditioned overrides, and evaluates correctness, responsiveness, and efficiency through trajectory-grounded evaluation. Five-model evaluations show that agents often satisfy only part of the task requirements, with performance varying across task sources, revision types, and models. Further analyses reveal varied milestone timing, mixed effects of dynamic delivery, and contrasting revision-handling outcomes, with gains from instruction rewriting while preserving browser state and losses from browser resets. DynaRev provides a testbed for studying how web agents adapt to evolving user goals. The code and data are available at https://github.com/zsq259/DynaRev.

AI.tldr: 提出DynaRev基准，含181个任务，用于评测Web智能体在动态目标修订下的表现，通过语义里程碑在任务定义阶段投递修订，覆盖可加式修订、无条件覆盖与运行时条件覆盖，并从正确性、响应性、效率三维度进行轨迹级评测。对五个模型的评测显示智能体常仅满足部分需求，性能随任务来源、修订类型与模型而变。
AI.motivation: 现有Web智能体评测通常在执行前将目标完全指定且此后固定不变，而真实用户常在交互过程中修改需求，二者存在明显落差，缺乏研究此类交互的基准。
AI.method: 构建DynaRev基准，包含181个任务；采用语义里程碑机制，在任务定义的阶段投递目标修订；修订类型涵盖可加式修订、无条件覆盖、运行时条件覆盖；采用基于轨迹的评测，衡量正确性、响应性与效率；对五个模型进行评测及进一步分析（里程碑时机、动态投递效果、修订处理结果）。
AI.result: 五模型评测显示智能体通常只满足任务需求的一部分，性能在任务来源、修订类型和模型之间存在差异；分析发现里程碑触发时机存在变化、动态投递效果不一、修订处理结果呈对比态势；在保留浏览器状态下重写指令可带来收益，而重置浏览器则造成性能损失。
AI.conclusion: DynaRev为研究Web智能体如何适应用户目标演化提供了测试平台，代码与数据已开源。

title: Accuracy is not compatibility: two Evo 2 checkpoints hinge on one FP8 matrix multiplication
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23740390 ; code: https://github.com/astding/mmaemu
summary: FP8 formats specify how values are stored, not how products are summed; this gap can break checkpoints. Evo 2, a DNA language model, documents a Hopper FP8 requirement for its 1B and 40B checkpoints. On two Blackwell (sm_120) GPUs both fail the developers' forward test (the 7B passes); on an RTX 5070 Ti the 40B's next-base accuracy is 25.7%, near guessing. Greater accuracy breaks them, as BioNeMo saw for the 40B on Hopper: natively, 99.996% of one projection's outputs are correctly rounded (H100: about 30%), and fp32 accumulation of the same operands fails. Our H100 FP8 GEMM emulator, mmaemu (bit-exact on captured 1B projections), localises the dependence to the 1B's first projection (of 21), where exact sums fail but pass when shrunk by the H100's 1.4% (measured in-sample), not 2.1%. The 40B fails with only its first projection native. Emulating only that projection, weights unchanged, raises 40B BRCA1 variant-classification AUROC from 0.434 to 0.869 (H100: 0.868) on the RTX 5070 Ti, despite a narrow forward-test miss, and 0.481 to 0.867 on an RTX PRO 6000. We tested one model family but not training origin; releases should specify reference arithmetic.

AI.tldr: The paper shows that FP8 checkpoints of Evo 2 depend not just on storage format but on the specific FP8 accumulation arithmetic of the reference hardware; a bit-exact H100 FP8 GEMM emulator (mmaemu) localises this dependence to a single projection, and emulating only that projection restores accuracy on Blackwell GPUs.
AI.motivation: FP8 formats only specify how values are stored, not how products are summed, so the same checkpoint can behave differently across GPU generations. Evo 2's 1B and 40B checkpoints require Hopper FP8; on Blackwell (sm_120) they fail the developers' forward test and, for the 40B, next-base accuracy collapses to near guessing. The authors aim to explain and remedy this hardware-dependent checkpoint fragility.
AI.method: The authors build mmaemu, an H100 FP8 GEMM emulator that is bit-exact on captured 1B projections, and use it to localise which projections depend on reference arithmetic. They compare exact-fp32 accumulation against the H100's measured 1.4% shrunken accumulation, and test both forwards and a downstream BRCA1 variant-classification task (AUROC) on RTX 5070 Ti and RTX PRO 6000.
AI.result: Greater accuracy breaks the checkpoints: natively 99.996% of one projection's outputs are correctly rounded (H100 ~30%), while fp32 accumulation of the same operands fails. The dependence localises to the 1B's first of 21 projections, where exact sums fail but pass when shrunk by the H100's 1.4% (not 2.1%). The 40B fails with only its first projection native. Emulating only that projection with unchanged weights raises 40B BRCA1 AUROC from 0.434 to 0.869 (H100: 0.868) on RTX 5070 Ti, and 0.481 to 0.867 on RTX PRO 6000, despite a narrow forward-test miss.
AI.conclusion: The checkpoints are tied to a specific reference FP8 accumulation arithmetic, not just FP8 storage, and this can be localised and emulated with a single projection to recover accuracy on non-Hopper hardware. The authors tested only one model family and not training origin, and recommend that FP8 releases specify reference arithmetic.

title: The generative paradox: the Anti-Prompt paradigm for human capability
summary: Generative AI in education is usually judged by the output of human-AI teams. That focus overlooks a second outcome: what people can still understand, challenge, repair, and adapt when assistance changes or disappears. We call this tension the generative paradox and distinguish four manifestations: performance, assistance, ownership, and capability stock. We propose developmental function allocation, which complements operational function allocation and meaningful human control by treating retained human capability as a design objective alongside current joint performance. The Anti-Prompt paradigm reverses the default interaction order: when immediate generation would preempt a consequential human act, AI should first create the conditions for human construction. We distinguish the validity of a product, responsibility for its construction, and evidence of capability after support changes. Representative Anti-Prompts, a canonical interaction sequence, and stress tests spanning mathematical reasoning, experimental science, software diagnosis, and lesson design make these distinctions concrete. We conclude with falsifiable predictions about retained capability and a system-level hypothesis about the reproduction and distribution of expertise.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"生成悖论"并区分其四种表现，倡导将"保留的人类能力"作为设计目标，提出发展性功能分配与"反提示"（Anti-Prompt）范式。
AI.motivation: 当前对教育中生成式AI的评价主要看人机团队产出（performance），忽视了辅助变化或消失后人类是否仍能理解、质疑、修复与适应，这一被忽视的"第二结果"构成核心张力。
AI.method: 概念分析与框架构建：区分生成悖论的四种表现（绩效、辅助依赖、所有权、能力存量）；提出"发展性功能分配"，与操作性功能分配和有意义的人类控制互补，将保留的人类能力视为设计目标；提出"反提示"范式，逆转默认交互顺序——当即时生成会抢占关键人类行为时，AI应先创造人类自主建构的条件；区分产品有效性、建构责任与支持变化后能力的证据；并给出代表性反提示、规范交互序列与跨领域压力测试。
AI.result: 以数学推理、实验科学、软件诊断与教学设计四类压力测试具体化上述区分，展示框架如何落地。
AI.conclusion: 提出关于能力保留的可证伪预测，以及关于专业知识再生产与分布的系统层面假设；主张在设计阶段将保留的人类能力与当前联合绩效并列考量。

title: LinQuant: Functional Invariances for Low-Precision Linear Recurrences
summary: Linear recurrences are emerging as practical alternatives to softmax attention in large language models, appearing in both standalone and hybrid architectures. However, despite their rapid emergence, low-precision inference remains much less developed for these models than for softmax attention. During prefill, chunkwise-parallel algorithms cast much of the recurrence as dense matrix multiplications, suggesting a natural path to low-precision execution. Simply quantizing these operations in their native form, however, can be fragile. In this work, we identify functional invariances that preserve the full-precision computation while making the operands more amenable to quantization. Building on this observation, we introduce LinQuant, a framework for low-precision recurrent prefill based on seven such invariances, including rotations, diagonal rescalings, and alternative placements of recurrent decay and write factors. We derive when these transformations remain valid across common recurrence families spanning linear, gated, and delta-rule updates, and show that they provide complementary degrees of freedom for improving low-precision accuracy. Finally, we translate this framework to production by augmenting SSDi8, an existing low-precision prefill pipeline for Mamba-2, with the applicable invariances. LinQuant improves perplexity at matched latency on Mamba-2 1.3B, 2.7B, and 8B and Nemotron-H 8B, demonstrating the practical utility of invariance-based quantization for recurrent models.

AI.tldr: LinQuant提出基于七种"功能不变性"（旋转、对角重缩放、循环衰减与写因子的替代放置等）的低精度线性循环模型prefill量化框架，在保持全精度计算等价的前提下提升操作数可量化性，并集成到Mamba-2的SSDi8流水线中。
AI.motivation: 线性循环正成为softmax注意力的实用替代方案（独立或混合架构），但其低精度推理发展远落后于softmax注意力。分块并行（chunkwise-parallel）prefill将循环大量转化为稠密矩阵乘法，看似天然适合低精度执行，但直接对原生形式量化较为脆弱、精度不稳。
AI.method: 识别在保持全精度计算结果不变的同时使操作数更易量化的"功能不变性"，构建LinQuant框架，涵盖七种不变性：旋转、对角重缩放、循环衰减与写因子的替代放置等。推导这些变换在线性、门控、delta-rule等常见循环族中保持有效的条件，并说明其提供互补自由度以改善低精度精度。最后将适用的不变性嵌入现有Mamba-2低精度prefill流水线SSDi8。
AI.result: 在等延迟条件下，LinQuant在Mamba-2 1.3B、2.7B、8B以及Nemotron-H 8B上均降低了困惑度（perplexity）。
AI.conclusion: 基于不变性的量化对循环模型具有实际效用；功能不变性为低精度循环prefill提供了系统化、可跨循环族迁移的量化设计空间，并可直接落地到生产流水线。

title: Softmax Routing Dynamics in Mixture-of-Experts Models: Collapse and Recovery
summary: Softmax routing in mixture-of-experts models can concentrate probability on a subset of experts, suppressing access to the others. We study how this concentration forms, why it persists, and how suppressed probabilities recover. For fixed experts, a stationary-loss barrier identifies the face supporting the optimal routed output. In a common-target square-loss model with freely trainable expert outputs, slow adaptation tracks fixed-expert dynamics on finite horizons, while every fixed positive adaptation rate yields an interior routing limit. An exact normal-velocity decomposition separates complementary-expert covariance from relative gradient advantage. Under positive two-sided power bounds along recovery paths, uniform over initial masses, the resulting coefficient's order of vanishing gives logarithmic or power-law recovery times. Integrations of constructed fields reproduce these orders. An exact discrete log-odds identity relates neural updates to threshold crossing. In paired Transformer-MoE training, removing a class-conditional router-gradient contrast delays confirmed recovery and reduces accumulated log-odds on fixed tokens, both with and without capacity constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究MoE中Softmax路由的概率集中如何形成、为何持续以及被抑制概率如何恢复：用固定专家下的stationary-loss障碍刻画最优路由输出支撑面，在公共目标平方损失下证明慢适应在有限时域跟踪固定专家动力学、每个正适应率给出内部路由极限，并通过法向速度分解与对数几率恒等式给出对数或幂律恢复时间，实验验证了路由梯度对比的去除会延迟恢复。
AI.motivation: Softmax路由易把概率集中到少数专家，抑制其他专家；但其集中机制、持续原因与概率恢复规律缺乏理论刻画。
AI.method: 固定专家下用stationary-loss barrier识别支撑最优路由输出的面；在公共目标平方损失、专家输出可训练模型中分析慢适应与内部路由极限；提出精确的法向速度分解，分离互补专家协方差与相对梯度优势；在正的双侧幂界下按初始质量一致地推导系数消失阶；用构造场的积分复现这些阶；给出精确离散对数几率恒等式联系神经更新与阈值穿越；在配对Transformer-MoE训练中做路由梯度对比消融。
AI.result: 慢适应在有限时域上跟踪固定专家动力学，且每个正适应率都导致内部路由极限；恢复时间呈对数或幂律阶，与构造场积分结果一致；去除类条件路由梯度对比会延迟确认恢复，并降低固定token上的累积对数几率，在有/无容量约束下均成立。
AI.conclusion: 路由集中的持续源于损失面的障碍与梯度优势结构，恢复速率可由解析系数阶预测；路由梯度中的类条件对比对恢复至关重要。

title: Locating and Closing Information Gaps in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-step Web tasks often require several LLM agents to gather and combine evidence. The communication graph of a fixed workflow restricts which agents can read each other's outputs: evidence retrieved by one agent may never reach the agent that needs it, leaving an information gap and an incomplete or incorrect answer. Adding a connection can deliver the missing evidence, but can also lead the receiver to adopt an incorrect upstream conclusion that displaces a correct answer; the final output alone does not separate the two. We propose Selective Probing and Link Insertion for Closing information gaps in multi-agent Execution (SPLICE), which locates information gaps per query and decides what to adopt after adding an edge. After the original workflow runs, SPLICE uses the query and node outputs to locate a possible gap, adds one directed edge from a source to a receiver to deliver the relevant evidence, and re-executes the receiver and affected downstream nodes, producing a candidate answer. The adoption decision reads both the final answers of the two runs and the process changes the edit caused inside the workflow: how far the receiver moved, where its new content came from, and whether the change reached the final answer. A selector trained on these process features chooses between adopting the candidate answer and retaining the original. On five benchmarks, SPLICE raises the task score on Web tool use by 8.0% and the mean score on four reasoning and planning benchmarks by 5.7% relative to the static skeleton, at 1.25 to 1.44$\times$ the skeleton's cost, and transfers zero-shot to four unseen backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出SPLICE：定位多智能体多步Web任务中的信息缺口，通过选择性探测与单条有向边插入补足证据，并基于"过程特征"训练选择器决定是否采纳重执行结果，在五个基准上提升任务分数且零样本迁移到四个未见骨干模型。
AI.motivation: 固定工作流的通信图限制了智能体之间可读取的输出来源，某个智能体检索到的证据可能永远无法到达真正需要它的节点，造成信息缺口与不完整/错误的答案。而简单增加连接虽能传递缺失证据，也可能让接收方采纳错误的上游结论、从而覆盖原本正确的答案；仅凭最终输出无法区分这两种情形。
AI.method: 1）先运行原始工作流；2）利用查询与各节点输出定位可能的信息缺口；3）插入一条从源到接收方的有向边以传递相关证据，并重执行该接收方及其受影响的下游节点，得到候选答案；4）采纳决策不只看两次运行的最终答案，还看编辑引起的工作流内部过程变化——接收方偏移程度、新内容来源、变化是否传导至最终答案；5）在这些过程特征上训练选择器，在采纳候选答案与保留原答案之间取舍。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，相对静态骨架（static skeleton）：Web工具使用任务分数提升8.0%，四个推理与规划基准平均提升5.7%；成本为骨架的1.25–1.44倍；并可零样本迁移到四个未见骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体工作流中的信息缺口可被按查询定位并以单条边最小化修复；将"采纳决策"建立在过程级可观测信号而非仅最终答案上，能有效避免引入错误上游结论，从而在有限成本开销下稳定提升多步Web任务性能并具备良好迁移性。

title: End-to-End Guarantees for Masked Diffusion Models under Conditional Mixing
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Diffusion Language Models: Foundations, Efficiency, and Reasoning (DiffuLM). 26 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables
summary: Masked diffusion models train a denoiser on masked cross-entropy and generate by unmasking many positions in parallel. Existing MDM sampling bounds assume an exact denoiser or leave its error uncontrolled while training bounds cover only the masking distribution on which the model was trained. We present an end-to-end guarantee for a learned denoiser under conditional mixing (CM): stationary sources (e.g. floored order-$r$ Markov and two-sided-Doeblin hidden-Markov sources) for which revealing distant visible tokens moves a masked token's posterior on average exponentially little in the distance with correlation length $τ_c$. We show the empirical risk minimizer trained under any masking distribution attains per-token excess $\varepsilon'$ on that distribution from $\varepsilon'^{-\mathcal{O}(τ_c\log|\mathcal{V}|)}$ training sequences, independent of sequence length $N$ -- one sample budget serves every decoding schedule when each schedule's denoiser is trained under its own weighting. We further show that the exponent's order $Θ(τ_c\log|\mathcal{V}|)$ is minimax-optimal up to constants; more efficient rates require added structure. With this, we bound the end-to-end KL as $\mathrm{KL}(π\Vert p_{\mathrm{alg}})\leq \varepsilon+N\varepsilon'$ under a dilated schedule of $T=\mathcal{O}(τ_c\log(N|\mathcal{V}|/\varepsilon))$ denoising steps versus $Ω(N)$ steps for a fixed random order on an explicit CM source. Finally, we show that block-autoregressive samplers chain across blocks with no added error and that a $Λ$-looped order-$r$ message-passing class on order-$r$ sources achieves polynomial sample complexity, with approximation error improving per loop until saturation at $Λr\approx τ_c\log(1/\varepsilon')$. Experiments on released and retrained models support our results' qualitative predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文为学习式去噪器下的掩码扩散模型（MDM）给出端到端采样-训练联合保证：在条件混合（CM）源上，基于经验的ERM去噪器仅需 ε'^{-O(τ_c log|V|)} 条训练序列（与序列长度 N 无关），可将端到端 KL 控制为 ε+Nε'，并证明该指数率在常数意义下 minimax 最优。
AI.motivation: 现有 MDM 采样界的不足：要么假设去噪器精确，要么对其误差不加控制；而训练界只覆盖训练时所用的掩码分布，无法保证在其他解码调度下的表现。作者希望打通"训练误差—采样调度—端到端分布误差"之间的缺口，并厘清样本复杂度与相关长度 τ_c、词表大小 |V| 的依赖是否为最优。
AI.method: 1) 定义条件混合（CM）源：平稳源，揭示远处可见 token 对掩码 token 后验的平均影响随距离指数衰减，相关长度 τ_c（涵盖 floored order-r 马尔可夫源与 two-sided-Doeblin 隐马尔可夫源）。2) 在任意掩码分布下分析经验风险最小化器（ERM）的 per-token 超额风险 ε'。3) 证明样本复杂度 ε'^{-Θ(τ_c log|V|)} 的 minimax 最优性。4) 在稀释（dilated）调度下 T=O(τ_c log(N|V|/ε)) 步推导端到端 KL ≤ ε+Nε'。5) 分析块自回归采样器的误差链式传播，以及 Λ-loop order-r 消息传递类的近似误差随循环衰减至饱和 Λr≈τ_c log(1/ε')。
AI.result: 1) ERM 在训练掩码分布上达到 per-token 超额 ε' 需 ε'^{-O(τ_c log|V|)} 条序列，与 N 无关；同一批样本可为每个解码调度（各自加权训练）复用。2) 指数阶 Θ(τ_c log|V|) 在常数意义下 minimax 最优，进一步改进需额外结构假设。3) 稀释调度下 KL(π‖p_alg) ≤ ε+Nε'，步数 T=O(τ_c log(N|V|/ε))，而在显式 CM 源上固定随机顺序需 Ω(N) 步。4) 块自回归采样器跨块链式传播无额外误差引入。5) Λ-loop order-r 消息传递类在 order-r 源上具多项式样本复杂度，近似误差逐循环下降并在 Λr≈τ_c log(1/ε') 处饱和。6) 已发布与重训练模型的实验支持上述定性预测。
AI.conclusion: 论文将 MDM 的训练误差、采样调度与端到端分布误差统一到一个可解的框架中：CM 条件下学习式去噪器的样本复杂度可精确刻画且 minimax 最优，稀释调度相较固定随机顺序在步数上有指数级优势，块自回归与循环消息传递结构能进一步降低误差。整体结论强调"更高效率需额外结构"这一权衡，并由实验定性验证。

title: Bridging Semantics and Structure: A Theoretically Grounded Framework for Link Prediction on TAGs
comment: 33 pages. Accepted for publication in ACM Transactions on Knowledge Discovery from Data (TKDD)
summary: Link prediction on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) is a fundamental problem with applications in knowledge discovery, recommendation and beyond. Recent progress has highlighted the promise of combining Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Language Models (LMs) in order to leverage the complementary structural and semantic signals. However, due to the distinct inductive biases of GNNs and LMs, the design of an optimal fusion strategy remains an open research question. In this work, we present Bridge-LP, an intuitive, simple, efficient and theoretically grounded framework that unifies graph and language representations. It is built around three theoretically-justified design components: (D1) jumping connection of textual proximity, which enables robust LM training; (D2) compressed embedding, which encodes neighborhood information long exploited by classical link prediction heuristics, thereby enriching structural signals in a learnable way; and (D3) cache embedding training strategy, which reduces computational complexity. Together, these mechanisms establish an end-to-end cross-modal framework that scales to large graphs while capturing richer graph-text interactions. We conduct an extensive empirical evaluation, comparing against 40 existing models across 9 diverse datasets. Experiments show that Bridge-LP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, delivering up to a 43.06% improvement in Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) and setting a new benchmark for language-graph integration.

AI.tldr: 提出 Bridge-LP，一个统一图与语言表示、可扩展至大图的端到端跨模态链接预测框架，由三个理论支撑的设计组件构成，在 9 个数据集上对比 40 个模型，MRR 最高提升 43.06%。
AI.motivation: 文本属性图（TAG）上的链接预测是知识发现、推荐等任务的基础问题。结合 GNN 与 LM 可同时利用结构与语义信号，但二者归纳偏置不同，最优融合策略仍是开放问题。
AI.method: Bridge-LP 框架包含三个理论论证的设计组件：(D1) 文本邻近性的跳跃连接，实现稳健的 LM 训练；(D2) 压缩嵌入，以可学习方式编码经典链接预测启发式所利用的邻域信息；(D3) 缓存嵌入训练策略，降低计算复杂度。三者共同构成端到端跨模态框架。
AI.result: 在 9 个多样化数据集上与 40 个现有模型对比，Bridge-LP 持续优于 SOTA，MRR 最高提升 43.06%，为语言-图融合树立新基准。
AI.conclusion: Bridge-LP 提供了一种直观、简单、高效且理论可解释的图-语言表示统一方案，在扩展到大规模图的同时捕捉更丰富的图文交互，验证了其融合设计的有效性。

title: Smooth Action Chunking Via Movement-Primitive Representations for Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation learning has become a widely adopted approach for vision-based robot policies, owing to its conceptual simplicity, scalability, and ability to leverage large-scale datasets. As these policies have grown more capable, action chunking has become their standard interface. At each decision step the policy outputs several future actions at once. Backbones from diffusion policies to large vision-language-action models all share it. Whatever backbone produces the chunk, its temporal structure is learned only implicitly. The commanded trajectory is therefore jerky both within a chunk and between successive chunks. On real hardware this appears as visible vibration and as repeated saturation of the follower's velocity limit. We address this issue by incorporating a movement-primitive-based trajectory representation into action chunking. Specifically, a trajectory segment is represented as a linear combination of smooth basis functions, yielding smooth trajectories by construction while leaving the policy architecture, training objective, and inference procedure unchanged. The same representation also yields a closed-form, inference-time correction for the second source of jerk. We condition the predicted coefficients so that the new chunk passes through a via-point at the previous chunk's last commanded action. This correction needs no retraining and, unlike asynchronous Real-Time Chunking, applies to policies queried in one shot. We instantiate it on a one-shot (ACT) and an iterative (DiT) backbone and evaluate in simulation and on a real bimanual ALOHA platform. The representation lowers within-chunk jerk by an order of magnitude on the one-shot backbone and by 2.4 times on the iterative one, with task success statistically non-inferior. The conditioning then removes 73-84% of the boundary discontinuity, at negligible per-step cost.

AI.tldr: 将基于运动基元的轨迹表示引入动作分块（action chunking）：用光滑基函数线性组合参数化轨迹段，天然生成光滑轨迹；并对相邻块边界不连续给出闭式、推理时的via-point条件修正，无需重训练。在ACT与DiT骨干、仿真与真实双臂ALOHA上验证：块内jerk降低一个数量级（ACT）与2.4倍（DiT），边界不连续减少73–84%，任务成功率统计上非劣。
AI.motivation: 模仿学习中action chunking已成标准接口（diffusion policy到大型VLA均采用），但块内时间结构仅被隐式学习，导致块内与块间轨迹抖动；在真实硬件上表现为可见振动与从动端速度限反复饱和。
AI.method: 以运动基元思想，将轨迹段表示为光滑基函数的线性组合，构造性保证光滑，同时不改变策略架构、训练目标与推理流程；对块间抖动来源，在推理时对预测系数做闭式条件化，使新块的起点通过上一块最后指令动作的via-point；无需重训练，且适用于一次性查询的策略（区别于异步Real-Time Chunking）。实例化于一次性骨干ACT与迭代骨干DiT。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实双臂ALOHA平台上：块内jerk在一次性骨干上降低一个数量级，在迭代骨干上降低2.4倍，任务成功率统计上非劣；via-point条件化解除了73–84%的边界不连续，每步开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入光滑轨迹表示可有效抑制action chunking的块内与块间抖动，且以极低代价兼容现有骨干与推理范式，具备良好通用性与部署价值。

title: EpiAgent: Epistemic Self-Play for LLM Agents
summary: Epistemic game theory explains an agent's strategic behavior via the beliefs it holds about others and how these beliefs are updated as the interactions unfold. Modern LLM-based agents, however, often lack an explicit mechanism for learning and updating such beliefs to guide decisions under incomplete information. To bridge this gap, we propose EpiAgent, a framework that equips LLM-based agents with an explicit, learnable epistemic layer, which maintains beliefs over others' private information and combines these beliefs with the agent's available information into an epistemic state for action selection. Concretely, the agent's policy is decomposed into two coupled stages: Epistemic Update, which updates these beliefs from interaction histories, and Action Planning, which selects actions conditioned on the updated epistemic state. By formulating their dependency as a bi-level optimization problem, we introduce Epistemic Self-Play, an algorithm that alternately optimizes the two stages through self-play, utilizing an intrinsic prediction reward to evaluate how well inferred beliefs predict subsequent observations. Empirical results across both mixed and competitive scenarios show that EpiAgent consistently outperforms prompting-based and RL-based baselines. Further analyses reveal the benefits of dedicated epistemic training, improvements in belief inference accuracy, and the contribution of learned beliefs to action planning. These results demonstrate the value of an explicit, learnable epistemic layer for effective multi-agent interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出EpiAgent框架，为LLM智能体引入显式可学习的认知（epistemic）层，维持并更新关于他人私有信息的信念，通过双层优化与"认知自博弈"交替训练信念更新与动作规划，在混合与竞争场景中超越提示与RL基线。
AI.motivation: 认知博弈论通过智能体对他人持有的信念及其随交互更新的方式来解释策略行为；而现代基于LLM的智能体普遍缺乏在不完全信息下学习、更新此类信念以指导决策的显式机制。
AI.method: 将策略分解为两个耦合阶段：认知更新（Epistemic Update，从交互历史更新对他人私有信息的信念）与动作规划（Action Planning，基于更新后的认知状态选择动作）；将二者依赖建模为双层优化问题，提出认知自博弈（Epistemic Self-Play）算法，通过自博弈交替优化两阶段，并用内在预测奖励评估推断信念对后续观测的预测能力。
AI.result: 在混合与竞争场景中，EpiAgent持续优于基于提示（prompting-based）和基于强化学习（RL-based）的基线；进一步分析显示专用认知训练带来收益、信念推断准确率提升，且学习到的信念对动作规划有实质贡献。
AI.conclusion: 显式、可学习的认知层对有效的多智能体交互具有重要价值，为LLM智能体在不完全信息博弈中的信念建模提供了可行范式。

title: Sparse Fine-Tuning for Parameter-Efficient Adversarial Training
summary: Deep neural networks achieve strong performance across many tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Adversarial training (AT) is one of the most effective defenses, yet it suffers from high memory cost on large models and the persistent clean-robust accuracy trade-off. Recent work introduces parameter-efficient fine-tuning, such as LoRA, into AT, but this constraint induces a notable robustness gap relative to full-parameter AT. In this work, we revisit parameter-efficient adversarial fine-tuning from a parameter space perspective. Through gradient analysis, we find that adversarial optimization is highly concentrated on a small subset of parameters, which we call Robustness-Critical Parameters (RCPs), suggesting that robustness is encoded in a sparse subspace. Building on this observation, we propose Sparse Adversarial Fine-Tuning (SAFT), which identifies RCPs via adversarial gradient saliency and performs AT by updating only these parameters while freezing the rest. Across architectures and datasets, SAFT outperforms LoRA-based methods in both clean and robust accuracy with fewer trainable parameters, and approaches or surpasses full parameter AT in robustness while updating only about 5\% of parameters.

AI.tldr: 该论文从参数空间视角重新审视参数高效对抗微调，发现对抗优化高度集中于少量"鲁棒性关键参数"（RCPs），据此提出SAFT方法，仅更新约5%的参数即可在干净与鲁棒精度上优于LoRA类方法，并接近甚至超越全参数对抗训练。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练（AT）虽有效但存在大模型显存开销大和干净-鲁棒精度权衡问题；将LoRA等参数高效微调引入AT虽降低成本，却相比全参数AT产生明显的鲁棒性差距。
AI.method: 通过梯度分析发现对抗优化高度集中于小部分参数（鲁棒性关键参数RCPs），表明鲁棒性编码在稀疏子空间中。据此提出稀疏对抗微调（SAFT）：基于对抗梯度显著性识别RCPs，仅更新这些参数并冻结其余参数进行对抗训练。
AI.result: 在多种架构与数据集上，SAFT以更少可训练参数在干净精度和鲁棒精度上均优于基于LoRA的方法；仅更新约5%参数即可接近或超越全参数AT的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 对抗鲁棒性可由稀疏参数子空间承载，基于梯度显著性选择RCPs的稀疏对抗微调为高效对抗训练提供了优于LoRA的有效方案。

title: EnvOS: Auditing Computer-Use Agents When the World Moves On : Phenomenon-Based Task Construction, Certification, and Evidence-Based Evaluation
comment: 74 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshops (AABA4ET and CL4FMAgents)
summary: Computer-use agents built on large language models (LLMs) work in software that can change while they act: an appointment moves, a policy is revised, a record is updated. Testing agents under such changes is harder than it looks. When an agent fails, the cause may be the agent, but it may also be a change that did not fire as intended, an update the agent never received, or a grader that scored the episode wrongly. We introduce EnvOS, a framework for building and certifying environments that change mid-task. Before any agent runs, EnvOS checks that each change fires correctly, that the task remains solvable, and that the grader separates correct from incorrect behavior; after each run, separate code re-checks the verdict from archived evidence. We apply it to stale information, where a value the agent has already seen changes before the agent acts on it. In clinic booking, Claude Opus 5 succeeds on 0/16 tasks when nothing extra is shown, 2/16 when reminded to re-check the source, and 15/16 when the updated value is shown; the gain over the reminder holds after correcting for all tests (p = 0.00293). In insurance-claim approval, Opus 5 re-checks on its own and succeeds on 10/10, whereas Claude Sonnet 5 rises from 1/10 to 9/10 when the current policy is shown again, a gain significant in its pre-registered test but not after correcting for all tests. Whether an agent caught a change thus varied with the model and the interface. We also stress-test the grading itself: on corrupted episodes designed blind from the rules, the EnvOS pipeline accepted none of 26 as clean, and on an externally generated set it caught 25 of 39, against 4 for simple log checks. Because every EnvOS environment is generated from a seed and graded by an audited automatic verifier, the same environments are natural candidates for training agents with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards.

AI.tldr: EnvOS 是一个用于构建与"认证"任务中途可变环境的框架，在智能体运行前验证变更正确触发、任务仍可解、评分器能区分对错，运行后由独立代码依据归档证据复核判定；在"陈旧信息"场景中它揭示了智能体对界面变更的敏感度因模型而异，并证明其评分流程可有效剔除被污染 episode。
AI.motivation: LLM 计算机使用智能体运行于会变化的环境中，失败原因难以归因：可能源于智能体本身，也可能源于变更未按预期触发、变更未传递给智能体、或评分器误判。因此需要一个能保证环境变更与评分可信度的构建与认证框架。
AI.method: 提出 EnvOS 框架：运行前执行三项校验（变更正确触发、任务在变更后仍可解、评分器能区分正确与错误行为）；运行后由独立代码基于归档证据复审判定。将其应用于"陈旧信息"任务（智能体已见到的值在其行动前发生变化），覆盖诊所预约与保险理赔审批两类场景，并对模型 × 界面提示多做比较，采用多重检验校正。同时对评分环节做压力测试：用规则盲设计的损坏 episode 检验流水线能否拒收不洁样本，并与简单日志检查对比。
AI.result: 诊所预约：Claude Opus 5 在无额外提示时 0/16 成功，提示重新核查来源后 2/16，直接展示更新值后 15/16，且该提升在多重检验校正后仍显著（p = 0.00293）。保险理赔：Opus 5 自主复查，10/10 成功；Claude Sonnet 5 展示当前策略后由 1/10 升至 9/10，仅在预注册检验中显著，校正后不显著。评分压力测试：26 个损坏 episode 流水线全部拒收（0 个被误判为干净）；外部生成集合中捕获 25/39，而简单日志检查仅捕获 4/39。
AI.conclusion: 智能体能否察觉环境变更取决于模型与界面设计，单一提醒不足以普遍奏效；EnvOS 的自动审计评分显著优于简单日志检查。由于环境由种子生成并由受审计的自动验证器评分，同一批环境天然适合用于基于可验证奖励的强化学习训练。

title: Achieving Minimax-Optimal First-Order and Best-of-Both-Worlds Regret Simultaneously in Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: We study first-order and best-of-both-worlds regret guarantees in multi-armed bandits. Pogodin and Lattimore (2019) proposed an algorithm that combines minimax-optimal worst-case regret with a first-order guarantee whose loss-dependent term is $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{K L^\star}\log T)$, where $T$ denotes the horizon, $L^\star$ denotes the smallest expected cumulative loss among fixed arms, and $K$ denotes the number of arms. However, a logarithmic gap remains between this loss-dependent term and the optimal first-order scale. In this paper, we remove this logarithmic factor by proposing an efficient and parameter-free algorithm that achieves the minimax optimal first-order regret guarantee $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{K L^\star})$. Technically, our algorithm is built upon FTRL with a Tsallis entropy regularizer (Zimmert and Seldin,2021), with a learning rate adapted to the learner's cumulative loss and a sampling distribution determined by a scalar fixed point. This construction controls the combined estimation and stability cost in terms of the learner's loss. Moreover, we show that the same algorithm achieves a best-of-both-worlds guarantee, with $\mathcal{O}(\sum_{i\ne i^\star}\frac{\log T}{Δ_i})$ regret for i.i.d. losses with a unique best arm $i^\star$, where $Δ_i$ denotes the suboptimality gap of arm $i$.

AI.tldr: 本文去除了Pogodin与Lattimore (2019)算法中损失相关项与最优一阶尺度之间的对数间隙，提出高效、免参数算法，同时达到极小极大最优的一阶遗憾 $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{KL^\star})$ 与最优-最坏世界（BOBW）保证 $\mathcal{O}(\sum_{i\ne i^\star}\log T/\Delta_i)$。
AI.motivation: 已有工作（Pogodin & Lattimore, 2019）虽将极小极大最优最坏情形遗憾与一阶保证结合，但其损失相关项为 $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{KL^\star}\log T)$，与最优一阶尺度 $\sqrt{KL^\star}$ 之间仍存在对数间隙；本文旨在消除该间隙。
AI.method: 基于带 Tsallis 熵正则项的 FTRL（Zimmert & Seldin, 2021）：学习率依学习者的累积损失自适应调整，采样分布由一个标量不动点确定；该构造以学习者损失控制估计成本与稳定性成本的合成量，且算法高效、免参数。
AI.result: 实现极小极大最优的一阶遗憾界 $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{KL^\star})$，去除原对数因子；同一算法在唯一最优臂 $i^\star$ 的 i.i.d. 损失下取得最优-最坏世界保证 $\mathcal{O}(\sum_{i\ne i^\star}\log T/\Delta_i)$。
AI.conclusion: 单一免参数算法同时获得无对数间隙的最优一阶遗憾与 BOBW 界，统一并强化了多臂老虎机中一阶与最优-最坏世界遗憾的理论结果。

title: Reaction precedents extend retrosynthetic prediction beyond training coverage
summary: Reaction precedents guide retrosynthesis, but how far they can compensate for gaps in task-specific training coverage remains unclear. Using 2.71 million reactions, we restricted training and retrieval coverage by transformation or time, then expanded only the retrieval corpus with model parameters fixed. For transformations excluded from training, mean Top-1 accuracy increased from 13.0% to 58.0% on a historical test set and from 4.9% to 23.1% on a temporally held-out test set. For temporal coverage gaps, retrieval expansion enabled a model trained on records before 2017 to match or exceed a non-retrieval model trained on records before 2025 on both test sets. Without task-specific fine-tuning, precedents improved all 14 representative general-purpose models on both test sets and USPTO-50K; the strongest with precedents surpassed all eight representative specialized models. These findings show that inference-time reaction precedents can extend retrosynthetic prediction beyond task-specific training coverage without parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 该文研究推理阶段检索到的反应先例能否弥补任务特定训练覆盖的不足。实验表明，仅扩展检索语料而不更新参数，就能显著提升逆合成预测在未见反应类型和时间外推场景下的准确率。
AI.motivation: 反应先例可指导逆合成，但其能否以及在多大程度上补偿任务特定训练覆盖缺口尚不清楚，作者希望据此量化先例的作用边界。
AI.method: 基于271万条反应数据，通过按反应类型或时间限制训练与检索覆盖，固定模型参数、仅扩展检索语料，并在历史测试集、时间外推测试集及USPTO-50K上评估，同时对比14个通用模型与8个专用模型。
AI.result: 对未纳入训练的反应类型，平均Top-1准确率由13.0%升至58.0%（历史测试集），由4.9%升至23.1%（时间外推测试集）；在时间覆盖缺口下，仅用2017年前数据训练的模型经检索扩展可在两个测试集上追平或超过用2025年前数据训练的无检索模型；在无任务微调下，先例使14个通用模型全部提升，最优者超过全部8个代表性强专用模型。
AI.conclusion: 推理时引入反应先例可在不更新参数的情况下，将逆合成预测拓展到任务特定训练覆盖之外，是一种有效的覆盖缺口补偿机制。

title: CBE: A Complexity-adaptive Boundary-aware Ensemble Method for Imbalanced Data
summary: In many real-world classification tasks, datasets exhibit class imbalance, which can degrade the generalization performance of conventional learning algorithms. Data complexity has recently been recognized as a more objective indicator of learning difficulty than the imbalance ratio alone, because class overlap and complex decision boundaries often impair classifiers more severely than imbalance itself. Samples near the decision boundary are inherently difficult to classify, which has motivated many researchers to focus on such instances to improve classifier performance. However, most under-sampling approaches fail to differentiate their sampling of boundary samples across datasets of varying complexity. To overcome this limitation, we propose a complexity-adaptive boundary-aware ensemble (CBE) framework that links the sampling weight distribution to data complexity and dynamically adjusts the boundary preference of under-sampling accordingly. We also introduce an overall complexity measure that combines metrics at multiple levels and use it to divide imbalanced datasets into three categories. Extensive experiments on 24 benchmark datasets from UCI and KEEL show that the proposed method outperforms many existing methods in terms of F-measure and G-mean on Easy and Median datasets, without degrading performance on hard cases.

AI.tldr: 提出复杂度自适应的边界感知集成框架（CBE），将欠采样的采样权重分布与数据复杂度挂钩，动态调整对边界样本的偏好，以提升不平衡分类性能。
AI.motivation: 类别不平衡数据中，仅用不平衡比不足以刻画学习难度；数据复杂度（类重叠、复杂决策边界）对分类器的损害更严重，而多数欠采样方法在不同复杂度数据集上对边界样本的采样缺乏差异化处理。
AI.method: 构建复杂度自适应的边界感知集成（CBE）框架：引入融合多层级指标的整体复杂度度量，据此把不平衡数据集划分为三类；令欠采样的采样权重分布随数据复杂度变化，动态调节边界偏好，并结合集成学习。
AI.result: 在 UCI 与 KEEL 的 24 个基准数据集上实验，所提方法在 Easy 与 Median 数据集上的 F-measure 与 G-mean 优于多种现有方法，且在困难数据集上性能不下降。
AI.conclusion: 以数据复杂度驱动边界感知欠采样的自适应调节是可行且有效的，可在不牺牲困难场景性能的前提下提升不平衡分类的整体表现。

title: Distributional Reward Calibration and Budget-Neutral Credit Assignment for Multimodal RLVR
summary: We revisit advantage estimation in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and observe that any token-level advantage admits a two-stage factorization: a \emph{sample-level baselining} step that converts scalar verifier rewards into a comparable sequence-level signal, and a \emph{token-level credit assignment} step that distributes that signal over the trajectory. Existing estimators typically address only one of these stages: affine baselines preserve the shape of each task's reward law, so heavy tails and binary cliffs propagate into the gradient, while token-level credit rules tie the size of each token's update to raw confidence scales and need not conserve the total credit issued by the verifier. We propose \textbf{TACE} (Two-stage Advantage and Credit Estimation), a two-stage estimator that addresses both stages. At stage~(S1), we replace linear standardization with a one-dimensional optimal-transport map to a standard normal, which gives a common population reward law across tasks and caps finite-sample outliers deterministically. At stage~(S2), we rank-calibrate a stop-gradient evidence contrast within each trajectory and renormalize the clipped token weights to have mean one, so credit is redistributed across tokens while its total mass and sign are conserved. We prove population-level inter-task moment equity, a deterministic tail bound, and mass-conservation, boundedness, and sign-anchoring properties that affine baselines and unnormalized token weights do not satisfy. On a multimodal reasoning suite, TACE obtains the strongest results on a majority of the benchmarks but does not dominate every setting.

AI.tldr: 论文重新审视GRPO中的优势估计，指出任一token级优势可分解为"样本级基线化"与"token级信用分配"两阶段，现有估计器仅处理其一。作者提出两阶段估计器TACE：S1用一维最优传输映射到标准正态替代线性标准化，S2在轨迹内对标停梯度证据对比并重归一化裁剪权重至均值1。理论证明任务间矩公平性、确定性尾部界与质量守恒等性质，多模态推理基准上多数任务最优但并非全面占优。
AI.motivation: 现有GRPO优势估计器只覆盖两阶段因子分解中的单一阶段：仿射基线（如线性标准化）保留各任务奖励分布的形状，导致重尾与二值悬崖直接传入梯度；token级信用规则则将每个token的更新幅度绑定于原始置信度尺度，且不保证信用总量与验证器发放的总量守恒。因此需要一个同时处理样本级基线化与token级信用分配的统一估计器。
AI.method: 提出TACE两阶段估计器。阶段S1：用一维最优传输映射将标量验证器奖励映射到标准正态，取代线性标准化，从而在各任务间建立共同总体奖励分布并对有限样本离群值实现确定性截断。阶段S2：在每条轨迹内对停梯度（stop-gradient）证据对比进行秩校准，并将裁剪后的token权重重归一化为均值1，使信用在token间再分配的同时保持总质量与符号守恒。
AI.result: 理论层面证明了总体级别的任务间矩公平性、确定性尾部界，以及质量守恒、有界性和符号锚定等性质，这些是仿射基线与未归一化token权重所不具备的。实验层面，在多模态推理基准套件上，TACE在多数基准取得最强结果，但并未在所有设置中全面占优。
AI.conclusion: 将优势估计显式拆分为样本级基线与token级信用两阶段，并用最优传输与秩校准归一化分别改进，可同时获得任务间分布一致性与信用守恒等理论保证，并在多模态推理任务上带来多数领先但非普遍占优的性能提升。

title: Topology Survives Shuffling: Robust Long-Context Memory Access Prediction for Graph Analytics
summary: Graph analytics generates irregular, topology-dependent memory-access streams via indirect traversals, limiting data prefetching. Accurate prediction enables timely prefetches that hide memory latency. However, ML predictors couple short histories with fixed horizons, fitting the training trace's node layout rather than learning transferable graph patterns. We propose LoCoMAP, a long-context representation-learning framework for memory-access prediction with independently controlled observation history and prediction horizon. We evaluate Connected Components (CC), PageRank (PR), and Single-Source Shortest Paths (SSSP) on six synthetic graph families, with Erdos-Renyi (ER) and Grid as random and deterministic controls. We test two interventions: same-family regeneration changes connectivity, while node shuffling disrupts layout but preserves connectivity. Across 18 graph-workload pairs, extending history from 8 to 128 accesses improves F1 by 7.8%, while extending prediction horizon from 8 to 512 improves F1 by 88.3%. For CC, regeneration is less disruptive than shuffling: without retraining, long context retains 95.4% of original F1 and outperforms short context in six families. Under full shuffle, long context improves CC F1 by 33.6% across ER, Barabasi-Albert, Copying Model, and Stochastic Block Model (SBM), with a 2.06x gain on SBM, but not on Watts-Strogatz or Grid, where near-zero delta mass shifts into heavy tails beyond the predictor's range. Long context outperforms short context on six real-world CC graphs. At full shuffle, long-context PR retains 57.6% of original F1 and averages 11.0% above short context. Both SSSP models retain about 30% of original F1 under full shuffle as distance updates access vertex data in a new order. Within these bounds, long-context predictors are robust across related graphs and layouts without retraining, enabling a generalizable graph prefetcher.

AI.tldr: LoCoMAP：一种长上下文表示学习框架，解耦观测历史与预测跨度，用于不规则图分析访存预测
AI.motivation: 图分析因间接遍历产生不规则、依赖拓扑的访存流，难以预取。现有ML预测器将短历史与固定跨度耦合，只是拟合训练trace的节点布局，而非学习可迁移的图模式。
AI.method: 提出LoCoMAP，独立控制观测历史长度与预测跨度；在CC、PR、SSSP三 workload 与六类合成图（含ER与Grid作为随机与确定性对照）上评估，并设计两种干预实验：同族重生成（改变连通性）与节点洗牌（破坏布局、保留连通性）。
AI.result: 18个图-workload组合中，历史从8增至128使F1提升7.8%，跨度从8增至512使F1提升88.3%。CC下重生成干扰小于洗牌：不重训时长上下文保留95.4%原始F1，并在六族上优于短上下文；全洗牌下长上下文在ER、BA、Copying、SBM上F1提升33.6%（SBM上2.06倍），但在WS与Grid上无效，因近零delta质量移入预测器范围外的重尾。真实CC图上长上下文在六图均优于短上下文。全洗牌下PR保留57.6% F1、平均高于短上下文11.0%；SSSP两模型仅保留约30%。
AI.conclusion: 在此边界内，长上下文预测器无需重训即可跨相关图与布局保持鲁棒，可支撑可泛化的图预取器。

title: Neighborhood Elites: Quality-Diversity Search for Uncertainty Quantification in Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly capable, yet they produce wrong answers indistinguishable from correct ones. In question answering (QA), such an error propagates unnoticed into downstream tasks. Perturbation-based uncertainty quantification (UQ) addresses this by probing a model over a set of input rewrites and reading uncertainty from how much its predictions vary. Yet this set is usually built generically, by free paraphrasing, token-level perturbation, or adversarial search. Such rewrites leave two things uncontrolled that matter in QA: what kind of change is made to the context, and how explicitly the context supports the answer. When neither is controlled, the composition of the set is determined by the generator rather than by design, and the estimate inherits whatever that generator happens to produce. Quality-diversity (QD) search is built to cover a predefined exploration space, so we recast input perturbation as a QD problem and propose \emph{neighborhood elites (NE)}, a neighborhood constructor that spreads answer-preserving rewrites across two axes, the kind of edit and the explicitness of support. We compare NE against three other neighborhood constructors, holding the editor, QA model, uncertainty measure and search objective fixed, and against three scores read from the original context. Across five extractive-QA datasets and five instruction-tuned LLMs, NE improves failure detection against every other constructor in at least 24 of the 25 dataset-model pairs, reaching 0.726 AUROC and 0.211 AUPRC lift over the base rate. Additionally, NE detects failure better than semantic entropy computed over decoder samples, by 0.074 AUROC and 0.062 AUPRC lift, and this advantage widens as the neighborhood grows.

AI.tldr: 将输入扰动重构为质量-多样性(QD)搜索问题，提出"邻域精英(NE)"构造器，在两轴上展开保答案改写以做不确定性量化，显著提升抽取式QA的失败检测。
AI.motivation: LLM会给出与正确答案难以区分错误答案，QA中错误会无声传播到下游任务。基于扰动的UQ依赖一组输入改写来估计不确定性，但现有改写集（自由复述、词级扰动、对抗搜索）通常泛泛生成，未控制两点：对上下文所做改动的类型、以及上下文支持答案的显式程度。二者不受控时，集合构成由生成器决定而非设计决定，估计结果随之漂移。
AI.method: 把输入扰动建模为QD问题，利用QD搜索覆盖预定义探索空间的能力，提出NE构造器：将保答案改写沿"编辑类型"和"支持显式度"两轴铺开，使邻域在设计空间内均衡覆盖。实验固定编辑器、QA模型、不确定性度量与搜索目标，将NE与三种邻域构造器对比，并与从原始上下文中读取的三种得分对比。
AI.result: 在5个抽取式QA数据集与5个指令微调LLM共25个数据集-模型对上，NE在至少24/25对上优于其他所有构造器的失败检测，AUROC达0.726，AUPRC较基率提升0.211。相对解码器采样上的语义熵，NE分别提升0.074 AUROC与0.062 AUPRC，且邻域增大时优势扩大。
AI.conclusion: 对扰动邻域的结构化、可控设计（而非依赖生成器自发多样）是提升扰动式UQ的关键；NE作为QD式邻域构造器在跨数据集、跨模型上稳定优于现有构造器与语义熵。

title: Interpretable by Design Tabular Prediction via In-Context Local Linear Learning
summary: In-context learning (ICL) lets tabular foundation models make predictions without dataset-specific training or fine-tuning. These models achieve strong predictive accuracy, but interpreting how individual features contribute to the prediction remains difficult. In biology, for example, feature contributions can help identify biomarkers or risk genes. Post-hoc interpretability methods assign feature importance scores, but these scores do not indicate what the model actually uses and can lead to explanation errors. We introduce TICL$^3$ (Tabular In-Context Local Linear Learning), an interpretable-by-design predictor that uses a tabular foundation model to guide a simple linear prediction rule. TICL$^3$ first learns a shared linear model to capture dataset-level feature effects. Then, for each query, it retrieves similar training samples using representations from the foundation model and fits a second linear model to the residuals in that neighborhood. The shared model captures broad effects, while the local model corrects errors among similar samples. Their combined coefficients determine each feature contribution to the final query-specific linear score, so the same model makes and explains the prediction. Across 386 classification benchmark-dataset evaluations, TICL$^3$ trails TabICLv2 by 1.1 percentage points and outperforms CatBoost in 266 evaluations. It improves average support F1 over MAPLE by 4.7 points and achieves the best performance on both real-data selected-feature utility metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出TICL³，一种"设计即可解释"的表格预测器：用表格基础模型表示检索近邻，在数据集级共享线性模型与查询级局部线性模型之间做残差拟合，使同一模型既完成预测又给出特征贡献。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型的上下文学习(ICL)预测精度高，但难以解释单个特征对预测的贡献（如生物医学中识别生物标志物/风险基因）。事后解释方法给出的特征重要性分数并不代表模型真实使用的信息，易产生解释错误，因此需要内生可解释的架构。
AI.method: 1) 用表格基础模型学习数据集级共享线性模型，捕捉全局特征效应；2) 对每个查询，用基础模型表示检索相似训练样本，在邻域内对残差拟合第二个线性模型；3) 将共享模型与局部模型的系数相加，得到查询特定的线性评分及各特征贡献。
AI.result: 在386个分类基准-数据集评测中，较TabICLv2仅低1.1个百分点，并在266项评测中优于CatBoost；平均支持集F1比MAPLE高4.7个点；在两项真实数据的特征选择效用指标上均取得最佳表现。
AI.conclusion: 全局线性项与局部残差修正的结合在几乎不牺牲精度的前提下实现了忠实的内生可解释性，表明"局部线性+基础模型检索"是表格基础模型可解释预测的可行范式，但相对最强基线仍有约1个百分点的精度差距。

title: Multistep and Multivariate Time Series Explainability with GradientSHAP: A Wind Power Case Study
summary: As the effects of climate change become increasingly apparent, the demand for renewable energy sources such as wind power continues to grow. However, renewables' variable and intermittent nature presents significant challenges in their integration into energy grids. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a powerful tool to address these issues. Still, its adoption in the energy sector has been hindered by the opacity of many AI models, which often function as black boxes. This paper introduces a carefully adapted GradientSHAP approach to provide interpretability for multivariate, multistep wind power forecasting -- a largely underexplored area. This capability is critical for day-ahead grid management and, to the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to apply GradientSHAP in the context of wind power forecasting. To address the inherent dimensionality, we developed novel visualizations that deliver both local and global explanations, uncovering intricate relationships between environmental factors, site-specific conditions, and temporal dynamics. While GradientSHAP is not an out-of-the-box solution, our findings demonstrate that, with thoughtful handling of SHAP values and domain expertise, it can offer valuable insights into model behaviour, supporting more informed and trustworthy decision-making. Nevertheless, its complexity poses challenges for practical implementation. Future research should focus on streamlining these interpretability methods to make them more actionable for routine deployment in critical energy applications.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将改进的GradientSHAP方法用于多变量、多步风电功率预测的可解释性分析，并提出新的可视化方式同时给出局部与全局解释，揭示环境因素、站点条件与时间动态之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 风电等可再生能源具有波动性和间歇性，给电网集成带来挑战；AI虽能应对，但其"黑箱"特性阻碍了在能源领域的应用，而风电功率预测的可解释性研究仍很缺乏。
AI.method: 对GradientSHAP进行针对性适配，用于多变量、多步风电功率预测；针对高维问题设计新颖可视化，提供局部与全局解释。
AI.result: GradientSHAP并非开箱即用方案，但在合理处理SHAP值并结合领域知识的情况下，能揭示模型行为的有价值洞见，支持更可信的决策；同时其复杂性给实际落地带来挑战。
AI.conclusion: GradientSHAP在风电预测可解释性方面具有价值，但复杂度高，未来研究应简化此类方法以提升在关键能源应用中的可部署性。

title: Last-Iterate Convergence for Constrained MDPs: From Dual Descent to Primal-Dual
summary: We study policy optimization for infinite-horizon, discounted constrained Markov decision processes. While primal-dual ($\texttt{PD}$) methods are widely used in practice, their theoretical guarantees typically hold for an impractical mixture policy. In contrast, dual descent ($\texttt{DD}$) methods output a single policy ("last iterate") with guarantees on its performance. However, such methods require iteratively solving entropy-regularized MDPs in an inner-loop, limiting their practical effectiveness. Moreover, existing analyses rely on strong coverage assumptions that are difficult to satisfy in practice. Consequently, we first provide a new analysis of $\texttt{DD}$ methods that does not require coverage assumptions. We then employ entropy-regularized natural policy gradient and dual regularization to eliminate the inner loop, resulting in an efficient $\texttt{PD}$ algorithm. We develop a novel tracking analysis which shows that, compared to existing methods, the proposed algorithm achieves improved last-iterate convergence guarantees. Furthermore, our theoretical framework allows us to analyze a truncated bilevel method that interpolates between $\texttt{DD}$ and $\texttt{PD}$ methods. Finally, we generalize our analysis to handle linear function approximation. Compared to prior last-iterate methods, we prove stronger guarantees under less restrictive assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无限时域折扣约束MDP的策略优化，提出了无需覆盖假设的DD方法新分析，并通过熵正则化自然策略梯度与对偶正则化消除内循环，给出改进last-iterate收敛保证的高效PD算法，并推广至线性函数逼近。
AI.motivation: 实践中广泛使用的primal-dual（PD）方法理论保证仅适用于不实用的混合策略；dual descent（DD）方法虽输出单一last-iterate策略且有保证，但需在内循环迭代求解熵正则MDP，实用性受限，且现有分析依赖难以满足的强覆盖假设。
AI.method: 首先给出不依赖覆盖假设的DD方法新分析；随后采用熵正则化自然策略梯度与对偶正则化消除内循环，构造高效PD算法；开发新颖的tracking分析；并利用该理论框架分析介于DD与PD之间的截断bilevel方法；最后将分析推广至线性函数逼近。
AI.result: 提出算法相较现有方法获得改进的last-iterate收敛保证；理论框架可分析截断bilevel方法；在线性函数逼近下，相比先前last-iterate方法，在更弱假设下证明了更强保证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作统一了DD与PD方法的理论分析，在更少限制性假设下为单策略（last-iterate）输出提供了更强收敛保证，并支持线性函数逼近，提升了约束MDP策略优化的理论严谨性与实用性。

title: Beyond Selected Breakthroughs: Evaluating Language Models on Randomly Sampled Mathematical Conjectures
summary: The last year has seen a shift in AI-assisted mathematics, with frontier language models producing proofs of and counterexamples to long-standing open conjectures. However, studying only the current set of major breakthroughs provides an incomplete picture of LLM capabilities and the computational resources needed to achieve reported results. To address this, we introduce a new dataset, OpenConjecture, which collects conjectures from mathematics papers published on the arXiv since February 2026. We use these conjectures as a source of open mathematical problems, and apply frontier GPT models to a random sample of 200 of these conjectures over three passes using a reproducible protocol without problem-specific mathematical guidance. Rather than attempt expert verification of these candidate solutions, we analyze the types of problems for which LLMs produce solutions and the characteristics of these solutions. The models we test produce candidate solutions for roughly 60% of the conjectures, with counterexamples about 1.3 times more common than proofs. We estimate solution novelty, assess how solutions cite and relate to existing literature, and analyze whether the proposed resolution relies on either an error in or underspecification of the conjecture. We find that models sometimes propose resolutions that are outside the authors' intent (e.g., proposing the trivial group as a counterexample) and that a number of proofs follow closely from existing results, but that some resolutions exhibit at least moderate novelty. Our findings underscore the need for evaluations that go beyond correctness to assess fidelity to the intended statement, attribution, and the nature of the mathematical contribution.

AI.tldr: 提出 OpenConjecture 数据集（收录 2026 年 2 月以来 arXiv 论文中的猜想），用前沿 GPT 模型在无可复现偏差的协议下对 200 个随机猜想做三遍求解，结果显示约 60% 得到候选解，反例约为证明的 1.3 倍，且需超越"正确性"评估陈述忠实度、归因与数学贡献性质。
AI.motivation: 仅关注少数重大突破无法全面反映 LLM 的数学能力及达成结果所需算力，需要以大规模、新近的开放猜想为样本进行系统评估。
AI.method: 构建 OpenConjecture 数据集（来源为 2026 年 2 月起 arXiv 论文中的猜想）；随机抽取 200 个猜想，用前沿 GPT 模型在三轮重复下按可复现协议求解，不提供问题特定数学提示；不做专家级正确性验证，而是分析可解问题的类型与解的特征，包括新颖性估计、与文献的引用与关联、以及解是否依赖猜想本身的错误或表述不充分。
AI.result: 约 60% 的猜想获得候选解；反例数量约为证明的 1.3 倍；部分解偏离作者原意（如以平凡群作反例），部分证明直接可由已有结果推出，但也有一些解具有至少中等程度的新颖性。
AI.conclusion: LLM 在开放猜想上产出率高但质量异质；评估需超越正确性，纳入对原陈述意图的忠实度、文献归因及数学贡献性质的考察。

title: Explainable and Adaptive Machine Learning for Fraud Risk Detection in Bangladesh's Digital Banking Ecosystem
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Presented at the 11th Annual Banking Conference 2026, Bangladesh Institute of Bank Management (BIBM), Dhaka, Bangladesh, 28 October 2026
summary: The rapid expansion of digital banking and mobile financial services creates growing challenges for fraud detection, particularly under severe class imbalance and operational constraints. This study presents an explainable and adaptive machine-learning framework integrating chronological evaluation, leakage-conscious feature engineering, probability calibration, SHAP-based explainability, and adaptive risk prioritization. Experiments use the synthetic PaySim mobile-money benchmark and compare Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM. XGBoost achieved the strongest fixed-threshold performance, with PR-AUC of 0.5658, ROC-AUC of 0.9068, and F1-score of 0.5369. Platt calibration reduced the test Brier score from 0.1141 to 0.0245, improving probability reliability. SHAP analysis identified temporal, destination-account, transaction-type, and amount features as important model drivers. An adaptive top-1% policy reduced false positives from 192 to 117, but recall declined from 0.4236 to 0.2122, demonstrating a clear alert-capacity trade-off. The results provide a reproducible methodological framework rather than evidence of deployment performance in Bangladesh, since PaySim is synthetic. Validation using governed real-world financial data is therefore an important direction for future research.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可解释、自适应的机器学习框架用于移动金融欺诈检测，在合成数据PaySim上对比四种模型，XGBoost固定阈值性能最佳（PR-AUC 0.5658），Platt校准将Brier分数从0.1141降至0.0245，SHAP揭示时序、收款账户、交易类型与金额为关键特征，top-1%自适应策略将误报从192降至117但召回由0.4236降至0.2122，体现告警容量权衡。
AI.motivation: 数字银行与移动金融服务快速扩张，欺诈检测面临严重类别不平衡与运营约束的双重挑战；同时模型需具备可解释性与概率可靠性，并需在有限告警容量下实现风险排序，故构建兼顾可解释性与自适应的完整方法框架。
AI.method: 整合时序化评估、防泄漏特征工程、概率校准（Platt）、基于SHAP的可解释性分析与自适应风险优先级策略；在合成PaySim移动支付基准上对比Logistic Regression、Random Forest、XGBoost与LightGBM。
AI.result: XGBoost固定阈值表现最优：PR-AUC 0.5658、ROC-AUC 0.9068、F1 0.5369；Platt校准使测试Brier分数由0.1141降至0.0245；SHAP显示时序、收款账户、交易类型与金额为重要驱动特征；top-1%自适应策略将误报从192降至117，但召回从0.4236降至0.2122。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供的是可复现的方法学框架，而非实际部署性能证据（因PaySim为合成数据）；基于受治理的真实金融数据进行验证是未来重要方向，并需明确告警容量与召回之间的权衡决策。

title: Retrieving from Your Own Mistakes: On-Policy Training of Embedding Models for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Complex questions in retrieval-augmented generation require evidence spread over several documents, and an answer is reliable only when the retriever finds all of it. Chain embedding retrievers collect such evidence step by step, re-encoding the question together with the passages retrieved so far, and we find that they are already strong: trained only on gold histories, a small chain embedding retriever that calls no language model outperforms graph-based systems and is competitive with a search agent. This training, however, leaves a gap. At test time the retriever conditions on its own retrievals, which soon contain mistakes: by the third step, about half or more of the states it visits hold a wrong passage, and these passages lower its chance of retrieving a missing gold passage well beyond what the difficulty of the states explains. We propose on-policy state training, which trains the encoder on the states it reaches itself. At every epoch the current encoder retrieves chains for the training questions; each state it visits, including those built on its own mistakes, is labeled with the earliest gold passage still missing while the other missing gold passages are masked, so that no correct continuation is penalized; and the encoder is updated contrastively on these states mixed with teacher-forced ones, so that its training distribution follows it as it learns. The resulting retriever retrieves complete evidence more often than teacher-forced training and the systems we compare, and it transfers without further training to harder long-chain variants of HotpotQA and 2WikiMultiHopQA that we construct. On the same states, it recovers from its own mistakes far more often, and controlled comparisons attribute the gain to training on the states the encoder currently reaches.

AI.tldr: 提出on-policy state training：在编码器自身到达的状态（含自错误状态）上用"最早缺失金标段落"打标签做对比学习，与teacher-forced状态混合训练，使链式嵌入检索器在复杂多文档问答中更常检索到完整证据，并可零样本迁移到更难的long-chain变体。
AI.motivation: 复杂问答需跨多文档的证据，只有检索到全部证据答案才可靠。链式嵌入检索器逐步检索，但仅在gold histories上训练，测试时条件于自身检索结果，到第三步约一半以上状态含错误段落，这些错误段落显著降低检索缺失金标段落的能力，形成训练-测试分布不匹配。
AI.method: On-policy state training：每个epoch用当前编码器为训练问题检索链；对访问到的每个状态（包括基于自身错误构建的状态），用"最早仍缺失的金标段落"作标签，同时屏蔽其他缺失金标段落以避免惩罚正确续接；在这些状态与teacher-forced状态的混合集上做对比学习更新编码器，使训练分布随学习进程同步移动。
AI.result: 相比teacher-forced训练及对照系统，更常检索到完整证据；无需额外训练即可迁移到作者构建的HotpotQA与2WikiMultiHopQA更难long-chain变体；在相同状态上更常从自身错误中恢复；受控对比实验将增益归因于在当前到达状态上的训练。
AI.conclusion: 训练分布与推理时自条件分布的对齐（on-policy状态训练）是提升链式嵌入检索器完整证据检索与错误恢复能力的关键，且具良好迁移性。

title: LatentWeave: Test-Time Latent Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in test-time optimization have shown that the multimodal reasoning performance of large multimodal language models (MLLMs) can be improved during inference without modifying backbone model parameters. However, existing approaches primarily operate at the prompt or output level, leaving the latent reasoning process largely uncontrolled and insufficient to prevent error accumulation during autoregressive generation. To address this limitation, we propose LatentWeave, a test-time framework that treats multimodal reasoning as a controllable latent trajectory. LatentWeave performs structured Latent Weaving, progressively refining intermediate hidden states segment-wise to correct emerging deviations, and further introduces Reasoning Anchors via lightweight WEAVE tokens to stabilize reasoning structure and guide answer-oriented generation. These mechanisms are designed to enable fine-grained, step-aware intervention in the latent reasoning process while keeping the main MLLM backbone parameters fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks report improvements over the evaluated baselines; the contribution of latent optimization, anchor training, and additional test-time computation is analyzed separately in the ablation and efficiency studies. Our code is available at https://github.com/jins7/LatentWeave.

AI.tldr: LatentWeave 是一个测试时框架，将多模态推理视为可控的隐轨迹，通过分段的 Latent Weaving 与基于 WEAVE token 的 Reasoning Anchors 在冻结主干参数下实现对隐推理过程的细粒度干预。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 测试时优化方法主要作用于提示或输出层面，隐推理过程缺乏控制，难以抑制自回归生成中的误差累积。
AI.method: 提出 LatentWeave：1) 结构化 Latent Weaving，分段逐步精炼中间隐状态以纠正出现的偏差；2) 引入轻量级 WEAVE token 作为 Reasoning Anchors，稳定推理结构并引导面向答案的生成；主干 MLLM 参数保持冻结。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上较评测基线取得提升；消融与效率研究分别分析了隐优化、锚点训练及额外测试时计算的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将多模态推理建模为可控隐轨迹并在隐空间进行测试时干预，是实现细粒度、步感知推理控制的有效途径。

title: Prefix Executability: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents Beyond Final Success
summary: Tool-use benchmarks often score agents by final task success, but terminal outcomes can obscure whether the intermediate tool-call trajectory was executable. We propose prefix executability as a trajectory-level evaluation protocol for tool-using agents. The protocol measures whether every prefix of a predicted tool-call sequence remains executable under tool schemas, state preconditions, and data dependencies, and summarizes reliability using Prefix Executability Curves (PEC), First-Error Depth (FED), Trajectory Executability Rate (TER), horizon-normalized AUC-PEC, and Recovery Rate (RR). We instantiate the protocol on stratified samples from BFCL-v3 multi-turn and ToolSandbox, and on the complete Airline/Retail base splits of $τ^3$-bench. We observe that outcome-only and prefix-level rankings diverge: agents whose execution is conditioned on an unverified plan often achieve higher point-estimate final success than non-plan-conditioned baselines while substantially lowering TER and AUC-PEC. These divergences are precisely the failure modes that prefix executability is designed to expose: they reveal whether apparent success rests on an executable trajectory, where invalidity first enters, and whether success follows recovery from an earlier failure. As a validation intervention, explicit pre-execution plan checking can improve executable-prefix survival while maintaining competitive terminal success. These results show that final success alone is insufficient for evaluating tool-use agents and that prefix-level executability provides an actionable reliability signal for comparing agents, diagnosing failures, and assessing validation mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 提出前缀可执行性（prefix executability）作为工具使用智能体的轨迹级评估协议，用 PEC、FED、TER、horizon-normalized AUC-PEC 和 RR 五个指标刻画可靠性；实验表明仅看最终成功率与前缀级排名会不一致，显式执行前计划校验可提升可执行前缀存活率并保持有竞争力的最终成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用基准多以最终任务成功与否打分，但终端结果会掩盖中间工具调用轨迹是否真正可执行，导致无法判断成功是否建立在可执行轨迹之上、无效性从何处首次出现、以及成功是否来自失败后的恢复。
AI.method: 提出前缀可执行性协议：检查预测工具调用序列的每个前缀在工具模式（schema）、状态前置条件和数据依赖下是否仍可执行；用 Prefix Executability Curves（PEC）、First-Error Depth（FED）、Trajectory Executability Rate（TER）、horizon-normalized AUC-PEC、Recovery Rate（RR）汇总可靠性。在 BFCL-v3 多轮与 ToolSandbox 的分层样本、以及 τ³-bench 完整的 Airline/Retail base 划分上实例化；并以显式执行前计划校验作为验证性干预。
AI.result: 仅看结果与看前缀级的排名出现分歧：将执行条件置于未经验证计划之上的智能体，其最终成功点估计常高于非计划条件基线，但 TER 与 AUC-PEC 显著下降；显式执行前计划校验可提升可执行前缀存活率，同时终端成功率保持有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 最终成功单独不足以评估工具使用智能体；前缀级可执行性提供了可操作的可靠性信号，可用于智能体比较、失败诊断与验证机制评估。

title: Improving the Intrinsic Interpretability of Differentiable Decision Trees through Euclidean Feature-Concentration Regularisation
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Based on the author's MSc dissertation, University of Birmingham
summary: Differentiable decision trees (DDTs) support end-to-end optimisation and explicit decision paths, but dense oblique splits can obscure the role of individual input features. We propose the Euclidean-Concentrated Differentiable Decision Tree (EU-DDT), which regularises the relative absolute feature weights at each internal node using their normalised squared Euclidean distance from the uniform distribution. This encourages dominance by a small number of features while retaining probabilistic soft routing. Across five matched random seeds, EU-DDT reduces the mean effective number of features from 8.94 to 1.54 on Wine and from 45.28 to 9.06 on Digits. Mean test accuracy changes from 100.0% to 93.9% on Wine and from 92.3% to 94.6% on Digits, illustrating the dataset-dependent trade-off between concentration and predictive performance. We also use EU-DDT to parameterise a PPO actor with an MLP critic. Two random-seed runs per environment show a consistent qualitative increase in concentration while preserving effective task performance. In representative CartPole-v1 and MiniPacman runs, EU-DDT reaches 100% final evaluation success, while mean node concentration increases from 0.1272 to 0.7179 and from 0.0437 to 0.7237, respectively. These results support EU regularisation as a mechanism for reducing node-level feature complexity; the reinforcement-learning evidence remains preliminary because only two seeds are evaluated.

AI.tldr: 提出EU-DDT：用特征权重的归一化平方欧氏距离对内部节点施加正则，使少数特征占主导，在分类与PPO控制任务中显著降低有效特征数并基本保持性能。
AI.motivation: 可微决策树支持端到端优化与显式决策路径，但稠密斜向分裂使单个输入特征的作用难以解释，因此需要一种促使节点聚焦少数特征的正则化机制。
AI.method: 对每个内部节点的相对绝对特征权重，计算其与均匀分布的归一化平方欧氏距离作为正则项（EU正则），鼓励少数特征主导，同时保留概率软路由结构；并将其用于参数化PPO的actor（critic为MLP）。
AI.result: 五个匹配随机种子下，平均有效特征数由8.94降至1.54（Wine）、45.28降至9.06（Digits）；平均测试准确率Wine由100.0%变93.9%，Digits由92.3%升至94.6%。RL中两环境各两次运行：CartPole-v1与MiniPacman最终评估成功率均达100%，平均节点集中度分别由0.1272升至0.7179、由0.0437升至0.7237。
AI.conclusion: EU正则可作为降低节点级特征复杂度的有效机制，且集中度与预测性能之间存在依赖数据集的权衡；强化学习证据仅基于两个种子，属初步结论。

title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
comment: 76 pages, 8 figures, 15 tables (27 pages main text, 7 main figures, 2 main tables)
summary: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.

AI.tldr: 在多轮强化学习仿真环境中训练的语言模型能显著提升结构化精神科接诊访谈（病史采集、鉴别诊断、初始管理规划）表现，并在精神科医师角色扮演的随机双盲交叉研究中验证；但对急性安全风险的漏判仍有残留缺口，需要临床监督。
AI.motivation: 临床接诊访谈是精神科主要诊断工具，要求临床医生建立良好关系并厘清复杂重叠的表现；作者希望检验多轮强化学习（RL）仿真训练能否提升语言模型在结构化文本精神科接诊中的能力，并为对话式智能体提供可控制、可压力测试的训练与评估平台。
AI.method: 在仿真环境中进行多轮强化学习训练；采用随机、双盲、交叉设计（N=60对匹配情景，共120次接诊），由32名委员会认证精神科医师扮演标准化患者，另由15名独立委员会认证精神科医师对去标识化转录文本评分；使用改编的临床检查量表、以患者为中心的沟通指标、鉴别诊断适当性评分；并基于两个Delphi共识分类体系（临床安全风险、关系胜任力）构建256个对抗性挑战情景，评估漏判急性安全风险的情况。
AI.result: 训练后智能体在76.7%的匹配情景对中优于基线模型（p<0.0001）：临床检查量表效应量d_z=0.77（p<0.0001）；以患者为中心沟通82.0% vs. 65.2%（p<0.001）；鉴别诊断适当性68.3% vs. 33.3%（p<0.001）。在127个经精神科医师验证的仿真接诊情景中，临床量表得分近乎翻倍（0.706 vs. 0.379），综合奖励0.564 vs. 0.294（p<0.0001）。急性安全风险漏判率由30.5%降至12.9%（p<0.0001）。
AI.conclusion: 仿真环境可作为训练与压力测试精神科对话智能体的受控试验床，其收益可迁移至真实精神科医师扮演的接诊情境；但仍存在残余差距，需配套安全防护措施与临床医师监督。

title: A New AFIB Detection Method with Deep Neural Networks
summary: Early detection of atrial fibrillation (AFIB), characterized by irregular heart rhythms, can potentially save thousands of lives annually [20]. Numerous studies have attempted to address this challenge using various algorithms and methodologies. This paper introduces a novel and robust method that enhances the precision of AFIB detection. Neural Networks (NN) are widely recognized for their ability to identify complex electrocardiogram (ECG) patterns, facilitating the accurate detection of irregular heart rhythms. This study explores multiple conventional machine learning algorithms alongside neural network approaches to develop a robust AFIB detection system. To evaluate the effective- ness and robustness of the proposed method, the MIT BIH arrhythmia database (MITDB) and the Long-term Atrial Fibrillation Database (LTAFDB), both available on the Physionet site. Our approach presents a novel feature engineering technique, employing specific features such as a time series of the differences in successive heart rates (dBPM) rather than traditional inter-beat intervals. The model analyzes inputs labeled into five distinct classes, using only clean intervals identified through a new labeling method for training while treating others as outliers. This strategy ensures a more accurate and reliable AFIB detection process. The best-performing model, a Deep Neural Network (DNN), achieved an F1 score of 95.18% for binary atrial fibrillation classification on a benchmark dataset distinct from the training set. Models trained using our approach have demonstrated superior performance than previously published models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于逐拍心率差值时序（dBPM）等新特征工程与五类标签/离群点清洗策略的深度神经网络AFIB检测方法，在MITDB与LTAFDB数据集上取得二分类F1 95.18%。
AI.motivation: 房颤（AFIB）以心律不规则为特征，早期检测每年可挽救大量生命，但现有算法普遍沿用传统的搏动间期特征，精度与鲁棒性仍有提升空间，需要更可靠的检测方案。
AI.method: 在MITDB与LTAFDB两个PhysioNet数据库上，对比多种传统机器学习算法与神经网络方法。核心创新为特征工程：不采用传统inter-beat interval，而使用相邻心率差值的时间序列（dBPM）；输入被标注为五个类别，仅用新标注方法筛出的干净区间参与训练，其余作为离群点剔除。最优模型为深度神经网络（DNN）。
AI.result: 最佳DNN模型在与训练集独立的基准数据集上，二分类房颤识别F1达95.18%，性能优于已有文献模型；多算法对比验证了所提特征的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 基于dBPM特征、五类标注与干净区间筛选的DNN方案显著提升了AFIB检测精度与鲁棒性，可为早期房颤筛查提供更可靠的技术路径。

title: FIRME: Registry-Anchored Memory Graphs for Evolving, Heterogeneous Investor Knowledge
comment: 20 pages. Accepted at the 3rd Workshop on LLMs and Generative AI for Finance (AI4F) at ACM ICAIF 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Financial AI workflows that reuse investor knowledge need persistent memory that integrates observations across sources and periods without losing identity or provenance. In a knowledge graph, recurring observations may use different surface forms, fragmenting relationship histories and preventing evidence from accumulating. We introduce Fusion and Identity Registry for Memory Evolution (FIRME), a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles incoming observations to persistent canonical relationships and retains their source, time, and context. Within periods, rule-based fusion links investor-call discussions to portfolio cash-flow signals, directly or through a fixed product-topic ontology. Across periods, canonical identities and persistent aliases direct recurring observations to the same relationship history; deterministic updates summarize reinforcement, inactivity, and reactivation. We evaluate FIRME on proprietary investor-call and cash-flow records and on S&P 500 earnings-call transcripts.
